planet_in_house/jupiter/1.summary: Jupiter in the lagna is classically one of the best placements: a dignified, learned, long-lived and fortunate person, with directional strength and protective power over the whole chart.
common_outcomes: Handsome or dignified appearance (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.50; Jataka Parijata 8.58)
Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.50; Jataka Parijata 8.58)
Learned (Brihat Jataka 20.7; Saravali 30.50; Bhrigu Sutras 1-6)
Optimistic, jovial, magnetic personality (Raman); wise and ethical (PanchangBodh)
rare_outcomes: Fearless, blessed with children (Phaladeepika 8.14)
Acts only after weighing consequences (Saravali 30.50)
Spends on pilgrimages (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
A 'Maharaja yoga' effect around the 16th year when exalted (Bhrigu Sutras 1-6); text detail only

by_area.personality: Magnetic, optimistic, jovial, pleasant manners (Raman); energetic, courageous and great (Saravali 30.50); wisdom and ethics (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Lawyers, professors, writers, theologians; an influential leader (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.58); fortunate (Phaladeepika 8.14).
by_area.health: Gluttony and corpulence can affect health (Raman); weight gain (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Its 7th aspect supports marriage (Bhrigu Sutras commentary).
by_area.family: Happiness from children (Phaladeepika 8.14); more sons if the 5th is unafflicted (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Learned in shastras and Vedas (Bhrigu Sutras 1-6); 'blessed with the grace of God' (Bhrigu Sutras commentary).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Directional strength in the 1st (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
A strong Jupiter in a kendra wards off arishtas affecting the child (Jataka Parijata and Jataka Desamarga, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary; via summary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
With Rahu, sins committed (Raman)
Debilitated or in an enemy or malefic sign: unstable mind, vanity, ingratitude, fewer children (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6)
planet_in_house/jupiter/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: very good for Sagittarius lagna (lagna and 4th lord), Pisces lagna (lagna and 10th lord) and Cancer lagna (exalted 9th lord). PanchangBodh: for Gemini and Virgo lagnas it carries kendradhipati dosha.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.58 (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. I)

source_views.view: In own sign a good speaker, versed in shastras, with children, long life; exalted, all fully realised; debilitated or afflicted, unstable, vain, ungrateful; commentator: ideal position with digbala and aspects on 5, 7, 9; Hamsa Yoga.

planet_in_house/jupiter/1.disagreements: Broad agreement on a benefic result. Bhrigu Sutras makes the good results conditional on dignity (full only in own or exaltation sign) and gives a harsh list when debilitated or afflicted; other classics give unconditional praise.
planet_in_house/jupiter/1.phrasing_guidance: Lead with wisdom, optimism and a protective, ethical presence. Mention weight or indulgence lightly as a lifestyle point, not a health prediction; treat long life as traditional praise.

planet_in_house/jupiter/2.summary: Jupiter in the 2nd is read as eloquence, good food and wealth by most texts; Chamatkar Chintamani is the main dissenter, saying wealth is hard to accumulate.
common_outcomes: Eloquent or sweet-tongued (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.51; Brihat Jataka 20.7; Jataka Parijata 8.63)
Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.51; Jataka Parijata 8.63; Bhrigu Sutras 7-12)
Good food and comfortable meals (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.51; Jataka Parijata 8.63)
Good-looking face and body (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.51)
rare_outcomes: What he foretells comes true (Bhrigu Sutras 7-12)
Poet, writer, astrologer or scientist (Raman)
Earns with difficulty and cannot accumulate (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Charitable (Saravali 30.51); liberal in gifts (Jataka Parijata 8.63); measured, truthful speech (PanchangBodh); does not quarrel (Raman).
by_area.career: Teaching, advising, finance, law, religious or ceremonial work (PanchangBodh); writer, poet, astrologer, scientist (Raman).
by_area.finance: Vast wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.63); steady accumulation rather than sudden gains; generosity can outrun income (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Overeating rich food is a caution (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Good wife (Raman).
by_area.family: Good family surroundings (Raman); family traditions respected (PanchangBodh).
by_area.spirituality: Learned (Phaladeepika 8.14); ceremonial or religious work (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Own sign or exaltation: very prosperous (Bhrigu Sutras 7-12)
Exalted in Cancer: a voice of natural authority (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
With a malefic: obstacles in education and dishonest or coarse speech (Bhrigu Sutras 10-11)
Debilitated and with a malefic: dissipation and harm to family (Bhrigu Sutras 12); family wealth takes more effort (PanchangBodh)
planet_in_house/jupiter/2.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: powerful Dhana yogas for Scorpio lagna (2nd and 5th lord in own sign), Aquarius lagna (2nd and 11th lord) and Gemini lagna (exalted 7th and 10th lord); also good for Virgo lagna.

source_views.view: Rich, intelligent, predictions come true; own/exalted very wealthy; with malefics obstacles to education and bad speech; commentator: agrees with Phaladeepika and Saravali and confirms it in practice.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, Vol. I ch. V 'Planets in the Second House' p.55

source_views.view: Measured truthful speech; teaching, advising, finance, law; steady savings; overeating and over-generosity cautions; aspects 6, 8, 10.

planet_in_house/jupiter/2.disagreements: Chamatkar Chintamani (via summary) says the person can never accumulate wealth; the Bhrigu Sutras commentator suspects the 'karako bhava nashaya' idea behind this and sides with Phaladeepika, Saravali and Bhrigu Sutras. Brihat Jataka mentions only eloquence, not wealth.
planet_in_house/jupiter/2.phrasing_guidance: Speak of wise, trustworthy speech and steady, values-led finances. Don't promise riches; mention generosity and rich food as things to balance.

planet_in_house/jupiter/3.summary: Jupiter in the 3rd is one of its weaker classical placements: stinginess is the common thread, with humiliation or sinfulness in Phaladeepika and Saravali; Raman and PanchangBodh are milder, reading a thoughtful counsellor who is less suited to bold action.
common_outcomes: Stingy or miserly (Phaladeepika 8.14; Brihat Jataka 20.7; Bhrigu Sutras 13-18; Raman)
Many or notable siblings (Phaladeepika 8.14; Bhrigu Sutras 13-18; Raman)
Humiliated or disrespected (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.52)
Optimistic, philosophical mind (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Dominated by the wife (Saravali 30.52; Jataka Parijata 8.66)
Ever successful despite the faults (Saravali 30.52)
Travel around the 38th year (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18); text detail only
Fortunate yet unable to earn as much as he hopes (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Malicious, sinful (Phaladeepika 8.14); clever and determined (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18); optimistic but conventional, misses opportunities (Raman); a counsellor more than a fighter, may hesitate (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Writers, editors, teachers, publishers (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Indigent (Jataka Parijata 8.66); poor if the 3rd lord is afflicted (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18).
by_area.health: Digestive weakness (Saravali 30.52); body heated, ill health (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Few friends (Raman); friend to nobody (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).
by_area.family: A brother of high standing (Phaladeepika 8.14); strong 3rd lord gives long-lived brothers (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18); sibling relations ethical but sometimes distant (PanchangBodh).
by_area.spirituality: Faith grows through personal experience (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Strong 3rd lord: long-lived brothers (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18)
Upachaya house: improves with effort and age (PanchangBodh)
Its aspects on the 7th, 9th and 11th support marriage, fortune and gains (Bhrigu Sutras commentary; PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
3rd lord with a malefic: loss of brothers, impatience, poverty (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18)
Afflicted: ingratitude (Raman)

source_views.view: Miserly, many brothers, clever, determined, forsakes relations; strong 3rd lord helps brothers; commentator: all agree on miserliness but other evils apply only to an afflicted Jupiter.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted under 'Other Views' in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via summary)
source_views.view: Happiness from brothers but ungrateful and friendless; fortunate yet earns less than he wants.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, Vol. I ch. VI 'Planets in the Third House' p.75

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, 'Jupiter in houses' (modern practitioner site)

planet_in_house/jupiter/3.disagreements: Phaladeepika 8.14, Saravali 30.52 and Jataka Parijata 8.66 are negative (sinful, humiliated, henpecked); Brihat Jataka says only stingy; Raman calls it 'also a good position' while listing faults; PanchangBodh and the Bhrigu Sutras commentator treat the negatives as applying only under affliction. Saravali alone adds 'ever successful'.
planet_in_house/jupiter/3.phrasing_guidance: Present as a reflective, principled person who may be cautious with money and slow to push. Avoid moral labels like 'sinful' or 'vile'.

planet_in_house/jupiter/4.summary: Jupiter in the 4th is consistently read as happiness at home: family, mother, friends, property, conveyances and contentment, often with learning and religious leaning.
common_outcomes: Happy (Brihat Jataka 20.7; Phaladeepika 8.14; Bhrigu Sutras 19-23; Raman)
Happiness with mother, friends, spouse, children, attendants (Phaladeepika 8.14)
Relatives, conveyances, wealth, comforts (Saravali 30.53; Jataka Parijata 8.69)
Land and property (Bhrigu Sutras 19-23; PanchangBodh)
rare_outcomes: Crafty disposition (Jataka Parijata 8.69)
Enemies act like servants, yet not contented (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Gajakesari Yoga if joined by the Moon (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)

by_area.personality: Wise, of good conduct, highly intelligent (Bhrigu Sutras 19-23); philosophically inclined, learned (Raman); eloquent (Jataka Parijata 8.69); comfort can breed complacency (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Favour of the ruling class (Raman); gains in property and vehicles (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealth, grain, conveyances (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.53); landlord (Bhrigu Sutras 19-23).
by_area.relationships: A source of misery to enemies (Saravali 30.53); terror to enemies (Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness with mother and family (Phaladeepika 8.14); respected mother (PanchangBodh); peaceful domestic life (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Religious inclination and great spiritual advancement (Raman); home as a place of learning or worship (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Strong 4th lord, or Venus or Moon association, or benefic vargas: many lands and a spacious house (Bhrigu Sutras 20)
With the Moon: Gajakesari Yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Well fortified: prosperity in all 4th-house matters and a peaceful home (Raman)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
Aspected or joined by a malefic: no land or conveyance, living in others' houses, bitterness with relatives (Bhrigu Sutras 21-23)
Afflicted: hardships and obstacles (Raman)
planet_in_house/jupiter/4.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Virgo lagna (4th and 7th lord in own sign), Sagittarius lagna (lagna and 4th lord) and Aries lagna (exalted 9th lord) give better results.

planet_in_house/jupiter/4.disagreements: Little classical disagreement. Jataka Parijata 8.69 adds 'crafty' and Chamatkar Chintamani 'not contented'; VedicFeed alone suggests strain with the mother.
planet_in_house/jupiter/4.phrasing_guidance: Speak of a peaceful, values-centred home and inner contentment. Property and vehicles can be mentioned as traditional indications, not promises.

planet_in_house/jupiter/5.summary: Jupiter in the 5th gives intelligence and good counsel in every text; on children the texts split sharply, Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata seeing few or distress, Saravali and Bhrigu Sutras many.
common_outcomes: Intelligent (Brihat Jataka 20.7; Phaladeepika 8.15; Bhrigu Sutras 24-31; Raman)
Adviser or minister to rulers (Phaladeepika 8.15; Raman)
Clever in counsel, virtuous (Jataka Parijata 8.73)
Learned, happy, wealthy (Saravali 30.54)
rare_outcomes: Distress through children (Phaladeepika 8.15); few sons (Jataka Parijata 8.73)
Many sons and friends (Saravali 30.54); many prosperous children (Bhrigu Sutras 24-31)
A responsible post early in life, around the 18th year (Bhrigu Sutras 24, as read by its commentator)
Wealth through children (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Courageous and always happy (Saravali 30.54); good conversationalist, feeds others (Bhrigu Sutras 24-31); discriminating, decorous manners (Raman).
by_area.career: Adviser to rulers (Phaladeepika 8.15); logic, law, preceptor (Raman); orator and imaginative writer (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).
by_area.finance: Choice riches (Jataka Parijata 8.73); weak 5th lord can bring fines or losses through government (Bhrigu Sutras 26-29 as interpreted by the commentator).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Saravali 30.54); good friends and vehicles (Raman).
by_area.family: Children: few or a source of distress (Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata) versus many and prosperous (Saravali, Bhrigu Sutras, Raman); PanchangBodh says never judge timing or number of children from this alone.
by_area.spirituality: Mantra, past merit, god-fearing (Raman; PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Benefic aspect on Jupiter protects children even with Rahu/Ketu (Bhrigu Sutras 31)
Strengthened Jupiter: a smooth life (Raman)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
Weak 5th lord (malefic, enemy or debilitated sign): loss of children or only one (Bhrigu Sutras 26-29 as interpreted)
With Rahu or Ketu: harm to children unless a benefic aspects (Bhrigu Sutras 30-31)
'Karako bhava nashaya' (significator in its own house harms it) is invoked here by some; PanchangBodh calls it debated
planet_in_house/jupiter/5.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Leo lagna (5th lord in own sign), Scorpio lagna (2nd and 5th lord) and Pisces lagna (exalted lagna and 10th lord) are very beneficial.

planet_in_house/jupiter/6.summary: Jupiter in the 6th overcomes enemies in every text, but most classics add laziness, humiliation and some weakness of health or digestion; modern writers read service, healing and reconciliation.

by_area.finance: Spending turns to charity; caution with loans on trust (PanchangBodh); 'unlucky' (Raman).
by_area.health: Dyspepsia but health generally good (Raman); free from disease with a benefic, cold or rheumatic troubles with a malefic (Bhrigu Sutras 32-34); liver and weight from rich diet (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Enemies reconciled rather than crushed (PanchangBodh); happiness from the wife (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).
by_area.family: Growth of family members (Bhrigu Sutras 32-34).
by_area.spirituality: Interest in mantra (Phaladeepika 8.15).

planet_in_house/jupiter/10.phrasing_guidance: Present as a career of trust and integrity: teaching, advising, administration. Avoid guaranteeing status; speak of reputation built on ethics.

planet_in_house/jupiter/11.summary: Jupiter in the 11th is a strong placement for gains: wealth, conveyances, servants and fame; Phaladeepika and Saravali add few children, and Saravali limited education.
common_outcomes: Wealthy, many gains (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.60; Jataka Parijata 8.95; Bhrigu Sutras 50-53; Raman)
Prosperous (Brihat Jataka 20.7)
Conveyances and servants (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.60)
Strong or piercing intellect, renowned (Jataka Parijata 8.95; Raman)

Effortless gains if joined by the Moon (Bhrigu Sutras 53)

by_area.finance: Many gains, conveyances and servants (Saravali 30.60); income rises steadily, wishes often fulfilled later in life (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.16; Raman).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Raman); influential friends and mentors; supportive elder siblings (PanchangBodh).

planet_in_house/jupiter/11.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Aquarius lagna (2nd and 11th lord in own sign) and Virgo lagna (exalted 4th and 7th lord) give very powerful Dhana yogas.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted under 'Other Views' in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via summary)

planet_in_house/jupiter/11.phrasing_guidance: Speak of growing gains, good mentors and wishes fulfilled with time. Do not predict number of children.

planet_in_house/jupiter/12.summary: Jupiter in the 12th is read negatively by every classic (disliked, idle, poor speech, servitude, scepticism), while modern writers reframe it as generosity, spiritual retreat and moksha.
common_outcomes: Disliked or odious (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
Idle or indolent (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
Poor or harsh speech (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
Servitude (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
rare_outcomes: A 'villain' (Brihat Jataka 20.7)
Sceptical about religion, irresolute, wandering (Jataka Parijata 8.98); derides religion but later repents and reforms (Raman)
Interested in study and mathematics, few children (Bhrigu Sutras 54-58)
Spends on good causes without praise (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Evil-minded (Jataka Parijata 8.98; Raman); generosity and release (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Hospitals, ashrams or life abroad (PanchangBodh); service to others (Phaladeepika 8.16).
by_area.finance: Poor (Bhrigu Sutras 54); loss of wealth (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary); spends on charity, education, pilgrimage and guests faster than it saves (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Restful sleep is common (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Lascivious life, later reformed (Raman); loose character (Bhrigu Sutras 54).
by_area.family: No or few children (Phaladeepika 8.16; Bhrigu Sutras 54).
by_area.spirituality: Spends on religious causes (Bhrigu Sutras 58); meditation, retreat, service in institutions, moksha (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
With a benefic, or in own or exaltation sign, an auspicious afterlife is promised (Bhrigu Sutras 55); read as strong spiritual merit
As lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th it can give Vipareeta Raja Yoga (Uttara Kalamrita, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary; via summary)
Pisces makes the spiritual current strong (PanchangBodh)
Satyacharya, as read by Bhattotpala (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes): a benefic in the 12th reduces expenditure
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
As lord of good houses it harms them from the 12th (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
With a malefic: adverse results (Bhrigu Sutras 56)
In Capricorn expenses need firmer boundaries (PanchangBodh)
planet_in_house/jupiter/12.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: when Jupiter rules a dusthana (6th, 8th or 12th) its placement here can work as Vipareeta Raja Yoga.

planet_in_house/jupiter/12.disagreements: Strong split between classical and modern readings. Phaladeepika, Saravali, Brihat Jataka, Jataka Parijata, Bhrigu Sutras and Raman are negative; PanchangBodh and VedicFeed present a spiritual and generous Jupiter. Raman uniquely adds later reform. Satyacharya's general rule (benefics in the 12th curb expense) is at odds with PanchangBodh's 'spends faster than it saves'.
planet_in_house/jupiter/12.phrasing_guidance: Do not repeat labels like 'villain' or 'evil-minded'. Present as a generous, inward, spiritually inclined placement that needs budgeting and clear boundaries, and suits retreat, service or work abroad.

planet_in_house/ketu/1.summary: Ketu in the lagna is classically adverse for body, standing and reputation, giving a lean or weak constitution and an unsettled, inward or unusual personality; modern authors add intuition, psychic sensitivity and a spiritual bent.
common_outcomes: Weak, lean or emaciated constitution (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Foss name 83 'disease')
Unhappiness or loss of position (Phaladeepika 8.28)
Instability, restlessness, wandering disposition (Raman HJH; Braha)
Intuition, psychic or spiritual leanings (Raman HJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 8.28: ungrateful, a tale-bearer, an outcast, associates with the wicked, bodily deformity
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): troublesome to family members, wind complaints
Bhrigu Sutras 1-4 (Rahu or Ketu): in Aries, Taurus or Cancer, kind-hearted and fond of enjoyments; with a malefic aspect, facial marks
Braha: makes the person go unnoticed or seem invisible to others

by_area.personality: Morbid imagination, strange appetites, excitability, possible deceitfulness (Raman HJH); shy, changeable, many-faceted, intuitive and discriminating (Braha); diplomatic (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.career: Phaladeepika 8.28: fallen from position.
by_area.health: Weak constitution and emaciated figure (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); wind troubles (Chamatkar Chintamani); danger from poisons or contaminated food (Braha); disease (Foss name 83, especially in childhood).
by_area.relationships: Married life unhappy unless other configurations help (Raman HJH); ups and downs, spouse may be domineering (Braha).
by_area.family: Troublesome to family members (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.spirituality: Psychic powers likely (Raman HJH); interest in enlightenment and the occult (Braha).

strengtheners: Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: psychic, spiritual, profound discrimination, respected (Braha)
Ketu in a kendra connected with a kendra/trikona lord becomes a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu or Rahu in the lagna while the lagna lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th: bodily trouble in the lagna lord's dasa (Jataka Parijata 11.31)
Ketu in Cancer or Leo heightens the negatives (Braha)
Ketu in the lagna with the 8th lord is quoted from Bhavartha Ratnakara as shortening life (Bhrigu Sutras commentary, 8th-house Saturn section)
planet_in_house/ketu/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is always in the 7th. Phaladeepika 8.34: Ketu gives results like Mars. Braha says Ketu gives its full effects around the 48th year. Node dignity is disputed: Braha treats Gemini and Virgo as the only agreed strong signs for either node (and Cancer/Leo as weak); Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary, singles out Aries, Virgo and Scorpio (and Gemini, Virgo for the 2nd) as good signs for Ketu.

planet_in_house/ketu/1.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Phaladeepika is entirely negative; Raman and Braha add psychic or spiritual capacity. The Bhrigu Sutras give the same sign-based relief (Aries, Taurus, Cancer) as for Rahu, while Braha treats Cancer as weak for the nodes.
planet_in_house/ketu/1.phrasing_guidance: Describe an inward, perceptive and somewhat elusive personality; encourage grounding routines and self-care. Avoid words like 'outcast' or predictions of illness; mention partnership balance (Rahu in 7th) gently.

planet_in_house/ketu/2.summary: Ketu in the 2nd is classically poor for speech, learning, family harmony and finances, with mouth or eye complaints; a minority view (Foss's name-list, Ketu in Gemini/Virgo or Aries) gives distinctive speech and comforts.

Lack of wealth or learning; financial liabilities (Phaladeepika 8.28; Bhrigu Sutras 5-6; Raman HJH; Braha)

by_area.health: Diseases of the mouth (Chamatkar Chintamani); speech problems, poor food or intoxicants (Braha); disease and loss of children (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6).

planet_in_house/ketu/2.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. planet_in_house/ketu/8.lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is in the 2nd. Braha: whenever the nodes are in the 2nd or 8th, happiness is disturbed.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.31 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Short-lived, separated from dear friends, quarrelsome, injured by weapons, disappointed in all undertakings.

planet_in_house/ketu/8.phrasing_guidance: Speak of resilience through setbacks, research and intuition, and of care with shared finances and health routines. Avoid any mention of short life, injury or chronic disease as predictions.

planet_in_house/ketu/9.summary: Ketu in the 9th is classically adverse for fortune, righteousness and the father; modern readings add short temper and haughtiness but also valour, thrift and a good spouse, with fortune restored when Ketu is well placed.
common_outcomes: Misfortune or ill luck (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha)
Strain with or loss of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha); poor treatment of parents (Raman HJH)
Unrighteous conduct or slandering the good in classical lists (Phaladeepika 8.32; Bhrigu Sutras 24; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Foss name 57)
Little interest in philosophy or religion (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Wealth earned with the help of foreigners; anxious for children (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Good spouse and children; many children (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Eloquent, valorous, fond of pomp; saves money through frugality (Raman HJH)
Bhrigu Sutras 24: childless, dependent livelihood

by_area.personality: Short-tempered, upset by trifles, haughty but valorous, eloquent (Raman HJH); narrow-minded (Braha); untruthful, thrifty (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.finance: Indigent (Phaladeepika 8.32); frugal and saves much (Raman HJH); wealth via foreigners (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.health: Short-sighted (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.relationships: Good wife (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.family: Deprived of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32); hostile to parents (Raman HJH); difficulties with a father whose life may be troubled (Braha); good children (Raman HJH).
by_area.spirituality: Foss: Ketu here may indicate religious extremism or experiencing 'papa' (demerit), though he softens the term.

strengtheners: Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: benefit from a fine father, luck, good morals (Braha)
Trikona placement connected with a kendra/trikona lord (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52)
Node in the 9th or 10th with a trikona lord gives prosperity (Uttara Kalamrita, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Node in a trikona associated with the 2nd or 7th lord: harmful dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.32 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Follows a sinful course, does unrighteous things, deprived of the father, unlucky, indigent, slanders the good.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 24 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 9th: childless, intimacy with low-born women, dependent livelihood, irreligious.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 9th (Ketu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Anxious to have children; earns wealth with the help of foreigners.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the ninth house ('Planets in the Ninth House')
source_views.view: Short-tempered, upset over trifles, eloquent but uses it to scandalise; pompous, haughty, but valorous; hostile to parents; short-sighted; saves through frugal living; good wife and children.

source_views.view: Short-sighted, untruthful, thrifty, many children, good wife; also lists moral faults.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 9th house' section
source_views.view: Harms most 9th-house matters: narrow-minded, little interest in religion, difficulties with the father, luck and higher education disturbed. Gemini/Virgo: benefit from a fine father, luck, good morals.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Ketu, the South Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 57
source_views.view: In the 9th Ketu causes one to commit or experience 'papa' (57), which Foss reads less harshly; elsewhere he links Ketu in the 9th with religious extremism.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

planet_in_house/ketu/9.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Raman HJH and Hindu Predictive Astrology give a good spouse and (many) children, while the Bhrigu Sutras give childlessness; Chamatkar Chintamani is mildly positive financially.
planet_in_house/ketu/9.phrasing_guidance: Describe an independent, sometimes sceptical relationship with tradition, teachers and the father, and a fortune built through one's own choices. Avoid moral judgments and statements about the father's death.

planet_in_house/ketu/10.summary: Ketu in the 10th mixes obstacles and irregular conduct in career with boldness, renown and, in several sources, pilgrimage and spiritual inclination; as an upachaya malefic it can give marked career success.
common_outcomes: Energetic, bold, widely renowned (Phaladeepika 8.32; Raman HJH)
Obstacles in undertakings or in good works (Phaladeepika 8.32; Raman HJH)
Pilgrimages, religious study, spiritual disciplines (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Rath)
Career success as a malefic in an upachaya house (Braha; Foss name 78)
rare_outcomes: Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): unfortunate and distressed, no happiness from the father; destroys enemies in Aries, Virgo or Scorpio
Bhrigu Sutras 25-28 (Rahu or Ketu): relations with widows, poor quarters; better places with a benefic; interest in poetry
Work in an unusual profession or one 'related to the upward direction', e.g. aviation (Foss name 78)
Fertile brain, happy (Hindu Predictive Astrology)

by_area.personality: Very clever, bold (Raman HJH); fertile brain (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.career: Obstacles in all undertakings (Raman HJH); excellent career success unless Ketu is in an inimical sign, where strange career difficulties and deception arise (Braha); rise in career, unusual profession (Foss name 78).
by_area.family: No happiness from father (Chamatkar Chintamani); Rath: the nodes in the 10th obstruct the 9th (father, fortune) by argala.
by_area.spirituality: Religious, scripturally learned, many pilgrimages when beneficially disposed (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); Rath: Ketu's beneficial argala on the 12th leads to the spiritual path and meditation.

strengtheners: Ketu in Aries, Virgo or Scorpio (Chamatkar Chintamani); Gemini or Virgo (Braha)
Beneficially disposed Ketu (Raman HJH); association with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 25-28)
Malefics in upachaya houses (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16; Braha)
Node in the 9th or 10th with a trikona lord gives prosperity (Uttara Kalamrita, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in a sign of the Sun or Moon, or one unfriendly to the nodes: strange career difficulties (Braha)
Papargala on the 9th: hardship for the father or guru (Rath)

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.32 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Obstacles to good acts, impure and vile acts, yet energetic, bold and widely renowned.

source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 10th: relations with widows, poor quarters (better with a benefic), interest in poetry.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 10th (Ketu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Unfortunate, distressed, no happiness from father; destroys enemies if in Aries, Virgo or Scorpio.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events (Sagar), 9th-house argala discussion
source_views.view: Ketu in the 10th has papargala on the 9th but subhargala on the 12th of final emancipation; Ketu being moksha karaka, this leads the native to the spiritual path and teaches meditation.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the tenth house ('Planets in the Tenth House')
source_views.view: Strong, bold, well known; vile deeds and impure resolves; obstacles in undertakings; very clever; if beneficially disposed, happy, religious, well read in scripture, visits pilgrim centres.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Fertile brain, happy, religious, pilgrimages to sacred rivers and places, fond of scriptures.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 10th house' section
source_views.view: As a malefic in an upachaya house, excellent career success; in an inimical sign, strange career difficulties and vulnerability to deception; interest in spiritual disciplines and pilgrimage. Gemini/Virgo: honour and fame.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Ketu, the South Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 78

Hindu Predictive Astrology and Braha are positive (religious, successful), Chamatkar Chintamani negative (unfortunate, no paternal happiness), and Phaladeepika and Raman HJH mixed (renowned but obstacles).
planet_in_house/ketu/10.phrasing_guidance: Describe a career with an unusual or independent bent, success that comes through boldness and persistence, and a pull towards meaning or pilgrimage. Avoid calling actions 'vile'; frame obstacles as course-corrections.

planet_in_house/ketu/11.summary: Ketu in the 11th is favourable in nearly all sources: accumulation of wealth, success in undertakings, good qualities, learning and gains, with some concern for children or odd friendships.
common_outcomes: Accumulates or hoards wealth; gains of all kinds (Phaladeepika 8.33; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Raman HJH; Braha)
Success in undertakings; requirements met (Phaladeepika 8.33; Raman HJH; Braha)
Many good qualities; learned (Phaladeepika 8.33; Chamatkar Chintamani; Raman HJH; Braha)
Fame (Foss name 79)
rare_outcomes: Windfalls through speculation such as lotteries or markets (Raman HJH)
Charitable works (Raman HJH)
Issues (children) unfortunate (Chamatkar Chintamani)
Humorous, witty (Hindu Predictive Astrology)

by_area.personality: Noble, with many good qualities of head and heart (Raman HJH); humorous, witty, intelligent (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.career: Success in all ventures (Raman HJH); successful undertakings (Braha).
by_area.finance: Hoards money (Phaladeepika 8.33; Raman HJH); wealthy (Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha); speculative windfalls (Raman HJH).
by_area.relationships: Strange friends or difficulties with them (Braha); fine, possibly ascetic friends in Gemini/Virgo (Braha).
by_area.family: Children unfortunate (Chamatkar Chintamani); blessed with children (Bhrigu Sutras 29-30).

strengtheners: Malefics in upachaya houses (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16)
Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: constant opportunities, special eldest sibling (Braha)

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.33 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the eleventh house ('Planets in the Eleventh House')

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)

source_views.view: Successful undertakings and fortunate gains; strange friends or difficulties with them; scriptures say learned and wealthy with many fine qualities.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Ketu, the South Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 79
source_views.view: 'In the eleventh house he gives fame' (79).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

planet_in_house/ketu/11.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. The only real divergence is about children: Chamatkar Chintamani says unfortunate, the Bhrigu Sutras say blessed with children.
planet_in_house/ketu/11.phrasing_guidance: Describe steady gains and quiet success, with a detached attitude to reward; mention friendships that may be unusual. Avoid promising windfalls.

planet_in_house/ketu/12.summary: Ketu in the 12th is read in two ways: classical verses stress secret wrongdoing, wasteful spending and eye trouble, while many later and modern authors regard it as an excellent placement for spiritual liberation, charity and foreign residence.
common_outcomes: Expenditure, sometimes wasteful (Phaladeepika 8.33; Braha) or on charities (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Eye troubles (Phaladeepika 8.33; Bhrigu Sutras 31-32; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha)
Spiritual insight and interest in liberation (Frawley; Braha)
Restless mind, foreign residence, travel (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
rare_outcomes: Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): like a king, spends on charities, enemies vanquished
Ability to ward off negative psychic influences (Frawley)
Foss name 74: heroism or enmity
Inherited property may be lost (Raman HJH)

by_area.personality: Capricious, unsettled (Hindu Predictive Astrology); restless, wandering mind (Raman HJH); discriminating (Braha).
by_area.finance: Spends on vile things and destroys wealth (Phaladeepika 8.33); unexpected expenses and debts (Braha); spends on charities (Chamatkar Chintamani); inherited property may be lost (Raman HJH).
by_area.health: Eye diseases (Phaladeepika 8.33; Chamatkar Chintamani); left eye or ear (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Befriended by lower classes (Raman HJH); little sexual pleasure (Braha).
by_area.family: Few children (Bhrigu Sutras 31-32).
by_area.spirituality: Ketu does well in the 12th, giving spiritual insight (Frawley); excellent for a spiritual seeker (Braha). BPHS 33 places liberation with Ketu in the 12th from the Karakamsa (a different reference point).

strengtheners: Ketu unaspected by malefics in the 12th, or with a benefic in its own/exalted sign (Frawley, on strengthening Ketu)
Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: few unexpected expenses, fine spiritual tendencies, success abroad (Braha)
Benefic aspect (BPHS 33, for Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa, especially in Aries or Sagittarius)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Malefic aspect or conjunction blocks liberation in the Karakamsa rule (BPHS 33)
Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th associated with those houses' lords: harm in its dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 17-18)
planet_in_house/ketu/12.lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is in the 6th. The liberation reading in BPHS 33 is counted from the Karakamsa, not the lagna; Raman HJH also cites it (Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa gives final emancipation).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.33 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Commits sins secretly, spends money on vile things, destroys wealth, follows forbidden conduct, suffers eye disease.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 31-32 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 12th: few children, eye troubles, an unhappy after-life.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 12th (Ketu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)

source_views.view: Restless, wandering mind; leaves the country of birth; befriended by the lower classes; inherited property may be lost. (Elsewhere in the 12th-house chapter: Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa gives final emancipation.)

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Capricious, unsettled mind, foreign residence, traveller; also lists licentiousness.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses', p. 145, and remedial-measures chapter (pp. ~258-259)
source_views.view: Ketu does well in the 12th, giving spiritual insight and protection from negative psychic influences; Ketu in the 12th unaspected by malefics is a strong Ketu.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Ketu in the 12th house' section
source_views.view: Excellent for the spiritual seeker: discrimination and interest in spiritual evolution; but unexpected expenses, debts, little sexual pleasure; scriptures add wasteful spending and left eye/ear trouble.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Ketu, the South Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 74
source_views.view: In the twelfth house or sign Ketu can cause heroism or enmity (74).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

planet_in_house/ketu/12.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Phaladeepika is wholly negative; Chamatkar Chintamani gives royal status and charity; Frawley and Braha make the 12th Ketu's best house for spirituality. The well-known 'Ketu in 12th gives moksha' rule in BPHS is counted from the Karakamsa, not the lagna.
planet_in_house/ketu/12.phrasing_guidance: Lead with the inward, spiritual and charitable potential, and with life or work abroad; suggest mindful spending and rest. Do not promise liberation or discuss after-death states.

planet_in_house/mars/1.summary: Mars in the lagna gives a bold, energetic, hot-blooded nature with courage and drive. The texts warn of rashness, temper, injuries and scars, and it is one of the Kuja dosha houses.
common_outcomes: Injury to a limb, scars or marks on the body (Phaladeepika 8.8, Brihat Jataka 20.6, Raman)
Cruel, reckless or rash temperament (Phaladeepika 8.8, Jataka Parijata 8.58, Raman)
Courage, self-confidence and enterprise (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Hot constitution and proneness to accidents, cuts and burns (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Given to wandering, fickle and sickly (Jataka Parijata 8.58)
Pilfering habits; big navel; reddish complexion; early danger to the father (Raman HPA)
Handsome appearance; love of liberty and independence (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Daring, active, practical, independent and rash (Raman); cruel and reckless in the old texts (Phaladeepika 8.8).
by_area.health: Hot constitution; risk of accidents, cuts and burns; overuse of physical resources can harm health (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.relationships: Domestic life unhappy unless other factors help (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); 1st house is counted for Manglik dosha in most lists (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Ruchaka yoga forms for Aries, Scorpio and Capricorn lagna (PanchangBodh)
Results scale with the dignity of the sign (Brihat Jataka 20.10)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman stresses that aspects to Mars here must be examined carefully (How to Judge a Horoscope)
planet_in_house/mars/1.lagna_or_context_notes: PanchangBodh: Ruchaka yoga (Mars in a kendra in own or exaltation sign) arises for Aries, Scorpio and Capricorn lagna. Raman's classical Kuja dosha list (2, 4, 7, 8, 12) does not include the 1st (How to Judge a Horoscope, 'Planets in the 7th House'), while PanchangBodh says most modern lists do.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.8 (English tr. on siva.sh)
source_views.view: Injured limb, reduced longevity, cruel and reckless.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: An injured limb.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.58 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)

source_views.view: Hot constitution, scars, pilfering habits, big navel, early danger to father, reddish complexion, active, adventurous, powerful, low-minded.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. I, 'Planets in the First House'
source_views.view: Hot constitution, courage, self-confidence, enterprise, practical ability, love of liberty, reckless, rash; scars but handsome; unhappy domestic life unless offset; accident-prone; examine aspects.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses (modern site)
source_views.view: Strong body, quick reflexes, direct manner; impatience and temper; aspects 4th, 7th, 8th; Ruchaka for Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn lagna; most lists count it for Manglik dosha.

source_views.source: VedicFeed (Mona), Effects of Mars in 12 Houses (modern site)
source_views.view: Energetic, strong, courageous, focused; reckless, aggressive, acts without consulting.

planet_in_house/mars/1.disagreements: The classics stress cruelty and injury; Raman and the modern sites stress courage and enterprise. Kuja dosha lists differ: Raman's classical list omits the 1st house, PanchangBodh says most modern lists include it.
planet_in_house/mars/1.phrasing_guidance: Lead with energy, courage and a direct style; suggest channelling it into sport or decisive work and taking care against haste and accidents. Do not frame Manglik status as a danger to a spouse.

planet_in_house/mars/2.summary: Mars in the 2nd makes speech sharp and quarrelsome and ties earning to hard effort. The texts split on money, and this is a Kuja dosha house in the classical list.
common_outcomes: Harsh or sharp speech, quarrelsome (Phaladeepika 8.8; Raman)
Hot-tempered (Jataka Parijata 8.63; Raman HPA)
Earns through effort, land or technical skill (Jataka Parijata 8.63; PanchangBodh)
Mixes with or befriends bad company (Phaladeepika 8.8; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
rare_outcomes: Eats poor food (Brihat Jataka 20.6)
Much travelling in pursuit of metals, mining or agriculture (Jataka Parijata 8.63)
Broken education; large patrimony (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Quarrelsome, satirical, aggressive and unsympathetic (Raman).
by_area.career: Metal-work, mining or agriculture (Jataka Parijata 8.63).
by_area.finance: Phaladeepika gives lack of wealth; Raman (How to Judge a Horoscope) gives good earning and accumulation but miserliness; Raman HPA calls him extravagant.
by_area.family: Family disputes are a risk (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Kuja dosha does not arise when the 2nd is Gemini or Virgo, or when Mars is in Leo or Aquarius (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Conjunction with Jupiter or the Moon counters Kuja dosha (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Afflicted Mars here may cause speech problems that stall progress (VedicFeed)
planet_in_house/mars/2.lagna_or_context_notes: Kuja dosha: Raman counts the 2nd as the mildest of the dosha houses (order of strength 2, 12, 4, 7, 8), counted from lagna, Moon or Venus, and judged by bhava not rashi; South Indian practice counts it, many North Indian astrologers do not (PanchangBodh).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.8
source_views.view: Unattractive face or harsh speech, lacks learning and wealth, depends on bad people.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6
source_views.view: Eats bad food.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.63
source_views.view: Wanders much for metallurgy and agriculture; hot-tempered.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Quarrelsome, extravagant, harsh speech, short-tempered, wasteful, sharp-tongued, broken education, satirical, large patrimony, aggressive, unpopular.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. I, 'Planets in the Second House' and Vol. II Kuja dosha section
source_views.view: Quarrelsome, good earning but miserly, accumulates money, good talker, befriends evil-minded people, unsympathetic. Kuja dosha house, mildest of the five; exceptions Gemini and Virgo.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Forceful frank speech; money through effort, land or technical skill; quick spending; family disputes; Manglik in South Indian lists, not in many North Indian ones.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Mars in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Bold, hard-working risk-taker building wealth; harsh speech; afflicted, speech problems.

planet_in_house/mars/2.disagreements: On money: Phaladeepika says without wealth, Raman says good earnings and accumulation (How to Judge a Horoscope) or extravagance (HPA). On Kuja dosha: counted in Raman's classical list and South Indian practice, not by many North Indian astrologers (PanchangBodh).
planet_in_house/mars/2.phrasing_guidance: Speak of frank, forceful speech and self-earned money, advising tact in family talk and steady saving. Mention Manglik only as a matching convention, never as a threat.

planet_in_house/mars/3.summary: Mars is at home in the 3rd: courage, prowess, wealth, fame and success through bold effort. Its cost falls on siblings.
common_outcomes: Brave, invincible and of great prowess (Phaladeepika 8.8, Jataka Parijata 8.65, Raman)
Wealthy and happy (Phaladeepika 8.8)
Famous (Jataka Parijata 8.65)
Bad for brothers and sisters, few or no brothers (Phaladeepika 8.8; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Good intellect and strength (Brihat Jataka 20.6, via its rule that Mars in the 3rd acts like the Sun there)
Danger in journeys; ear defects (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Weak sexual morals (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Upright (Jataka Parijata 8.65) and of good character (Phaladeepika 8.8), but Raman calls him reckless, pioneering and unprincipled.
by_area.career: Writing, media, sport, marketing, defence and technical trades (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.8).
by_area.health: Ear defects possible (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); accident risk (VedicFeed).
by_area.family: Few or no brothers (Phaladeepika 8.8, Raman HPA); worry from family misunderstandings (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).

strengtheners: Mars is the natural significator of the 3rd and is generally well placed here (PanchangBodh)
If the 3rd is Capricorn, Aries or Scorpio, the evil effects are largely modified (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Further affliction of the house shows violent or self-destructive tendencies (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
A karaka in its own house can strain sibling matters (PanchangBodh, citing some astrologers)
planet_in_house/mars/3.lagna_or_context_notes: Raman: Mars in the 3rd in Capricorn (exaltation), Aries or Scorpio (own signs) largely removes the bad effects (How to Judge a Horoscope). Not a Kuja dosha house (PanchangBodh).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.8
source_views.view: Good character, wealth, courage, invincible, happy, no brothers.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.2
source_views.view: Mars in houses other than 1, 2 and 9 acts like the Sun: in the 3rd, good intellect and great strength.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.65
source_views.view: Famous, of immense prowess and upright views.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Pioneering, few brothers, weak sex morals, courageous, intelligent, reckless, adventurous, short-tempered, unprincipled, unpopular.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. I, 'Planets in the Third House'
source_views.view: Bad for siblings, danger by journeys, brave, family misunderstandings, reckless, pioneering, ear defects; further affliction: violent tendencies; Capricorn, Aries or Scorpio modify the evil.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Natural karaka, well placed: initiative, stamina, competitive nerve, results grow with age; spirited sibling bonds; not Manglik.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Mars in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Frank, witty, direct; over-adventurous with accident risk; short-tempered.

planet_in_house/mars/3.disagreements: Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata praise character (good, upright); Raman calls him unprincipled. All agree on courage; the sibling cost is stated by Phaladeepika and Raman.
planet_in_house/mars/3.phrasing_guidance: Lead with courage, drive and self-made success. Mention sibling friction lightly and recommend care in travel and risky activities.

planet_in_house/mars/4.summary: Mars in the 4th is hard on domestic peace: friction with mother and relatives, few comforts and an unsettled home, though property and political success are possible. It is a Kuja dosha house.
common_outcomes: Lacking friends, relatives, comforts or vehicles (Phaladeepika 8.8, Jataka Parijata 8.68)
Little happiness, troubled mind (Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.2; Raman)
Quarrels at home or with the mother (Raman)
Owns houses but is not happy in them (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
rare_outcomes: Valiant but dominated by the spouse (Jataka Parijata 8.68)
Success in politics (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Sickly mother; danger to the father (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Restless at home and in mind (PanchangBodh); Raman HPA uses coarse and tyrannical.
by_area.career: Political success (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.finance: Property through effort (PanchangBodh); gains through real estate (VedicFeed).
by_area.relationships: Ego clashes can strain the marriage (VedicFeed).
by_area.family: Deprived of happiness from mother, relations and friends; quarrels with the mother (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); no mother or friends (Phaladeepika 8.8).

strengtheners: Kuja dosha does not arise when the 4th is Aries or Scorpio, or when Mars is in Leo or Aquarius (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Ruchaka yoga forms for Capricorn, Leo and Libra lagna (PanchangBodh)
Conjunction with Jupiter or the Moon counters Kuja dosha (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars has no directional strength in the 4th (PanchangBodh)
Mars joining Rahu or Ketu here is flagged by Raman as a risk to mental wellbeing, including self-destructive tendencies (How to Judge a Horoscope)
planet_in_house/mars/4.lagna_or_context_notes: Ruchaka yoga for Capricorn, Leo and Libra lagna (PanchangBodh). Kuja dosha: Raman places the 4th in the middle of the dosha order and exempts Aries and Scorpio in the 4th (How to Judge a Horoscope). PanchangBodh calls the 4th Manglik in every common list and the most testing placement.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.8
source_views.view: Without friends, mother, land, comfort or vehicles.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.2
source_views.view: As the Sun in the 4th: no happiness and a troubled mind.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.68
source_views.view: Bereft of relations, dominated by the spouse, though valiant.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Sickly mother, quarrels, unhappy home, danger to father, domestic quarrels over conveyances, uncomfortable, coarse, tyrannical.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. I, 'Planets in the Fourth House'
source_views.view: Generally bad: little happiness from mother, relations, friends; political success; quarrels with mother; owns houses without happiness; Rahu or Ketu with Mars is serious.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses
source_views.view: No digbala, restlessness at home and in mind, property through effort; Ruchaka for Capricorn, Leo, Libra lagna; Manglik in all lists, most testing placement.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Mars in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Gains through property, enjoys comfort, resilient; restless, aggressive, domestic unrest affects health and marriage.

planet_in_house/mars/4.disagreements: Phaladeepika denies land and vehicles; Raman says he owns houses, and PanchangBodh and VedicFeed give property gains. On Kuja dosha severity, PanchangBodh calls the 4th the most testing, while Raman ranks the 7th and 8th as stronger.
planet_in_house/mars/4.phrasing_guidance: Speak of a restless energy that needs a calm home base and patience with family. Do not predict harm to parents; mention Manglik only as a matching custom with known exceptions.

planet_in_house/mars/5.summary: Mars in the 5th sharpens and hardens the mind but is classically unfavourable for children, happiness and calm thinking. Some texts still give wealth and daring.
common_outcomes: Difficulty with children or few children (Phaladeepika 8.9, Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.2, Raman)
Unhappy, with a disturbed mind (Phaladeepika 8.9, Raman)
Rash, restless, daring (Jataka Parijata 8.72; Raman)
Ambitious, intelligent and persevering (Raman HPA)
rare_outcomes: Cruel, wandering, unrighteous, sensual yet wealthy (Jataka Parijata 8.72)
Backbiting or tale-bearing (Phaladeepika 8.9; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Colic; health lost through over-indulgence (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Bold and decisive (Raman HPA) but weak-willed and disturbed in mind (Phaladeepika 8.9, Raman).
by_area.career: Technical, strategic and competitive study suit the sharpened mind (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Jataka Parijata 8.72); poor (Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.2); speculation tempts (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Colic (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.relationships: Passionate, fast-moving romance (PanchangBodh); troubles for wife and friends (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.family: Misfortunes through children (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); children must be judged from the 5th, its lord and Jupiter together, so Mars alone promises nothing (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Mars is yogakaraka for Cancer and Leo lagna (PanchangBodh)
planet_in_house/mars/5.lagna_or_context_notes: For Cancer and Leo lagna, Mars is yogakaraka, which changes the reading (PanchangBodh). Not a Kuja dosha house (PanchangBodh).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.9
source_views.view: Unhappy, childless, beset by setbacks, slanderous, weak-willed.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.2
source_views.view: As the Sun in the 5th: childless and without wealth.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.72
source_views.view: Cruel, wandering, restless, daring, unrighteous, sensual and wealthy.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Unpopular, no issues, ambitious, intelligent, persevering, unhappy, bold, unprincipled, decisive.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. I, 'Planets in the Fifth House'
source_views.view: Troubles for wife, friends and children; disturbed thoughts; rash, weak-minded, backbiter; colic; misfortune through children; over-indulgence harms health.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Sharp technical and strategic mind, passionate romance; children read from house, lord and Jupiter, not Mars alone; speculation temptation; yogakaraka for Cancer and Leo lagna; not Manglik.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Mars in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Uplifted outlook and noble romance; recklessness strains relationships.

planet_in_house/mars/5.disagreements: Jataka Parijata gives wealth, Brihat Jataka gives poverty. The classics deny or trouble children; PanchangBodh says Mars alone cannot decide that. Raman calls him weak-minded (How to Judge a Horoscope) but also persevering and decisive (HPA).
planet_in_house/mars/5.phrasing_guidance: Highlight a quick, competitive intelligence and passion; advise patience in speculation and romance. Never predict childlessness.

planet_in_house/mars/6.summary: Mars is at its best in the 6th: victory over enemies, wealth, fame and success in competitive or authoritative roles.
common_outcomes: Victorious, destroys opponents (Phaladeepika 8.9, Jataka Parijata 8.76, Raman)
Wealthy and famous (Phaladeepika 8.9, Jataka Parijata 8.76)
Success as a ruler, politician or in power (Phaladeepika 8.9; Raman)
Strong appetite and passion (Phaladeepika 8.9, Jataka Parijata 8.76; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Worries from near relatives (Raman)
Good lands (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Passionate, powerful and intelligent (Raman).
by_area.career: Police, military, surgery, medicine, law and sport (PanchangBodh); political success (Raman).
by_area.finance: Opulent; owns property (Jataka Parijata 8.76).
by_area.health: Inflammation, fever, blood pressure and overwork injuries are the cautions (PanchangBodh).
by_area.family: Worries from near relatives (Raman).

strengtheners: Malefics in the 6th give good results (Satyacharya, in Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes)
Upachaya and one of Mars's best houses (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Afflicted Mars: accidents, losses and trouble through employees (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.9
source_views.view: Passionate, wealthy, famous, royal and victorious.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.2
source_views.view: As the Sun in the 6th: powerful but overcome by enemies (the variant reading, per Sastri's note, gives 'conqueror of enemies').

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.76
source_views.view: Owns property, destroys foes, strong appetite, opulent, famous and strong.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Successful, good lands, rich, success over enemies, intelligent, political success, powerful, worry from relations.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. I, 'Planets in the Sixth House'
source_views.view: Highly passionate, victorious, successful as ruler or politician; worries from relatives; afflicted: accidents, losses, trouble through employees.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses
source_views.view: One of the best houses: beats rivals, wins disputes, clears debts; police, military, surgery, law, sport; health cautions; not Manglik.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Mars in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Stamina and managerial ability; impatient with slower colleagues.

planet_in_house/mars/6.disagreements: Only Brihat Jataka's main reading (via its Sun rule) has the native overcome by enemies; every other source gives victory.
planet_in_house/mars/6.phrasing_guidance: Speak confidently about competitive strength, problem-solving and success in demanding work; add a light note about overwork and heat.

planet_in_house/mars/7.summary: Mars in the 7th brings passion and conflict into partnership: friction with the spouse, a strong-willed partner and rash dealings. It is a major Kuja dosha house.
common_outcomes: Tension, quarrels or clashes in married life (Raman; Jataka Parijata 8.79)
Humiliation or trouble through women or partners (Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.3; Phaladeepika 8.9)
Rash, stubborn, tactless and peevish (Raman)
Restless wandering (Phaladeepika 8.9)
rare_outcomes: Two marriages (Raman)
Fond of war (Jataka Parijata 8.79)
Illness; dropsy (Phaladeepika 8.9; Raman HPA)
Submissive to the spouse (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Intelligent but tactless, stubborn and peevish (Raman).
by_area.career: Rash speculation and lack of success (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Clashes and tensions in marriage, or two marriages (Raman); passionate, direct, with a strong-willed partner (PanchangBodh); the classical Kuja dosha dictum treats this as harmful to the spouse (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).

strengtheners: Kuja dosha does not arise when the 7th is Capricorn or Cancer, or when Mars is in Leo or Aquarius (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Conjunction with Jupiter or the Moon counters Kuja dosha (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Ruchaka yoga for Libra, Taurus and Cancer lagna; Mars is yogakaraka for Cancer lagna (PanchangBodh)
planet_in_house/mars/7.lagna_or_context_notes: Ruchaka yoga arises for Libra, Taurus and Cancer lagna (PanchangBodh). Raman's Kuja dosha order of strength is 2, 12, 4, 7, 8, so the 7th is the second strongest; it is counted from lagna, Moon or Venus by bhava, and he calls the dosha one of the most misunderstood and misapplied dicta (How to Judge a Horoscope).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.9
source_views.view: Improper conduct, illness, wandering, loss of the spouse.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.3
source_views.view: As the Sun in the 7th: humiliation at the hands of women.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.79
source_views.view: Quarrelsome about women and fond of war.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Two wives or friction with the wife, dropsy, rash speculation, unsuccessful, intelligent, tactless, stubborn, passionate, tension in married life.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, 'Planets in the 7th House' and Kuja dosha section
source_views.view: Submissive to the spouse, clashes or two marriages, rash and speculative, tactless and unsuccessful. Kuja dosha rules and exceptions (7th exempt in Capricorn or Cancer).

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Passion, directness, strong-willed partner, quick arguments; Manglik in every list; Ruchaka for Libra, Taurus, Cancer lagna; yogakaraka for Cancer.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Mars in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Long-term contentment and passionate intimacy; disturbances and loss of affection.

planet_in_house/mars/7.disagreements: VedicFeed gives a positive, passionate marriage, while the classics and Raman are negative. Raman says both submissive to and in conflict with the spouse. Raman argues the Kuja dosha is overapplied and lists several exemptions.
planet_in_house/mars/7.phrasing_guidance: Speak of passion and strong wills in partnership, with patience and fair conflict as the work. Never predict a spouse's harm, divorce or remarriage; if Manglik comes up, mention the exceptions and that matching is a custom, not a sentence.

planet_in_house/mars/8.summary: Mars in the 8th is classically one of its hardest placements, linked with health strain, accidents, few children and marital trouble. It is the strongest Kuja dosha house, though some texts give wealth and authority.
common_outcomes: Few children and weak eyesight (Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.3; Raman)
Bodily defects or blood-related complaints (Phaladeepika 8.10; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Domestic quarrels and dislike of relatives (Raman)
Public censure (Phaladeepika 8.10)
rare_outcomes: Plain dress, rich and with authority over many people (Jataka Parijata 8.83; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope 'will rule over many')
Nerve under pressure and a gift for investigation, surgery and hidden subjects (PanchangBodh)
Danger to maternal uncles (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Hates relatives (Raman); zealous and intuitive (VedicFeed).
by_area.career: Investigation, surgery and research (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Poverty (Phaladeepika 8.10) against wealth and authority (Jataka Parijata 8.83).
by_area.health: Bloody complaints such as piles (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); care around accidents and fire (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Classical texts link it with loss of or strain with the spouse and extra-marital ties (Raman); strongest Kuja dosha house in Raman's list.
by_area.family: Very few children (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.spirituality: Hidden subjects (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Kuja dosha does not arise when the 8th is Sagittarius or Pisces, or Mars is in Leo or Aquarius (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Conjunction with Jupiter or the Moon counters Kuja dosha (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
'Other alleviating factors' can offset the longevity concern (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Satyacharya counts malefics in the 8th as favourable (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 8th with a fixed lagna, Venus in the 9th, the Moon in the 7th and Jupiter as 2nd lord: a life of servitude (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
planet_in_house/mars/8.lagna_or_context_notes: Raman's Kuja dosha order places the 8th as the strongest of the five houses, exempting Sagittarius and Pisces (How to Judge a Horoscope). PanchangBodh counts it Manglik in every list and reads the 8th as a house of resilience.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.10
source_views.view: Deformed body, poverty, reduced longevity, public censure.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.3
source_views.view: As the Sun in the 8th: few children and defective eyesight.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.83
source_views.view: Plain in attire, rich, with authority over a multitude.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Reduced longevity, few children, danger to maternal uncles, widower later, hates relatives, bad sight, extra-marital relations.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, 'Planets in the Eighth House' and Kuja dosha section
source_views.view: Longevity concern unless offset, may lose spouse, few children, extra-marital life, hates relatives, quarrels, piles, rules many people; servitude combination; strongest Kuja dosha house, Sagittarius and Pisces exempt.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Mars in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Nerve under pressure, investigation, surgery, hidden subjects; care with accidents, fire, shared money; resilience; Manglik in all lists.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Mars in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Zealous, passionate, intuitive, sees through pretence; clingy, fears betrayal.

planet_in_house/mars/8.disagreements: Jataka Parijata gives wealth and authority and Raman also says he will rule over many, while Phaladeepika gives poverty and censure. Modern sites read it as intensity and resilience rather than misfortune.
planet_in_house/mars/8.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as intensity, resilience and investigative ability, with sensible caution around risk and shared finances. Never speak of lifespan, a spouse's death or widowhood; treat Manglik as a matching custom with exemptions.

planet_in_house/mars/9.summary: Mars in the 9th gives authority, renown and an active, combative relationship with belief, but most texts flag friction with the father and questionable conduct.
common_outcomes: Strained relations with the father or parents (Phaladeepika 8.10, Jataka Parijata 8.86; Raman)
Renowned or famous in other respects (Jataka Parijata 8.86; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Wields authority and is affluent (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); friend of the ruler (Phaladeepika 8.10)
Stubborn, impetuous and self-seeking (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Commits sinful acts (Brihat Jataka 20.6)
Prone to violence; disliked by many (Phaladeepika 8.10)
Successful trader or naval merchant; loss from agriculture (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Logical, acute, stubborn and impetuous (Raman HPA); risk of dogmatism (PanchangBodh).

planet_in_house/mars/12.summary: Mars in the 12th is read as a draining placement: losses and expenses, trouble in marriage, heat-related ailments, eye trouble and exposure to deception. It is a Kuja dosha house.

Defective eyes (Phaladeepika 8.10; Raman HPA)
Liable to fraud and deception (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Slanderous, cruel or base (Phaladeepika 8.10)
Diseases from excess bodily heat (Raman)
Work abroad, in institutions, or disciplined spiritual practice (PanchangBodh)

by_area.finance: Without wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.97); energy and money spent in distant or unseen places such as travel, legal or medical costs (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Heat-related ailments (Raman); restless sleep (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Classical texts give loss of or no spouse (Phaladeepika 8.10, Jataka Parijata 8.97); malefics in the 7th and 8th with Mars here suggest a second marriage (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.spirituality: Disciplined spiritual practice suits it (PanchangBodh).

planet_in_house/mars/12.lagna_or_context_notes: Kuja dosha: Raman ranks the 12th second-mildest (order 2, 12, 4, 7, 8) and exempts Taurus and Libra (How to Judge a Horoscope). PanchangBodh notes both regional verses count the 12th.

planet_in_house/mercury/1.summary: Mercury in the lagna is one of the best-agreed placements: every text read describes a learned, intelligent and pleasant-spoken person, and several add long life.
common_outcomes: Learned, intelligent, quick-witted (Phaladeepika, Saravali, Brihat Jataka, Jataka Parijata, Raman)
Sweet, skilful or clever speech (Phaladeepika 8.11; Saravali 30.38; Bhrigu Sutras)
Skill in poetry and mathematics; knows the right time and place (Saravali 30.38)
Humour, adaptability, wide reading (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Long life (Phaladeepika 8.11; Saravali 30.38)
Interest in mantra, tantra, occult study or astrology (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17; Raman)

by_area.finance: Gains of wealth with academic distinction (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); devoted to acquiring wealth as well as learning (Jataka Parijata 8.58).
by_area.health: Good health when Mercury is with benefics; skin, bile or jaundice trouble when with malefics (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); nervous trouble if Rahu or Ketu share the lagna (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Early marriage (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); its 7th aspect brings talkative intelligence into partnership (PanchangBodh).
by_area.family: Happiness from brothers when Mercury is exalted or in own sign (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17).
by_area.spirituality: Listens devoutly to scripture, inclined to virtue and religion (Bhrigu Sutras; Jataka Parijata 8.58); learned in shastras (Phaladeepika 8.11).

Directional strength (digbala) in the 1st (PanchangBodh)

Benefic association: health, wealth, grain, skill in logic and arithmetic (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17)

Debilitation in Pisces (Brihat Jataka 20.11 scale; Bhrigu Sutras)
Mercury turns malefic when joined or aspected by malefics (Bhrigu Sutras commentary on house 1)
