planet_in_house/mercury/3.disagreements: Sharp split. Brihat Jataka 20.6 (rogue), Jataka Parijata 8.65 (deceptive, vacillating) and Saravali 30.40 (cunning, fickle) are negative; Phaladeepika 8.11 is mixed (brave, good siblings, but dejected); Bhrigu Sutras, Chamatkar Chintamani, Raman and PanchangBodh are largely positive. by_area.health: Busy thinking can disturb sleep and peace (PanchangBodh).

by_area.family: Happiness from parents (Bhrigu Sutras 32-37); articulate, practical mother (PanchangBodh); father a self-made man (Raman).

planet_in_house/mercury/8.phrasing_guidance: Present as a respected, research-minded intellect. Never turn longevity statements into a lifespan prediction, and avoid talk of death; say texts associate it with endurance and reputation.

by_area.family: Friendly relations with the father (Raman); father long-lived (Bhrigu Sutras 64-66); father or early guru educated (PanchangBodh); many children (Bhrigu Sutras 64-66).
by_area.spirituality: Religious devotion (Phaladeepika 8.13); Vedas, shastras, meditation (Bhrigu Sutras 64-66); dharma examined rather than taken on trust (PanchangBodh).

planet_in_house/mercury/10.summary: Mercury in the 10th is one of its most favoured places: success in undertakings, learning, virtue and reputation, with careers in knowledge, communication and administration.
common_outcomes: Succeeds in undertakings (Phaladeepika 8.13; Saravali 30.47; Raman)

by_area.health: Possible eye weakness (Raman; Bhrigu Sutras 68).
by_area.relationships: With Venus, a charming spouse and wealth (Raman).
by_area.family: Work and home closely linked through the 4th aspect (PanchangBodh).
by_area.spirituality: In own or exaltation sign or with Jupiter, performs religious rites (Bhrigu Sutras 67-70).

planet_in_house/mercury/12.disagreements: Learning: Phaladeepika 8.13 says unlearned and Jataka Parijata 8.98 senseless, but Saravali 30.49 and Bhrigu Sutras 76-81 say learned. Satyacharya's rule (via Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes) that benefics in the 12th curb expenditure is not reflected in the house-specific verses.
planet_in_house/mercury/12.phrasing_guidance: Avoid the classical labels (cruel, poor, senseless). Present as a private, inward or behind-the-scenes mind, good for research, languages, foreign links and contemplation, with a caution about worry and overspending.

planet_in_house/moon/1.summary: The Moon in the lagna makes the mind and moods visible in the person. A strong (waxing or well-placed) Moon gives charm, health and wealth; a weak or waning one gives a fragile, dependent temperament. Phase and sign decide almost everything.
common_outcomes: Waxing Moon: strong body, long life, fearlessness, power and wealth (Phaladeepika 8.5); full Moon: long life and learning (Jataka Parijata 8.57)
Waning Moon: the reverse, a weak and dependent condition (Phaladeepika 8.5; Jataka Parijata 8.57)
Fanciful, romantic, restless yet easy-going, with changing fortunes (Raman)
Sociable, attractive, liked by the opposite sex (Raman HPA)
Much travel (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Outside Aries, Taurus or Cancer: dullness, mental weakness, defects of speech, sight or hearing, servility (Brihat Jataka 20.4)
Inclined to corpulence, a 'windy' constitution, ailments of the private parts or ears (Raman HPA)
Success in work that deals with the public (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Fanciful, romantic, idealistic, sociable, capricious and fickle-minded (Raman); health and mood show on the face (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Success in professions that bring contact with the masses (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.finance: Wealth with a waxing, exalted or own-sign Moon (Phaladeepika 8.5, Jataka Parijata 8.57, Brihat Jataka 20.4).
by_area.health: Health follows mood (PanchangBodh); Raman HPA lists a windy temperament and ear complaints.
by_area.relationships: Loved by the opposite sex (Raman HPA).
by_area.family: Aries lagna with the Moon there: many children (Brihat Jataka 20.4).
by_area.spirituality: With Jupiter the mind is elevated (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).

strengtheners: Waxing or full Moon (Phaladeepika 8.5, Jataka Parijata 8.57; PanchangBodh)
Moon in Aries, Taurus or Cancer in the lagna escapes the bad results (Brihat Jataka 20.4)
Exalted (Taurus) or own sign (Cancer) in the lagna: wealth, fame and beauty (Jataka Parijata 8.57)
Jupiter with the Moon: elevated mind (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon reverses the good results (Phaladeepika 8.5); deafness, a defective limb, a servile mind (Jataka Parijata 8.57)
Waning Moon plus a malefic in the lagna: very low vitality (Jataka Parijata 8.57)
Saturn with the Moon: constant worry (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Rahu with the Moon: hysterical tendencies (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Mars with the Moon: menstrual disorders in women (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
planet_in_house/moon/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Brihat Jataka 20.4: the bad results do not apply for Aries, Taurus or Cancer lagna; Cancer (own sign) makes the native rich, Aries gives many children, Taurus gives wealth. Jataka Parijata 8.57: exalted or own-sign Moon in the lagna gives wealth, fame and beauty. Raman notes the planet's dignity and aspects must modify the reading (How to Judge a Horoscope, intro to 'Planets in the First House').

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.5 (English tr. on siva.sh)
source_views.view: Waxing Moon in the lagna: strong body, long life, fearless, powerful, wealthy; a waning Moon gives the reverse.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.4 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Mute, insane, dull, blind, mean, deaf or servile, except in Aries, Taurus or Cancer; own sign rich, Aries many children, Taurus wealthy. Sastri's note: the Moon is generally bad in the lagna except in these three signs.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.57 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Waning Moon: deaf, defective limb, servile; with a malefic, little vitality. Exalted or own sign: wealth, fame, beauty. Full Moon: long life and learning.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Fanciful, romantic, moderate eater, attractive, inclined to stoutness, much travel, capricious, sociable, educated, loved by the opposite sex, shy, proud, fickle and eccentric.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. I, 'Planets in the First House'
source_views.view: Fanciful, romantic, restless but easy-going, changing fortune, idealist and traveller; Saturn: worry; Mars: menstrual disorders; Rahu: hysteria; Jupiter: elevated mind; success with the masses.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Moon in the 12 houses (modern site)
source_views.view: Mood shows on the face; waxing gives an open, appealing presence, waning turns sensitivity inward; health follows mood.

source_views.source: VedicFeed (Mona), Effects of Moon in 12 Houses (modern site)
source_views.view: Friendly and caring, varied experiences and travel; moody, sensitive, self-conscious.

planet_in_house/moon/1.disagreements: Brihat Jataka is the harshest (dull, impaired) unless the sign is Aries, Taurus or Cancer; Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata make phase the deciding factor rather than sign; Raman reads it as a romantic, restless, sociable temperament without such extremes.
planet_in_house/moon/1.phrasing_guidance: Describe a responsive, expressive and people-oriented nature whose wellbeing tracks mood. Never use the old 'dull' or 'impaired' wording; suggest routines that steady emotions.

planet_in_house/moon/2.summary: The Moon in the 2nd is good for wealth, family and pleasant, persuasive speech, though income may rise and fall.
common_outcomes: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.5, Jataka Parijata 8.62, Raman)
Large or happy family (Brihat Jataka 20.4; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Sweet, persuasive or learned speech (Phaladeepika 8.5, Jataka Parijata 8.62, Raman HPA)
Handsome or attractive, much admired (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Defect in some limb (Phaladeepika 8.5)
Squint eyes; reserved and not very sociable (Dhundiraja, as quoted by Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Shrewd at guessing others' hidden intentions; fond of study (Jataka Parijata 8.62)
Breaks in education (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Generous, intelligent, charming, poetic (Raman HPA); sensual (Phaladeepika 8.5).
by_area.finance: Wealthy, but the position is somewhat variable; money through women (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); income comes in waves (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Fond of women and well liked (Jataka Parijata 8.62).
by_area.family: Large family and much happiness (Brihat Jataka 20.4; Raman); family women anchor security (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Taurus (exaltation) in the 2nd; Cancer guards savings (PanchangBodh)
Results improve with dignity of the sign held (Brihat Jataka 20.10)
weakeners_or_cancellations: A waning Moon in Scorpio here benefits from automatic savings (PanchangBodh)
planet_in_house/moon/2.lagna_or_context_notes: PanchangBodh: Cancer in the 2nd guards savings, Taurus is exaltation, a waning Moon in Scorpio needs disciplined saving.

source_views.view: Large family, much happiness, money through women, variable finances, fair complexion; quotes Dhundiraja: reserved, squint-eyed, much admired.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Moon in the 12 houses

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Moon in 12 Houses

planet_in_house/moon/2.disagreements: Raman HPA calls the native sociable and charming, while Dhundiraja (via Raman) calls him reserved. Phaladeepika alone adds a defective limb.
planet_in_house/moon/2.phrasing_guidance: Talk about warmth in speech, family support and good earning, with advice to smooth out ups and downs in money.

planet_in_house/moon/3.summary: The Moon in the 3rd gives siblings, an active, travelling mind and changing work. Texts disagree on character: some give strength and virtue, others hardness and stinginess, especially with a waning Moon.
common_outcomes: Has brothers or many siblings (Phaladeepika 8.5, Raman HPA)
Active mind, fond of travel, changes of occupation (Raman)
Miserly or stingy (Phaladeepika 8.5, Raman HPA)
Hard or cruel streak (Brihat Jataka 20.4, Raman HPA)
rare_outcomes: Kind to relatives and virtuous but of modest wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.65)
Sickly, dyspeptic, later piles (Raman HPA)
Fair wife, subordinate to the wife, attached to children (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Lustful and strong (Phaladeepika 8.5); mild yet unscrupulous, purposeless and miserly in Raman HPA.
by_area.career: Frequent changes in occupation (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); writing, teaching and media suit it (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Little wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.65).
by_area.health: Raman HPA lists a sickly, dyspeptic, lean body.
by_area.relationships: Subordinate to wife (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.family: Brothers and sisters (Phaladeepika 8.5, Raman HPA); kind to relatives (Jataka Parijata 8.65).
by_area.spirituality: Rather indifferent to spiritual values (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); impious (Raman HPA).

strengtheners: Upachaya house: improves with effort over time (PanchangBodh)
Cancer or Taurus here steadies effort (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon: cruel, miserable, impious, unscrupulous (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Afflicted: unfavourable for peace of mind (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Sastri's note to Brihat Jataka: the Moon is bad in the 3rd
planet_in_house/moon/3.lagna_or_context_notes: PanchangBodh: Cancer or Taurus in the 3rd steadies effort; Scorpio asks for patience.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Moon in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Upachaya; courage follows mood so routine helps; sisters central; writing, teaching and media; aspect to the 9th links effort to fortune.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Moon in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Creative, imaginative, intuitive, close to siblings, loves travel; emotions can overwhelm, trouble focusing.

planet_in_house/moon/3.disagreements: Jataka Parijata calls the native kind and virtuous, while Brihat Jataka and Raman HPA call him cruel; Raman makes the harsh side depend on a waning Moon. Phaladeepika gives strength, Raman HPA a sickly body.
planet_in_house/moon/3.phrasing_guidance: Highlight curiosity, communication and sibling bonds, and suggest routines that keep a busy mind focused. Avoid labelling character as cruel or stingy.

planet_in_house/moon/4.summary: The Moon in the 4th is one of its best placements: happiness, home, vehicles, friends and a strong bond with the mother. Its directional strength lies here.
common_outcomes: Happy and contented (Phaladeepika 8.6, Brihat Jataka 20.4, Raman)
Vehicles, friends and renown (Phaladeepika 8.6)
Owns a house; happiness from relatives (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Fine tastes, polite manners, well educated (Raman HPA)
rare_outcomes: Desires other people's spouses (Jataka Parijata 8.68)
Becomes a leader; proud and somewhat quarrelsome (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Contented, generous, pleasure-loving (Phaladeepika 8.6); good nature and learning (Jataka Parijata 8.68).
by_area.career: May become important as a leader (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.finance: Wealthy and successful (Raman HPA); prosperity (Jataka Parijata 8.68).
by_area.relationships: Raman lists sensual pleasures unless Jupiter aspects.
by_area.family: Home, mother, land and vehicles matter greatly (PanchangBodh); a good mother (Raman HPA).

strengtheners: Directional strength (digbala) in the 4th; a waxing Moon here is among the steadiest placements (PanchangBodh)
Jupiter's aspect restrains sensual excess (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Afflicted Moon: early separation from the mother (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); with malefics, early loss of the mother (Raman HPA)
The 'karaka bhava nashaya' maxim (significator in its own house harms it) is later than Parashara and matters mainly for a waning or afflicted Moon (PanchangBodh)

planet_in_house/moon/4.phrasing_guidance: Speak warmly of home, comfort and family support. Do not mention a parent's early loss.

planet_in_house/moon/5.summary: The Moon in the 5th gives children, a sharp and creative intellect and a chance at advisory or state roles.

Ministerial office or service to the state (Phaladeepika 8.6; Raman)
High-minded, compassionate, acts after careful thought (Jataka Parijata 8.71)
rare_outcomes: Many daughters; gains through animals; interrupted education (Raman HPA)

planet_in_house/moon/5.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise creativity, good judgement and joy through children or students. Keep speculation advice cautious.

planet_in_house/moon/6.summary: The Moon in the 6th is a weak placement for health, digestion and peace of mind and brings rivals, though it suits service and caring work. A full Moon fares much better than a waning one.
common_outcomes: Stomach or digestive troubles (Phaladeepika 8.6, Brihat Jataka 20.4, Raman)
Many enemies or rivals (Brihat Jataka 20.4, Raman HPA)
Delicate constitution, weak sexual vigour, indolence (Brihat Jataka 20.4, Raman)
Success in subordinate or service roles (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope; PanchangBodh)
rare_outcomes: Full Moon: very sensual and long-lived (Jataka Parijata 8.75)
Humiliation (Phaladeepika 8.6)
Success as a caterer (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Ill health in early childhood (balarishta) (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.finance: Poor (Raman HPA).
by_area.health: Stomach troubles (Phaladeepika 8.6, Raman); sleep, fluid balance and digestion (PanchangBodh); difficulties often ease by the forties (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Submissive to the opposite sex (Raman).
by_area.family: Worried by cousins (Raman HPA).

planet_in_house/moon/6.phrasing_guidance: Describe a caring, service-minded person who should protect sleep, diet and routine. Never mention lifespan or childhood danger; keep health advice general.

planet_in_house/moon/7.summary: The Moon in the 7th gives an attractive spouse and a sociable, passionate nature, with jealousy and a roving eye as the cautions.

Passionate and fond of the opposite sex (Brihat Jataka 20.5, Jataka Parijata 8.79, Raman)
Jealous or envious (Brihat Jataka 20.5, Raman)
Sociable, energetic and successful (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Compassionate and given to wandering (Jataka Parijata 8.79)
Pain in the loins or groin; stingy (Raman)

Fickle or unsteady mind; anxiety (Brihat Jataka 20.5; Raman)
Gains through legacies or inheritance (Raman)
Slender build and weak eyesight (Raman)

source_views.view: Mental aberration, apprehensive, complexes, capricious, unhealthy; may lose mother early; slender, weak eyes; legacies; fond of fighting and amusement, large-hearted; perspiration; Mars and Saturn affect eyesight.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Moon in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Dusthana but also longevity and inheritance; intuition, healing, research, occult; feelings run underground; aspect to the 2nd; waxing phase or benefic aspect softens.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Moon in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Resilient and serious about goals, possibly long life, unexpected gains; moody, business losses, low energy.

planet_in_house/moon/8.disagreements: Jataka Parijata gives a lively, liberal, learned person with no illness note, unlike the other classics. VedicFeed even suggests long life, against Phaladeepika.
planet_in_house/moon/8.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as emotional depth, intuition and resilience, with self-care for stress. Never mention lifespan, a parent's death or mental illness.

planet_in_house/moon/9.summary: The Moon in the 9th is very fortunate: prosperity, children, friends, virtue and devotion, with success in what one begins.
common_outcomes: Prosperous and fortunate (Phaladeepika 8.7, Raman)
Sons, friends and relatives (Brihat Jataka 20.5; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Devoted to gods and ancestors, gives generously (Jataka Parijata 8.86; Raman HPA)
Virtuous and principled (Phaladeepika 8.7; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Successful from the start of undertakings, victorious (Phaladeepika 8.7)
Builds charitable institutions; acquires good property; visits foreign countries (Raman)
Lover of fiction; agricultural success (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Popular, educated, generous-minded (Raman).
by_area.career: Fortune through elders or teachers (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealthy, with immovable property (Raman).
by_area.family: Many sons, friends and kinsmen (Brihat Jataka 20.5, Raman); good children (Raman HPA).
by_area.spirituality: Religious, devotional and mystical (Raman HPA); pilgrimage, teachers and philosophy settle the mind (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Aspects of Saturn, Mars and Mercury on the Moon: the native becomes a ruler (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Waxing Moon is fortunate; Jupiter's aspect helps a waning one (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars with the Moon: harm to the mother (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Venus with the Moon: an irregular moral life (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Saturn here causes much suffering (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
planet_in_house/moon/9.lagna_or_context_notes: PanchangBodh: Scorpio in the 9th (the Moon's debilitation) suggests faith reached through questioning.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI
source_views.view: Popular, educated, intelligent, charitable institutions, wealthy, travel, godly, good children, property, religious, mystical, righteous, good reputation.

source_views.view: Fortunate and prosperous, many sons and friends, principled, generous; Saturn, Mars, Mercury aspects make a ruler; conjunction cautions for Mars, Venus, Saturn; charitable institutions, property, foreign travel.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, Moon in the 12 houses
source_views.view: Belief becomes emotional reality; pilgrimage and teachers; fortune through elders; waxing fortunate, waning works on merit with Jupiter's help.

source_views.source: VedicFeed, Effects of Moon in 12 Houses
source_views.view: Travel, knowledge, relations with people from abroad; obsessive fixations and restlessness.

planet_in_house/moon/9.disagreements: Essentially none on the core; Raman's conjunction cautions are conditional.
planet_in_house/moon/9.phrasing_guidance: Speak of grace, faith, generosity and support from elders and teachers. Avoid repeating notes about harm to the mother.

planet_in_house/moon/10.summary: The Moon in the 10th gives success in undertakings, virtue, wealth and a public, people-facing career, though standing may move with mood.

Virtuous, does good deeds and helps good people (Phaladeepika 8.7, Brihat Jataka 20.5, Raman)
Wealth, ornaments, clothing and skill in the arts (Jataka Parijata 8.89; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Intelligent and bold (Brihat Jataka 20.5; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Trustee of religious institutions (Raman)
With Jupiter: learned in ancient subjects and astrology; with Saturn's aspect: a dispassionate thinker who earns through printing or books (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Persuasive, shrewd, tactful, ambitious (Raman HPA).
by_area.career: Great position, easy success (Raman HPA); public, changeable career in care, food, hospitality, travel or water (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealthy and comfortable (Raman); obtains wealth and goods (Jataka Parijata 8.89).
by_area.health: Comfortable, long life (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Religious (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).

strengtheners: Jupiter with the Moon: learning in ancient subjects and astrology (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
A waxing Moon makes consistent standing easier (PanchangBodh)
Sastri's note to Brihat Jataka: the Moon is very good in the 10th
weakeners_or_cancellations: No directional strength in the 10th; reputation tracks mood as much as merit (PanchangBodh)

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.89

source_views.view: Persuasive, passionate, charitable, shrewd, bold, tactful, ambitious, great position, trustee of religious bodies, many friends, easy success, wealthy, long life.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, 'Planets in the Tenth House'

planet_in_house/moon/10.phrasing_guidance: Highlight a public-facing, helpful career and a good reputation built on consistency.

planet_in_house/moon/11.summary: The Moon in the 11th gives gains, fame, a noble and generous nature, many friends and a long, prosperous life.

Famous (Brihat Jataka 20.5; Raman)
Noble-minded and generous (Phaladeepika 8.7; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Children, servants or helpers, and many friends (Phaladeepika 8.7, Raman)

Helped by women; vast lands (Raman)

by_area.family: Wife and children (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); many children (Raman HPA).

Cancer or Taurus adds loyalty; a waning Moon loses less here (PanchangBodh)

source_views.view: Noble, generous, rich, wife and children; introspective, quiet; famous with business profits; vast lands; helped by women.

planet_in_house/moon/11.phrasing_guidance: Speak of supportive networks, generosity and growing gains; mention that contentment matters as much as acquisition.

Defect or deformity in some limb (Brihat Jataka 20.5; Raman)
Lazy or lethargic (Phaladeepika 8.7; Raman with a waning Moon and Saturn)

Disliked by others and insulted (Phaladeepika 8.7)
Weak eyesight (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

strengtheners: Waxing Moon (PanchangBodh)
Bhattotpala reads benefics in the 12th as reducing expenditure (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon with Saturn: sloth and lethargy (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

planet_in_house/moon/12.phrasing_guidance: Describe a private, inward and imaginative nature that needs rest and solitude to recharge, possibly drawn to life abroad or spiritual retreat. Avoid words like miserable, wicked or deformed, and do not imply depression.

planet_in_house/rahu/1.summary: Rahu in the lagna gives a strong, unusual, self-driven personality with worldly drive and resilience against rivals, but classical texts warn of health weakness, especially of the head and face, and modern authors of unsettled marriage and self-image.
common_outcomes: Strength, power or wealth (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha; Foss name 64 'tremendous power')
Overcomes enemies or competitors (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Health that is hard to diagnose or treat conventionally; head and face complaints (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Braha)
Odd, eccentric or out-of-the-ordinary personality, interest in the occult (Raman HJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 8.25: a short life despite wealth and strength
Bhrigu Sutras 1-4: in Aries, Taurus or Cancer, kind-hearted and fond of enjoyments; aspected by a malefic, marks on the face
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): remains under others' influence and stays detached despite many marriages
Braha: often gives striking good looks

by_area.personality: Wilful, with a 'hypocritical super-consciousness' towards others; odd and eccentric (Raman HJH); big ego with fragile confidence and a lifelong struggle for self-acceptance (Braha); obliging, sympathetic and courageous (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha).
by_area.health: Diseases of the head and face (Phaladeepika 8.25); health generally unsatisfactory, calling for non-medical remedies (Raman HJH); illness from upset emotions, hard to diagnose (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Usually bad for marriage (Raman HJH); constant ups and downs in married life; spouse may be spiritual or devious (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Inclines one to the occult (Raman HJH); inclined to spiritual or occult subjects (Braha).

strengtheners: Rahu in Aries, Taurus or Cancer in the lagna: protects from the evils of the chart (Saravali 12.10-11); with benefic aspect 'no evil exists' (Garga Hora GP 25; Raman HJH)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: honour, fame, leadership (Braha); Foss reports a text saying Rahu in Gemini in the 1st removes all afflictions
Rahu in a kendra connected with a kendra/trikona lord becomes a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52); in a kendra or trikona Rahu is said to lead to religious sacrifices (BPHS 21.3)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in Cancer or Leo heightens the negatives (Braha) — note this conflicts with Saravali's listing of Cancer as protective
Rahu aspected by a malefic: facial marks (Bhrigu Sutras 1-4)
Rahu or Ketu in the lagna while the lagna lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th: bodily trouble in the lagna lord's dasa (Jataka Parijata 11.31)
planet_in_house/rahu/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is always in the 7th, so marriage readings must include Ketu in 7. Raman HJH: Rahu here 'partakes of the characteristics of Saturn' (cf. Phaladeepika 8.34). Braha says Rahu gives its full effects around the 42nd year. Node dignity is disputed: Raman (Hindu Predictive Astrology) gives Rahu's exaltation as Taurus, while Braha says the only placements agreed upon are Mercury's signs Gemini and Virgo and treats Cancer and Leo as weak for the nodes.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.25 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Short-lived but wealthy and strong; suffers diseases of the head and face.

source_views.view: Ketu or Rahu in the lagna with the lagna lord in a dusthana: privation of some limb in the lagna lord's dasa and 6th lord's antardasa.

source_views.view: Health generally unsatisfactory, needing non-medical treatment; occult leaning; marked wilfulness; odd and eccentric; usually bad for marriage; Rahu takes on Saturn's character.

source_views.view: Bad for domestic happiness; health, longevity and confidence weakened; egocentric yet insecure; eccentric; wealthy; occult interest; illnesses from emotions; physical strength and strong will; defeats competitors; often good looks. Gemini/Virgo: honour and leadership.

planet_in_house/rahu/1.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika 8.25 gives short life, whereas Saravali 12 and Garga Hora treat Rahu in the lagna in Aries, Taurus or Cancer as protective. Braha regards Cancer as a weak sign for Rahu, contradicting that Saravali list. Hindu Predictive Astrology is mildly positive in character (obliging, sympathetic), Raman HJH more negative (wilful, hypocritical).
planet_in_house/rahu/1.phrasing_guidance: Describe a magnetic, unconventional drive for self-making, with advice to ground ambition in routine and self-care. Avoid predictions about lifespan, pregnancy loss or specific illnesses; mention partnership balance (Ketu in the 7th) gently.

planet_in_house/rahu/2.summary: Rahu in the 2nd unsettles speech, family harmony, diet and finances; texts swing between poverty and wealth gained through the ruler, friends or business, with Jupiter's influence the main stabiliser.
common_outcomes: Ambiguous, insincere or harsh speech (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha)
Friction or disturbance in family life (Raman HJH; Braha; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Uncertain finances (Raman HJH; Bhrigu Sutras 5-6; Braha)
Disease or marks of the mouth, face or eyes (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Bhrigu Sutras 5-6)
rare_outcomes: Wealth through the ruler or government (Phaladeepika 8.25)
Foss name 88: in the 2nd Rahu gives the position and insignia of royalty (high position or abundant wealth)
More than one marriage if afflicted (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Fondness for rich dinners, alcohol or meat (Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)

by_area.personality: Quick to anger yet tender-hearted (Phaladeepika 8.25); peevish (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); fearless but untruthful (Chamatkar Chintamani); vivid, peculiar imagination (Braha).
by_area.finance: Uncertain unless other good combinations; good earnings if Jupiter aspects the 2nd; gains through friends and business (Raman HJH). Poverty (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6); wealth through the sovereign (Phaladeepika 8.25); craving for money, phenomenal wealth possible if well disposed (Braha). Rath: Rahu in the 2nd does not by itself cause poverty yoga; it is formed when Jupiter is 2nd, 5th, 9th or 12th from Rahu.
by_area.health: Mouth or face disease (Phaladeepika 8.25); danger to eyesight (Raman HJH); right-eye problems, facial scars (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Domestic quarrels or separation from the spouse (Braha).
by_area.family: Friction in family life (Raman HJH); destruction of the family line in Chamatkar Chintamani's wording; loss of children (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6).

strengtheners: Jupiter's aspect on the 2nd (Raman HJH)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: great wealth, fine education, poetic or speaking talent (Braha)
Rahu in the 2nd associated with or aspected by the 5th or 9th lord: wealth and longevity in its dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 2nd, 5th, 9th or 12th from Rahu forms Daridra (poverty) yoga (Rath)
Association with a malefic: marks on the lips (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6)
A malefic joined with the 2nd/7th lord while a node is in the 2nd/7th is treated as dangerous in the node's dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
planet_in_house/rahu/2.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 8th. Braha calls this one of Rahu's worst positions and adds that whenever the nodes are in the 2nd or 8th, happiness is disturbed. Node dignity is disputed: Raman (Hindu Predictive Astrology) gives Rahu's exaltation as Taurus, while Braha says the only placements agreed upon are Mercury's signs Gemini and Virgo and treats Cancer and Leo as weak for the nodes.

planet_in_house/rahu/2.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika gives wealth via the ruler and Foss's name-list gives royal position, while Bhrigu Sutras and Hindu Predictive Astrology give poverty and Braha calls it one of Rahu's worst houses. Rath clarifies that the placement alone does not make poverty.
planet_in_house/rahu/2.phrasing_guidance: Talk about learning to steady speech, diet and spending, and about family dynamics needing patience. Frame money as variable rather than poor; note Jupiter's role if present. Avoid predicting family breakdown or loss of children.

planet_in_house/rahu/3.summary: Rahu in the 3rd, an upachaya house, is one of its best placements: courage, initiative, strong will, wealth and long life, at the cost of harmony with siblings.
common_outcomes: Courageous, bold, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Wealth and long life (Phaladeepika 8.25; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Strained relations with, or few, siblings (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Braha)
Fulfilment of efforts and desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Abundance of oilseeds/produce (Bhrigu Sutras 7-8); with a benefic, a mark on the neck
Severe criticism for one's views; sudden, unexpected news (Raman HJH)
Gymnastic or physical skill; many relations (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Talent in organising, writing, music or drama (Braha)

by_area.personality: Proud, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25); 'brave for outward appearances' (Raman HJH); adventurous, excited, motivated (Braha).
by_area.career: Ability in organisational or detail work, communication, fine arts; Gemini/Virgo may give work as a producer or director (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.25); very wealthy (Hindu Predictive Astrology); favours wealth and respect (Braha).
by_area.health: Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha).
by_area.family: Hostile to brothers (Phaladeepika 8.25); generally bad for brothers (Raman HJH); few younger siblings or no happiness from them (Braha); few children (Hindu Predictive Astrology).

strengtheners: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th aspected by benefics destroys all evils (Saravali 12.3-5); counteracts other negative combinations (Raman HJH)
Malefics in upachaya houses give good results (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16; Braha)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: greater courage, artistic and communicative excellence (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Bhrigu Sutras 7-8 gives only a neutral or minor result, so the strong positive reading rests on Phaladeepika and later authors
Sibling matters remain the weak point even when Rahu is strong (Braha)
planet_in_house/rahu/3.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 9th. Uttara Kalamrita 4.9 does not list the 3rd among Rahu's favourable houses (it lists 4, 7, 8, 10, 11) but reserves the 3rd as Ketu's best house.

source_views.view: Very well placed: adventurous, courageous, firm personality, cravings to communicate, wealth and respect, fulfilment of efforts, organisational skill, literary or artistic talent, long life; the only bad effect is few or unhappy relations with younger siblings.

planet_in_house/rahu/3.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. planet_in_house/rahu/4.summary: Rahu in the 4th disturbs inner contentment, the home and the relationship with the mother, with restless cravings for property and comfort; a minority of texts (Uttara Kalamrita, Chamatkar Chintamani in certain signs) rate it favourable.
common_outcomes: Happiness only occasional; restless or troubled mind (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha)
Difficulties around the mother or her health (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha; Foss name 66)
Strong desire for land or home that is not easily satisfied (Braha)
Fraud suffered or committed; few friends (Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): in Aries, Cancer or Virgo, beneficial results and royal status
Bhrigu Sutras 9-10: many ornaments, two marriages, serves others
Proficiency in foreign (European) languages; subordinate position (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Gemini/Virgo: exceptional homes and a strong, beneficial mother (Braha)

by_area.personality: Foolish in behaviour (Raman HJH; Phaladeepika 8.25); insatiable cravings for worldly benefits that disturb contentment (Braha).
by_area.career: Subordinate service (Hindu Predictive Astrology; Bhrigu Sutras 9-10).
by_area.health: Phaladeepika 8.25 gives short life.
by_area.relationships: Few friends (Raman HJH); two wives (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10).
by_area.family: Mother sickly (Chamatkar Chintamani); mother in distress if Rahu is with a malefic, not with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10); difficulties with a mother who may lead a troubled life (Braha); disputes with relatives or over property (Foss name 81).

strengtheners: Association with a benefic protects the mother (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10)
Rahu in Aries, Cancer or Virgo (Chamatkar Chintamani); Gemini or Virgo (Braha)
Uttara Kalamrita 4.9 lists the 4th among Rahu's favourable houses
Kendra placement connected with a kendra/trikona lord makes the node a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52); BPHS 21.3 (Rahu in an angle leads to religious sacrifices)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 4th aspected by a malefic: suffering in domestic comforts (Jataka Parijata 12.139)
Association with a malefic: mother's distress (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10)
Braha: nodes in any kendra bring many major changes in life
planet_in_house/rahu/4.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 10th. Node dignity is disputed: Raman (Hindu Predictive Astrology) gives Rahu's exaltation as Taurus, while Braha says the only placements agreed upon are Mercury's signs Gemini and Virgo and treats Cancer and Leo as weak for the nodes.

source_views.view: Rahu is favourable in the 7th, 4th, 8th, 11th or 10th house.

source_views.view: Foolish in behaviour, few friends, subject to fraud or guilty of fraudulent action.

source_views.view: Difficulties with a mother who may lead a troubled life; strong desire for land and home but negative for it; education difficulties; powerful cravings that disturb contentment; nodes in kendras bring major life changes. Gemini/Virgo: special homes, fine vehicles, strong beneficial mother.

source_views.view: In the 4th house Rahu is harmful to the mother (66) and gives enmity, e.g. disputes over relatives or property (81); Foss stresses these need not be literal.

planet_in_house/rahu/4.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. planet_in_house/rahu/4.phrasing_guidance: Describe an inner restlessness about home and security that settles with conscious effort; speak about the mother relationship as one needing understanding. Avoid predictions of short life or a mother's illness.

planet_in_house/rahu/5.summary: Rahu in the 5th is traditionally linked with obstacles concerning children (the 'serpent curse' motif), stomach complaints and a hard or unconventional mind, though some sources allow sharp intelligence and a son.
common_outcomes: Few, delayed or lost children, or sorrow through them (Phaladeepika 8.26; Bhrigu Sutras 11-13; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Foss name 77)
Stomach or abdominal complaints, colic, flatulence (Phaladeepika 8.26; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Hard-hearted, narrow or unconventional thinking (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Troubled love affairs (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Childlessness attributed to a serpent's curse, remedied by worship of a Naga image (Phaladeepika 12; Bhrigu Sutras 11-13)
Speaking through the nose (Phaladeepika 8.26)
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): gets a son but worries over the spouse
Foss name 89: in the 5th Rahu gives penetrating, high intelligence

by_area.personality: Hard-hearted (Phaladeepika 8.26); mistaken by others and unfriended, hard-hearted and unconventional (Raman HJH); tyrannical yet polite, narrow-minded (Hindu Predictive Astrology); intelligent but troubled mind, practical, worldly (Braha).
by_area.career: Gemini/Virgo: excellence in sports, politics or crafts (Braha).
by_area.finance: Gemini/Virgo: successful investments (Braha).
by_area.health: Belly-ache (Phaladeepika 8.26); colic and heart trouble (Raman HJH); windy diseases (Bhrigu Sutras 11-13); stomach ailments (Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha).
by_area.relationships: Disturbed love affairs (Braha); Raman HJH: Rahu afflicting the 5th gives strange courtships.
by_area.family: Childless or loss of children (Phaladeepika 8.26; Bhrigu Sutras 11-13); will lose a number of children (Raman HJH).
by_area.spirituality: Not much inclined to spiritual practice (Braha).

strengtheners: Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: extremely intelligent, powerful children, good relations with them (Braha)
Rahu in a trikona connected with a kendra/trikona lord (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52); BPHS 21.3
Bhrigu Sutras 11-13: children after worship of a Naga image (traditional remedy)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 5th with the 5th lord in a dusthana: loss of children (Jataka Parijata 13.12)
Rahu in the 5th (9th from the 9th) with its dispositor in the 8th and the 9th lord debilitated: lack of fortune (BPHS 20.30)
Rahu or Ketu in a trikona associated with the 2nd or 7th lord: harmful in their dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
Moon with a malefic and Rahu in the 5th, 8th or 12th: mental disorders (Raman HJH); Venus with Rahu here gives unusual sexual orientation per Raman HJH
planet_in_house/rahu/5.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 11th. Frawley lists the 5th among Rahu's 'difficult houses' (for remedial measures).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.26 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Speaks through the nose, childless, hard-hearted, suffers from belly-ache.

source_views.view: If Rahu occupies the 5th or joins its lord, childlessness is due to the curse of a serpent (for Ketu, a Brahmin's curse).

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 11-13 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha) 13.12 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1932, vol. II)

source_views.view: Desires for money carried from a past life; intelligent but troubled mind; practical, not spiritual; few children or troubles with them; disturbed love affairs; stomach problems. Gemini/Virgo: very intelligent, powerful children, successful investments.

planet_in_house/rahu/5.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. planet_in_house/rahu/5.phrasing_guidance: Never say someone will have no children or that a child will die. Speak of children possibly being delayed or needing extra care, of a mind that thinks unconventionally, and of attention to digestion. Present the serpent-curse idea only as tradition if asked.

planet_in_house/rahu/6.summary: Rahu in the 6th is widely rated one of its best houses: victory over enemies and rivals, wealth and long life, though sources mention puzzling or chronic ailments.
common_outcomes: Defeats enemies and competitors, few or no enemies (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Frawley)
Wealthy and long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Braha)
Ailments that are hard to diagnose, or of the lower body (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH)
Fame and wealth (Foss name 80)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 8.26: troubled by enemies or by malefic planets (Sastri: 'demons'), with anal disease
Many cousins (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Success through foreigners (Frawley)
Bhrigu Sutras 14-16: tolerant and very happy; with the Moon, liaisons with women of high (royal) family

by_area.personality: Tolerant and very happy (Bhrigu Sutras 14-16); powerful and virile (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.career: Excels in detail work and service jobs, health or catering fields (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha).
by_area.health: Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Braha); sickness of a puzzling nature (Raman HJH); can contribute to nervous-system disorders (Frawley); Rahu or Ketu in the 6th/8th causes stomach disorders (Santhanam's note to BPHS 17.3-5).
by_area.relationships: Raman HJH: private life may become scandalous.
by_area.family: Many cousins (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).

strengtheners: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th aspected by benefics destroys all evils (Saravali 12.3-5; Raman HJH)
Malefics in upachaya houses (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16; Braha)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo heightens the benefits (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon and Saturn joining Rahu here: liability to mental strain (Raman HJH)
Rahu aspected by Mars in the 6th or 8th: boils/carbuncles (Phaladeepika 14)
Rahu or Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th associated with the lords of those houses: harm during their dasas (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 17-18)
Phaladeepika 19.15 makes Rahu's dasa fully good only when Rahu is in a house other than 6, 8 or 12
planet_in_house/rahu/6.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 12th. Frawley (houses chapter) singles out the 6th as a good house for Rahu, yet in his remedies chapter lists it among Rahu's difficult houses.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.26 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)

planet_in_house/rahu/7.summary: Rahu in the 7th brings intense, unconventional or unsettled partnerships: classical texts warn of loss through relationships and of separation or remarriage, while a few sources rate the 7th as favourable for worldly gains through others.
common_outcomes: Disturbance, strife or separation in marriage (Phaladeepika 8.26; Bhrigu Sutras 17-21; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha; Foss names 78-79)
Unconventional or foreign partner/associations (Raman HJH; Braha)
Loss of wealth through relationships (Phaladeepika 8.26; Phaladeepika 10.2 with the Sun)
Luxurious habits, rich food (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
rare_outcomes: Remarriage after the loss of the first spouse (Bhrigu Sutras 17-21; Braha citing the scriptures)
Diabetes and the spouse's reproductive-health troubles (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Uttara Kalamrita 4.9: Rahu is favourable in the 7th

planet_in_house/rahu/7.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 29-30 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 11th: blessed with children and wealthy.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 11th (Rahu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Acquires wealth through foreigners and has happiness from children.

source_views.source: Saravali (Kalyana Varma) 12.3-5 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th aspected by benefics removes all evils.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa) Kanda I, section 4, sloka 9 (tr. S.S. Sareen)
source_views.view: Rahu is favourable when in the 11th.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 21.11 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1)
source_views.view: Rahu with the Sun, Saturn and Mars in the 11th: cessation of one's duties (a four-planet combination).

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the eleventh house ('Planets in the Eleventh House')
source_views.view: Distinguished in army or navy, famous, wealthy, learned; few children; ear afflictions; much wealth from foreign countries.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Wealthy, influential among working people, many children, good agriculturist.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Rahu in the 11th house' section
source_views.view: An excellent placement: wealth, profits, community respect, powerful friends, opportunities, ambitions fulfilled; difficulties with the eldest sibling; scriptures say few children (Ketu in 5th).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

planet_in_house/rahu/11.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika and Raman HJH say few children; Hindu Predictive Astrology and Bhrigu Sutras say many or blessed with children.
planet_in_house/rahu/11.phrasing_guidance: Describe strong networks and gains, especially through broad or international circles; suggest balancing ambition with attention to children and creative life (Ketu in the 5th).

planet_in_house/rahu/12.summary: Rahu in the 12th is classically a placement of heavy or hidden expenditure and secret wrongdoing, with eye trouble; modern readings add foreign residence, sudden expenses, and, in some views, spiritual leanings.
common_outcomes: Heavy or wasteful expenditure, many losses (Phaladeepika 8.27; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Rath)
Secret wrongdoing (Phaladeepika 8.27; Braha citing scriptures)
Eye trouble (Bhrigu Sutras 31-32; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Few children (Bhrigu Sutras 31-32; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
rare_outcomes: Water-related disease (Phaladeepika 8.27)
Prosperous and helpful, though of loose morals (Raman HJH)
Saintly (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Gemini/Virgo: thrift, success abroad (Braha)

by_area.personality: Helpful by nature (Raman HJH); saintly (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.career: Unsuccessful undertakings (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras).
by_area.finance: Spends much (Phaladeepika 8.27); wealth wasted (Braha); sudden unwanted expenditures that may tempt one towards illegitimate gains (Rath); prosperous (Raman HJH) versus poor (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.health: Water-disease (Phaladeepika 8.27); eye troubles (Bhrigu Sutras; Raman HJH; Braha); left ear or eye (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Friendship with ill-intentioned people (Chamatkar Chintamani); little sexual pleasure in an inimical sign (Braha).
by_area.family: Few children (Bhrigu Sutras 31-32; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.spirituality: Saintly (Hindu Predictive Astrology); Bhrigu Sutras 31-32 and Braha's scriptural summary describe an unpleasant after-death state.

strengtheners: Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: thrift, foreign success, a 'heavenly' state after death (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 12th with Mars, Saturn and the Sun is a classical bad combination for the after-life (BPHS 23.9)
Moon with a malefic and Rahu in the 12th, 8th or 5th: mental disorders (Raman HJH)
Rahu or Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th associated with those houses' lords: harm in their dasas (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 17-18)
Rahu in a dusthana spoils its dasa (Phaladeepika 19.15)
planet_in_house/rahu/12.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 6th. Frawley lists the 12th among Rahu's difficult houses. Raman HJH also cites a combination (Sun in 7th, Mars in 10th, Rahu in 12th) for early loss of the father.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.27 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Commits sins secretly, spends much, suffers from a water-related disease.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 31-32 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 12th: few children, eye troubles, an unhappy after-life.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 12th (Rahu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Poor, unsuccessful in undertakings, friendly with evil-minded people.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 23.9 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1)
source_views.view: Rahu in the 12th with Mars, Saturn and the Sun: the native 'goes to hell' (combination; the 12th as house of the after-life).

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events (Sagar), discussion of 11th/12th house and gains
source_views.view: A malefic Rahu in the 12th gives various unwanted and sudden expenditures that tempt the native towards illegal gains.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the twelfth house ('Planets in the Twelfth House')
source_views.view: Prosperous, immoral but of a helpful nature, eye troubles.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Deformed, few children, defective sight, very many losses, saintly.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Rahu in the 12th house' section
source_views.view: Spends whatever is gained; scriptures say wealth is wasted and sins committed; left ear/eye problems; little sexual pleasure in inimical signs. Gemini/Virgo: thrift, foreign success, good after-death state.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. on remedial measures for Rahu (pp. ~256-257)
source_views.view: The 12th is among Rahu's difficult houses calling for remedies.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

planet_in_house/rahu/12.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Raman HJH calls the native prosperous and Hindu Predictive Astrology 'saintly', against the losses and secret wrongdoing in Phaladeepika, Chamatkar Chintamani and Braha.
planet_in_house/rahu/12.phrasing_guidance: Frame as a call for budgeting, sleep hygiene and healthy outlets for escapism; mention travel or life abroad as possibilities. Do not discuss after-death states or label the person immoral.

planet_in_house/saturn/1.summary: In the lagna Saturn is judged chiefly by sign: in its own or exaltation sign (and, per some texts, Jupiter's signs) the classics promise rank like a village or city head; elsewhere they describe a hard, slow start, low vitality and a sober, serious temperament.
common_outcomes: Serious, grave, patient temperament; progress slow but steady (Raman HJH)
Difficult childhood or early misfortune when Saturn is not in a dignified sign (Phaladeepika 8.20; Saravali 30.74; Raman HJH)
Leaning, thin or low-vitality constitution in the classical descriptions (Brihat Jataka 20.9; Raman HJH; Braha)
Indolence or inactive habits named by several texts (Phaladeepika 8.20; Saravali 30.74; Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Status equal to a king, chief or city head when Saturn is in own/exaltation sign in the lagna (Phaladeepika 8.20; Saravali 30.74; Brihat Jataka 20.9 adds Sagittarius and Pisces and calls the native a scholar and handsome)
Bhrigu Sutras 1-7: in the sign of the 4th or 10th lord the native is very fortunate (Maharaja yoga); in Libra, lordship over a village/town with agricultural prosperity
Bhrigu Sutras 1-7: Saturn in the lagna aspected by the Moon (with no benefic aspect) is said to make one live by begging
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras commentary): large properties and prosperity, but greedy and narrow-minded; humiliates enemies

by_area.personality: Calm, grave and serious; self-confidence justified and moral stability marked when Saturn is unafflicted; may copy foreign customs (Raman HJH). Braha: mature, disciplined, humble, with an ascetic, non-attached streak.
by_area.career: Progress in any venture slow but certain; losses through negligence or missed opportunity are possible (Raman HJH). Well placed, Braha says the person can become a leader or politician of high status.
by_area.finance: Poverty or indigence is the classical complaint outside own/exaltation signs (Phaladeepika 8.20; Brihat Jataka 20.9); Bhrigu Sutras gives agricultural and financial prosperity in Libra.
by_area.health: Rheumatic and bilious complaints (Bhrigu Sutras 1); childhood illness (Brihat Jataka 20.9; Saravali 30.74); weak, emaciated body (Raman HJH); bone-related ailments and thinness (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Saturn's aspect from the lagna falls on the 7th, which Braha says harms married life.
by_area.spirituality: Braha: Saturn here gives an ascetic, non-attached nature that cares little for worldly desire.

strengtheners: Saturn in Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius in the lagna (Phaladeepika 8.20; Saravali 30.74; Brihat Jataka 20.9)
Saturn in Sagittarius or Pisces in the lagna (Brihat Jataka 20.9; Uttara Kalamrita 4.16 says Saturn in a Jupiter sign does only good even in the lagna)
Saturn in the lagna in the sign of the 4th or 10th lord, i.e. Sagittarius or Pisces lagna (Bhrigu Sutras 1-7 with commentary)
Benefic (Jupiter/Venus) aspect cancels the Moon-aspect 'begging' result (Bhrigu Sutras 1-7)
Own or exaltation sign in a kendra forms Sasa yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in Aries (debilitated) in the lagna: sickly, low vitality and ambition, poor start in life (Braha)
Any sign other than own/exaltation (or Jupiter's) brings the hardship version (Phaladeepika 8.20; Brihat Jataka 20.9; Saravali 30.74)
Affliction to Saturn removes the 'welfare of others' quality and leaves the foreign-imitation trait (Raman HJH)
Moon's aspect on lagna-Saturn without benefic aspect (Bhrigu Sutras 1-7)
planet_in_house/saturn/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Saturn rising in Libra is yogakaraka (lord of 4th and 5th) for Libra lagna; Capricorn lagna is better than Aquarius lagna because in Aquarius Saturn also rules the 12th. Raman HJH says the same results follow if Saturn only aspects the lagna. Braha: effects intensify the closer Saturn is to the ascendant degree; Saturn 'gives its full effects in the 36th year'.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.20 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Own or exaltation sign in the lagna: on a par with a king, chief or mayor. Any other sign: sorrow and misery from childhood, indigence, slovenliness and indolence.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (Varahamihira) 20.9 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Outside Sagittarius, Pisces, Aquarius, Capricorn and Libra: poor, sickly, love-stricken, unclean, ill in childhood, indistinct speech. In those five signs: equal to a king, village headman or city mayor, learned and handsome.

source_views.source: Saravali (Kalyana Varma) 30.74 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Own or exaltation sign: equals a king or heads a country or city; other signs: misery in boyhood, unclean disposition, indolence.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa) Kanda I, section 4, sloka 16 (tr. S.S. Sareen)
source_views.view: Saturn in exaltation, own sign or a sign of Jupiter does only good even if in the lagna.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 8 (Saturn), sutras 1-7 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rheumatic and bilious diseases; in Libra, lordship of village/town and agricultural prosperity; in own sign, a rich father; in the sign of the 4th/10th lord, Maharaja yoga; aspected by the Moon (no benefic aspect), livelihood by begging. Commentator adds that Saturn in the lagna generally gives prosperity and long life and that own/exalted Saturn here forms Sasa yoga.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 1st house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Large properties and prosperity, but greedy, sorrowful and narrow-minded; humiliates enemies.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the first house ('Planets in the First House')
source_views.view: Foreign customs easily copied; if unafflicted, concern for others' welfare, justified self-confidence, moral stability; calm, grave and serious; body weak; slow but certain progress; some aversion to responsibility; inactive habits; early-life misfortunes. Same if Saturn aspects the lagna.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Lists foreign habits, a strong but cunning and thrifty mind, aspiring and curious nature, sickliness and flatulence among the traits, alongside several moral faults.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Saturn in the 1st house' section
source_views.view: Health problems, delays and ups and downs unless well placed; Libra, Capricorn, Aquarius, Sagittarius and Pisces give a very long life and leadership; thin, bone ailments, slow and serious; aspect on 7th harms marriage; ascetic and non-attached; debilitated in Aries the person is sickly and starts life badly.

planet_in_house/saturn/1.disagreements: Which signs count as 'good' differs: Phaladeepika and Saravali name only own and exaltation signs; Brihat Jataka adds Sagittarius and Pisces; Uttara Kalamrita names Jupiter's signs generally. Bhrigu Sutras emphasises disease and a rich father in own sign, which its own commentator questions (the 1st house does not signify father). Raman HJH gives a largely positive character picture (moral stability, steady progress), while Raman's Hindu Predictive Astrology lists mostly negative traits for the same placement.
planet_in_house/saturn/1.phrasing_guidance: Lead with dignity: if Saturn is in Libra, Capricorn, Aquarius, Sagittarius or Pisces, describe steady, earned authority. Otherwise frame it as a slow start that improves with age and discipline. Avoid predicting poverty, illness or begging; speak of energy management and patience, never of disease.

planet_in_house/saturn/2.summary: Saturn in the 2nd strains early finances, family warmth and speech, with several texts promising wealth and comforts later, often away from the native place; for lagnas where Saturn is a functional benefic the financial picture is reversed.
common_outcomes: Money comes slowly and with much work (Raman HJH; Braha; Bhrigu Sutras 8-9)
Harsh or reserved speech; unsocial manner (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Unattractive or afflicted face, or mouth/eye complaints (Phaladeepika 8.21; Saravali 30.75; Bhrigu Sutras 8-9; Braha)
Wealth, vehicles and comforts later in life, often after moving away or abroad (Phaladeepika 8.21; Saravali 30.75; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka (Sun's 2nd-house result applied to Saturn): immensely rich but deprived of wealth by the ruler
Bhrigu Sutras 8-9: two marriages; with a malefic, misconduct with women and charge of a religious institution (matha); no lands
Gains through metals, storage, mines and labour (Raman HJH); coal, wood, metal, mining (Braha)

by_area.personality: Harsh in speech, unsocial and sorrowful, coming across many opportunities but seldom taking them (Raman HJH).
by_area.career: Gain by dealing with metals, storage, mines or labour (Raman HJH); hard-labour trades (Braha).
by_area.finance: Earning is an uphill struggle, much work for little gain, unless the 2nd is Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius (Raman HJH); financial stringency (Bhrigu Sutras 8-9); later accumulation (Phaladeepika 8.21; Saravali 30.75).
by_area.health: Eye trouble (Bhrigu Sutras 8-9); right-eye, mouth, teeth or gum complaints (Braha); disease of the face (Brihat Jataka via 20.1).
by_area.relationships: Bhrigu Sutras 8-9 speaks of two marriages; Hindu Predictive Astrology also lists two wives.
by_area.family: Unhappy family life (Raman HJH; Braha); 'devoid of his own men' (Saravali 30.75).

strengtheners: Saturn in Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius in the 2nd: slow but steady wealth, learning, dedication to family (Raman HJH; Braha)
Lagnas where Saturn rules good houses: Aries, Taurus, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn (Bhrigu Sutras commentary); Libra, Virgo, Taurus, Capricorn (Braha)
Saturn lord of a good house in the 2nd lets the late-life prosperity of Phaladeepika/Saravali materialise (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in Aries in the 2nd: poverty, hard or deceitful work, disturbed family, eye defect (Braha)
Association with a malefic (Bhrigu Sutras 8-9)
planet_in_house/saturn/2.lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary gives a lagna-by-lagna list where Saturn in the 2nd still brings good finances (e.g. Taurus lagna: Saturn as 9th-10th lord; Libra lagna: 4th-5th lord). Braha notes Saturn's aspect on the 8th from here supports longevity and that full effects show around the 36th year.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.21 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Ugly face, without wealth, follows improper ways; later in life lives in a foreign country with vehicles, wealth and enjoyments.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (Varahamihira) 20.9 with 20.1 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Brihat Jataka 20.9 gives Saturn's lagna result explicitly and says that in the other houses Saturn gives the same results as the Sun (20.1-3): immensely rich but deprived of wealth by the ruler, with diseases of the face.

source_views.source: Saravali (Kalyana Varma) 30.75 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Ugly face, enjoys worldly prosperity, devoid of his own people, dispenses justice; later goes to other countries and earns money and conveyances.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 8, sutras 8-9 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Financial stringency, two wives, no lands, eye troubles; with a malefic, misconduct with women and charge of a matha. Commentator lists lagnas where finances will nonetheless be good.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 2nd house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Harsh speech; acquires wealth after separating from family and leaving the native place.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the second house ('Planets in the Second House')
source_views.view: Unless the 2nd is Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius, earning is uphill; harsh speech, unsocial, sorrowful, aimless; unhappy family life; gains through metals, storage, mines, labour; unpopular.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Two wives, diseased face, unpopular, broken education, weak sight, unsocial, harsh or stammering speech, fondness for drink.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Saturn in the 2nd house' section
source_views.view: Poor and hard-working for money, education suffers, mouth/teeth/right-eye issues, family life marred; long-lived; earns from coal, wood, metal, mining; leaves native place later. Negatives do not apply for Libra, Virgo, Taurus or Capricorn lagnas; in own/exaltation, slow steady wealth and learning.

planet_in_house/saturn/2.disagreements: Brihat Jataka (via the Sun rule) makes the native very rich though wealth is taken by the ruler, and Saravali says he 'enjoys worldly prosperity', whereas Phaladeepika, Bhrigu Sutras, Raman and Braha describe early poverty or uphill earning. Most agree on later or foreign gains. Raman excepts Libra/Capricorn/Aquarius in the 2nd; Braha and the Bhrigu Sutras commentator except whole lagnas instead.
planet_in_house/saturn/2.phrasing_guidance: Describe money as built slowly through persistence, with improvement later in life or after relocation. Speak of measured, careful speech rather than 'harsh' speech. Do not predict two marriages; mention family responsibilities gently.

planet_in_house/saturn/3.summary: Saturn in the 3rd, an upachaya house, is broadly favourable: courage, intelligence and eventual success after early setbacks, while relations with (especially younger) siblings tend to be distant or burdened.
common_outcomes: Courageous, bold and enduring (Saravali 30.76; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Good intellect (Phaladeepika 8.21; Brihat Jataka via 20.2; Saravali 30.76)
Loss, absence or strain with brothers/younger siblings (Bhrigu Sutras 10-13; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Success only after disappointments and reverses; improves with age (Raman HJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Honoured by rulers; may head local boards or municipalities and protect many (Raman HJH)
Phaladeepika 8.21: happy with his wife, generous, yet inactive and overcome with sorrow
Bhrigu Sutras 10-13: livelihood through undesirable trades; in own/exaltation sign many brothers
Literary or communication talent (Braha)

by_area.personality: Brave, eccentric, prone to gloom and misgiving that lifts with age (Raman HJH); conservative in action, strong-willed (Braha); intelligent and charitable (Saravali 30.76).
by_area.career: May become head of local bodies (Raman HJH); success late, hard physical work possible, talent in writing or communications (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); Bhrigu Sutras commentary: a malefic in an upachaya house gives wealth.
by_area.health: Possible right-ear problem (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Phaladeepika 8.21: happy with his wife.
by_area.family: Sorrow through brothers or loss of brothers (Raman HJH; Bhrigu Sutras 10-13); enmity with siblings if Saturn is with a malefic (Bhrigu Sutras 10-13); few younger siblings, relations distant (Braha).

strengtheners: Saturn in own sign or exaltation: many brothers (Bhrigu Sutras 10-13); powerful, motivated, gradually rising (Braha)
General rule that malefics thrive in upachaya houses (Bhrigu Sutras commentary; Braha; Uttara Kalamrita 4.16)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn afflicted: despondency can deepen into mental affliction (Raman HJH)
Saturn with a malefic: hostility to siblings (Bhrigu Sutras 10-13)
Saturn in Aries: suffering through siblings, stagnant life, efforts fail (Braha)
planet_in_house/saturn/3.lagna_or_context_notes: Saturn here aspects the 5th, 9th and 12th. Uttara Kalamrita 4.16 states malefics are auspicious in upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.21 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Very intelligent, liberal, happy with his wife, but inactive and overcome with sorrow.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (Varahamihira) 20.9 with 20.2 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Brihat Jataka 20.9 gives Saturn's lagna result explicitly and says that in the other houses Saturn gives the same results as the Sun (20.1-3): a good intellect and great strength.

source_views.source: Saravali (Kalyana Varma) 30.76 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Dark complexion, physically clean, base, with indolent attendants, courageous, charitable and highly intelligent.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 8, sutras 10-13 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Loss of (or no younger) brothers, livelihood through undesirable trades; own/exaltation sign gives many brothers; with a malefic, enmity towards brothers. Commentator: as a malefic in an upachaya house Saturn makes one courageous and wealthy.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 3rd house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Unhappy on account of brothers; ambitious; a good orator; many obstacles in life.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the third house ('Planets in the Third House')
source_views.view: Brave, wealthy, loss of brothers, eccentric; honoured by rulers, may head local bodies, protects many; success only after reverses; gloomy mind that improves with age.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Intelligent, wealthy, loss of brothers, polite, adventurous, bold, eccentric, courageous, obliging; agriculture.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Saturn in the 3rd house' section
source_views.view: Few or distant younger siblings; desires succeed only after initial failures; hard work with no help; courageous and protective; literary or arts talent; possible right-ear issue.

planet_in_house/saturn/3.disagreements: Phaladeepika alone calls the native inactive and sorrowful despite intelligence; the others stress courage and effort. Bhrigu Sutras says own/exalted Saturn gives many brothers, while Braha says even then siblings are few (but of good character).
planet_in_house/saturn/3.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a placement of grit: results come through sustained effort and grow with age. Mention sibling relationships as an area needing patience, not as loss.

planet_in_house/saturn/4.summary: Saturn in the 4th is one of its harder classical placements, reducing domestic happiness, comfort, property and the mother's welfare; the results reverse where Saturn is dignified or a functional benefic (e.g. Taurus and Libra lagnas).
common_outcomes: Unhappiness or lack of domestic comfort (Phaladeepika 8.22; Brihat Jataka via 20.2; Jataka Parijata 12.140; Raman HJH)
Mother's welfare or closeness affected (Phaladeepika 8.22; Bhrigu Sutras 14-21; Raman HJH; Braha)
Troubles with houses and vehicles; few fixed assets (Phaladeepika 8.22; Raman HJH; Braha)
Sickliness in early years (Phaladeepika 8.22; Saravali 30.77; Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Heart complaint or 'broken-heartedness' (Saravali 30.77; Braha)
Prominent nails and hair (Saravali 30.77)
Bhrigu Sutras 14-21: in own/exaltation sign, horses and prestigious conveyances; if Saturn is lagna lord, a long-lived mother and all comforts
Success in foreign countries and good patrimony (Hindu Predictive Astrology)

by_area.personality: Lethargic temperament with a wish for a secluded life (Raman HJH); overly serious (Braha).
by_area.finance: Will not inherit property (Raman HJH) versus 'good patrimony' (Hindu Predictive Astrology); Dhana yoga for Aries, Taurus and Libra lagnas (Bhrigu Sutras commentary).
by_area.health: Sickly early years (Phaladeepika 8.22; Saravali 30.77); windy and phlegmatic complaints (Raman HJH); heart trouble (Saravali 30.77; Braha).
by_area.relationships: Disliked by relatives (Raman HJH); devoid of relatives (Saravali 30.77).
by_area.family: Deprived of the mother or her happiness (Phaladeepika 8.22; Raman HJH); with the 8th lord, loss of mother and happiness (Bhrigu Sutras 14-21); interrupted education (Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Own/exaltation Saturn here can make one extraordinarily spiritual and unattached (Braha).

strengtheners: Saturn in own or exaltation sign: mother and comforts protected, fine conveyances (Bhrigu Sutras 14-21; Braha); Sasa yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Saturn as lagna lord in the 4th: long-lived mother and comforts (Bhrigu Sutras 14-21)
Taurus and Libra lagnas: happiness and plentiful real estate (Braha); Aries, Taurus, Libra lagnas form Dhana yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Benefic aspect or association (Raman HJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Association with the 8th lord (Bhrigu Sutras 14-21)
Saturn in Aries: extreme unhappiness, poor education, no inheritance (Braha)
Conjunction with the Moon raises concern for the mother (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
planet_in_house/saturn/4.lagna_or_context_notes: Jataka Parijata 12.140 adds that any malefic in the 4th brings misfortune and Saturn specifically removes comfort and happiness. Saturn aspects the 6th, 10th and 1st from here.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.22 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Unhappy, houseless, without vehicles, deprived of the mother, sickly in early years.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (Varahamihira) 20.9 with 20.2 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Brihat Jataka 20.9 gives Saturn's lagna result explicitly and says that in the other houses Saturn gives the same results as the Sun (20.1-3): no happiness and a troubled mind.

source_views.source: Saravali (Kalyana Varma) 30.77 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Heart disease or broken-heartedness; devoid of relatives, conveyances, wealth, intelligence and happiness; sickly in boyhood; prominent nails and hair.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha) 12.140 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1932, vol. II)
source_views.view: Saturn in the 4th causes loss of comfort and happiness.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 8, sutras 14-21 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Loss of mother and a stepmother, avoided if Saturn is in own/exaltation sign (then fine conveyances); as lagna lord, long-lived mother and comforts; with the 8th lord, loss of mother and happiness.
