source_views.view: A strong 9th lord in the 4th with Venus gives long-lasting pleasure and opulence; a 9th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, even with a benefic, gives only short-lived happiness.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XIV.97
source_views.view: If the 9th lord is in a kendra or trikona in great strength and the lagna is aspected by its own lord, good fortunes come in a crowd.

lord_in_house/9/4.disagreements: None on the core. Raman's printed text says the afflicted case 'may not have any domestic unhappiness', which contradicts the rest of his sentence; read it as domestic unhappiness.
lord_in_house/9/4.phrasing_guidance: Present as a placement for domestic blessings, property and peace of mind. Do not promise specific property gains; mention that timing comes through dashas.

lord_in_house/9/5.summary: Lord of one trikona in another trikona: fortune through children, intelligence, devotion and merit from past actions. Widely regarded as one of the best placements for the 9th lord.
common_outcomes: good fortune through children (BPHS 24.101); children fortunate and distinguished (Raman HTJH; Braha)
a prosperous and famous father (Raman HTJH)
learned, righteous, devoted to teachers (BPHS 24.101)
knowledge of scripture and mantra; finds a good guru (Braha)
wealth from investments (Braha)
rare_outcomes: common in charts of famous saints; may become a spiritual teacher or head a religious organisation (Braha)
Frawley (Example Charts: Gloria Steinem, Libra lagna): the 9th lord Mercury in the 5th with Saturn gives power of advice and writing ability

by_area.personality: Wise, righteous, devoted to teachers and elders (BPHS 24.101); highly intelligent (Braha).
by_area.career: Advisory and writing ability (Frawley, Steinem chart); spiritual teaching (Braha).
by_area.finance: Great wealth from investments (Braha).
by_area.family: Children fortunate and successful (Raman HTJH; Braha); father prosperous and famous (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: Blessed with divine grace; knowledge of scriptures and mantras; strong dharma (Braha).

strengtheners: strong in a trikona with the lagna aspected by its own lord: fortunes come in a crowd (JP 14.97)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: dual lordship of the 6th, 8th or 12th mixes results (BPHS 24.146-147)
lord_in_house/9/5.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries (Jupiter, 9th+12th) and Libra (Mercury, 9th+12th) the 9th lord also owns the 12th; Frawley (pp. 159-160) says a 12th lordship mainly gives the results of the other house ruled, which supports a good reading here.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.101
source_views.view: Good fortune through children, devoted to teachers, learned and righteous.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: A prosperous and famous father; the native's sons fortunate and distinguished.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: One of the finest placements: lucky, wealthy, divine grace, knowledge of scripture and mantra, a good guru, wealth from investments, successful children; common in charts of saints and spiritual teachers.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Gloria Steinem
source_views.view: Mercury as 9th lord in the 5th with Saturn (Libra lagna) gives power of advice and writing abilities.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action' (dual house rulership, Raja yoga), pp. 159-161
source_views.view: A planet ruling two houses gives mixed results, weighted by its mulatrikona sign: Saturn as 8th and 9th lord for Gemini is on the whole more positive than negative; the 12th lordship mainly gives the results of the other house ruled; lords of the 9th and 10th create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XIV.97
source_views.view: If the 9th lord is in a kendra or trikona in great strength and the lagna is aspected by its own lord, good fortunes come in a crowd.

lord_in_house/9/5.disagreements: None: BPHS, Raman and Braha all treat it as one of the best placements.
lord_in_house/9/5.phrasing_guidance: Celebrate wisdom, devotion and joy through children or students. Never make fertility or childbirth predictions; say only that children are a traditional area of blessing.

lord_in_house/9/6.summary: The fortune lord in a dusthana: classical and modern sources agree that luck is reduced, with enemies, debts or a troubled father, though a strong lord limits the harm and Braha sees good jobs and helpers.
common_outcomes: little fortune; trouble from enemies (BPHS 24.102; Braha)
a sickly or troubled father (Raman HTJH; Braha)
lack of support from maternal relatives (BPHS 24.102), though Braha gives benefits from a maternal uncle
good jobs, workers and servants (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika's Nirbhagya yoga (9th lord in 6/8/12): loss of ancestral property, disregard for elders, poverty; stated as a traditional view
benefics flanking the 6th: gains when the father's legal problems end favourably (Raman HTJH)
the father may work in medicine or healing (Braha)

by_area.career: Gets good jobs (Braha); when afflicted, efforts to make one's fortune may be frustrated by litigation or the father's debts (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Little fortune (BPHS 24.102; Braha).
by_area.family: Father sickly or troubled (Raman HTJH; Braha); maternal relatives unsupportive (BPHS 24.102), or a maternal uncle helps (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Little faith or appreciation of religion (Braha); Nirbhagya yoga includes irreligion (Phaladeepika 6.66).

strengtheners: 9th lord strong despite the dusthana (Phaladeepika 15.9: a strong lord there causes only slight harm; Raman HTJH: a very powerful 9th lord confers fortune even from a malefic house)
benefic aspect on the 9th lord or 9th house (Phaladeepika 15.5; Raman HTJH: a well-disposed 9th house reduces the harm)
benefics flanking the 6th (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: weak, debilitated or combust 9th lord (Phaladeepika 15.9: a weak lord in a dusthana causes great harm)
malefic affliction: fortune frustrated by litigation or the father's debts (Raman HTJH)
JP 12.86: a 9th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, even with a benefic, gives only short-lived happiness
lord_in_house/9/6.lagna_or_context_notes: For Cancer (Jupiter, 6th+9th) and Capricorn (Mercury, 6th+9th) lagnas the lord occupies its own sign here, and BPHS 24.146-147 says both lordships act. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.102
source_views.view: Little fortune, lacks support from maternal relatives, troubled by enemies.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.66 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: When the 9th lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, Nirbhagya yoga: loss of ancestral property, disrespect to elders, irreligion, poverty.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 15.5, 15.9 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: A house whose lord is in a dusthana suffers unless aspected by a benefic; a weak lord there does great harm, a strong one only slight harm.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: A sickly father; benefics flanking the 6th bring gains when the father's legal troubles end; malefics frustrate fortune through litigation or the father's debts.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Troubles with or a sickly father, little faith or luck, good workers and jobs, powerful enemies, little travel, benefits from a maternal uncle.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII, closing note to the ninth-lord results
source_views.view: The ninth-lord results are general; a very powerful 9th lord can confer fortune even from a malefic house, and if the 9th lord is afflicted but the 9th house is well disposed the bad results are much reduced. Literal application is warned against.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XII.86
source_views.view: A strong 9th lord in the 4th with Venus gives long-lasting pleasure and opulence; a 9th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, even with a benefic, gives only short-lived happiness.

lord_in_house/9/6.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata, Raman and Braha are all negative on fortune. They differ on maternal relatives (BPHS: no support; Braha: benefits from a maternal uncle). Raman's closing note and Phaladeepika 15.9 both say a strong 9th lord limits the harm.
lord_in_house/9/6.phrasing_guidance: Say fortune may need persistence and that challenges can be met through service and skill. Present 'poverty/misfortune' only as a traditional caution that depends on the lord's strength. No health claims about the father.

lord_in_house/9/7.summary: Fortune through marriage, partners and the public: a kendra-trikona link that classically brings happiness from the spouse and fame.
common_outcomes: happiness through marriage; a noble, lucky, devoted or wealthy spouse (BPHS 24.103; Raman HTJH; Braha)
may go abroad and prosper there (Raman HTJH)
famous and virtuous (BPHS 24.103)
successful business partnerships and benefits from the spouse's family (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 20.9: 9th lord in the 7th joined or aspected by Jupiter makes the person devoted to the father
with ascetic yogas in the chart, seeks spiritual guidance and fulfilment abroad (Raman HTJH)
the 9th lord aspects the lagna from here, giving health, good looks and respect (Braha)

by_area.personality: Virtuous and famous (BPHS 24.103); fortunate and respected (Braha).
by_area.career: Successful partnerships (Braha); prosperity abroad (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Benefits from the spouse's family (Braha).
by_area.relationships: A noble and lucky wife (Raman HTJH); a religious, devoted or wealthy spouse (Braha); happiness through marriage (BPHS 24.103).
by_area.family: Devoted to the father when Jupiter is involved (BPHS 20.9); a powerful father who also may prosper abroad (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Seeks spiritual guidance abroad when ascetic yogas are present (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: Jupiter's conjunction or aspect (BPHS 20.9)
strong in a kendra with the lagna aspected by its own lord (JP 14.97)
weakeners_or_cancellations: inauspicious yogas spoiling the 9th lord bring a traditional father-related caution about foreign lands (Raman HTJH); never predict
lord_in_house/9/7.lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Saturn (8th+9th) occupies the 7th; BPHS 24.146-147 says both lordships act, while Frawley (pp. 159-160) argues Saturn's 9th-house (mulatrikona) role dominates for Gemini.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.103
source_views.view: Happiness through marriage, famous, virtuous.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 20.9
source_views.view: 9th lord in the 7th joined or aspected by Jupiter: devoted to the father.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: May go abroad and prosper; the father may also prosper abroad; a noble, lucky wife; with ascetic yogas, spiritual fulfilment abroad.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: A wealthy, beautiful or devoted spouse, benefits from the spouse's family, successful partnerships, a powerful father; the 9th lord aspects the lagna, so healthy, fortunate and respected.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XIV.97
source_views.view: If the 9th lord is in a kendra or trikona in great strength and the lagna is aspected by its own lord, good fortunes come in a crowd.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action' (dual house rulership, Raja yoga), pp. 159-161
source_views.view: A planet ruling two houses gives mixed results, weighted by its mulatrikona sign: Saturn as 8th and 9th lord for Gemini is on the whole more positive than negative; the 12th lordship mainly gives the results of the other house ruled; lords of the 9th and 10th create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses.

lord_in_house/9/7.disagreements: None on the core. Raman alone stresses going abroad and prospering there.
lord_in_house/9/7.phrasing_guidance: Speak of partners and marriage as a source of support and growth. Do not promise a marriage date or describe the spouse with certainty.

lord_in_house/9/8.summary: The fortune lord in the house of upheaval: all sources see luck that is spoiled or must be worked hard for and a difficult story with the father, with inheritance, legacies and occult knowledge as the compensations.
common_outcomes: limited fortune; rewards need strict perseverance (BPHS 24.104; Braha)
no happiness from elder siblings (BPHS 24.104)
a hard life for the father or early loss of him (Raman HTJH; Braha; traditional, never predict)
gains through wills, legacies or a partner's wealth (Braha); with benefic influence, substantial paternal inheritance (Raman HTJH)
strong intuition and knowledge of occult subjects (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika's Nirbhagya yoga (9th lord in 6/8/12) as a traditional caution
BPHS 20.30: a debilitated 9th lord in the 8th shows lack of fortune
JP 14.89: the 9th lord in the 8th aspected by a debilitated or inimical planet, or itself debilitated or in a malefic amsa, makes one unlucky
afflictions may lead the native to abandon family traditions or damage religious trusts set up by the family (Raman HTJH)

by_area.finance: Fortune is limited (BPHS 24.104); gains from legacies, wills or a partner's wealth (Braha); severe poverty and heavy responsibility if the 8th is afflicted (Raman HTJH).
by_area.relationships: Gains from the partner's wealth (Braha).
by_area.family: No happiness from elder siblings (BPHS 24.104); the father's life may be hard (Braha); inheritance of paternal property with benefic influence (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: Little faith in conventional religion but strong intuition and occult knowledge (Braha); affliction can mean abandoning family traditions (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: strong 9th lord (Phaladeepika 15.9; Raman HTJH: a very powerful 9th lord confers fortune even from a malefic house)
benefic influence on the 9th lord: paternal inheritance (Raman HTJH); benefic aspect on the 9th house or lord (Phaladeepika 15.5)
own-sign case: for Gemini lagna Saturn owns the 8th and 9th and sits in its own sign Capricorn here
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation (BPHS 20.30; JP 14.89) or combustion
conjunction with the 8th lord is called a difficult combination in BPHS 20.13
malefics afflicting the 8th: poverty and heavy responsibility (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/9/8.lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Saturn (8th+9th) is in its own sign Capricorn here; Frawley (pp. 159-160) holds that Saturn's 9th-house mulatrikona role dominates for Gemini, supporting a milder reading. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.104
source_views.view: Limited fortune; no happiness from elder siblings.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 20.30
source_views.view: 9th lord in the 8th and debilitated: lacks fortune.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.66 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Nirbhagya yoga for the 9th lord in a dusthana: loss of ancestral property, irreligion, hardship.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 15.9 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: A strong lord in a dusthana causes only slight harm; a weak one great harm.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Traditional risk of early loss of the father and, with an afflicted 8th, poverty and heavy responsibility; benefic influence gives substantial paternal inheritance; affliction may lead to abandoning family traditions.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: A very bad position that spoils luck: hard persistence for small rewards, little faith; gains from a partner's wealth, wills and legacies; strong intuition and occult knowledge.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XIV.89
source_views.view: If the 9th lord in the 8th is aspected by a debilitated or inimical planet, or is itself debilitated or in a malefic amsa, the person is unlucky.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII, closing note to the ninth-lord results
source_views.view: The ninth-lord results are general; a very powerful 9th lord can confer fortune even from a malefic house, and if the 9th lord is afflicted but the 9th house is well disposed the bad results are much reduced. Literal application is warned against.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action' (dual house rulership, Raja yoga), pp. 159-161
source_views.view: A planet ruling two houses gives mixed results, weighted by its mulatrikona sign: Saturn as 8th and 9th lord for Gemini is on the whole more positive than negative; the 12th lordship mainly gives the results of the other house ruled; lords of the 9th and 10th create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses.

lord_in_house/9/8.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata, Raman and Braha are all negative on fortune (Braha: 'a very bad position'). Raman and Braha give the compensations: inheritance, legacies and occult knowledge. All agree the lord's strength is decisive.
lord_in_house/9/8.phrasing_guidance: Describe fortune as coming through depth, research and change rather than easy luck. State Nirbhagya as a traditional view only. No predictions about the father's health or longevity.

lord_in_house/9/9.summary: The fortune lord in its own house: luck, dharma, higher learning and the father's support are all strengthened. One of the strongest placements in the chart.
common_outcomes: abundant fortune (BPHS 24.105; a strong 9th lord in the 9th gives great fortune, BPHS 20.1)
a long-lived, prosperous father and happiness from him (Raman HTJH; Braha)
religious and charitable (Raman HTJH); wise, idealistic, of great faith (Braha)
travel abroad that brings money and distinction (Raman HTJH); many long journeys (Braha)
virtuous, handsome, much happiness from siblings (BPHS 24.105)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 20.28: exalted Mercury with the 9th lord in the 9th: prosperity from about age 36
happiness from grandchildren (Braha)

by_area.personality: Virtuous and handsome (BPHS 24.105); wise, idealistic, performs good deeds (Braha).
by_area.finance: Earns money and distinction through foreign travel (Raman HTJH); lucky and fortunate (Braha).
by_area.family: Father long-lived and prosperous (Raman HTJH; Braha); much happiness from siblings (BPHS 24.105).
by_area.spirituality: Religiously inclined and charitable (Raman HTJH); powerful dharma, great faith (Braha).

strengtheners: strong in its own trikona with the lagna aspected by its own lord: fortunes come in a crowd (JP 14.97)
exalted Mercury joining (BPHS 20.28)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction, or the 9th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, is a traditional caution for the father (Raman HTJH); never predict
dual dusthana lordship (e.g. Jupiter 9th+12th for Aries, Saturn 8th+9th for Gemini) mixes results (BPHS 24.146-147)
lord_in_house/9/9.lagna_or_context_notes: The lord is in its own sign; which planet that is depends on the lagna. Dual lordship mixes results (BPHS 24.146-147).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.105
source_views.view: Abundant fortune, virtuous, handsome, much happiness from siblings.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 20.1, 20.28
source_views.view: Strong 9th lord in the 9th gives great fortune; with exalted Mercury, prosperity from about age 36.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: A long-lived, prosperous father; the native religious and charitable, earning money and distinction through foreign travel. Afflicted, or in the 6th/8th/12th from the navamsa lagna: a traditional caution for the father.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Own house: a wealthy, powerful, long-lived father, religious or philosophical, lucky, many long journeys, wise, performs good deeds, great faith.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XIV.97
source_views.view: If the 9th lord is in a kendra or trikona in great strength and the lagna is aspected by its own lord, good fortunes come in a crowd.

lord_in_house/9/9.disagreements: None: BPHS, Raman and Braha all give strong fortune and a supportive father.
lord_in_house/9/9.phrasing_guidance: Present as a strong blessing for fortune, ethics and learning. Keep age-based timings as traditional hints, not promises.

lord_in_house/9/10.summary: The 9th lord in the 10th links dharma with karma: fortune shows through career, status and public honour. It is a key part of the Dharma-Karmadhipati raja yoga.
common_outcomes: royal or ministerial status, respected (BPHS 24.106)
very famous and powerful; posts of authority (Raman HTJH)
great luck in career; may obtain a high government position (Braha)
a righteous livelihood; law-abiding (Raman HTJH)
much wealth and comfort (Raman HTJH); happiness from the mother and many fixed assets, as the 9th lord aspects the 4th (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 20.7: if the 10th lord is also in the 9th (exchange) with benefic aspect, the father is wealthy and famous
Phaladeepika 6.37-38: the 9th and 10th lords together in a good house give a Raja yoga of kingly status
Frawley (Example Charts: Nelson Rockefeller, Virgo lagna): Venus as ruler of the 2nd and 9th in the 10th gives prominence

by_area.personality: Generous (Raman HTJH); respected (BPHS 24.106).
by_area.career: Fame, power and posts of authority (Raman HTJH); a prominent career with a possible high government post (Braha); ministerial status (BPHS 24.106).
by_area.finance: Much wealth and every kind of comfort (Raman HTJH).
by_area.family: Father wealthy and famous in the exchange case (BPHS 20.7); happiness from the mother (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Righteous means of livelihood (Raman HTJH); strong dharma and good deeds (Braha).

strengtheners: a relationship of the 9th and 10th lords (conjunction, exchange, mutual aspect, or each in its own house) forms the Raja yoga (Uttara Kalamrita 4.3; Laghu Parashari st. 15)
the pair joined with, or placed in the houses of, the 1st, 4th, 5th or 7th lords: wealth, happiness and prosperity (Uttara Kalamrita 4.3)
conjunction in an auspicious house (Phaladeepika 6.37-38); benefic aspect in the exchange (BPHS 20.7)
strong in a kendra with the lagna aspected by its own lord (JP 14.97)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the yoga lords should not also own the 8th or 11th (Uttara Kalamrita 4.3); association with the 8th and 11th lords endangers success (Laghu Parashari st. 21)
a 9th lord that also owns the 8th or 12th, or yoga lords joined by the 8th or 12th lords, destroys the merit of the yoga (Uttara Kalamrita 4.83)
debilitation or combustion (BPHS 20.12 on a weak 9th lord)
lord_in_house/9/10.lagna_or_context_notes: For Taurus Saturn owns both the 9th and 10th, a single-planet case Row discusses under Laghu Parashari st. 15. For Gemini the 9th lord Saturn also owns the 8th, which Uttara Kalamrita 4.3 and 4.83 say spoils the yoga; Frawley (pp. 159-161) likewise wants the 9th and 10th lords not to rule other bad houses.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.106
source_views.view: May attain royal or ministerial status; respected.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 20.7
source_views.view: 9th lord in the 10th with the 10th lord in the 9th and benefic aspect: father wealthy and famous.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.37-38 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: 9th and 10th lords conjoined in an auspicious house: Raja yoga, a person of kingly status and following.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Very famous and powerful, generous, holds posts of authority, much wealth and comfort; a righteous livelihood and law-abiding.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Prominent, successful, famous career with great luck and strong dharma; may obtain high government position; the 9th lord aspects the 4th, so mother, comforts and education flourish.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, slokas 3 and 83
source_views.view: 4.3: the 9th and 10th lords in their own houses, conjoined in either, exchanged, or in mutual aspect form Raja yoga; joined with or placed in the houses of the 1st, 4th, 5th or 7th lords they give wealth and prosperity; they must not also own the 8th or 11th. 4.83: a 9th lord owning the 8th or 12th, or the pair joined with the 8th or 12th lords, destroys the merit.

source_views.source: Laghu Parashari / Jataka Chandrika (tr. B. Suryanarain Row, 1900), stanzas 15 and 21 with Row's notes
source_views.view: Stanza 15: the 9th and 10th lords conjoined in the 9th or 10th, in exchange, or each in its own house produce good (Raja yoga, i.e. success under authority); mutual aspect also counts. Stanza 21: if the 8th and 11th lords join them, success is endangered.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Nelson Rockefeller
source_views.view: Venus as ruler of the 2nd and 9th placed in the public 10th house is given prominence.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action' (dual house rulership, Raja yoga), pp. 159-161
source_views.view: A planet ruling two houses gives mixed results, weighted by its mulatrikona sign: Saturn as 8th and 9th lord for Gemini is on the whole more positive than negative; the 12th lordship mainly gives the results of the other house ruled; lords of the 9th and 10th create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XIV.97
source_views.view: If the 9th lord is in a kendra or trikona in great strength and the lagna is aspected by its own lord, good fortunes come in a crowd.

lord_in_house/9/10.disagreements: Texts differ on whether the placement alone is enough: BPHS 24.106, Raman and Braha give strong career results from the 9th lord in the 10th by itself, while Laghu Parashari (st. 15) and Uttara Kalamrita (4.3) define the Raja yoga by a relationship of both lords. Uttara Kalamrita bars 8th and 11th co-lordship; Laghu Parashari warns against association with the 8th and 11th lords.
lord_in_house/9/10.phrasing_guidance: Describe strong potential for respected, purposeful work and public honour. Avoid promising 'royal' office; translate it as leadership or recognition in one's field, depending on dashas.

lord_in_house/9/11.summary: Fortune feeds the house of gains: income grows steadily, wishes are fulfilled and elders and friends support the person.
common_outcomes: wealth grows day by day (BPHS 24.107); exceedingly rich (Raman HTJH; Braha)
powerful and influential friends (Raman HTJH; Braha)
a well-known, well-placed or wealthy father (Raman HTJH; Braha)
devoted to elders, meritorious (BPHS 24.107)
ambitions fulfilled, many opportunities (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 20.8: exalted Sun with the 9th lord in the 11th makes the person devoted to dharma and to the father
Frawley (Example Charts: Mozart; Franklin Roosevelt, both Leo lagna): Mars as 9th lord in the 11th gives potential income and recognition
the 9th lord aspects the 5th from here: intelligence, fine children, successful investments (Braha)

by_area.personality: Meritorious, devoted to elders (BPHS 24.107).
by_area.career: Income and recognition (Frawley, Mozart chart); countless opportunities (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealth grows steadily (BPHS 24.107); exceedingly rich (Raman HTJH).
by_area.relationships: Powerful, influential or spiritual friends (Raman HTJH; Braha). If afflicted, unfaithful friends may destroy wealth by scheming (Raman HTJH).
by_area.family: Father well known (Raman HTJH); fine children (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Devoted to dharma with an exalted Sun involved (BPHS 20.8).

strengtheners: exalted Sun joining (BPHS 20.8)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: affliction: unfaithful friends destroy wealth through selfish scheming and fraud (Raman HTJH)
debilitation with combustion (BPHS 20.12)
lord_in_house/9/11.lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Saturn (8th+9th) falls in Aries here, its debilitation sign, which BPHS 20.12 treats as weak for fortune (with combustion). For Leo lagna Mars here is Frawley's repeated example of a fortunate 9th lord in the house of gains.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.107
source_views.view: Wealth grows daily, devoted to elders, meritorious.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 20.8
source_views.view: Exalted Sun with the 9th lord in the 11th: devoted to dharma and father.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Exceedingly rich, powerful and influential friends, a well-known and well-placed father; afflicted, unfaithful friends destroy wealth through scheming and fraud.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Great wealth, ambitions fulfilled, powerful and spiritual friends, countless opportunities, a wealthy father; the 9th lord aspects the 5th: intelligence, fine children, good investments.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart; Franklin Roosevelt
source_views.view: Both Leo-lagna charts have Mars, ruler of the 9th, in the 11th house of gains; Frawley reads it as potential good income and recognition.

lord_in_house/9/11.disagreements: None: BPHS, Raman, Braha and Frawley's example charts all favour wealth and influential friends.
lord_in_house/9/11.phrasing_guidance: Frame as steady growth in gains and goodwill. Avoid promising specific amounts.

lord_in_house/9/12.summary: The fortune lord in the house of loss: classical and modern sources agree fortune is reduced, often with a modest background and hard work, while Braha and Rath add far-off lands and a strong pull towards moksha.
common_outcomes: fortune diminishes; spending on auspicious works (BPHS 24.108)
a poor background, hard work, success slow to come (Raman HTJH)
religious and noble yet often in want (Raman HTJH)
travel to far-off lands (Braha); fortune sought abroad (Rath, Carnegie chart)
excellent for moksha though weak for conventional religion (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.108 adds poverty from hosting guests (generosity outrunning means)
Phaladeepika's Nirbhagya yoga as a traditional caution
Rath (Crux ch. 5, Chart 25, Andrew Carnegie): the 9th lord in the 12th shows a poor father, and with Jupiter there the native sails to distant lands for his fortune
comfort of fine beds and a peaceful afterlife (Braha)
BPHS 20.19 has an exchange of 9th and 12th lords among harsh father-related verses; treat as traditional only

by_area.personality: Religious and noble (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Must work very hard and success may not come easily (Raman HTJH); fortune made in distant lands (Rath, Carnegie chart).
by_area.finance: Fortune diminishes (BPHS 24.108); a poor background and often in want (Raman HTJH).
by_area.family: The father may be of modest means or have a difficult life (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath).
by_area.spirituality: Spending on religious works (BPHS 24.108); excellent for moksha (Braha).

strengtheners: strong 9th lord (Phaladeepika 15.9; Raman HTJH: a very powerful 9th lord confers fortune even from a malefic house); benefic aspect (Phaladeepika 15.5)
own-sign case: Jupiter for Aries lagna owns the 9th and 12th and sits in Pisces, own sign; Mercury for Libra owns the 9th and 12th and sits in Virgo, exalted
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation or combustion (BPHS 20.12)
exchange with the 12th lord is flagged in BPHS 20.19 as difficult for the father (traditional)
JP 12.86: a 9th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, even with a benefic, gives only short-lived happiness
lord_in_house/9/12.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries and Libra lagnas the 9th lord also owns the 12th and sits in its own sign here; Frawley (pp. 159-160) says a 12th lordship mainly gives the results of the other house ruled, which supports a milder reading. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.108
source_views.view: Fortune diminishes; spending on auspicious works; poverty through hospitality to guests.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 20.19
source_views.view: 9th lord in the 12th with the 12th lord in the 9th is listed among harsh father-related combinations.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.66 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Nirbhagya yoga for the 9th lord in a dusthana.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII 'Results of the Lord of the Ninth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: A poor background: suffers and works hard, success may not come; religious and noble but always in want; a traditional caution that the father may die early.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '9th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 9th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Luck spoiled, little happiness from the father, little faith or gain from gurus; comfortable bed pleasures, travel to far-off lands, a good afterlife; bad for religion but excellent for moksha.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, ch. 5, Chart 25 (Andrew Carnegie)
source_views.view: The 9th lord in the 12th shows a poor father; with the 9th lord Jupiter in the 12th the native would have to sail to distant lands for his fortune.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIII, closing note to the ninth-lord results
source_views.view: The ninth-lord results are general; a very powerful 9th lord can confer fortune even from a malefic house, and if the 9th lord is afflicted but the 9th house is well disposed the bad results are much reduced. Literal application is warned against.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XII.86
source_views.view: A strong 9th lord in the 4th with Venus gives long-lasting pleasure and opulence; a 9th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, even with a benefic, gives only short-lived happiness.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action' (dual house rulership, Raja yoga), pp. 159-161
source_views.view: A planet ruling two houses gives mixed results, weighted by its mulatrikona sign: Saturn as 8th and 9th lord for Gemini is on the whole more positive than negative; the 12th lordship mainly gives the results of the other house ruled; lords of the 9th and 10th create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses.

lord_in_house/9/12.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are negative on fortune and the father. Braha and Rath add a positive side: far-off lands and moksha. Raman stresses poverty and effort; Rath's Carnegie example shows great fortune made abroad.
lord_in_house/9/12.phrasing_guidance: Say fortune may come through distant places, generosity and spiritual life rather than easy material luck. Never predict the father's death or illness; mention distance only as a possibility.

lord_in_house/10/1.summary: The lord of career and action sits on the lagna: work and reputation become central to identity, and the person is often self-made, known and capable.
common_outcomes: rises in life by sheer perseverance; self-employed or in an independent profession (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 13.4)
learned, famous, wealthy, poetic (BPHS 24.109)
a successful, respected career; may be a pioneer with his own business (Braha)
wealth increasing over life after early difficulties (BPHS 24.109)
rare_outcomes: BPHS mentions being sickly in childhood but happier later; Rath ties this to Saturn as a 10th-house significator, till about age ten (Crux 13.4); state only as a traditional phrase
with the lagna lord also in the 1st: very famous, a pioneer who founds a public institution and takes up social projects (Raman HTJH)
Simhasana yoga (10th lord in the 1st or 2nd) gives its good results after middle age (Rath Crux 13.4)
Frawley (Example Charts: Sri Aurobindo, Cancer lagna): the 10th lord Mars rising with the 9th lord Jupiter is a potential Raja yoga and strong political combination
career may involve the person's body or image: model, actor, showman (Braha)

by_area.personality: Career-minded and dignified (Braha); Rath adds fickleness through Mercury's signification and fame and status through Jupiter's (Crux 13.4).
by_area.career: Self-employed or independent (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4); a pioneer in one's field (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealth increases over life (BPHS 24.109).
by_area.spirituality: Strong dharma; may visit holy lands (Braha).

strengtheners: lagna lord joined with it in the 1st: fame and pioneering public work (Raman HTJH)
a strong 10th lord in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra, with a benefic in the 10th: renown and king-like affluence (Phaladeepika 16.27)
strong in shadbala (Jataka Parijata, via summary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: a 10th lord without strength makes one fickle-minded and ill-behaved (JP 15.2)
dual lordship: both lordships act (BPHS 24.146-147)
lord_in_house/10/1.lagna_or_context_notes: For Virgo (Mercury) and Pisces (Jupiter) lagnas the same planet rules the 1st and 10th and sits in its own sign here. Rath (Crux 13.4) reads the result through the 10th-house significators: Mercury fickleness, Saturn childhood health, the Sun an independent profession, Jupiter fame. Uttara Kalamrita 4.79 adds that a benefic owning a kendra does not give favourable results by that lordship alone.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.109
source_views.view: Learned, famous, wealthy, poetic; sickly as a child but happier later, with wealth increasing.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata XI.18 (via summary, Wikipedia: Karmasthana; verse not located in the Sastri translation, Adhyaya XV)
source_views.view: 10th lord in the lagna makes one self-made and praiseworthy if strong in shadbala.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.27
source_views.view: If a benefic occupies the 10th and the 10th lord in full strength is in a kendra or kona in its own or exaltation sign, or if the lagna lord is in the 10th, the person is revered, widely renowned, given to virtuous deeds, with king-like affluence and long life.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Rises by sheer perseverance; self-employed or an independent profession. With the lagna lord joined in the 1st, very famous, a pioneer who founds a public institution.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Career-minded, self-made, self-employed, successful, respected or famous; may pioneer with his own business; career may involve the body or image; strong dharma.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 13.4 (placement of the tenth lord)
source_views.view: Read through the significators: via Mercury fickle-minded, via Saturn ill-health in childhood (till about ten, after Parasara), via the Sun an independent profession, via Jupiter fame and status; Simhasana yoga (10th lord in 1st/2nd) gives results after middle age.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Sri Aurobindo
source_views.view: Mars (10th lord) and Jupiter (9th lord) rising in Cancer form a strong political combination and potential Raja yoga.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.2
source_views.view: If the 10th lord has no strength the person is fickle-minded and ill-behaved.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, sloka 79
source_views.view: Benefics owning trikonas are auspicious in the 2nd, 3rd, 11th and kendras; a benefic owning a kendra does not give favourable results, while a malefic owning a kendra is not inauspicious.

lord_in_house/10/1.disagreements: None substantial. BPHS mentions childhood illness, which Raman and Braha omit and Rath attributes to Saturn as significator.
lord_in_house/10/1.phrasing_guidance: Describe a self-driven, achievement-oriented person whose work becomes their signature. Do not repeat the childhood-illness line as a prediction.

lord_in_house/10/2.summary: Career feeds wealth: the work of the person directly builds savings and family standing, and recognition from authorities is a classical theme.
common_outcomes: wealthy, virtuous, honoured by government (BPHS 24.110); fortunate, rises well and makes much money (Raman HTJH)
the family trade or family business as livelihood (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)
catering, restaurants or food business (Raman HTJH; Braha); hotel trade when the Moon influences the 10th lord (Rath Crux 13.4)
a good speaker; work may involve speaking, poetry or lecturing (Braha)
happiness from the father (BPHS 24.110)
rare_outcomes: Jataka Parijata (via summary) says the 10th lord in the 2nd gives exceptional fame
Simhasana yoga (10th lord in the 1st or 2nd): good results after middle age (Rath Crux 13.4)
afflicted: losses and winding up of the family business (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)

by_area.personality: Generous and virtuous (BPHS 24.110); truthful and charitable (Braha).
by_area.career: Family business, catering or restaurants (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4); speaking or lecturing (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.110); makes a lot of money (Raman HTJH); good earning ability, an artha lord in an artha house (Braha).
by_area.family: Develops the family trade (Raman HTJH); happiness from the father (BPHS 24.110); family happiness (Braha).

strengtheners: a strong Jupiter, significator of the family deity (Rath Crux 13.4)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics afflicting the 10th lord or 10th: losses and closing of the family business (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.110
source_views.view: Wealthy, virtuous, honoured by government, generous, happiness from the father.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata XI.18 (via summary, Wikipedia: Karmasthana; verse not located in the Sastri translation, Adhyaya XV)
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 2nd confers exceptional fame.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Fortunate, rises well, makes a lot of money; may develop the family trade; afflicted, losses and winding up of the family business; prospers in catering and restaurants.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: An artha lord in an artha house: good wealth and earning ability; good speaker, truthful, charitable; career may involve food; family happiness.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 13.4 (placement of the tenth lord)
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 2nd or with the 2nd lord: family business as the source of livelihood, disrupted if the 10th lord is afflicted; the hotel trade if the Moon also influences it; Jupiter's strength as family-deity significator matters.

lord_in_house/10/2.disagreements: None. Raman, Braha and Rath all add the family trade and food or catering businesses to BPHS's wealth and honour.
lord_in_house/10/2.phrasing_guidance: Frame as work that builds savings and family standing. Do not promise government honours.

lord_in_house/10/3.summary: Career expressed through courage, communication and initiative; BPHS sees valour, eloquence and support from siblings and staff.
common_outcomes: happiness from siblings and servants; valorous, eloquent, truthful (BPHS 24.111)
constant short journeys for work (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)
a speaker or writer of note if well placed; literary or communications career (Raman HTJH; Braha)
siblings help the career (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 13.4)
career advances only through hard work and self-effort (Braha)
rare_outcomes: the 3rd is the 6th from the 10th, pointing to short-term service or contracts (Rath Crux 13.4)
with Venus associated, a job of constant travelling (Rath Crux 13.4)
career in music, dance or drama (Braha)

by_area.personality: Brave, eloquent, truthful (BPHS 24.111); courageous and adventurous (Braha).
by_area.career: Writing, speaking, communications or performing arts (Raman HTJH; Braha); travelling work and short-term contracts (Rath Crux 13.4).
by_area.family: Siblings advance the career (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4); rivalry between brothers can cause reversals if the 3rd lord is afflicted (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: a well-placed 10th lord: a celebrated speaker or writer (Raman HTJH)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: 10th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, or in an unfriendly nakshatra: a slow rise beset with obstacles (Raman HTJH)
afflicted 3rd lord: rivalry between brothers harms the career (Raman HTJH)

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.111
source_views.view: Happiness from siblings and servants, valorous, eloquent, truthful.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Constant short journeys; a celebrated speaker or writer if well placed; brothers help the career. In the 6th/8th/12th navamsa or an unfriendly nakshatra the rise is slow; an afflicted 3rd lord brings sibling rivalry and reversals.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Career in music, dance, drama, literature or communications; siblings involved in the livelihood; advance only through hard work; courageous, many short journeys.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 13.4 (placement of the tenth lord)
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 3rd: a job of constant short travel, especially with Venus; siblings further the career; being 6th from the 10th it shows short-term service or contracts.

lord_in_house/10/3.disagreements: BPHS is favourable. Raman adds a slow rise when the lord is weak in the navamsa, and Rath's 6th-from-the-10th reading points to short-term service or contracts rather than a steady post.
lord_in_house/10/3.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise initiative, communication skill and teamwork. Mention possible role changes as a growth pattern, not instability.

lord_in_house/10/4.summary: A kendra lord in another kendra: career supports home, land, vehicles and the mother's welfare, and the person tends to be content and settled.
common_outcomes: happy; owns vehicles, land and houses (BPHS 24.112; Braha)
lucky and highly learned; famous for learning and generosity (Raman HTJH)
devoted to the mother's welfare (BPHS 24.112); happiness from the mother (Braha)
agriculture, real estate or dealings in immovable property (Raman HTJH; Braha)
royal favour and respect wherever one goes when the lord is strong (Raman HTJH); favours from government (Braha)
rare_outcomes: with the 4th, 9th and 10th lords well disposed and related: great political authority, even head of government (Raman HTJH)
Frawley (Example Charts: Napoleon Bonaparte, Libra lagna): the 10th lord Moon in the 4th in exchange with Saturn (4th and 5th lord) in the 10th creates a powerful Raja yoga
honoured at the close of life (Braha)

by_area.personality: Learned and generous (Raman HTJH); passionate about career (Braha).
by_area.career: Successful career and high status, as the 10th lord is angular and aspects its own house (Braha); agriculture or real estate (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Vehicles, land and houses (BPHS 24.112; Braha).
by_area.family: Caring towards the mother (BPHS 24.112); a long-lived mother (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Goes on holy pilgrimages and performs good deeds (Braha).

strengtheners: a strong 10th lord in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra, with a benefic in the 10th (Phaladeepika 16.27)
relationship with well-disposed 4th and 9th lords (Raman HTJH)
exchange with the planet in the 10th, as in Napoleon's chart (Frawley, Example Charts)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitated, combust, in an enemy sign or afflicted: loss of lands and a life of servitude (Raman HTJH)
joined by the 8th lord in the 4th in a malefic shashtyamsa: the same (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/10/4.lagna_or_context_notes: Uttara Kalamrita 4.79: a benefic owning a kendra does not give favourable results, while a malefic owning one is not inauspicious; this tempers natural benefics as 10th lords. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.112
source_views.view: Happy, devoted to mother's welfare, owns vehicles, land and houses.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.27
source_views.view: If a benefic occupies the 10th and the 10th lord in full strength is in a kendra or kona in its own or exaltation sign, or if the lagna lord is in the 10th, the person is revered, widely renowned, given to virtuous deeds, with king-like affluence and long life.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Lucky, highly learned, famous for learning and generosity; strong, respected and receives royal favour; agriculture or immovable property; with related 4th, 9th and 10th lords, great political authority. Debilitated or afflicted: loss of lands and servitude.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: An excellent position (angular, aspecting its own house): successful career, high status, pilgrimages, comforts, homes and land, happiness from the mother, favours from government.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Napoleon Bonaparte
source_views.view: For Libra lagna the 10th lord Moon and Saturn (4th and 5th lord, in the 10th) are in mutual reception, creating a powerful Raja yoga.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, sloka 79
source_views.view: Benefics owning trikonas are auspicious in the 2nd, 3rd, 11th and kendras; a benefic owning a kendra does not give favourable results, while a malefic owning a kendra is not inauspicious.

lord_in_house/10/4.disagreements: None on the core. Raman adds a sharp downside (loss of lands, servitude) when the lord is debilitated or afflicted.
lord_in_house/10/4.phrasing_guidance: Speak of stability, property and family harmony. Avoid promising property purchases.

lord_in_house/10/5.summary: A kendra lord in a trikona (a kendra-trikona link): career benefits from intelligence, learning and creativity, and the person is knowledgeable, joyful and prosperous.
common_outcomes: knowledgeable, joyful, wealthy, with children (BPHS 24.113)
shines as a broker and in speculation (Raman HTJH); career involving speculation (Braha)
highly intelligent; wealthy and successful children (Braha)
career in art, sports or politics (Braha)
rare_outcomes: with benefics joining the 10th lord: a simple, pious life of prayer (Raman HTJH)
in the 6th, 8th or 12th navamsa: may head an orphanage or remand home (Raman HTJH); Rath likewise reads service for orphans, the handicapped and the old (Crux 13.4)
the 5th is the 8th from the 10th, pointing to research, occult studies, gambling or speculation (Rath Crux 13.4)

by_area.personality: Bright and joyful (BPHS 24.113); virtuous or pious (Braha).
by_area.career: Broking and speculation (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 13.4); research or occult studies (Rath Crux 13.4); art, sports or politics (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.113); profitable investments (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Happy love affairs (Braha).
by_area.family: Children (BPHS 24.113); wealthy, successful children (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Knowledge of mantras or spiritual techniques (Braha); a pious life with benefics joining (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: benefics joining the 10th lord (Raman HTJH)
a strong 10th lord in its own or exaltation sign in a trikona, with a benefic in the 10th (Phaladeepika 16.27)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the 10th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th navamsa (Raman HTJH)
Rath: natural benefics such as Jupiter and the Moon placed 8th from their own sign can damage it, though exchanges modify this (Crux 13.4)
lord_in_house/10/5.lagna_or_context_notes: For Capricorn lagna Venus (5th+10th) and for Cancer lagna Mars (5th+10th) sit in their own signs here; Frawley (p. 161) names Venus for Capricorn and Mars for Cancer as single planets able to produce Raja yoga.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.113
source_views.view: Knowledgeable, joyful, wealthy, with children.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.27
source_views.view: If a benefic occupies the 10th and the 10th lord in full strength is in a kendra or kona in its own or exaltation sign, or if the lagna lord is in the 10th, the person is revered, widely renowned, given to virtuous deeds, with king-like affluence and long life.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Shines as a broker and in speculation; with benefics joining, a simple and pious life; in the 6th/8th/12th navamsa, may head an orphanage or remand home.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Auspicious: highly intelligent, successful children, profitable investments, career in speculation, art, sports or politics, knowledge of mantras, a strong sense of destiny.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 13.4 (placement of the tenth lord)
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 5th is 8th from the 10th: research, occult studies, gambling or speculation, and service for orphans, the handicapped and the old; natural benefics 8th from their sign can harm it.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Raja Yoga', p. 161
source_views.view: Lords of the 9th and 10th can create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses; Venus for Capricorn and Aquarius and Mars for Cancer and Leo are single planets that can produce Raja yoga.

lord_in_house/10/5.disagreements: Classical texts are favourable. Rath's 8th-from-the-10th reading and Raman's orphanage note add a research, service or speculative tone.
lord_in_house/10/5.phrasing_guidance: Describe success through intelligence and creativity. No fertility predictions.

lord_in_house/10/6.summary: The career lord in a dusthana: work involves competition, service and problem-solving; classically there is less paternal happiness, cleverness but limited wealth, and trouble from rivals.
common_outcomes: lacks paternal happiness, clever but poor, troubled by enemies (BPHS 24.114)
an occupation tied to the judiciary, prisons or hospitals (Raman HTJH); medicine, nursing or hospital work (Braha)
ups and downs in professional life; enemies may block promotion (Braha)
must work hard and gains are slow (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika's Duryoga (10th lord in 6/8/12): efforts unrewarded, low public regard, selfishness, living away from home; traditional view
Jataka Parijata (via summary): 10th lord in 6/8/12 brings a bad name and hardships
Saturn aspecting the 10th lord: a low-paid job with few prospects (Raman HTJH)
benefics aspecting: a post of authority, esteemed for character (Raman HTJH)
Rahu or afflicted malefics with the 10th lord: disgrace in career and possible legal trouble (Raman HTJH)

by_area.personality: Clever (BPHS 24.114).
by_area.career: Judiciary, prisons or hospitals (Raman HTJH); medicine or nursing; may be superseded by juniors (Braha).
by_area.finance: Clever but poor (BPHS 24.114); good for wealth but gains are slow (Braha).
by_area.family: Less happiness from the father (BPHS 24.114); a prominent uncle (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: A 10th lord in the 6th impedes religious rites (JP 15.9).

strengtheners: a strong 10th lord (Phaladeepika 15.9: a strong lord in a dusthana does slight harm)
benefic aspect on the 10th house or lord (Phaladeepika 15.5); benefics aspecting: authority and esteem (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: weak or afflicted lord (Phaladeepika 15.9)
Saturn's aspect: low-paid work (Raman HTJH)
Rahu or afflicted malefics with the lord: disgrace (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/10/6.lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Jupiter (7th+10th) goes to Scorpio; for Sagittarius Mercury (7th+10th) goes to Taurus. For Aries Saturn (10th+11th) goes to Virgo. Phaladeepika 6.70 notes that weak 1st, 4th, 9th and 10th lords in dusthanas with strong dusthana lords in kendras form a bad yoga; the reverse is good.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.114
source_views.view: Lacks paternal happiness, clever but poor, troubled by enemies.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.67 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Duryoga for the 10th lord in a dusthana: labour bears little fruit, low public regard, selfish, often away from home or abroad.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata XI.18 (via summary, Wikipedia: Karmasthana; verse not located in the Sastri translation, Adhyaya XV)
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th: bad name and many hardships.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 15.5, 15.9 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Benefic aspect protects a house whose lord is in a dusthana; harm depends on the lord's strength.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Occupation in the judiciary, prisons or hospitals; Saturn's aspect a low-paid job; benefic aspect a post of authority; Rahu or afflicted malefics, disgrace and possible legal trouble.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: An artha lord in an artha house is good for wealth but gains are slow; ups and downs, enemies block promotion, may be superseded by juniors; medicine, nursing or hospital work.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.9
source_views.view: If the 10th lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th it impedes religious rites; even an exalted 10th lord spoils a religious work when its exaltation sign is a dusthana.

lord_in_house/10/6.disagreements: Classical texts are negative. Braha calls it good for wealth though slow (an artha lord in an artha house), and Raman makes the outcome depend on the aspecting planet: Saturn low-paid work, benefics authority, Rahu disgrace.
lord_in_house/10/6.phrasing_guidance: Describe careers in service and problem-solving and the need to handle competition wisely. Present Duryoga only as a traditional caution. No health claims.

lord_in_house/10/7.summary: Career through partnership and the public; BPHS sees marital happiness, high-mindedness, eloquence and devotion to truth.
common_outcomes: marital happiness; high-minded, eloquent, truthful (BPHS 24.115)
a mature or career-minded spouse who helps the work (Raman HTJH; Braha)
travel abroad for work, even on diplomatic missions (Raman HTJH); travel for the profession (Braha)
profits through partnerships and joint ventures (Raman HTJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 21.7: the 10th lord in the 7th with Saturn and Mars and an afflicted 7th lord indicates strong sensual indulgence (traditional view)
malefic affliction: debased habits (Raman HTJH); a 10th lord without strength in the 7th makes one ill-behaved (JP 15.17); traditional, never use as character judgement
the 10th lord aspects the lagna from here: healthy, respected and fortunate (Braha)

by_area.personality: Diplomatic, known for skill in talking and achieving objectives (Raman HTJH); eloquent and truthful (BPHS 24.115).
by_area.career: Partnerships, co-operative ventures and diplomacy (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Profits through partnerships (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.relationships: A mature spouse who assists the work (Raman HTJH); a famous or career-oriented spouse (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Devoted to dharma (BPHS 24.115).

strengtheners: a strong 10th lord in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra, with a benefic in the 10th (Phaladeepika 16.27)
weakeners_or_cancellations: conjunction with Saturn and Mars and an afflicted 7th lord (BPHS 21.7)
malefic affliction (Raman HTJH); a weak 10th lord here (JP 15.17)
lord_in_house/10/7.lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini and Sagittarius lagnas the 10th lord also owns the 7th and sits in its own sign here; Uttara Kalamrita 4.79 says a benefic owning a kendra does not give favourable results, which applies to Jupiter (Gemini) and Mercury (Sagittarius) as double kendra lords.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.115
source_views.view: Marital happiness, high-minded, eloquent, devoted to truth and dharma.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 21.7
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 7th with Saturn and Mars, and the 7th lord afflicted: excessive sensual indulgence.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: A mature wife who helps in the work; diplomatic travel abroad; skilled in talking; profits through partnerships. Malefic affliction: debased habits.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Good career, spouse aids the livelihood, profits through partnerships, happy marriage, a famous or powerful spouse, travel for the profession; the 10th lord aspects the lagna.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.17
source_views.view: If the 10th lord is without strength and occupies the 7th, the person is ill-behaved.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, sloka 79
source_views.view: Benefics owning trikonas are auspicious in the 2nd, 3rd, 11th and kendras; a benefic owning a kendra does not give favourable results, while a malefic owning a kendra is not inauspicious.

lord_in_house/10/7.disagreements: None on the core: BPHS, Raman and Braha all favour partnership and marriage. Raman and Jataka Parijata warn about conduct when the lord is afflicted or weak.
lord_in_house/10/7.phrasing_guidance: Speak of partnerships and public dealings as the field of success. Do not repeat the sensual-indulgence line as a character judgement; it is conditional and traditional.

lord_in_house/10/8.summary: The career lord in the house of upheaval: all sources see an unsteady career with breaks, and Raman and Braha add occult, mystical or spiritual work and gains through others' money.
common_outcomes: lacks steady work; many breaks and changes in career (BPHS 24.116; Raman HTJH; Braha)
inclined to criticise others (BPHS 24.116)
merit goes unnoticed; difficulty finding one's proper dharma (Braha)
if fortified: a high office, but only for a short time (Raman HTJH)
work in occult or mystical subjects; gains from wills, insurance or a partner's wealth (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.116 also states long life; do not use as a longevity claim
BPHS ch. 21: the 10th lord in the 8th or 12th with malefics and without strength gives a harsh intellect and mental distress (traditional)
Phaladeepika's Duryoga as a traditional caution
Jupiter influencing the 10th lord: a mystic or spiritual teacher (Raman HTJH)
Saturn here: work at cremation grounds or cemeteries (Raman HTJH)

by_area.personality: Inclined to criticise others (BPHS 24.116).
by_area.career: Many breaks and changes (Raman HTJH; Braha); occult or mystical work (Braha); spiritual teaching if Jupiter is involved (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Gains from wills, insurance companies or a partner's wealth (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Mystic or spiritual teacher with Jupiter's influence (Raman HTJH); a 10th lord in a dusthana impedes religious rites (JP 15.9).

strengtheners: a strong 10th lord (Phaladeepika 15.9); fortified: high office for a short time (Raman HTJH)
benefic aspect on the 10th house or lord (Phaladeepika 15.5); Jupiter's aspect or association (Raman HTJH)
own-sign case: for Leo lagna Venus owns the 3rd and 10th and is in Pisces (exalted) here
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic conjunction or aspect with lack of strength (BPHS 21: mental distress, traditional)
malefic affliction: traditional lines on offences (Raman HTJH); never use as character judgement
lord_in_house/10/8.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Mars (3rd+10th) here is in Virgo. For Aries lagna Saturn (10th+11th) here is in Scorpio. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.116
source_views.view: Lacks steady work, long-lived, inclined to criticise others.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra ch. 21 (karma bhava, verse on 10th lord in 8th or 12th with malefics)
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 8th or 12th, with malefics and without strength, gives a harsh intellect and mental distress.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.67 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Duryoga for the 10th lord in a dusthana.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata XI.18 (via summary, Wikipedia: Karmasthana; verse not located in the Sastri translation, Adhyaya XV)
source_views.view: 10th lord in 6/8/12: bad name and hardships.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Many breaks in career; fortified, a high office for a short time; malefic affliction, offences; Jupiter's influence, a mystic or spiritual teacher; Saturn, work at burning grounds or graveyards.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Career problems, difficulty finding one's dharma, merit unnoticed, many changes; occult or mystical work; gains from wills, insurance or a partner's wealth.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.9
source_views.view: If the 10th lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th it impedes religious rites; even an exalted 10th lord spoils a religious work when its exaltation sign is a dusthana.

lord_in_house/10/8.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha agree on instability. Raman and Braha add occult, mystical or spiritual work as the constructive side. Strength decides.
lord_in_house/10/8.phrasing_guidance: Say career may go through changes and suits deep, investigative or behind-the-scenes work. Avoid longevity statements and avoid labelling the person 'critical' or 'cruel'.

lord_in_house/10/9.summary: The career lord in the house of fortune and dharma: a central Dharma-Karmadhipati link giving high status, wealth and children.
common_outcomes: royal or high status, wealth and children (BPHS 24.117)
a spiritual stalwart; with Jupiter's aspect, a beacon to spiritual seekers (Raman HTJH)
a hereditary profession, or work as preacher, teacher or healer (Raman HTJH); spiritual teacher or religious career (Braha)
the father has great influence; a dutiful son (Raman HTJH); a wealthy, long-lived father (Braha)
fortunate and honoured; long journeys for career (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 21.21: with the Moon in the 5th the person becomes renowned
BPHS 20.7: with the 9th lord in the 10th (exchange) and benefic aspect, the father is wealthy and famous
Phaladeepika 6.37-38: 9th and 10th lords together in a good house give kingly Raja yoga
JP 15.9: with Mercury exalted or in the 9th, engaged in meritorious works and sacrifices

by_area.personality: Dutiful and charitable (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Royal-equal status (BPHS 24.117); hereditary profession, preacher, teacher or healer (Raman HTJH); spiritual teacher (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealth (BPHS 24.117); generally fortunate and well-to-do (Raman HTJH).
by_area.family: Children (BPHS 24.117); strong influence of the father (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: A spiritual stalwart (Raman HTJH); pilgrimages (Braha); meritorious works (JP 15.9).

strengtheners: exchange or conjunction with the 9th lord, or mutual aspect: Raja yoga (Uttara Kalamrita 4.3; Laghu Parashari st. 15)
the pair joined with, or placed in the houses of, the 1st, 4th, 5th or 7th lords: wealth and prosperity (Uttara Kalamrita 4.3)
Moon in the 5th (BPHS 21.21); Jupiter's aspect (Raman HTJH)
a strong 10th lord in its own or exaltation sign in a trikona (Phaladeepika 16.27)
weakeners_or_cancellations: yoga lords that also own the 8th or 11th (Uttara Kalamrita 4.3), or association with the 8th and 11th lords (Laghu Parashari st. 21)
a 9th lord owning the 8th or 12th, or the pair joined with the 8th or 12th lords, destroys the merit (Uttara Kalamrita 4.83)
a 10th lord without strength (JP 15.2)
lord_in_house/10/9.lagna_or_context_notes: For Taurus Saturn owns both the 9th and 10th (Row's note to Laghu Parashari st. 15). For Aries the 10th lord Saturn also owns the 11th, and for Gemini the 9th lord Saturn also owns the 8th; Uttara Kalamrita 4.3 says the yoga lords should not hold those lordships.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.117
source_views.view: Royal or royal-equal status, wealth and children.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 21.21
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 9th with the Moon in the 5th: renowned.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.37-38 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: 9th and 10th lords conjoined in a good house: Raja yoga.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: A spiritual stalwart, a beacon to seekers if Jupiter aspects; generally fortunate; hereditary profession or preacher, teacher, healer; the father has great influence; charitable.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Wealthy, powerful, long-lived father; successful career, pilgrimages, very religious, spiritual teacher or religious career, fortunate, honoured, long journeys for career.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, slokas 3 and 83
source_views.view: 4.3: 9th and 10th lords in their own houses, conjoined in either, exchanged or in mutual aspect form Raja yoga; linked with the 1st, 4th, 5th or 7th lords they give wealth and prosperity; they must not also own the 8th or 11th. 4.83: a 9th lord owning the 8th or 12th, or the pair joined with 8th or 12th lords, destroys the merit.

source_views.source: Laghu Parashari / Jataka Chandrika (tr. B. Suryanarain Row, 1900), stanzas 15 and 21 with Row's notes
source_views.view: Stanza 15: the 9th and 10th lords conjoined in the 9th or 10th, exchanged, or each in its own house produce good (Raja yoga); mutual aspect also counts. Stanza 21: joined by the 8th and 11th lords, success is endangered.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.9
source_views.view: When Mercury, free of Rahu and Ketu, is exalted or in the 9th and the 10th lord occupies the 9th, the person performs sacrifices and other meritorious works.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Raja Yoga', p. 161
source_views.view: Lords of the 9th and 10th can create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses; Venus for Capricorn and Aquarius and Mars for Cancer and Leo are single planets that can produce Raja yoga.

lord_in_house/10/9.disagreements: Whether the placement alone (BPHS 24.117, Raman, Braha) or a mutual relationship of both lords (Laghu Parashari st. 15; Uttara Kalamrita 4.3) is needed for the full Dharma-Karmadhipati Raja yoga.
lord_in_house/10/9.phrasing_guidance: Describe strong potential for respected, meaningful work. Translate 'royal status' as leadership or recognition; timing depends on dashas.

lord_in_house/10/10.summary: The career lord in its own house: competence, courage and a strong professional life, with truthful conduct and respect for teachers.
common_outcomes: skilled in all kinds of work, courageous, truthful, devoted to teachers (BPHS 24.118)
strongly placed: highly successful and respected in the profession (Raman HTJH)
honours from government or prominent persons; prosperous and wealthy (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 16.27: with a benefic in the 10th, the strong 10th lord in its own sign gives renown, virtuous deeds and king-like affluence
three other planets with the 10th lord in the 10th: may become an ascetic (Raman HTJH); JP 15.35 similarly gives emancipation when the 10th lord joins four other planets in a kendra or trikona
weak and afflicted: dependent, seeking favours, fickle (Raman HTJH)

by_area.personality: Capable, courageous, truthful (BPHS 24.118); fickle-minded if weak and afflicted (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Highly successful and respected (Raman HTJH; Braha); routine and ordinary if the lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Prosperous and wealthy (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Devoted to gurus (BPHS 24.118); a powerful dharma (Braha).

strengtheners: the lord is in its own sign; a benefic in the 10th adds renown (Phaladeepika 16.27)
a strong 10th lord in the tenth harmonic (D10) shows great accomplishment (Frawley, harmonic charts)
weakeners_or_cancellations: weak and afflicted: dependence and lack of self-respect (Raman HTJH)
in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna: an ordinary career (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/10/10.lagna_or_context_notes: Which planet sits in its own sign here depends on the lagna. Uttara Kalamrita 4.79: natural benefics owning kendras lose benefic quality, while malefics owning kendras are not inauspicious.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.118
source_views.view: Skilled in all work, courageous, truthful, devoted to teachers.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.27
source_views.view: If a benefic occupies the 10th and the 10th lord in full strength is in a kendra or kona in its own or exaltation sign, or if the lagna lord is in the 10th, the person is revered, widely renowned, given to virtuous deeds, with king-like affluence and long life.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Strongly disposed: highly successful and respected; weak and afflicted: dependent and fickle; in the 6th/8th/12th from the navamsa lagna, a routine career; with three other planets, may become an ascetic.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Own house: successful career, respected or famous, prosperous, honours from government or prominent persons; a powerful dharma.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.35
source_views.view: When the 10th lord occupies a kendra or trikona together with four other planets, the person attains emancipation.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'Harmonic Charts', tenth harmonic, p. 193
source_views.view: The tenth harmonic is read with the Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and the 10th lord; if the 10th lord is strong there the person accomplishes great actions or achieves life goals.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, sloka 79
source_views.view: Benefics owning trikonas are auspicious in the 2nd, 3rd, 11th and kendras; a benefic owning a kendra does not give favourable results, while a malefic owning a kendra is not inauspicious.

lord_in_house/10/10.disagreements: None on the core; Raman makes the result sharply dependent on strength.
lord_in_house/10/10.phrasing_guidance: Present as a strong career signature. Avoid absolute promises of success.
