lord_in_house/10/11.summary: Career feeds gains: work brings income, achievement and satisfaction; the person is cheerful, truthful and blessed with children.
common_outcomes: wealth and sons; cheerful, virtuous, truthful (BPHS 24.119)
immense riches; gives employment to hundreds (Raman HTJH)
major desires and ambitions realised (Braha)
many, wealthy or influential friends (Raman HTJH; Braha)
the eldest sibling may help the career (Braha)
rare_outcomes: JP 12.104: the 10th lord in the 11th with the 11th lord in the 10th (exchange) gives ornaments and vehicles
an afflicted 11th house: friends turn into enemies (Raman HTJH)
the 10th lord aspects the 5th from here: intelligence, children, profitable investments (Braha)

by_area.personality: Cheerful and honest (BPHS 24.119); a high sense of honour (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Employs many; a successful career (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Immense riches (Raman HTJH); wealth (BPHS 24.119; Braha).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Raman HTJH); wealthy and influential friends (Braha).
by_area.family: Sons (BPHS 24.119); help from the eldest sibling (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Engages in meritorious deeds (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: exchange with the 11th lord (JP 12.104)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: an afflicted 11th house: friends become enemies and cause hardship (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/10/11.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries lagna Saturn owns the 10th and 11th and is in its own sign Aquarius here.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.119
source_views.view: Wealth and sons, cheerful, virtuous, truthful, happy.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Earns immense riches, fortunate, meritorious, gives employment to hundreds, a high sense of honour, many friends; an afflicted 11th turns friends into enemies.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: A very good position for wealth: ambitions realised, successful career, wealthy and influential friends, the eldest sibling may aid the career; the 10th lord aspects the 5th.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XII.104
source_views.view: When the 10th lord is in the 11th and the 11th lord in the 10th, the person has ornaments and vehicles.

lord_in_house/10/11.phrasing_guidance: Frame as work that pays off and fulfils goals. No guaranteed figures.

lord_in_house/10/12.summary: The career lord in the house of loss and distance: classically expenses through government or authorities and worry about opponents; modern readers also see work abroad, in institutions or behind the scenes.
common_outcomes: expenses through government or authorities; constant fear of enemies; anxiety (BPHS 24.120)
has to work in a far-off place or foreign country (Raman HTJH; Braha)
career problems, many changes, little honour (Braha)
lacks comforts and faces many difficulties (Raman HTJH)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 21.6: with Rahu, the person is disliked and prone to misdeeds (traditional)
BPHS 21.17: with the 8th lord in the 10th and a malefic joined, wicked deeds (traditional)
Phaladeepika's Duryoga (often away from home or abroad) as a traditional caution
beneficially disposed: a spiritual seeker (Raman HTJH); interest in moksha with other indications (Braha)

by_area.personality: Anxious (BPHS 24.120).
by_area.career: Work in a far-off place (Raman HTJH; Braha); career changes, merit unnoticed (Braha).
by_area.finance: Expenses through government matters (BPHS 24.120).
by_area.family: Malefic affliction: separation from family (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: A spiritual seeker when well disposed (Raman HTJH); interest in moksha (Braha); a 10th lord in a dusthana impedes religious rites (JP 15.9).

strengtheners: a strong 10th lord (Phaladeepika 15.9); benefic aspect (Phaladeepika 15.5)
benefic disposition turns the placement towards spiritual seeking (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: conjunction with Rahu (BPHS 21.6); Rahu afflicting the 10th lord: traditional lines on cheating (Raman HTJH), never used as character judgement
malefics and lack of strength (BPHS 21 verse on the 8th/12th)
the Sun as 10th lord for Scorpio lagna falls in Libra here, its debilitation sign
lord_in_house/10/12.lagna_or_context_notes: For Leo lagna Venus (3rd+10th) goes to Cancer; for Capricorn Venus (5th+10th) goes to Sagittarius; for Cancer Mars (5th+10th) goes to Gemini. Frawley (p. 161) counts Venus for Capricorn and Mars for Cancer as Raja-yoga-producing planets. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.120
source_views.view: Expenses through government matters, constant fear of enemies, anxiety.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 21.6, 21.17
source_views.view: 10th lord in the 12th with Rahu: disliked and prone to misdeeds; with the 8th lord in the 10th and malefics: wicked deeds.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.67 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Duryoga: little reward for labour, low regard, often abroad or away from home.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata XI.18 (via summary, Wikipedia: Karmasthana; verse not located in the Sastri translation, Adhyaya XV)
source_views.view: 10th lord in 6/8/12: bad name and hardships.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XIV 'Results of the Lord of the Tenth House being situated in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Works in a far-off place, lacks comforts and faces difficulties; beneficially disposed, a spiritual seeker; malefic affliction, separation from family and unlawful dealings; Rahu afflicting, cheating.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '10th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 10th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Career problems, many changes, no honour or fame, may work in a far-off country, difficulty finding one's dharma; a particularly bad placement, with interest in moksha if other factors agree.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.9
source_views.view: If the 10th lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th it impedes religious rites; even an exalted 10th lord spoils a religious work when its exaltation sign is a dusthana.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Raja Yoga', p. 161
source_views.view: Lords of the 9th and 10th can create Raja yoga when well placed and not ruling other bad houses; Venus for Capricorn and Aquarius and Mars for Cancer and Leo are single planets that can produce Raja yoga.

lord_in_house/10/12.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are negative (expenses, anxiety, career trouble). Raman and Braha agree on work in distant places and add a spiritual-seeker or moksha side when the lord is well disposed.
lord_in_house/10/12.phrasing_guidance: Describe career potential in distant places or institutional settings and the need to manage work-related costs. Never call the person wicked or disliked; give Rahu-related lines only as conditional traditional views.

lord_in_house/11/1.summary: The lord of gains on the lagna: income, ambitions and social networks attach to the person, who is classically wealthy, happy, even-minded and eloquent.
common_outcomes: wealthy, happy, even-minded, a poet and eloquent speaker (BPHS 24.121)
born into a rich family, very rich, fairly rich or well-to-do as the lord is strong, middling or weak (Raman HTJH); born wealthy (Braha)
gains through one's own effort (Rath Crux 14.8)
achieves desires; many opportunities and beneficial friends (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.8: 11th lord in the 1st with the lagna lord joined with the 11th indicates a notable gain around age 33 (traditional timing)
JP 11.62: the 11th lord in the 1st brings treasure or other valuable property
Raman gives early loss of an elder brother and Rath ill-health for the native (Crux 14.8) as traditional lines; never predict

by_area.personality: Pure-natured, even-minded, articulate (BPHS 24.121).
by_area.career: Gains come through one's own effort (Rath Crux 14.8).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.121); family wealth at birth scaled by the lord's strength (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.2 counts the 11th lord in a kendra as giving much gain.
by_area.relationships: Beneficial friends; happiness from the eldest sibling (Braha).

strengtheners: a strong 11th lord: born into a very rich family (Raman HTJH); exaltation (BPHS 22.2)
lagna lord linked to the 11th (BPHS 22.8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation or malefic affliction (BPHS 22.11 for afflicted 11th lords generally)

Frawley (p. 160) treats the 11th lord as generally malefic in health terms and inclined to make the character egoistic or impulsive, though good for gains; Rath also reads the 11th lord in or aspecting the lagna as unfavourable for the native's health (Crux 14.8)
lord_in_house/11/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Dual lordship matters: Saturn (10th+11th) for Aries, Jupiter (8th+11th) for Taurus, Mars (6th+11th) for Gemini, Mercury (8th+11th) for Scorpio, Venus (6th+11th) for Sagittarius, Saturn (11th+12th) for Pisces. BPHS 24.146-147: both lordships give results.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.121
source_views.view: Pure-natured, wealthy, happy, even-minded, a poet and eloquent speaker.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 22.2, 22.8
source_views.view: 11th lord in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, or exalted, gives much gain; in the 1st with the lagna lord joined, a notable gain around age 33.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House Occupying Different Houses'
source_views.view: Born into a rich family, very rich, fairly rich or well-to-do as the lord is strong, middling or weak; earns much; loses an elder brother early (traditional).

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Wealthy, many opportunities, achieves desires and ambitions, born into a wealthy family, beneficial friends, happiness from the eldest sibling.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 14.8 (placement of the eleventh lord)
source_views.view: In the 1st (or aspecting it) the gain is through one's own effort; the house occupied by the 11th lord shows ill-health for that relation, so here the native may suffer; the 11th lord in the 1st, 2nd or 8th is also said to curtail longevity (traditional).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XI.62
source_views.view: If the lagna lord is in the 2nd and the 2nd lord in the 11th, or if the 11th lord is in the 1st, the person gets treasure or other valuable property.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'House Lords as Specific Significators', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 11th lord, though generally malefic for health and prone to make the character egoistic or impulsive, is still the lord of gains: good for acquisitions and work with groups. Mercury as 2nd and 11th lord for Leo is a double significator of wealth. Saturn as 11th and 12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious, as the 11th is a difficult house.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

lord_in_house/11/1.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha are favourable for wealth. Braha gives happiness from the eldest sibling while Raman gives early loss of an elder brother, and Rath and Frawley add health cautions; treat the sibling and health lines as unreliable.
lord_in_house/11/1.phrasing_guidance: Describe good earning ability and sociability. Give the age-33 note only as traditional timing for a specific combination.

lord_in_house/11/2.summary: The lord of gains in the house of wealth: a classic dhana yoga, giving abundant wealth, accomplishment, generosity and happiness.
common_outcomes: abundant wealth; accomplished, generous, righteous and happy (BPHS 24.122)
earns through commerce and banking (Raman HTJH); banking or money-lending (Braha)
lives with or is helped by elder siblings (Raman HTJH; Braha)
gains by using family wealth or other assets (Rath Crux 14.8)
profitable business with friends (Raman HTJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.3: with the 2nd lord in a kendra and Jupiter linked, great gains
BPHS 22.9: exchange of 2nd and 11th lords gives great fortune after marriage
with the 2nd lord as well: large sums; with the 9th lord too, in exaltation or own vargas, a millionaire (Raman HTJH, combinations)
Frawley (Example Charts: Nelson Rockefeller, Virgo lagna): the Moon as 11th lord waxing in the 2nd house of income

by_area.personality: Generous, accomplished, righteous (BPHS 24.122); intelligent and a good speaker (Braha).
by_area.career: Commerce and banking (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Abundant wealth (BPHS 24.122); several sources of income (Braha); family assets put to use (Rath Crux 14.8).
by_area.relationships: Exchange case links fortune to marriage (BPHS 22.9).
by_area.family: Lives with elder brothers: benefics give harmony, malefics domestic bickering (Raman HTJH); domestic happiness (Braha).

strengtheners: 2nd lord in a kendra and Jupiter associated (BPHS 22.3)
exchange with the 2nd lord (BPHS 22.9)
joined with the 2nd and 9th lords in exaltation or own vargas (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics joining: heavy losses on account of friends (Raman HTJH)
the 11th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna gives only moderate results (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/11/2.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Jupiter owns the 2nd and 11th and sits in Pisces, own sign. For Leo lagna Mercury owns the 2nd and 11th and sits in Virgo, own sign and exalted; Frawley (p. 160) calls Mercury for Leo a double significator of wealth, though somewhat malefic for health.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.122
source_views.view: Abundant wealth, accomplished, generous, righteous, happy.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 22.3, 22.9
source_views.view: 11th lord in the 2nd with the 2nd lord in a kendra and Jupiter linked: great gain; exchange of 2nd and 11th lords: great fortune after marriage.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House Occupying Different Houses'
source_views.view: Lives with elder brothers, harmoniously with benefics; earns through commerce and banking; business with friends profitable, but heavy losses through friends if malefics join.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Important Combinations' (11th lord with the lord of the house it occupies)
source_views.view: 11th lord with the 2nd lord in the 2nd: large sums of money; with the 9th and 2nd lords in exaltation or own vargas, a millionaire; in the 6th/8th/12th from the navamsa lagna, moderate results.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Wealthy through several means, eldest sibling helps earn, domestic happiness, banking or money-lending, ventures with friends succeed, learned, good speaker.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 14.8 (placement of the eleventh lord)
source_views.view: In the 2nd, gains accrue by using family wealth or other assets.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Nelson Rockefeller
source_views.view: The Moon, lord of the 11th house of gain, is waxing in the 2nd house of income (Virgo lagna).

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'House Lords as Specific Significators', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 11th lord, though generally malefic for health and prone to make the character egoistic or impulsive, is still the lord of gains: good for acquisitions and work with groups. Mercury as 2nd and 11th lord for Leo is a double significator of wealth. Saturn as 11th and 12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious, as the 11th is a difficult house.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

lord_in_house/11/2.disagreements: None on wealth. Raman adds that malefic company turns friends into a source of loss.
lord_in_house/11/2.phrasing_guidance: Frame as strong potential for savings and family prosperity. No guaranteed amounts; treat the 'after marriage' line as traditional.

lord_in_house/11/3.summary: Gains through effort, skills and siblings: the person is skilful and wealthy and enjoys siblings' support. Both houses are upachayas, so results grow with time.
common_outcomes: skilful, wealthy, happiness from siblings (BPHS 24.123)
gains through brothers; many friends and helpful neighbours (Raman HTJH; Braha)
may earn as a singer or musician (Raman HTJH); gains from music, drama or literature (Braha)
desires and ambitions fulfilled: a kama lord in a kama house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.4: with benefics, a large gain around age 36 (traditional timing)
BPHS 22.10: exchange of 3rd and 11th lords gives wealth through brothers and fine ornaments
with the 3rd lord: brothers as business partners and writing ability (Raman HTJH, combinations)
Frawley (Example Charts: Mick Jagger, Taurus lagna): Jupiter, exalted as 11th lord in the 3rd, gives good financial gains
BPHS 24.123 mentions occasional fear of colic; do not use as a health prediction

by_area.personality: Skilful (BPHS 24.123); courageous (Braha).
by_area.career: Music, singing, drama or literary work (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.123); good gains with a strong lord (Frawley, Jagger chart).
by_area.relationships: Many friends and helpful neighbours (Raman HTJH); happy friendships (Braha).
by_area.family: Gains through brothers (Raman HTJH; Braha); in the exchange case, wealth through brothers (BPHS 22.10).

strengtheners: benefic association (BPHS 22.4)
exchange with the 3rd lord (BPHS 22.10)
exaltation (Frawley, Jagger chart)
weakeners_or_cancellations: affliction gives contrary results (Raman HTJH); with malefics, the brother suffers losses and competitors obstruct (Raman HTJH, combinations)

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.123
source_views.view: Skilful, wealthy, happiness from siblings, occasional fear of colic.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 22.4, 22.10
source_views.view: With benefics: notable gain around age 36; exchange of 3rd and 11th lords: wealth through brothers.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House Occupying Different Houses'
source_views.view: A concert-singer or musician who earns thereby; gains through brothers; many friends and helpful neighbours; affliction gives contrary results.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Important Combinations' (11th lord with the lord of the house it occupies)
source_views.view: With the 3rd lord: both elder and younger siblings, brothers as business partners, much wealth and writing ability; with malefics, a brother suffers losses and competitors obstruct.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: A kama lord in a kama house: desires fulfilled; money from music, dance, drama or literature; gains through siblings; courageous, happy friendships.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Mick Jagger
source_views.view: Jupiter, exalted as lord of the 11th house of income (in the 3rd for Taurus lagna), gives good financial gains.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

lord_in_house/11/3.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise gains through skill and effort. Skip the colic line or present it as a traditional phrase with no health implication.

lord_in_house/11/4.summary: Gains through home, land, mother's family and comfort: BPHS adds pilgrimages and happiness from house and property.
common_outcomes: gains through the maternal family, pilgrimages, comfort in home and land (BPHS 24.124)
profits from land, rentals, farming and products of the earth (Raman HTJH; Braha)
a cultured, distinguished mother; wealth from maternal relations (Raman HTJH; Braha)
renowned for learning; a good education (Raman HTJH; Braha)
a devoted and charming wife; comfort and enjoyment (Raman HTJH)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.5: 11th lord in a kendra with benefics gives a notable gain around age 40 (traditional timing)
with the 4th lord: an excellent education, awards and earnings through lands, vehicles and houses (Raman HTJH, combinations)

by_area.personality: Learned and scholarly (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Real estate, rentals, farming (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Gains via property (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.2 counts kendra placement as giving much gain.

source_views.view: In its own house: succeeds without much effort, fair dealings, money spent on legitimate and charitable purposes, a famous elder brother; the planet shows the trade (Jupiter books and religion, Saturn industry, Venus arts and hospitality, and so on).

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Own house: easy gains, desires fulfilled, many financial opportunities, gains from a powerful eldest sibling, many friends.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

lord_in_house/11/11.phrasing_guidance: Present as strong potential for steady gains and fulfilment. Avoid promising wealth.

lord_in_house/11/12.summary: The gains lord in the house of expenditure: gains tend to flow out, often to good causes, and the person may have strong desires and dealings with foreigners or outsiders.
common_outcomes: spends on good causes; strong desires; associates with outsiders (BPHS 24.132)
losses in business; frequent fines and penalties (Raman HTJH)
expenses on account of an elder sibling's troubles (Raman HTJH; Braha)
many financial losses and unfulfilled desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.132 says lustful with many wives; a traditional line, not to be used as character judgement
Phaladeepika's Daridra yoga as a traditional caution
with the 12th lord: losses through varied expenditure; in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, debts (Raman HTJH, combinations)
comfortable bed pleasures (Braha)

by_area.personality: Strong desires (BPHS 24.132).
by_area.career: Business losses (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Gains flow out; fines and penalties (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.11: in a trika house with malefics, gains fail despite effort.
by_area.relationships: Few or bad friends (Braha). Traditional texts link it with multiple relationships (BPHS 24.132); treat with great care.
by_area.family: Burdened with domestic responsibilities; expenses for an elder sibling (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Spending on good causes (BPHS 24.132).

strengtheners: strong lord (Phaladeepika 15.9); benefic aspect (15.5)
own-sign case: for Pisces lagna Saturn owns 11th and 12th and is in Aquarius here
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic association (BPHS 22.11)
malefics afflicting the 12th: wealth squandered (Raman HTJH, combinations)
lord_in_house/11/12.lagna_or_context_notes: For Pisces lagna Saturn (11th+12th) is in its own sign Aquarius here; Frawley (p. 159) calls Saturn as 11th and 12th lord for Pisces very inauspicious, the 11th being itself a difficult house. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.132
source_views.view: Spends on good causes, strong desires, many wives, associates with outsiders.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 22.11
source_views.view: 11th lord in a trika house with malefics: no gain despite effort.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.68 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Daridra yoga for the 11th lord in a dusthana.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House Occupying Different Houses'
source_views.view: Losses in business; an ailing elder brother and expenses on his illness; frequent fines and penalties; many domestic responsibilities.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Important Combinations' (11th lord with the lord of the house it occupies)
source_views.view: With the 12th lord: losses through varied expenditure; with an afflicted 12th, wealth squandered; in the 6th/8th/12th from the navamsa lagna, debts.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Many financial losses, few opportunities, desires unfulfilled, losses and debts through the eldest sibling, few or bad friends, good bed pleasures.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'House Lords as Specific Significators', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 11th lord, though generally malefic for health and prone to make the character egoistic or impulsive, is still the lord of gains: good for acquisitions and work with groups. Mercury as 2nd and 11th lord for Leo is a double significator of wealth. Saturn as 11th and 12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious, as the 11th is a difficult house.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

lord_in_house/11/12.disagreements: BPHS 24.132 includes spending on good causes alongside negative lines; Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are wholly negative on gains. For Pisces lagna the own-sign placement does not rescue the result in Frawley's view.
lord_in_house/11/12.phrasing_guidance: Say income may flow to travel, charity or distant ventures and that budgeting helps. Do not repeat the 'many wives' or 'lustful' line.

lord_in_house/12/1.summary: The lord of expenditure on the lagna: classical and modern sources see high spending and a thin constitution or resources, while Braha, Raman and Frawley also see an ascetic, spiritual or travelling disposition.
common_outcomes: extravagant; lacks wealth and learning (BPHS 24.133)
a weak constitution, yet handsome and sweet-tongued (Raman HTJH)
constant travelling if the lagna is a common sign (Raman HTJH)
an ascetic or spiritual nature; travel for spiritual purposes (Braha)
Rath: loss of health is shown (Crux 15.10); a traditional line, never a medical claim
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.133 speaks of physical weakness and phlegm-related trouble; do not use as a health prediction
BPHS 23.14: with the lagna lord in the 12th and the 12th lord in the lagna joined with Venus, expenditure on dharmic matters
exchange of the lagna and 12th lords: miserly and disliked (Raman HTJH); contrast BPHS 23.14
the placement can also indicate living abroad or confinement (Raman HTJH); traditional
Frawley (Example Charts: Paramahansa Yogananda, Gemini lagna): the Moon as 12th lord in the 1st shows a capacity for noble self-negation

by_area.personality: Feeble-minded yet handsome and sweet-tongued (Raman HTJH); ascetic or spiritual (Braha); noble self-negation (Frawley, Yogananda chart).
by_area.finance: Extravagant and lacking wealth (BPHS 24.133); in the 12th lord's period with the lagna lord, wealth lost through short-sighted schemes (Raman HTJH, periods).
by_area.health: Physical weakness is a traditional line (BPHS 24.133; Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 15.10); never use as a medical prediction.
by_area.relationships: Bad for married life, as the 12th lord aspects the 7th (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Ascetic or spiritual nature; travel for spiritual purposes (Braha).

strengtheners: 12th lord with benefics, in own sign or exalted (BPHS 23.1 lists these as the good condition of the 12th lord)
a benefic 12th lord reduces the evil (Raman HTJH, periods)
exchange with the lagna lord plus Venus turns spending towards dharma (BPHS 23.14)
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the lagna lord without Venus: miserliness (Raman HTJH)
malefic, debilitated or combust company of the 12th lord: questionable spending (Raman HTJH, general combinations)
lord_in_house/12/1.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Saturn owns both the 1st and 12th and is in its own sign here; Frawley (pp. 159-160) says the lagna lord is always generally auspicious and a 12th lordship mainly gives the other house's results, so the lagna role dominates.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.133
source_views.view: Extravagant, physically weak, phlegm-related trouble, lacks wealth and learning.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 23.1, 23.14
source_views.view: 12th lord with benefics, own sign or exaltation is favourable; lagna lord in the 12th and 12th lord in the lagna with Venus: spending on dharma.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Weak constitution and feeble-minded, yet handsome and sweet-tongued; travels if in a common sign; with the 6th lord, long life unless the 8th is afflicted; can show confinement and living abroad; a lagna-12th exchange makes one miserly and disliked.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: 12th lord in the lagna with the lagna lord: in its period, loss of affection, dull intellect, miserliness and loss of wealth through short-sighted schemes; a benefic 12th lord reduces the evil.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Poor health and appearance, little confidence, an unhappy start; an ascetic or spiritual nature, travel for spiritual purposes; bad for married life as the 12th lord aspects the 7th.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Paramahansa Yogananda
source_views.view: The Moon in the 1st as lord of the 12th house of loss and negation shows a capacity for noble self-negation.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)
source_views.view: The 12th lord causes losses and grief to the house it occupies (in the 1st, loss of health; in the 2nd, loss of wealth). In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Dual House Rulership', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 12th lordship mainly gives the effect of the other house the planet rules (Venus as 5th+12th lord for Gemini is very auspicious); its negative effect shows most when the other house is also malefic (Saturn as 11th+12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious). The lagna lord is always generally auspicious despite a second malefic lordship.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/1.disagreements: BPHS, Raman, Braha and Rath are negative on body and resources; Braha, Raman and Frawley's Yogananda example add a spiritual or ascetic side. Raman reads a lagna-12th exchange as miserly, while BPHS 23.14 with Venus turns it to dharmic spending.
lord_in_house/12/1.phrasing_guidance: Describe a reflective, generous nature and a need to manage spending. Never mention bodily weakness or illness as a prediction.

lord_in_house/12/2.summary: The lord of expenditure in the house of wealth and speech: BPHS says spending goes to auspicious acts and the person is sweet-spoken and virtuous, while Raman, Braha and Rath predict financial losses unless the 12th lord is a dignified benefic.
common_outcomes: spends on auspicious acts; righteous, pleasant speech, good qualities (BPHS 24.134)
financial losses and possible debts (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 15.10)
irregular meals and weak eyesight (Raman HTJH; Braha); traditional lines
family life lacking harmony (Raman HTJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: a benefic 12th lord in dignity greatly reduces the evil and gives financial stability and tactful speech (Raman HTJH)
the 2nd lord in the 12th with the 12th lord in the 2nd (exchange) is a yoga for poverty (Frawley p. 179)
with the 2nd lord here: family bickering in the 12th lord's period, much reduced if the lord is favourably disposed (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.personality: Gentle-spoken and good-natured (BPHS 24.134); tactful if the lord is a dignified benefic, given to gossip if ill-disposed (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: BPHS gives spending on auspicious acts; Raman, Braha and Rath give losses and debts.
by_area.family: Lack of family harmony (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Religious giving (BPHS 24.134).

strengtheners: a benefic 12th lord in dignity (Raman HTJH); benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
12th lord in benefic vargas: spending on approved objects (JP 15.75)
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the 2nd lord: a poverty yoga (Frawley p. 179)
an ill-disposed 12th lord: gossip and quarrelling (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/12/2.lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Venus (5th+12th) is here in Cancer; Frawley (p. 159) calls Venus for Gemini very auspicious, giving mainly 5th-house results. For Cancer lagna Mercury (3rd+12th) is here in Leo. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.134
source_views.view: Spends on auspicious acts, righteous, pleasant speech, good qualities.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Financial losses, debts, irregular meals, poor eyesight, family discord; a benefic 12th lord in dignity greatly reduces this and gives financial stability and tactful speech; ill-disposed, gossip and quarrels.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 2nd lord: domestic bickering, poor food, ill temper in the 12th lord's period; much reduced if the 12th lord is favourably disposed.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Poor, financial losses, unhappy family life, foul language, poor right-eye vision, bad food, a poor speaker.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', p. 179
source_views.view: If the 2nd lord is in the 12th and the 12th lord in the 2nd, this is a yoga for poverty.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)
source_views.view: The 12th lord causes losses and grief to the house it occupies (in the 1st, loss of health; in the 2nd, loss of wealth). In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.75
source_views.view: If the 12th lord occupies benefic vargas, all outlay is on approved, legitimate objects; with or aspected by a weak planet, the outlay is questionable.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Dual House Rulership', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 12th lordship mainly gives the effect of the other house the planet rules (Venus as 5th+12th lord for Gemini is very auspicious); its negative effect shows most when the other house is also malefic (Saturn as 11th+12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious). The lagna lord is always generally auspicious despite a second malefic lordship.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/2.disagreements: Sharp: BPHS 24.134 is favourable in character and channels spending to good acts, while Raman, Braha and Rath predict financial losses. Raman partly reconciles them: a dignified benefic 12th lord gives financial stability.
lord_in_house/12/2.phrasing_guidance: Speak of kindness in speech and generous giving; suggest mindful saving.

lord_in_house/12/3.summary: The lord of loss in the house of siblings and effort: BPHS says sibling happiness is limited and the person may be at odds with others and focused on self-care.
common_outcomes: lacks sibling happiness, hostile to others, attentive to own body (BPHS 24.135)
timid and quiet; spends on younger siblings (Raman HTJH)
little success as a writer; a commonplace job (Raman HTJH); no literary ability (Braha)
strong intuition (Braha)
rare_outcomes: with the 2nd lord here and Jupiter or the 9th lord aspecting: more than one marriage (Raman HTJH)
with the 3rd lord: mounting expenditure and many journeys in the period; joined instead with the 6th and 8th lords, good food, riches and luxuries (Raman HTJH, periods)
malefic affliction: ear trouble (Raman HTJH; Braha); a traditional line only

by_area.personality: Timid and quiet (Raman HTJH); hostile to others (BPHS 24.135); intuitive (Braha).
by_area.career: Commonplace work; unsuccessful as a writer (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Spending on younger siblings (Raman HTJH).
by_area.family: Lacks sibling happiness (BPHS 24.135; Braha).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
the 12th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, or aspected by benefics, reverses the bad results (Raman HTJH, periods)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/12/3.lagna_or_context_notes: For Capricorn lagna Jupiter owns the 3rd and 12th and is in Pisces, own sign, here.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.135
source_views.view: Lacks sibling happiness, hostile to others, attentive to own body.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Timid and quiet, loss of a brother, shabbily dressed, ear trouble if afflicted, spends on younger brothers, an unsuccessful writer in a commonplace job; with the 2nd lord here and Jupiter or the 9th lord aspecting, more than one wife.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 3rd lord: brothers face hardship and expenses mount; contrary results if in the 6th/8th/12th navamsa or aspected by benefics; many journeys; combined with the 6th and 8th lords, riches and luxuries.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: No happiness from siblings, unfulfilled desires, no literary or artistic talent, fearful, unsuccessful efforts; yet strong intuition. Rule list: the 12th lord in the 3rd gives enormous intuition.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/3.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on little sibling happiness and weak efforts; Braha alone adds strong intuition.
lord_in_house/12/3.phrasing_guidance: Mention possible distance from siblings without implying conflict is fated. Encourage communication.

lord_in_house/12/4.summary: The lord of loss in the house of home and mother: BPHS, Raman and Braha see little happiness from the mother and losses around land, vehicles and houses; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a strong spiritual pull.
common_outcomes: little happiness from the mother; daily losses concerning land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136)
mental restlessness, enmity of relatives and living abroad (Raman HTJH)
an ordinary residence and trouble from landlords (Raman HTJH); few fixed assets, car problems (Braha)
a strong spiritual nature: a moksha lord in a moksha house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: a well-placed 12th lord mitigates much of this (Raman HTJH)
rents out part of the home or buys houses to rent (Braha)
many career changes, as the 12th lord aspects the 10th (Braha)
with the 4th lord and benefics: substantial property and growing interest in spiritual literature (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.personality: Mentally restless and worried (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Many career changes (Braha).
by_area.finance: Losses on land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136; Braha).
by_area.family: Little happiness from the mother (BPHS 24.136; Braha); enmity of relatives (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: Desire for liberation (Braha).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1); a well-placed 12th lord (Raman HTJH)
a strong Venus: own conveyance, though it gives trouble (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction of the 12th lord: trouble over property (Raman HTJH, periods)

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.136
source_views.view: Little happiness from the mother; daily losses concerning land, vehicles and houses.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Early loss of the mother (traditional), mental restlessness, enmity of relatives, living abroad, an ordinary house and trouble with landlords; well placed, these are largely mitigated; a strong Venus gives an often troublesome conveyance.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 4th lord: benefics give substantial property and interest in spiritual literature; malefics bring trouble over property and a crisis for the mother.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: A moksha lord in a moksha house: strong spiritual nature; little happiness from the mother, few comforts and assets, car problems, rents out houses; career changes as the 12th lord aspects the 10th.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/4.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on losses and distance from the mother; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a spiritual pull.
lord_in_house/12/4.phrasing_guidance: Suggest home life may involve moves or distance from the birthplace and that property needs careful handling. No claims about the mother's health.

lord_in_house/12/5.summary: The lord of expenditure in the house of children and learning: BPHS speaks of setbacks in education and children-related matters, spending on children and a pull towards pilgrimage.
common_outcomes: losses regarding children and education; expenses for children; pilgrimage (BPHS 24.137)
difficulty having children or unhappiness from them (Raman HTJH; Braha); traditional, never predict
religious-minded; undertakes pilgrimages (Raman HTJH)
mental unrest, losses from investments, trouble with exams (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.137 includes loss of children; never use as a prediction
BPHS 23.2: the Moon as 12th lord in the 5th, 9th or 11th is singled out (result implied; Leo lagna case)
crops fail if one takes up agriculture (Raman HTJH)
an ascetic or spiritual child (Braha)

by_area.personality: Religious-minded (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Losses from investments (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Unhappy love affairs (Braha).
by_area.family: Spending on children (BPHS 24.137).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage (BPHS 24.137; Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics afflicting the 12th lord: trouble on account of children (Raman HTJH, periods)
lord_in_house/12/5.lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Venus (5th+12th) and Sagittarius lagna Mars (5th+12th) are in their own signs here. Frawley (p. 159) calls Venus for Gemini very auspicious, giving mainly 5th-house results, and his mulatrikona rule points the same way for Mars (Aries, the 5th) for Sagittarius.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.137
source_views.view: Loss regarding children and education, expenses for the son, inclination to pilgrimage.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 23.2
source_views.view: Moon as 12th lord in the 9th, 11th or 5th is singled out for a result.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Difficulty begetting children or unhappiness from them; religious-minded, undertakes pilgrimages; weak-minded at times; crops fail in agriculture.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 5th lord: progeny in the period but mental strain and loss of friends; malefics bring trouble on account of children.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Few children or little happiness from them, an ascetic or spiritual child, no peace of mind, losses from investments, trouble with exams, unhappy love affairs.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Dual House Rulership', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 12th lordship mainly gives the effect of the other house the planet rules (Venus as 5th+12th lord for Gemini is very auspicious); its negative effect shows most when the other house is also malefic (Saturn as 11th+12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious). The lagna lord is always generally auspicious despite a second malefic lordship.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/5.disagreements: None on the core; BPHS, Raman and Braha are negative on children and peace of mind, with pilgrimage as the shared positive.
lord_in_house/12/5.phrasing_guidance: Talk about investment in children and education and a spiritual bent. Never predict loss of children or fertility problems.

lord_in_house/12/6.summary: A dusthana lord in another dusthana: Vimala yoga in Phaladeepika and a Viparita Raja yoga in Uttara Kalamrita and Rath, with Raman giving happiness and victory over enemies, while BPHS 24.138 gives harsh character lines and Braha is mixed.
common_outcomes: Vimala yoga: spends little, saves much, kind, happy, independent, respectable (Phaladeepika 6.69)
happy, prosperous, healthy; vanquishes enemies (Raman HTJH); defeats enemies and competitors, debts and expenses decrease (Braha)
litigation that ends in one's favour (Raman HTJH)
good for moksha, as the 12th lord aspects its own house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.138: conflict with kin, anger, unhappiness and attraction to others' spouses; traditional view, conflicts with Phaladeepika
Phaladeepika 6.32-33: an exchange of the 6th and 12th lords forms a Dainya yoga, which is unfavourable; differs from simple placement
Uttara Kalamrita 4.22: with the 6th and 8th lords also in dusthanas and connected only among themselves, a renowned and wealthy person of great power
with the 6th lord: a joyous period, fortune, wealth and a noble spouse (Raman HTJH, periods)
malefics afflicting the 12th lord: unscrupulous and ill-tempered (Raman HTJH); traditional

by_area.personality: Independent, frugal, kind (Phaladeepika 6.69).
by_area.career: Respectable occupation (Phaladeepika 6.69); Braha instead gives bad jobs and problems with subordinates.
by_area.finance: Spends little, saves much (Phaladeepika 6.69); prosperous (Raman HTJH); debts and expenses decrease (Braha).
by_area.relationships: BPHS warns of friction with relatives.
by_area.spirituality: Good for moksha (Braha).

strengtheners: the 6th and 8th lords also in dusthanas and connected (Uttara Kalamrita 4.22); with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, Vipareeta Raja yoga (Rath Crux 15.10)
joined with the 6th lord (Raman HTJH, periods); related to a well-placed 6th lord: fortunate (Raman HTJH, general combinations)
aaps.space (via summary) ties Vimala to the 12th lord in the 6th or 8th with malefic association
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the 6th lord (Dainya yoga, Phaladeepika 6.32-33)
malefics afflicting the 12th lord (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/12/6.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries (Jupiter, 9th+12th) the lord goes to Virgo; for Libra (Mercury, 9th+12th) to Pisces, its debilitation sign; for Aquarius Saturn (1st+12th) to Cancer. Frawley (pp. 159-160) says a 12th lordship mainly gives the other house's results, so for these lagnas the 9th or 1st lordship carries the weight. The pure 12th lords are the Moon for Leo and the Sun for Virgo.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.138
source_views.view: Hostility with kin, anger, unhappiness, sinful tendencies, attraction to others' spouses.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.69 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: 12th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th: Vimala yoga; spends little, saves much, kind, happy, independent, respectable occupation, known for good qualities.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.32-33 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Exchanges of the 12th lord with the 6th or 8th lords form Dainya yogas with unfavourable results.

source_views.source: aaps.space, Vimala Yog (via summary of Phaladeepika)
source_views.view: Vimala forms when the 12th lord is in the 6th or 8th with malefic association; frugal, happy, independent, respectable profession.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Happy and prosperous, long-lived, comfortable, healthy and handsome, vanquishes enemies; litigation ends in his favour; afflicted by malefics, unscrupulous and ill-tempered.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 6th lord: the 12th lord's period is full of festivities, fortune, wealth, a noble wife; combined with the 8th lord, political power and fame.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Unhealthy, bad jobs, problems with subordinates; defeats enemies and competitors; good for moksha as the 12th lord aspects its own house; decreases debts and expenses.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, sloka 22
source_views.view: If the 8th lord is in the 12th or 6th, the 6th lord in the 8th or 12th, and the 12th lord in the 8th or 6th, and these lords are connected among themselves and free of links with other planets, the native will be a great king, renowned and wealthy.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)
source_views.view: The 12th lord causes losses and grief to the house it occupies (in the 1st, loss of health; in the 2nd, loss of wealth). In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'General Combinations'
source_views.view: 12th lord in benefic vargas: wealth spent in honourable, approved ways; with a malefic, debilitated or combust planet: spending in questionable ways. Exalted or in a friendly sign: generous; related to a well-placed 6th lord: fortunate.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/6.disagreements: Sharp: BPHS 24.138 is harsh, while Phaladeepika's Vimala, Uttara Kalamrita 4.22, Raman and Rath are favourable; Braha is mixed (enemies defeated and debts reduced, but poor health and jobs). Sources also disagree on Vimala's houses (6th/8th only, or 6th/8th/12th).
lord_in_house/12/6.phrasing_guidance: Lead with the Vimala reading (discipline with money, independence, good name). Present BPHS's character lines only as a minority traditional view; never call the person sinful or unfaithful.

lord_in_house/12/7.summary: The lord of expenditure in the house of marriage: BPHS, Raman and Braha see constant spouse-related expenses and limited marital happiness, with Raman adding separation, later asceticism, or a spouse living abroad.
common_outcomes: constant expenses through the spouse; little marital happiness (BPHS 24.139; Braha)
a spouse from a modest family; possible separation (Raman HTJH)
a turn to asceticism later in life (Raman HTJH); possible ascetic nature (Braha)
problematic or unsuccessful partnerships (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.139 also mentions lack of strength and learning (traditional)
with the 7th lord: the wife may live abroad; benefic aspects bring money and a crisis survived (Raman HTJH, periods)
Rath gives the converse case, the 7th lord in the 12th, as a spouse from a poor family (Crux 15.10)

by_area.career: Problematic partnerships (Braha).
by_area.finance: Debts and expenses on account of the spouse (BPHS 24.139; Braha).
by_area.relationships: Marriage needs care; separation or a spouse living abroad are traditional themes (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: Takes to asceticism later (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
benefics aspecting the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, periods)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics afflicting the 7th and the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, periods)
lord_in_house/12/7.lagna_or_context_notes: For Taurus lagna Mars (7th+12th) and Scorpio lagna Venus (7th+12th) sit in their own signs here.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.139
source_views.view: Constant expenses through the spouse, little marital happiness, lacks strength and learning.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: A wife from a poor family, unhappy marriage possibly ending in separation, later asceticism; weak health; without learning or property.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 7th lord: some danger to the wife, who may live abroad; benefic aspects bring money and the wife surviving a crisis; malefics bring wandering and sorrow.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Unhappy married life, debts and expenses on account of the spouse, problematic partnerships; the 12th lord aspects the lagna, giving poor health, little fame and possibly an ascetic nature.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)
source_views.view: Planets placed in the 12th show losses to the houses they own: e.g. the 7th lord in the 12th gives a spouse from a poor family (the converse of this placement).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/7.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha are negative on marriage. Raman alone mentions the spouse living abroad, in the 12th lord's period with the 7th lord.
lord_in_house/12/7.phrasing_guidance: Say partnership needs conscious care and may involve periods of distance. No predictions of divorce, and no statements about the spouse's health.

lord_in_house/12/8.summary: A dusthana lord in another dusthana: Vimala yoga in Phaladeepika, a Viparita Raja yoga in Uttara Kalamrita, and unusually favourable in BPHS and Raman too (steady gains, wealth, legacies, pleasant speech); Braha is mixed.
common_outcomes: steady gains, pleasant speech and good qualities (BPHS 24.140)
rich and celebrated, a luxurious life; gains through legacies (Raman HTJH)
interest in the occult; righteous, famous, a gentle speaker (Raman HTJH)
frugality and independence (Phaladeepika 6.69); a strong spiritual nature (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.140 mentions a medium lifespan; do not use as a longevity claim
Phaladeepika 6.32-33: exchange of 8th and 12th lords forms a Dainya yoga, unfavourable
Uttara Kalamrita 4.79: if the 8th and 12th lords are associated or exchanged, the 8th lord gives good results and the 12th lord fortune
with the 8th lord: luck with some trouble, slow but successful ventures, money and authority in the period (Raman HTJH, periods)
no benefits from a partner's wealth or insurance (Braha)

by_area.personality: Pleasant-spoken and virtuous (BPHS 24.140; Raman HTJH); independent (Phaladeepika 6.69).
by_area.finance: Steady gains (BPHS 24.140); rich, with legacies (Raman HTJH); no benefit from a partner's wealth or insurance (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Occult interests and devotion to Vishnu (Raman HTJH); desire for final liberation (Braha).

strengtheners: the 6th and 8th lords also in dusthanas and connected (Uttara Kalamrita 4.22); with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, Vipareeta Raja yoga (Rath Crux 15.10)
Vimala condition per aaps.space summary (12th lord in 6th or 8th, malefic association)
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the 8th lord (Dainya, Phaladeepika 6.32-33), though Uttara Kalamrita 4.79 reads it favourably
malefic affliction of the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, general combinations)
lord_in_house/12/8.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Saturn (1st+12th) goes to Virgo; for Capricorn Jupiter (3rd+12th) goes to Leo. Frawley (pp. 159-160): the lagna lordship is always generally auspicious and a 12th lordship mainly gives the other house's results. The pure 12th lords are the Moon for Leo and the Sun for Virgo.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Rich and celebrated, a luxurious life with servants, gains through legacies; interested in the occult, devoted to Vishnu, righteous, famous, gentle-spoken.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 8th lord: luck with some troubles; in the period, happiness and success though slow, celebrations, money and authority.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: A moksha lord in a moksha house: strong spiritual nature, occult interests, desire for liberation; no benefit from a partner's wealth or insurance; said to decrease longevity (traditional).

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, sloka 22
source_views.view: If the 8th lord is in the 12th or 6th, the 6th lord in the 8th or 12th, and the 12th lord in the 8th or 6th, and these lords are connected among themselves and free of links with other planets, the native will be a great king, renowned and wealthy.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)

In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

lord_in_house/12/8.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Uttara Kalamrita and Raman agree it is favourable; Braha is mixed. On an 8th-12th exchange, Phaladeepika 6.32-33 (Dainya, unfavourable) and Uttara Kalamrita 4.79 (favourable) disagree. Vimala's exact formation rule also differs between sources.
lord_in_house/12/8.phrasing_guidance: Present as a quietly fortunate placement for savings, depth and spiritual growth. Do not mention lifespan.

lord_in_house/12/9.summary: The lord of loss in the house of dharma and teachers: BPHS and Braha warn of little faith, friction with teachers and a spoiled house of fortune, while Raman gives residence and prosperity abroad.
common_outcomes: disrespect towards teachers; enmity even with friends; self-interested (BPHS 24.141)
residence abroad and prosperity; property in foreign lands (Raman HTJH)
honest, generous and large-hearted (Raman HTJH)
little happiness from the father; little faith or gain from gurus (Braha)
comfortable beds and a peaceful afterlife (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 23.2: the Moon as 12th lord (Leo lagna) in the 9th is singled out for a result
BPHS 20.19: exchange of 9th and 12th lords is among harsh father-related combinations; traditional only
with the 9th lord: a steady career; benefics aspecting the 9th give piety but modest material prosperity (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.personality: Generous and large-hearted (Raman HTJH); disrespect for teachers (BPHS 24.141).
by_area.career: Prosperity abroad (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Property in foreign lands (Raman HTJH); debts and expenses on account of the father (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Friction even with friends (BPHS 24.141); Raman adds dislike of spouse, friends and preceptor.
by_area.family: Little happiness from the father (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: May lack spiritual leanings (Raman HTJH); little faith (Braha).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
benefics aspecting the 9th: piety and virtue (Raman HTJH, periods)
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the 9th lord (BPHS 20.19)
an afflicted 9th lord: loss of job and luck (Raman HTJH, periods)
lord_in_house/12/9.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries (Jupiter, 9th+12th) and Libra (Mercury, 9th+12th) the lord sits in its own sign here; Frawley (pp. 159-160) says a 12th lordship mainly gives the other house's results, here the 9th.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.141
source_views.view: Disrespect towards teachers, enmity even with friends, focused on own interests.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 23.2, 20.19

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Residence abroad and prosperity, property in foreign lands; honest, generous and large-hearted but perhaps without spiritual leanings; dislikes spouse, friends and preceptor; a traditional caution for the father.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 9th lord: a steady career; an afflicted 9th lord brings loss of job and luck; benefics aspecting the 9th give piety and virtue with modest prosperity.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: No happiness from the father, debts on his account, no luck or faith, no gains from gurus; fine beds and a peaceful afterlife; a particularly bad position since the house of fortune is spoiled.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Dual House Rulership', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 12th lordship mainly gives the effect of the other house the planet rules (Venus as 5th+12th lord for Gemini is very auspicious); its negative effect shows most when the other house is also malefic (Saturn as 11th+12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious). lord_in_house/12/9.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha are negative on teachers, the father and faith (Braha: 'a particularly bad position' since the house of fortune is spoiled); Raman alone gives prosperity and property abroad.
lord_in_house/12/9.phrasing_guidance: Describe a seeker who may find meaning far from home and think independently. Do not label the person disrespectful; no statements about the father's health or death.

lord_in_house/12/10.summary: The lord of expenditure in the career house: BPHS gives expenses through authorities and less happiness from the father; Raman and Braha add hard, institutional or unsettled careers.
common_outcomes: expenses from government or authorities; little happiness from the father (BPHS 24.142)
hard work and tedious journeys for the occupation (Raman HTJH)
work as a jailor, doctor or in cemeteries and similar places (Raman HTJH)
career problems, merit unnoticed, many career changes (Braha)
rare_outcomes: spends on agriculture and profits from it (Raman HTJH)
little happiness from sons (Raman HTJH)
with the 10th lord: spending on charity; paternal property may slip away; benefic aspects bring detachment (Raman HTJH, periods)
the 12th lord aspects the 4th from here: difficulty with degrees and friction with the mother (Braha)

by_area.finance: Expenses through authorities (BPHS 24.142); profits from agriculture (Raman HTJH).

by_area.spirituality: Benefic aspect gives detachment and spirituality (Raman HTJH, periods).

benefics aspecting the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, periods)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction of the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, periods)
lord_in_house/12/10.lagna_or_context_notes: Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148). For Pisces lagna Saturn (11th+12th) goes to Sagittarius here; for Aquarius Saturn (1st+12th) goes to Scorpio.

lord_in_house/12/10.phrasing_guidance: Describe demanding or institutional work, possible career changes and the need to manage work-related costs. No claims about the father's health.

troubled by extravagant brothers (Raman HTJH); difficulties with the eldest sibling (Braha)
may earn well trading in pearls and precious stones (Raman HTJH)
rare_outcomes: Frawley (Example Charts: Lord Rama, Cancer lagna): Mercury as 12th lord in the 11th shows a charitable nature
with the 11th lord: financial setbacks; benefics make one spend on religion and charity (Raman HTJH, periods)
the 12th lord aspects the 5th from here: problems with children and investments (Braha)

by_area.finance: Mixed: losses with occasional windfalls (BPHS 24.143); few profits (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.relationships: Few or bad friends (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.family: Extravagant or ailing brothers (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: Charitable nature (Frawley, Rama chart); spending on religion with benefic aspect (Raman HTJH, periods).

benefics aspecting the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, periods)

spends on religious and righteous purposes (Raman HTJH)
good eyesight and bed pleasures (Raman HTJH; Braha)

Vimala yoga by the general rule (Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.69)

BPHS 23.11-12: an afflicted 12th lord gives wandering between countries; a well-placed one with benefics gives travel abroad
a movable sign holding the Moon or Mercury, with benefic aspects: much travel and residence abroad (Raman HTJH)

by_area.career: Success in foreign lands (Braha).
by_area.finance: BPHS: heavy expenditure; Braha: few expenses, saves easily; Raman: spending on religious causes and, in its period, wealth without untoward expense.
by_area.spirituality: Moksha orientation (BPHS 23.10; Braha); seeks the company of holy people (Raman HTJH, periods).

benefics aspecting the 12th (BPHS 23.12); a benefic 12th lord here gives generally favourable results (Raman HTJH)
12th lord in benefic vargas: spending on approved objects (JP 15.75)

papakartari or malefic aspect: may leave the country under pressure (Raman HTJH)
lord_in_house/12/12.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Saturn (1st+12th) is in Capricorn; for Pisces Saturn (11th+12th) is in Aquarius; for Aries Jupiter (9th+12th) is in Pisces. Dual lordship shapes the result (BPHS 24.146-147).

lord_in_house/12/12.disagreements: BPHS 24.144 is negative, while Raman, Braha and Vimala readings are positive. Sources disagree whether Vimala includes the 12th: Phaladeepika's general rule (6.57) covers 6/8/12, but the aaps.space summary and Uttara Kalamrita 4.22 name only the 6th and 8th.
lord_in_house/12/12.phrasing_guidance: Present as a placement of inner life, foreign connections and spending on meaningful things. Mention both traditional views. Avoid describing the person as hostile; no health claims.

dasha_principle/houses_ruled_and_occupie.summary: A dasha lord brings up the affairs of the houses it rules, the house it sits in, the planets it joins and the planets that aspect it. Its own nature as a planet gives the general flavour of the period; its placement and links decide the specific events.
common_outcomes: List the houses the mahadasha lord rules and occupies, plus the planets it is joined with or aspected by; the period mainly activates those houses.
Read the planet's natural significations (e.g. Sun: father, government; Venus: spouse, comforts) as the background colour of the whole period, then narrow them by its houses.
A well-placed lord improves the houses it rules, occupies or aspects during its period; a weak, badly placed lord harms the same houses.
A planet linked to a house lord carries that lord's matters too (e.g. the Sun with the 5th lord can bring a child in the Sun's period).
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika assigns to the dasha all results described elsewhere in the text for the planet's placement, aspects, conjunctions and lordships, so any natal combination involving the planet can surface in its period.
strengtheners: Lord placed in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, in own, exalted or friendly sign, or joined with lords of good houses (BPHS 47.7-11; Phaladeepika 20.14).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, in an enemy sign, combust, or joined with malefics or dusthana lords (BPHS 47.12-15; Phaladeepika 20.14-20).
dasha_principle/houses_ruled_and_occupie.lagna_or_context_notes: Raman warns the rules must not be applied word for word: results must fit the person's age, circumstances and what is physically possible.

source_views.source: BPHS 47.2 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 2)
source_views.view: Dasha results are of two kinds: general results from the planet's natural character, and specific results from its placement and connections.

source_views.source: BPHS 47.7-11 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 2)
source_views.view: Example for the Sun: strong and well placed it gives wealth and honour; joined with the 5th lord it gives children, with the 2nd lord wealth, with the 4th lord vehicles.

source_views.source: BPHS 48.2-8 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 2)
source_views.view: Gives the typical results of the dasha of each house lord (lagna lord: well-being; 4th: house and land; 5th: education and children; 9th: fortune and religious leaning; 10th: honours; 6th: enemies and illness; 8th and 12th: loss and disease).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 20.1-21 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Lists the results of each bhava lord's dasha when the lord is strong (20.2-13) and when weak (20.15-20), and says every placement, aspect and lordship effect given in the earlier chapters should be assigned to the planet in its dasha (20.21).

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita 6.22-23 (tr. S.S. Sareen; printed as 22.5-23.5)
source_views.view: Results must be declared after examining the dasha lord and the house it occupies.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita 8.97 (tr. S.S. Sareen)
source_views.view: A planet's results come from its own nature, the planets associated with it and the position it holds; it gives the matters of its houses in its dasha and in the sub-periods under other planets.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXIV rules 5 and 10
source_views.view: In its dasha a planet gives what it signifies through ownership, association, location and aspect; well placed it benefits every house it is connected with, weak and ill placed it brings misery.

dasha_principle/houses_ruled_and_occupie.phrasing_guidance: Name the life areas the period highlights (from the houses ruled and occupied) before saying whether it is easy or hard; avoid predicting a single fixed event.
