dasha_ad/jupiter/mercury.summary: Mercury's sub-period in Jupiter's dasha (about 2 years 3 months 6 days) is good when Mercury is strong or well placed from Jupiter: wealth through trade, royal favour, comforts, learning, hospitality and a child. BPHS makes it bad if Mars aspects Mercury, if Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter or with malefics, and warns of danger to life if Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th; Phaladeepika records two opposite views.
common_outcomes: wealth through the trading community, royal favour bringing comforts, perfect hospitality (Jataka Parijata 18.113)
more wealth, auspicious events at home, closeness with relatives, more knowledge, trade gains, favour from rulers, gain from fine arts, a well-favoured child, help from superiors (Raman, p. 258)
gains of wealth, bodily comfort, high position, fulfilment of ambitions through the ruler (BPHS 56.20-21, when strong)
rare_outcomes: trouble from women, gambling and drink, disorders of the three humours (one view in Phaladeepika 21.41)
journeys abroad with danger from thieves on the road, wounds, burning sensations, eye trouble (BPHS 56.25-26)
fever and dysentery if Mars aspects Mercury (BPHS 56.22)

by_area.personality: Increase of knowledge and hospitality (Raman; Jataka Parijata 18.113); anger and distress without reason when afflicted (BPHS 56.27).
by_area.career: High position and fulfilled ambitions (BPHS 56.21); loss in business if Mars aspects or Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 56.22, 56.27-28); trade gains (Jataka Parijata 18.113).
by_area.finance: Wealth in one's own country (BPHS 56.23-24); loss of wealth in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter (BPHS 56.25); wealth at the start and loss at the end in the mixed case (BPHS 56.29).
by_area.health: Fever and dysentery (BPHS 56.22); wounds, burning sensations, eye trouble (BPHS 56.26); humoral disorders (Phaladeepika 21.41, one view).
by_area.relationships: Trouble from women (Phaladeepika 21.41, one view).
by_area.family: Happiness from parents (BPHS 56.24); a child (Raman; Phaladeepika 21.41, other view); closeness with relatives (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Worship of gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.41, other view).

strengtheners: Mercury exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 56.20, 56.24)
Mercury in a kendra or trikona, or with Jupiter (BPHS 56.20)
Mercury in a kendra, 5th or 9th from Jupiter (BPHS 56.23)
benefic aspect on an afflicted Mercury, at least early in the sub-period (BPHS 56.29)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars aspecting Mercury (BPHS 56.22)
Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter, or with a malefic without benefic aspect (BPHS 56.25)
Mercury with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 56.27)
Mercury ruling the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.30)
dasha_ad/jupiter/mercury.lagna_or_context_notes: Santhanam does not say from where 'kendra or trikona' is counted in verse 20; the gloss counts it from Jupiter and adds the 11th. Verses 23-26 are from Jupiter and 27-28 from the lagna. Uttara Kalamrita makes the Jupiter-Mercury pair good in their mutual periods when both are strong.

source_views.source: BPHS 56.20-31, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 681-682
source_views.view: Exalted, own sign, kendra or trikona, or with Jupiter: wealth, comfort, high position, ambitions fulfilled, vehicles, clothes, cattle. Aspected by Mars: more enemies, loss of comfort, business loss, fever and dysentery. Kendra, 5th or 9th from Jupiter or exalted: wealth at home, happiness from parents, vehicles. 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter, or with a malefic unaspected by a benefic: loss of wealth, foreign journeys, thieves, wounds, burning, eye trouble. With malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna: distress, anger, loss of cattle and business, fear of premature death. With a malefic but aspected by a benefic: gains at the start, loss and bodily distress at the end. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: premature death; remedy Vishnu Sahasranama.

source_views.source: BPHS 56.20-31, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com

dasha_ad/jupiter/mercury.disagreements: Phaladeepika itself records two opposite views of this sub-period. Jataka Parijata and Raman give only good results; BPHS makes it conditional and severe under affliction. Santhanam leaves verse 20's reference point open; the gloss counts it from Jupiter. Uttara Kalamrita (p. 154) says a benefic sub-lord under a malefic dasha lord gives bad results unless conjoined, which does not arise here since both are benefics.
dasha_ad/jupiter/mercury.phrasing_guidance: Frame it as a good period for study, trade, writing and dealings with authorities when Mercury is well placed. If afflicted, advise care with travel, health and business; do not predict death.

dasha_ad/jupiter/ketu.summary: Ketu's short sub-period in Jupiter's dasha (about 11 months 6 days) is mostly described as testing: modest gains at best, trouble from authority, illness, separation and suffering for elders, though pilgrimage is common. BPHS makes it good, with vehicles, royal favour and gains from a foreign ruler, when Ketu is in the 4th, 5th, 9th or 10th from Jupiter.
common_outcomes: pearl and coral ornaments, pilgrimage to shrines, more wealth, suffering for elders and the ruler (Jataka Parijata 18.114)
injury from a weapon, friction with servants, mental distress, trouble to wife and children, danger to life, loss of or separation from elders or friends (Phaladeepika 21.42)
pilgrimage, more wealth, suffering for seniors and rulers, change of residence, separation from relatives, poisonous effects, loss of wealth, illness and boils (Raman, p. 258)
rare_outcomes: imprisonment and the king's wrath (BPHS 56.33-34)
gains of wealth and clothes from a foreign (Yavana) ruler (BPHS 56.36)
death of a business partner (Raman, p. 258)

by_area.personality: Mental agony (BPHS 56.34; Phaladeepika 21.42).
by_area.career: Royal favour, success and business profit when Ketu is in the 4th, 5th, 9th or 10th from Jupiter (BPHS 56.35-36); the king's wrath and loss when in the 6th, 8th or 12th or with malefics (BPHS 56.33-34); may give up business (Raman).
by_area.finance: Moderate gains, wealth by undesirable means (BPHS 56.32); loss of wealth (BPHS 56.33; Raman).
by_area.health: Disease and loss of strength (BPHS 56.34); weapon injury (Phaladeepika 21.42); boils and poisonous effects (Raman); physical distress if Ketu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.37).
by_area.relationships: Trouble to wife and children (Phaladeepika 21.42).
by_area.family: Antagonism with father and brother (BPHS 56.34); separation from elders, relatives and friends (Phaladeepika 21.42; Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage to holy shrines (Jataka Parijata 18.114; Raman); food from funeral rites (BPHS 56.32).

strengtheners: Ketu in the 4th, 5th, 9th or 10th from Jupiter (BPHS 56.35)
Ketu with or aspected by a benefic gives modest gains (BPHS 56.32)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter, or with malefics (BPHS 56.33)
Ketu in (or 'lord of') the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.37)
dasha_ad/jupiter/ketu.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Ketu from Jupiter only. Santhanam reads verse 37 as 'lord of the 2nd or 7th (or in the 2nd or 7th)'; nodes own no sign in this library, so only the placement is checkable.

source_views.view: With or aspected by a benefic: moderate enjoyment and wealth, coarse food or food from others or from funeral rites, wealth by undesirable means. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter or with malefics: loss of wealth through the king's wrath, imprisonment, disease, loss of strength, enmity with father and brother, mental agony. In the 5th, 9th, 4th or 10th from Jupiter: vehicles, royal favour, success, business profit, cattle, wealth and clothes from a Yavana ruler. Lord of or in the 2nd or 7th: physical distress. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa.

dasha_ad/jupiter/venus.summary: Venus's sub-period in Jupiter's dasha (about 2 years 8 months) brings comforts, vehicles, wealth, marriage or marital happiness, children, music and learned company when Venus is well placed from the lagna or from Jupiter. BPHS makes it a time of quarrels, family discord and trouble from women or in-laws if Venus is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated or with Saturn or Rahu, and warns of danger if Venus rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: gain of cattle, grain, clothes, utensils, women, children, food and drink, a bed, ornaments; devotion to gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.43)
vehicles and valuable property, the glory of umbrellas and chowries; trouble from women and public odium (Jataka Parijata 18.115)

appointment, wealth, reputation, savings, growth of sons and grandsons, jewels, fine meals, marital happiness, family reunion, success in work, peace of mind; also trouble from women and public odium (Raman, pp. 258-259)
rare_outcomes: extraordinary income from journeys east; building reservoirs and charities (BPHS 56.39-43)
disputes with the father-in-law and brothers (BPHS 56.44)
gain of land in the solar months of Taurus or Libra (Raman, p. 258)

by_area.personality: Peace of mind and enjoyment (Raman).
by_area.career: Royal favour and gains (BPHS 56.39-43); appointment and success in profession (Raman); danger from the ruler when Venus is with Saturn or Rahu (BPHS 56.44).
by_area.finance: Wealth, vehicles, gain of blue and red goods, income from travel east (BPHS 56.39-43); loss of wealth when afflicted or if Venus rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.44, 56.48).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from the wife or a new wife (BPHS 56.45-46); marital happiness (Raman); quarrels with the wife, trouble through women (BPHS 56.44; Jataka Parijata 18.115).
by_area.family: Happiness from parents, more children, help to kin (BPHS 56.41, 56.45-47); discord with relatives, distress to wife and children when afflicted (BPHS 56.44).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and teachers, building reservoirs or temple works, charity (BPHS 56.42); devotion to gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.43).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lagna, or in its own sign, aspected by benefics (BPHS 56.39-43)
Venus in a kendra, trikona or the 2nd from Jupiter (BPHS 56.45)
both Jupiter and Venus strong, in benefic houses and with or aspected by benefics (Uttara Kalamrita)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter or the lagna, or debilitated (BPHS 56.44)
Venus with Saturn or Rahu (BPHS 56.44)
Venus ruling the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.48)

dasha_ad/jupiter/venus.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter and Venus are natural benefics but mutual enemies. Uttara Kalamrita treats their mutual periods as royal (king or minister) when both are strong and well placed, and as separating spouse and children when they are 6/8 or 2/12 from each other or owning such houses with malefic links. Phaladeepika 20.50 notes that both turn harmful as kendra owners.

source_views.source: BPHS 56.39-50, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 684-685
source_views.view: Kendra, trikona or 11th from the lagna, or own sign, aspected by benefics: vehicles, wealth from the ruler, enjoyment, blue and red articles, gains from travel east, family welfare, happiness from parents, devotion, reservoirs and charity. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter or the lagna, or debilitated: quarrels, enmity of kin, distress to wife and children; with Saturn or Rahu: danger from the king, discord with wife, disputes with father-in-law and brothers, loss. Kendra, trikona or 2nd from Jupiter: wealth, happiness from wife, meeting the king, more children, vehicles, music, learned company, sweets, help to kin. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: loss of wealth, fear of premature death, discord with the wife. Remedy: a tawny cow or female buffalo in charity.

dasha_ad/jupiter/sun.summary: The Sun's short sub-period in Jupiter's dasha (about 9 months 18 days) is one of the best in all four classics and in Raman: victory over enemies, royal honour, fame, wealth, vehicles, health and the birth of children. BPHS makes it bad, with fever, laziness and separation from kin, if the Sun is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Jupiter.
common_outcomes: victory, royal honour, fame, command over people, horses and vehicles, prosperity in one's town or country (Phaladeepika 21.44)
defeat of enemies, victory, ease, great diligence, income, royal favour and sound health (Jataka Parijata 18.116)
enemies overcome, victory, ease, diligence, wealth, royal favour, health, good deeds; some loss of bodily strength (Raman, p. 259)
rare_outcomes: nervous disorder, fever and reluctance to do good, antagonism towards all (BPHS 56.54-55)

by_area.personality: Great diligence (Jataka Parijata 18.116); laziness and antagonism towards others when afflicted (BPHS 56.54-55).
by_area.career: Cordial relations with the government, success in ventures (BPHS 56.51-53); command over people (Phaladeepika 21.44).
by_area.finance: Gain of wealth, vehicles, clothes and ornaments (BPHS 56.51-53).
by_area.health: Sound health (Jataka Parijata 18.116); nervous disorder and fever when afflicted (BPHS 56.54); physical distress if the Sun rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.56); loss of bodily strength (Raman).
by_area.family: Birth of children (BPHS 56.53); separation from kinsmen when afflicted (BPHS 56.55).
by_area.spirituality: Indulgence in sin and reluctance to do good deeds when afflicted (BPHS 56.55); good deeds (Raman).

strengtheners: Sun exalted or in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd, 11th or 2nd from the lagna, and strong (BPHS 56.51)
Sun in the 5th from Jupiter (Rath, Crux p. 331)

Sun ruling the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.56)
dasha_ad/jupiter/sun.lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun and Jupiter are natural friends, and Uttara Kalamrita lists the Guru-Sun pair among those whose mutual periods are good when both are strong (p. 161). BPHS judges the bad case from both the lagna and Jupiter; the gloss also applies the good conditions from Jupiter.

dasha_ad/jupiter/moon.summary: The Moon's sub-period in Jupiter's dasha (1 year 4 months) is generally good: royal favour, fame, wealth, good food, children and grandchildren, religious and charitable acts. BPHS requires the Moon to be full, strong and well placed; weak, with malefics or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or Jupiter, it brings loss of wealth and kin, wandering abroad, quarrels with co-heirs and distress to the mother.
common_outcomes: acquisition of women, defeat of enemies, money, farming profit, goods to sell, high renown, devotion to gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.45)
power gained through a woman's influence, royal favour and comforts, fine clothes and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.117)
more prosperity, fame and fortune, property, benefit through children, good meals and clothing, success, birth of a daughter or a marriage in the family, money (Raman, p. 259)
rare_outcomes: separation from a maternal uncle and distress to the mother (BPHS 56.63)
wandering in foreign lands and danger from rulers and thieves (BPHS 56.61-62)

by_area.career: Royal honour and comforts through the ruler (BPHS 56.58-60; Jataka Parijata 18.117); danger from the government when the Moon is weak (BPHS 56.61-63).
by_area.finance: Wealth, farming profit, goods (Phaladeepika 21.45); money (Raman); loss of wealth when the Moon is weak or afflicted (BPHS 56.61).
by_area.health: Physical distress if the Moon rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.64).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 56.58-59); gain of women (Phaladeepika 21.45); power through a woman (Jataka Parijata 18.117).
by_area.family: More children and grandchildren (BPHS 56.60); a daughter or a family marriage (Raman); quarrels with co-heirs, separation from the maternal uncle, distress to the mother when afflicted (BPHS 56.62-63).
by_area.spirituality: Good deeds, religious and charitable inclinations (BPHS 56.60); devotion to gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.45).

strengtheners: Moon in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lagna, or exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 56.58)
Moon full and strong and in a good house from Jupiter (BPHS 56.58-59)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon weak or with malefics (BPHS 56.61)
Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Jupiter (BPHS 56.61)
Moon ruling the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.64)
dasha_ad/jupiter/moon.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS combines conditions from the lagna and from Jupiter. Uttara Kalamrita lists the Guru-Chandra pair among those whose mutual periods are good when both are strong (p. 161). PVR Narasimha Rao, following Rath, makes the Moon the key reference for antardasha results in general.

Weak, with malefics, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or Jupiter: loss of wealth and kin, wandering abroad, danger from government and thieves, quarrels with co-heirs, separation from the maternal uncle, distress to the mother. dasha_ad/jupiter/mars.summary: Mars's sub-period in Jupiter's dasha (about 11 months 6 days) is split in the texts. BPHS gives marriage, land, courage and success when Mars is exalted or in its own sign or navamsa, and wealth with benefic links; Phaladeepika adds gains from enemies and influence. Jataka Parijata and Raman stress business failure, wandering, fever, risk and loss, and BPHS agrees when Mars is in the 8th or 12th from Jupiter or debilitated with malefics, the worst coming early.
common_outcomes: good relations with kin, gains from defeated enemies, good land, charity, political influence; slight harm to a teacher or elder or a serious eye injury (Phaladeepika 21.46)
business failure, wandering, high fever, great risk, loss of wealth, low spirits (Jataka Parijata 18.118)

disappointments, theft, loss of near relatives, inflammatory disease, transfer or leave, failed hopes, wandering, fever, risk, loss and depression; also pilgrimage, wealth, fame and adventure (Raman, p. 259)
rare_outcomes: gain of villages and land, marriage celebrations (BPHS 56.65-66)
loss of house and eye trouble (BPHS 56.69)
transfer or leave from work (Raman, p. 259)

by_area.career: Success in all ventures and influence (BPHS 56.66; Phaladeepika 21.46); business failure, transfer or leave (Jataka Parijata 18.118; Raman).
by_area.finance: Land, villages, wealth and grain (BPHS 56.66-67); loss of wealth and house when afflicted (BPHS 56.69); theft (Raman).
by_area.health: Eye trouble (BPHS 56.69; Phaladeepika 21.46); high fever (Jataka Parijata 18.118); inflammatory disease (Raman); physical and mental distress if Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.71).
by_area.relationships: Marriage (BPHS 56.66); happiness from wife and children (BPHS 56.68).
by_area.family: Good relations with kin (Phaladeepika 21.46); loss of near relatives (Raman); harm to a teacher or elder (Phaladeepika 21.46).
by_area.spirituality: Charity (Phaladeepika 21.46); merit of pilgrimage (BPHS 56.68, gloss); pilgrimage (Raman).

strengtheners: Mars exalted or in its own sign, or in an exalted or own navamsa (BPHS 56.65)
Mars in a kendra, trikona, the 11th or 2nd, with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 56.67)
Mars and Jupiter both strong, well placed and linked with benefics (Uttara Kalamrita)

Sastri (Uttara Kalamrita notes, pp. 160-161) says that in his experience one of the two is always functionally malefic for a given lagna, so their mutual periods rarely give the promised raja yoga. Santhanam gives no reference point for verse 67's houses; the gloss counts them from Jupiter.

In the 8th or 12th from Jupiter or debilitated with malefics: loss of wealth and house, eye trouble; worst at the start, mitigated later. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: physical distress and mental agony. Remedy: give a bull in charity.

dasha_ad/jupiter/rahu.summary: Rahu's sub-period at the end of Jupiter's dasha (about 2 years 4 months 24 days) is mostly troubled in the classics and Raman: illness, calamity, distress among relatives, trouble from rulers, thieves and enemies, and loss of income. BPHS makes it good, with gains in the first five months, authority, a foreign patron, long journeys and holy baths, when Rahu is exalted, in its own or moolatrikona sign, in a kendra or trikona, or linked with benefics or a kendra lord.
common_outcomes: distress among relatives, mental anguish, illness, danger from thieves, trouble from the ruler and enemies, loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.47)
fear of every trouble, disease, every kind of calamity, loss of income (Jataka Parijata 18.119)
income through low-caste people, fear of disease, every possible calamity, loss of wealth (Raman, p. 260)
rare_outcomes: rule over a village or region and a meeting with a foreign dignitary (BPHS 56.72-75)
bad dreams and quarrels without reason; illness from sorcery (BPHS 56.77-78, gloss)
inclination to yoga or spiritual practice (BPHS 56.73)

by_area.career: Authority over a village or country and a meeting with a foreign ruler (BPHS 56.74); danger from the government when afflicted (BPHS 56.76; Phaladeepika 21.47).
by_area.finance: Wealth and grain in the first five months when well placed (BPHS 56.73); loss of wealth and income (Phaladeepika 21.47; Jataka Parijata 18.119; Raman).
by_area.health: Disease (Jataka Parijata 18.119; Raman); wounds and snakes (BPHS 56.76); physical distress if Rahu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 56.79).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family when well placed (BPHS 56.74); domestic troubles, enmity with siblings and co-heirs (BPHS 56.76-77); distress among relatives (Phaladeepika 21.47).
by_area.spirituality: Yoga, long journeys, bathing in holy places, merit (BPHS 56.73-75).

Rahu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 56.72)

dasha_ad/jupiter/rahu.lagna_or_context_notes: This sub-period closes the Jupiter dasha. BPHS judges the good case from the lagna and dignity and the bad case from Jupiter. Rahu's 'own' and 'moolatrikona' signs vary by author; this library's vocabulary gives nodes only exalted (Taurus) and debilitated (Scorpio), so those parts are left manual. Uttara Kalamrita's translator cites Marie Antoinette, who died in Jupiter-Rahu with a maraka Jupiter, as a case where the dasha lord rather than Rahu killed.

With a malefic in the 8th or 12th from Jupiter: danger from thieves, snakes and the government, wounds, domestic trouble, enmity with siblings and co-heirs, bad dreams, quarrels, disease. In the 2nd or 7th from the lagna: physical distress. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa and the gift of a goat.

dasha_ad/ketu/ketu.summary: Ketu's own sub-period at the start of its dasha (about 4 months 27 days) is described by most texts as a strained time: worry over spouse and children, quarrels, fever, loss of money and separation from relatives. BPHS makes it good, with family happiness, official recognition and gains of land (though still with mental unease), when Ketu is in a kendra or trikona or linked with the lagna lord or the 9th, 10th or 4th lord.
themes: land and recognition when well placed
common_outcomes: fear for the wife and children, loss of happiness and wealth, trouble from enemies (Jataka Parijata 18.146)
quarrels with enemies, friction with friends, harsh words, burning fever, intrusion into others' homes, loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.66)
fear for wife or children, loss of wealth and happiness, mental trouble, separation from relatives, some restraint or detention, danger of poison (Raman, p. 271)
rare_outcomes: recognition from the ruler and gains of land and villages (BPHS 59.1-2, when well placed)
[maraka: Jataka Parijata 18.146 and Raman p. 271 speak of the death of wife and children]

by_area.personality: Mental agony even in the good case (BPHS 59.1-2); instability of mind when badly placed (BPHS 59.3-4); mental trouble (Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition from the ruler when well placed (BPHS 59.1-2); defamation when badly placed (BPHS 59.3-4); favours from superiors (Rele p. 99).
by_area.finance: Gains of land and villages when well placed (BPHS 59.1-2); loss of wealth and cattle (BPHS 59.3-4; Phaladeepika 21.66; Jataka Parijata 18.146).
by_area.health: Heart disease (BPHS 59.3-4; Rele); fever (Phaladeepika 21.66); danger of poison (Raman); disease when Ketu is in or linked to the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.5-6).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children when well placed (BPHS 59.1-2); distress to wife and children otherwise (BPHS 59.3-4; Jataka Parijata 18.146; Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from kinsmen (BPHS 59.5-6; Raman); loss of a brother when Ketu is in the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 99).

strengtheners: Ketu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 59.1)
Ketu joined with the lagna lord, or related to the 9th, 10th or 4th lord (BPHS 59.1; the 4th is clear in the Sanskrit gloss)
Rele: aspected by the 9th or 10th lord
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in its debilitation sign in the 8th or 12th with a combust planet (BPHS 59.3-4, Santhanam)
Ketu in or linked with the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.5-6)
Ketu with malefics (Rele p. 99)
dasha_ad/ketu/ketu.lagna_or_context_notes: In its own sub-period Ketu is both lords, so the position from the dasha lord is always the 1st; BPHS judges this sub-period only from the lagna. The library's node dignity (debilitated Scorpio) is the reverse of BPHS 47.35, which exalts Ketu in Scorpio, so the debilitation condition is left manual. Narasimha Rao (ch. 16) judges antardashas mainly from the Moon, and allows the dasha lord as a temporary lagna.

In debilitation and in the 8th or 12th with a combust planet: heart disease, defamation, loss of wealth and cattle, distress to wife and children, unstable mind. Related to the 2nd or 7th lords or placed in the 2nd or 7th: disease, great distress, separation from kin. Remedy: Durga Saptashati and Mrityunjaya japa.

dasha_ad/ketu/venus.summary: Venus's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 1 year 2 months) splits the sources: BPHS and Raman see wealth, vehicles, recovery of lost position, a child and pilgrimage when Venus is strong, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman's later months stress discord with spouse and relatives, illness in the family, fever and humiliation. BPHS reverses it when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu, debilitated, or in the 6th or 8th from the lagna.
common_outcomes: illness of wife and children, quarrels, loss of relatives and friends, fever and dysentery (Jataka Parijata 18.147)
conflict with a learned Brahmin, discord with spouse and kin, birth of a daughter, humiliation, worry for others (Phaladeepika 21.67)
wealth and happiness, birth of a child, success in efforts; at the end sickness, the wife and children ill, quarrels, fever and dysentery (Raman, p. 272)
rare_outcomes: recovery of a lost kingdom or reinstatement in high office (BPHS 59.7-9)
bathing at Setu and a vision of deities (BPHS 59.9, Sanskrit gloss)

by_area.personality: Mental agony when Venus is a 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 59.15).
by_area.career: Favour from the ruler, reinstatement in a high position, and dawn of fortune with a 9th-10th lord link (BPHS 59.7-9); loss of honour (Rele p. 100; BPHS 59.13-14).
by_area.finance: Gains of clothes, vehicles, land and villages (BPHS 59.7-9); good food and vehicles (BPHS 59.10-11); causeless quarrels, loss of wealth and cattle when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.12).
by_area.health: Headache, eye trouble, heart disease (BPHS 59.13-14; Rele); fever and dysentery (Jataka Parijata 18.147; Raman).
by_area.relationships: Discord with the spouse (Phaladeepika 21.67); illness of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.147; Raman); marriage (Rele p. 100); distress to the wife when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 59.13-14).
by_area.family: Birth of a child (Raman) or of a daughter (Phaladeepika 21.67); quarrels with kinsmen (BPHS 59.13-14); loss of relatives and friends (Jataka Parijata 18.147).
by_area.spirituality: Visits to sacred shrines (BPHS 59.9); religious tendencies and pilgrimage (Rele p. 100).

Debilitated, with a debilitated planet, or 6th or 8th from the lagna: quarrels with kin, headache, eye trouble, heart disease, defamation, losses, distress to wife and cattle. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical and mental distress. Remedy: Durga path and gift of a tawny cow or female buffalo.

dasha_ad/ketu/sun.summary: The Sun's short sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 4 months 6 days) is mostly hard in the general texts: disappointment, physical pain, being away from home, obstacles, fever and rifts with relatives or elders. BPHS makes it good, with wealth, official favour, a son and pious works, when the Sun is exalted, in its own sign, with benefics, or in a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th from Ketu, and adds a maraka warning when the Sun rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: disappointment, physical pain, exile in a foreign land, danger and obstruction in every business (Jataka Parijata 18.148)
death of a respected elder, fever, rifts with relatives, gains from foreign travel, service to the king against a rebellion, phlegm and wind disorders (Phaladeepika 21.68)
disappointment, pain, exile, obstacles; increase of knowledge, sickness in the family, a long journey and return, worry about the wife's health (Raman, p. 272)
rare_outcomes: headship of a small village (BPHS 59.20-21)
[maraka: BPHS 59.22-24 predicts fear of premature death when the Sun rules the 2nd or 7th]

by_area.personality: Sorrow and fear (BPHS 59.18-19, 22-24).
by_area.career: Favour of the ruler and fulfilment of ambitions when well placed (BPHS 59.16-17); danger and punishment from government when the Sun is with malefics in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 59.18-19); quarrels with superiors (Rele p. 100).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth (BPHS 59.16-17, 20-21); loss of wealth and cattle and trouble getting food when the Sun is with malefics 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.22-24).
by_area.health: Fever (BPHS 59.18-19; Phaladeepika 21.68); physical pain (Jataka Parijata 18.148); physical fitness when well placed (BPHS 59.20-21); serious illness if in the 2nd or 7th (Rele).
by_area.relationships: Worry about the wife's health (Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from parents (BPHS 59.18-19); death of an elder (Phaladeepika 21.68); birth of a son (BPHS 59.20-21; Rele).
by_area.spirituality: Pious deeds (BPHS 59.16-17, 20-21).

strengtheners: Sun exalted or in own sign, or with or aspected by benefics in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 59.16-17)
Sun in a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.20-21)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun with malefics in the 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.18-19)
Sun with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.22-24)
Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.24)
dasha_ad/ketu/sun.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS gives separate rules from the lagna (59.18-19) and from Ketu (59.20-24); keep them distinct.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.16-24, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Sun exalted, in own sign, or with or aspected by benefics in a kendra or trikona: wealth, royal favour, pious deeds, fulfilment of ambitions. With malefics in the 8th or 12th from the lagna: danger from government, separation from parents, foreign journeys, thieves, snakes and poison, punishment, quarrels with friends, sorrow, fever. In a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th from Ketu: fitness, wealth, a son, pious deeds, headship of a small village. With evil planets 8th or 12th from Ketu: trouble getting food, fear, loss of wealth and cattle; distress at the start, some relief at the end; fear of premature death if the Sun is 2nd or 7th lord. Remedy: gift of a cow and gold.

dasha_ad/ketu/moon.summary: The Moon's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 7 months) is mixed: sudden gains and sudden losses, worry over children, mental distress and family matters. BPHS makes it good, with recognition, property, vehicles, business success and family happiness, when the Moon is exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th, especially if waxing; bad if debilitated or in a dusthana, and it warns of danger when the Moon rules the 2nd, 7th or 8th.
common_outcomes: fatigue affecting wife, children and servants, loss of wealth and grain, distress of mind (Jataka Parijata 18.149)
sudden gains and unexpected losses of money, separation from a son, grief over a difficult childbirth, gain of servants and daughters (Phaladeepika 21.69)
disputes over women, trouble through children, gains and financial success, bilious and cold disorders, loss of relatives and money, distress of mind (Raman, p. 272)
rare_outcomes: merit from building reservoirs or temples (BPHS 59.25-28)
[maraka: BPHS 59.36 predicts fear of premature death when the Moon rules the 2nd, 7th or 8th]

by_area.personality: Enthusiasm and well-being when strong (BPHS 59.25-28); unhappiness and mental agony when weak (BPHS 59.29-30); distress of mind (Jataka Parijata 18.149; Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition from the ruler and business success (BPHS 59.25-28); good relations with the ruler in the middle, danger from the ruler at the end (BPHS 59.31-33); losses in business when weak (BPHS 59.29-30).
by_area.finance: Gains of food, clothes, vehicles and cattle (BPHS 59.25-28); cows, land and milk (BPHS 59.31-33); sudden gains and losses (Phaladeepika 21.69); loss of wealth (BPHS 59.34; Jataka Parijata 18.149).
by_area.health: Bilious and cold disorders (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness to wife and children (BPHS 59.25-28); disputes about women (Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from parents (BPHS 59.29-30); meeting and success through kin (BPHS 59.31-33); enmity with kin and distress to a brother when 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.34-35); separation from a son and a difficult childbirth (Phaladeepika 21.69).
by_area.spirituality: Building reservoirs and similar works of merit (BPHS 59.25-28).

strengtheners: Moon exalted or in own sign, in a kendra, trikona, 11th or 2nd from the lagna (BPHS 59.25-28)
waxing Moon: benefits realised fully (BPHS 59.28)
Moon strong in a kendra, trikona or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.31-33)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.29-30)

Moon lord of the 2nd, 7th or 8th (BPHS 59.36)

source_views.source: BPHS 59.25-36, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Moon exalted, in own sign, or in a kendra, trikona, 11th or 2nd from the lagna: recognition, enthusiasm, a house and land, gains of food, clothes, vehicles and cattle, business success, building reservoirs, happiness to wife and children, fully if waxing. Debilitated or 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna: unhappiness, obstacles, separation from parents, business losses, loss of cattle. Strong in a kendra, trikona or 11th from Ketu: cows, land, kin, milk and curd; good at the start, royal favour in the middle, danger from the ruler and distant travel at the end. 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu: loss of wealth, anxiety, enmity with kin, distress to a brother. Lord of the 2nd, 7th or 8th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Moon mantras and charity of the Moon's articles.

dasha_ad/ketu/mars.summary: Mars's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 4 months 27 days) is one of the most troubled in the general texts: family quarrels, loss of relatives, enemies, disputes, danger from thieves, fire and weapons, fevers and surgery. BPHS makes it good, with land, wealth, a new garden and royal favour, when Mars is exalted or in its own sign with benefics or well placed from Ketu, and warns of danger to life when Mars is 8th, 12th or 2nd from Ketu or rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: odium of sons, wife and younger brothers, pain from disease, foes and bad rulers, loss of some relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.150)
family quarrels, loss of relatives, danger from snakes, thieves and fire, trouble from enemies (Phaladeepika 21.70)
odium of family, loss of relatives, obstruction, disputes and contests, enemies, fever, fear of robbers, urinary disease, surgical operations (Raman, pp. 272-273)
rare_outcomes: laying out a new garden (BPHS 59.37-39)
imprisonment (Raman, p. 273)
[maraka: BPHS 59.41-43 and Rele p. 101 predict fear of death or sudden death under the listed conditions]

by_area.personality: Fear and anxiety (Raman); mental agony when Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43).
by_area.career: Recognition, popularity and reputation when Mars is well placed from Ketu (BPHS 59.40); trouble from bad rulers (Jataka Parijata 18.150); danger from the king (BPHS 59.41-42).
by_area.finance: Gains of land, villages, wealth and cattle (BPHS 59.37-39); loss and difficulties (Raman).
by_area.health: Diabetes or urinary trouble (BPHS 59.41-42; Raman; Rele); high fever and poison when Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43); surgery (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Odium of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.150); distress to the wife when Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43); disputes through women (Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness from children and friends when well placed (BPHS 59.40); odium of sons and younger brothers, loss of relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.150; Phaladeepika 21.70).

strengtheners: Mars exalted or in own sign with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 59.37-39)
Mars related to the 9th or 10th lord (BPHS 59.39)
Mars in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.40)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 8th, 12th or 2nd from Ketu (BPHS 59.41-42)
Mars as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43)
dasha_ad/ketu/mars.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS's main bad rule (59.41-42) is counted from Ketu, the dasha lord; the maraka rule (59.43) from the lagna. Rath (Crux p. 117) remarks that Ketu draws on the strength of Mars, so this pairing doubles the Mars-like quality.

In the 8th, 12th or 2nd from Ketu: fear of death, disaster on a foreign journey, diabetes, needless troubles, thieves, the king, quarrels, with some good mixed in. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: high fever, poison, distress to wife, mental agony, fear of premature death. Remedy: gift of a bull.

dasha_ad/ketu/rahu.summary: Rahu's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 1 year 18 days) pairs the two nodes and is mostly adverse in the general texts: fear of rulers and thieves, ruined business, disputes stirred by enemies, scandal and danger of poisoning. BPHS makes it good, with wealth, land and gains through foreign authorities after an uneasy start, when Rahu is exalted, in its own or a friend's sign, or in a kendra, trikona, 11th, 3rd or 2nd.
common_outcomes: fear of rulers and robbers, sorrow, ruin of every business, quarrels with bad people (Jataka Parijata 18.151)
disputes stirred by enemies, danger from rulers, fire, thieves and snakes, abuse from wicked people, use of malicious spells (Phaladeepika 21.71)
loss of land, imprisonment, quarrels with friends, blood poisoning, loss of property and honour, fear of kings and robbers, ruin of business (Raman, p. 273)
rare_outcomes: wealth and land from a foreign ruler (BPHS 59.45-47)

by_area.career: Ruin of business (Jataka Parijata 18.151; Raman); gains through foreign dignitaries when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 59.45-47); help from foreigners (Rele p. 101).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, grain, cattle, land and villages when well placed (BPHS 59.45-47); loss of land and property (Raman); gain by speculation (Rele).
by_area.health: Frequent urination, weakness, cold and intermittent fever, diabetes, stomach pain when Rahu is with a malefic in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 59.48-50); blood poisoning (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Possibility of marriage when well placed (Rele p. 101); adultery (Raman).
by_area.family: Quarrels with friends (Raman).

dasha_ad/ketu/rahu.lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu and Ketu are always opposite, so Rahu is always 7th from Ketu (ad_from_md == 7): no source uses that position, and BPHS judges this sub-period from the lagna. BPHS 47.35-36 gives Rahu exaltation in Taurus and own sign Aquarius (Virgo by some); the 'own' and 'friend's sign' clauses are left manual. BPHS lists the 2nd among the good houses (59.45) and also as a house of distress (59.50).

With a malefic in the 8th or 12th from the lagna: frequent urination, weakness, cold fever, thieves, intermittent fever, opprobrium, quarrels, diabetes, stomach pain. In the 2nd or 7th from the lagna: distress and danger. Remedy: Durga Saptashati path.

dasha_ad/ketu/jupiter.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 11 months 6 days) is the brightest part of the period in every classical source: honour from authorities, freedom from illness, land, children (often a son), religious acts and income. BPHS turns it adverse if Jupiter is debilitated or in a dusthana from the lagna, with early good fading later, and warns of danger when Jupiter rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: respect for gods, Brahmins and elders, the ruler's goodwill, freedom from illness, gain of land and children (Jataka Parijata 18.152)
birth of a fine son, honour from a high authority, income from land or a found treasure, gifts, large inflow of money, royal favour (Phaladeepika 21.72)
freedom from illness, land, children, profitable dealings, association with people of standing, danger of poison, marriage if unmarried (Raman, p. 273)
rare_outcomes: discovery of treasure (Phaladeepika 21.72)
[maraka: BPHS 59.59-60 predicts fear of premature death when Jupiter rules the 2nd or 7th]

by_area.career: Royal favour and victory over enemies (BPHS 59.51-54); honour from a high authority (Phaladeepika 21.72); association with people of good position (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth, grain and vehicles (BPHS 59.51-54); land, treasure and large income (Phaladeepika 21.72); loss of wealth when Jupiter is debilitated or in a dusthana (BPHS 59.55-56).
by_area.health: Freedom from illness (Jataka Parijata 18.152; Raman); danger from thieves, snakes and wounds when afflicted (BPHS 59.55-56); danger of poison (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Marriage if unmarried (Raman); separation from wife and children when afflicted (BPHS 59.55-56).
by_area.family: Birth of a son (BPHS 59.51-54; Phaladeepika 21.72); care of kinsmen (BPHS 59.57-58).
by_area.spirituality: Pious deeds and sacrifices (BPHS 59.51-54); respect for gods, Brahmins and elders (Jataka Parijata 18.152).

Debilitated or 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna: thieves, snakes, wounds, loss of wealth, separation from wife and children, physical distress; some good at the start, then adverse. With a benefic in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Ketu: garments and ornaments by royal favour, foreign journeys, care of kin, good food. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. dasha_ad/ketu/saturn.summary: Saturn's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is adverse in nearly every source: mental anguish, rifts with relatives, losses, fines, leaving one's post or homeland, danger on journeys and trouble from enemies. BPHS makes it good, with success, the employer's favour and property in one's own town, when Saturn is in its own sign, in Libra or Pisces, in a good navamsa or with a benefic in a kendra, trikona or the 3rd.
themes: success through steady work when strong
common_outcomes: misgiving, mental anguish, difference with kith and kin, leaving one's native country (Jataka Parijata 18.153)
trouble involving servants, annoyance to or from others, clashes with enemies that may injure a limb, loss of wealth and position (Phaladeepika 21.73)
danger from enemies, imprisonment, loss of wealth, indigestion, property at risk, change of residence, skin disease, anxiety over the partner's illness, exile (Raman, p. 273)
rare_outcomes: audience with the king or high dignitaries (BPHS 59.63-65)
[maraka: Raman p. 273 lists loss of the wife; BPHS 59.67-68 predicts death of parents and fear of premature death under the listed conditions]

by_area.career: Fines from government and resignation from the post when Saturn is weak (BPHS 59.61-62); success in ventures and the employer's favour when strong (BPHS 59.63-65); loss of position (Phaladeepika 21.73).
by_area.finance: Some gain in cattle but loss through fines (BPHS 59.61-62); loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.73; Raman); property in one's own town when strong (BPHS 59.63-65).
by_area.health: Physical distress (BPHS 59.67); limb injury from enemies (Phaladeepika 21.73); indigestion and skin disease (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Anxiety over the partner's sickness (Raman).
by_area.family: Distress to relatives (BPHS 59.61-62); difference with kin (Jataka Parijata 18.153); harm to parents (BPHS 59.67-68).

Saturn in an auspicious navamsa (BPHS 59.63-65)

weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn without strength or dignity (BPHS 59.61-62)
Saturn in the 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.63)

dasha_ad/ketu/saturn.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges the good case and the 8th/12th case from the lagna and the worst case from Ketu. Santhanam's note on 59.63-65 cites Brihat Jataka: Saturn in Libra, Pisces, Sagittarius, Capricorn or Aquarius in the lagna gives raja yoga. The Sanskrit gloss of 59.63 ties lethargy to Ketu (not Saturn) being in the 8th or 12th.

source_views.view: Saturn without strength or dignity: distress to self and kin, agony, some gain in cattle, loss through government fines, resignation from the post, foreign journeys, thieves on the road; in the 8th or 12th from the lagna, loss and lethargy. Saturn in a trikona in Pisces, in Libra, in own sign, in a good navamsa, or with a benefic in a kendra, trikona or 3rd from the lagna: success in all ventures, the employer's favour, comfortable journeys, property in one's own town, audience with the king. With a malefic 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu: distress, obstacles, lethargy, defamation, death of parents. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: homa with sesame and gift of a black cow or female buffalo.

dasha_ad/ketu/mercury.summary: Mercury's sub-period closes Ketu's dasha (about 11 months 27 days) and is mixed: the company of relatives and friends, gains through knowledge, a son and recognition, alongside worry about children, failed plans, trouble from enemies or officials and losses in farming or cattle. BPHS makes it strongly good when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona or in its own or exaltation sign, and adverse when it is joined with Saturn, Mars or Rahu in a dusthana or weak in a dusthana from Ketu.
common_outcomes: society of relatives and friends, wealth for children and spouse, happiness from knowledge (Jataka Parijata 18.154)
birth of a good son, recognition from a wealthy lord, gains from land, trouble from an enemy chief, losses in cattle and farming (Phaladeepika 21.74)
society of relatives and friends, material gains from knowledge, danger from relatives, anxiety about children, failure of plans, deception, jealousy, falsehood (Raman, p. 274)
rare_outcomes: attainment of a kingdom or high position (BPHS 59.69-71)
a sudden marriage or religious function (BPHS 59.69-71)
[maraka: BPHS 59.79 predicts fear of premature death when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th]

by_area.personality: Listening to religious discourses and keeping learned company (BPHS 59.72); deception, jealousy and falsehood around one (Raman).
by_area.career: High position when well placed (BPHS 59.69-71); conflict with officials and living in others' houses when Mercury is with Saturn, Mars or Rahu in a dusthana (BPHS 59.73-74); danger from the king at the start if weak in a dusthana from Ketu (BPHS 59.77-79).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, land, clothes and ornaments (BPHS 59.69-71); large business profits when well placed from Ketu (BPHS 59.75-76); loss of wealth, clothes, vehicles and cattle when afflicted (BPHS 59.73-74).
by_area.health: Good health when well placed from Ketu (BPHS 59.75-76); loss of speech or stammering in the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 102).
by_area.relationships: Marriage (BPHS 59.69-71; Rele); troubles to the wife when weak in a dusthana from Ketu (BPHS 59.77-79).
by_area.family: Birth of a son and family well-being (BPHS 59.69-71); happiness from a son (BPHS 59.75-76); anxiety about children (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Charity and religious functions (BPHS 59.69-71); religious discourses (BPHS 59.72); visits to sacred places in the middle of the sub-period (BPHS 59.78).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, exalted or in own sign (BPHS 59.69-71)
Mercury with the 9th or 10th lord (BPHS 59.72)
Mercury in a kendra, trikona or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.75-76)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury with Saturn, Mars or Rahu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.73-74)
Mercury weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.77-79)
Mercury lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.79)
dasha_ad/ketu/mercury.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS gives both lagna rules (59.69-74) and dasha-lord rules (59.75-79). Mercury's sub-period ends the Ketu dasha, so its end-phase results lead into Venus's dasha.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.69-79, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, exalted or in own sign: high position, enjoyments, charity, wealth and land, a son, religious functions and sudden marriages, family well-being, clothes and ornaments. With the 9th or 10th lord: learned company, dawn of fortune, religious discourses. With Saturn, Mars or Rahu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna: conflict with officials, living in others' houses, loss of wealth, clothes, vehicles and cattle; some good at the start, better in the middle, bad at the end. In a kendra, trikona or 11th from Ketu: health, happiness from a son, glory, good food and clothes, large business profits. Weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu: distress, trouble to wife and children and danger from the ruler at the start, pilgrimage in the middle. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Vishnu Sahasranama.

In the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with or aspected by a malefic: loss of wealth, quarrels with wife and children, pilgrimage, harsh or careless speech. dasha_ad/ketu/mercury.phrasing_guidance: Present as a good phase for study, writing, friendships and family events, with care over plans, paperwork and people who may mislead. Do not predict premature death.

dasha_ad/mars/mars.summary: Mars's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 4 months 27 days) is described by Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman as heated and quarrelsome: illness from heat and bile, wounds, friction with siblings and friends, trouble from rulers. BPHS makes it good (royal favour, recovery of lost position and wealth, property, a son) when Mars is in a kendra, trikona, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th, or exalted or in its own sign.
common_outcomes: illness from bile and heat, wounds, separation from brothers, money from land and litigation, trouble from cousins, fire, enemies, rulers and thieves (Phaladeepika 21.21)
great heat, dislike of friends, annoyance from brothers, danger from a ruler, failure of undertakings (Jataka Parijata 18.85)
the same, plus quarrels with relatives, loss of money, skin trouble, loss of blood, boils and anal fissures (Raman, pp. 245-246)
rare_outcomes: recovery of a lost kingdom or high position (BPHS 54.1-2)
anxiety through foreigners or warlike people, open violence (Raman, p. 246)

by_area.personality: Heat of temper and dislike of friends (Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).
by_area.career: Royal or government favour and reinstatement in position when Mars is well placed (BPHS 54.1-4); danger from rulers and failure of undertakings otherwise (Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, house, land and cattle when well placed (BPHS 54.1-4); money from land and litigation (Phaladeepika 21.21); loss of money (Raman).
by_area.health: Bile and heat disorders, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.21); urinary trouble and wounds when Mars is in the 8th or 12th or afflicted (BPHS 54.5); mental agony and bodily pain if Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.6).
by_area.relationships: Birth of a son when Mars is well placed (BPHS 54.1-3).
by_area.family: Separation from or annoyance with brothers (Phaladeepika 21.21; Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).

strengtheners: Mars in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th, 3rd or 2nd, or joined with the lagna lord (BPHS 54.1-2)
Mars exalted, in its own sign or own navamsa, with strength (BPHS 54.3-4)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 54.5)
Mars as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.6)
dasha_ad/mars/mars.lagna_or_context_notes: In its own sub-period Mars is both dasha and sub-period lord, so the position from the dasha lord is always the 1st; BPHS judges it from the lagna and by dignity. Santhanam reads verse 6 as Mars 'lord of the 2nd or 7th'; the Sanskrit gloss reads 'the 7th lord in the 2nd'.

Exalted, own sign or own navamsa with strength: ambitions fulfilled, house, land and cattle. In the 8th or 12th or with or aspected by malefics: urinary trouble, wounds, danger from snakes and rulers. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: mental agony and bodily pain. Remedy: Rudra japa and gift of a red bull; Shiva then restores health and wealth.

dasha_ad/mars/rahu.summary: Rahu's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 18 days) is one of the hardest in every source: danger from rulers, thieves, weapons, fire and poison, loss of wealth and of relatives, illness, even imprisonment. BPHS allows good results (honours, property, business profit, pilgrimage, foreign travel) when Rahu is exalted or in moolatrikona, or in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with benefics.
common_outcomes: danger from weapons, fire, thieves, enemies and rulers, poison, disease of belly, eyes and head, loss of elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.22)
peril from rulers and robbers, loss of wealth and grain, success in wrong pursuits (Jataka Parijata 18.86)
danger from rulers and robbers, loss of wealth, poisoning, loss of relatives, skin disease, change of residence, scandal, loss of cattle, fear of insects and thieves, imprisonment (Raman, p. 246)
rare_outcomes: bathing in holy rivers like the Ganges, foreign journeys, extraordinary business profit (BPHS 54.9-10)
falls into a well, famine, fear of ghosts, gonorrhoea (Raman, p. 246)

by_area.personality: Loss of memory and fretting (Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition from government when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 54.9-10); danger from rulers and imprisonment otherwise (BPHS 54.11-12; Jataka Parijata 18.86).
by_area.finance: Extraordinary business profit, house and land when well placed (BPHS 54.9-10); loss of wealth in the 2nd (BPHS 54.13) and in general (Jataka Parijata; Raman).
by_area.health: Wounds, vata and pitta disorders (BPHS 54.12); poison, belly, eye and head disease (Phaladeepika 21.22); skin disease (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from a son and gain of a wife when well placed (BPHS 54.10); great danger in the 7th (BPHS 54.13).
by_area.family: Loss of elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.22; Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage and bathing in holy rivers when well placed (BPHS 54.10).

strengtheners: Rahu exalted or in moolatrikona, or in a kendra, the 5th, 9th or 11th, with benefics (BPHS 54.9-10)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 54.11-12)
Rahu in the 2nd (loss of wealth) or the 7th (danger to life) (BPHS 54.13)
dasha_ad/mars/rahu.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Rahu here only from the lagna and by sign; it gives no rule from the dasha lord. Rahu's dignity follows the library's node convention (exalted Taurus); Santhanam's BPHS 47 also names Gemini as Rahu's moolatrikona.

source_views.source: BPHS 54.9-14, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 652-653
source_views.view: Rahu in moolatrikona, exaltation, a kendra, the 11th, 5th or 9th from the lagna and with benefics: recognition from government, house and land, happiness from a son, extraordinary business profit, holy bathing, foreign journeys. In the 8th or 12th or with or aspected by malefics: snakes, wounds, loss of cattle, danger from animals, bile and wind disease, imprisonment. In the 2nd: loss of wealth; in the 7th: great danger of premature death. Remedy: Naga puja, feeding Brahmins, Mrityunjaya japa for longevity.

dasha_ad/mars/jupiter.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 11 months 6 days) is a good part of the period in most sources: religious activity, honours, wealth, property, health and children. BPHS spoils it when Jupiter is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, combust, afflicted or weak, and warns of danger when Jupiter rules the 2nd (or 7th).
common_outcomes: worship of Brahmins and gods, visits to holy places, meritorious acts, hospitality, new children and friends (Phaladeepika 21.23)
wealth and land through Brahmins, freedom from illness, public esteem, ascendancy and happiness (Jataka Parijata 18.87)
end of the unfortunate time, favour from superiors, money, birth of children, wealth through holy people (Raman, pp. 246-247)
rare_outcomes: severe ear disease or phlegm complaints (Phaladeepika 21.23)
trouble from spirits, loss of servants and siblings when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.20-22)

by_area.career: Honours from government, success in business (BPHS 54.15-19); favour from superiors (Raman); wrath of rulers if Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.20-21).
by_area.finance: Increase of wealth, grain, property, cattle (BPHS 54.15-19); wealth and land through Brahmins (Jataka Parijata 18.87).
by_area.health: Sound health (BPHS 54.19; Jataka Parijata 18.87); ear and phlegm complaints (Phaladeepika 21.23); bile disease when afflicted (BPHS 54.21); fever if Jupiter rules the 2nd (BPHS 54.22).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 54.16, 54.19); new children (Phaladeepika 21.23; Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness at home (BPHS 54.16); loss of siblings when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.22).
by_area.spirituality: Worship, pilgrimage to holy places and meritorious deeds (Phaladeepika 21.23).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th or 2nd from the lagna, or in its exalted or own navamsa (BPHS 54.15-16)
Jupiter in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Mars, or with the lords of the 9th, 10th, 4th or lagna (BPHS 54.17-19)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, combust, with or aspected by malefics, or weak (BPHS 54.20-21)
Jupiter as lord of the 2nd (Santhanam) or 2nd/7th (gloss) (BPHS 54.22)
dasha_ad/mars/jupiter.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses two reference points: Jupiter's house from the lagna (vv. 15-16, 20-21) and from Mars, the dasha lord (vv. 17-19). Uttara Kalamrita (p. 160) says strong, well-placed Mars and Jupiter joined or aspected by benefics give raja yoga in their mutual periods, but P.S. Sastri's note doubts it from experience, calling Mars an enemy of Jupiter.

source_views.source: BPHS 54.15-22, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 653-654
source_views.view: Jupiter in the 9th, 5th, a kendra, 11th or 2nd from the lagna, or in an exalted or own navamsa: reputation, government honours, wealth and grain, happiness at home, property, wife and children. In a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Mars, or with the lords of the 9th, 10th, 4th or lagna, or in a benefic navamsa: house, land, health, fame, cattle, business success. In the 6th (OCR '5th'), 8th or 12th, debilitated, with or aspected by malefics, or weak: thieves, snakes, rulers' wrath, bile disease, trouble from spirits, loss of servants and siblings. Lord of the 2nd: fever or danger of premature death. Remedy: Shiva Sahasranama.

dasha_ad/mars/saturn.summary: Saturn's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is the most dreaded of the period: illness, loss of wealth and property, trouble from rulers, thieves and enemies, distress to family. BPHS gives a good version (honours, wealth, children) when Saturn is in a kendra, trikona, its own sign or moolatrikona, or with benefics, but unusually makes Saturn's good position from Mars bad.
common_outcomes: trouble after trouble to children, wife and elders, grief, loss and theft of wealth, illness from heat and wind (Phaladeepika 21.24)
illness bringing much misery, threats from enemies, robbers and rulers, loss of wealth (Jataka Parijata 18.88)
loss of money, illness, loss of relatives, danger from weapons or surgery, litigation, loss of property and position (Raman, p. 247)
rare_outcomes: results falling on Saturdays and in Saturn's month (BPHS 54.25)
defeat in battle and loss from selling farm land (BPHS 54.30-32)

by_area.personality: Mental agony (BPHS 54.27-32); violent or wrongful acts and ill repute when Saturn is in a kendra, 5th or 11th from Mars (BPHS 54.30-31).
by_area.career: Royal recognition and fame when Saturn is well placed (BPHS 54.23-25); loss of position, punishment by rulers, imprisonment otherwise (BPHS 54.26-32; Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth and grain when well placed (BPHS 54.24); loss of wealth, farm produce and land otherwise (BPHS 54.26, 54.32; Phaladeepika 21.24; Jataka Parijata 18.88).
by_area.health: Disease (BPHS 54.26); urinary trouble (BPHS 54.32); rheumatism and pains (BPHS 54.33-34); heat and wind illness (Phaladeepika 21.24).
by_area.relationships: Distress to wife and children (BPHS 54.29; Phaladeepika 21.24).
by_area.family: Children and grandchildren when well placed (BPHS 54.25); loss of siblings and family quarrels otherwise (BPHS 54.28-29).

strengtheners: Saturn in a kendra or trikona, its own sign or moolatrikona, an exalted or own navamsa, or with the lagna lord or benefics (BPHS 54.23-25)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn debilitated or in an enemy sign, or in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 54.26)
Saturn as 2nd or 7th lord with malefics (BPHS 54.27-29)
Saturn in a kendra, the 5th or 11th from Mars (BPHS 54.30-32)
Saturn in the 8th or 12th from Mars with malefics (BPHS 54.33-34)
dasha_ad/mars/saturn.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Saturn both from the lagna (vv. 23-29) and from Mars (vv. 30-35). Santhanam's note stresses that, against the usual rule, Saturn in a kendra, the 5th or 11th from Mars gives very bad results. Uttara Kalamrita (p. 251) says that in Mars's mahadasha Saturn's sub-period gives Mars's own results (and Mars's results show in Saturn's sub-period of Saturn's dasha).

source_views.source: BPHS 54.23-35, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 654-656
source_views.view: Saturn in a kendra, trikona, moolatrikona, exalted or own navamsa, or with the lagna lord or benefics: royal recognition, fame, wealth and grain, children and grandchildren, cattle; results on Saturdays and in Saturn's month. Debilitated, enemy sign, 8th or 12th: danger from foreign rulers, loss of wealth, imprisonment, disease, farm losses. 2nd or 7th lord with malefics: great danger, loss of life, rulers' wrath, thieves and fire, loss of siblings, family quarrels, distress to wife and children. Kendra, 11th or 5th from Mars: foreign journeys, loss of reputation, violent acts, loss from selling land, loss of position, defeat, urinary trouble. 8th or 12th from Mars with malefics: death, danger from rulers, thieves and enemies, rheumatism. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa.

source_views.source: BPHS 54.23-35, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 24 reads benefic conjunction or aspect; verse 26 'low-class rulers'; verse 30 gives kendra, 11th or trikona from the dasa lord; verse 33 predicts death in the sub-period when Saturn is in the 8th or 12th from the dasa lord with malefics.

dasha_ad/mars/saturn.disagreements: BPHS's rule that Saturn well placed from Mars (kendra, 5th, 11th) gives bad results reverses the usual principle; Santhanam flags this. Santhanam lists kendra, 11th and 5th from Mars; the gloss reads kendra, 11th or trikona. Uttara Kalamrita's results-exchange rule makes the sub-period reflect Mars's own condition, which the other texts do not say.
dasha_ad/mars/saturn.phrasing_guidance: Treat as a demanding stretch that rewards caution: avoid conflicts with authorities, review legal and property matters, look after health and family. Mention the favourable version only when Saturn is well placed from the lagna. Never predict death or imprisonment.

dasha_ad/mars/mercury.summary: Mercury's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 11 months 27 days) is mixed. BPHS gives religious and diplomatic activity, authority, vehicles and success in farming when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, and very high results when it is in a kendra or trikona from Mars; the other texts and Raman stress enemies, thieves and worry alongside trade gains.
common_outcomes: fear of enemies, trouble from thieves, loss of wealth, loss of cattle and horses, harassment by rulers (Phaladeepika 21.25)
wealth from traders, plenty of houses, cattle and grain, trouble from enemies and mental worry (Jataka Parijata 18.89)
marriage or inclination to it, knowledge, wealth through trade, trouble from enemies, worry, success in litigation (Raman, p. 247)
rare_outcomes: command of an army, music, discussions on scripture (BPHS 54.41-43)
poisoning by insects or animals (Raman, p. 247)

by_area.personality: Inclination to diplomacy and fame (BPHS 54.36-37); harsh speech and sinful thinking when Mercury is badly placed from Mars (BPHS 54.44-45).
by_area.career: Authority in government service (BPHS 54.37); high position and command (BPHS 54.41-43); antagonism with government when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40).
by_area.finance: Gains from trade, houses, cattle and grain (Jataka Parijata 18.89; Raman); loss of wealth and cattle (Phaladeepika 21.25; BPHS 54.38-39).
by_area.health: Heart disease when Mercury is debilitated, combust or in a dusthana (BPHS 54.38-39); many ailments when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40); critical illness if Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.46).
by_area.relationships: Marriage or wish to marry (Raman); distress to wife and children when Mercury is badly placed (BPHS 54.38-39).
by_area.family: Quarrels with kinsmen when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40); loss of kinsmen (BPHS 54.39).
by_area.spirituality: Company of holy people, japa, charity and religious rites (BPHS 54.36); discussion of scriptures and Puranas (BPHS 54.43).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 54.36-37)
Mercury in a kendra, trikona or exalted, from Mars (BPHS 54.41-43)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 54.38-39)
Mercury joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40)
Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars or with malefics (BPHS 54.44-45)
Mercury as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 54.46)
dasha_ad/mars/mercury.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses the lagna (vv. 36-39) and Mars, the dasha lord (vv. 40-45). Mercury and Mars are natural enemies (Mars treats Mercury as enemy); conjunction with Mars is itself listed as bad (v. 40). The gloss reads verse 44 as the dasha lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th; Santhanam reads Mercury in those houses from Mars.

source_views.source: BPHS 54.36-47, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 657-658
source_views.view: Kendra or trikona from the lagna: holy company, japa, charity, religious rites, fame, diplomacy, sweet food, vehicles, clothes, cattle, authority in government, success in farming. Debilitated, combust or 6th/8th/12th: heart disease, imprisonment, loss of kin, distress to wife and children, loss of wealth and cattle. With Mars: foreign journeys, more enemies, many ailments, trouble with government, quarrels with kin. Kendra, trikona or exalted from Mars: all ambitions, wealth, high position, clothes, ornaments, music, army command, scriptural discussion, Lakshmi's grace. 6th/8th/12th from Mars or with malefics: defamation, sinful thinking, harsh speech, thieves, fire, rulers, quarrels, danger on journeys. 2nd or 7th lord: critical illness. Remedy: Vishnu Sahasranama and gift of a horse.

dasha_ad/mars/mercury.phrasing_guidance: A mixed sub-period: good for trade, study, negotiation and settling disputes, with a need to guard against rivals, careless speech and travel risks. Advise attention to heart and general health only when the chart shows the afflicted conditions.

dasha_ad/mars/ketu.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 4 months 27 days) is turbulent in Phaladeepika and Raman: sudden danger from fire and weapons, quarrels, trouble from relatives and low people, possible departure from home. BPHS gives royal favour, wealth, land and a son when Ketu is in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th, or with benefics.
common_outcomes: danger from lightning, sudden trouble from fire and weapons, leaving one's country or loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.26)
opposition of bad people (Jataka Parijata 18.90, partly illegible in the scan)
quarrels with low people, loss of money, sins, trouble from relatives and brothers, family disputes, poisonous complaints, trouble through women, many enemies (Raman, pp. 247-248)
rare_outcomes: command of an army and friendship with rulers when Ketu is a strong yogakaraka (BPHS 54.50-51)
tooth trouble, dysentery, leprosy, distress from tigers (BPHS 54.52-53)

by_area.career: Government favour and authority when Ketu is well placed (BPHS 54.48-49); generalship and friendship with officials if Ketu is a yogakaraka (BPHS 54.50-51).
by_area.finance: Wealth, a little land early and more later (BPHS 54.49); loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.26; Raman; BPHS 54.54).
by_area.health: Fever, dysentery, tooth trouble when Ketu is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.52-53); disease in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.54).
by_area.relationships: Distress to wife and children (BPHS 54.53); trouble through women (Raman).
by_area.family: Birth of a son when well placed (BPHS 54.49); disputes with relatives and brothers (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Performance of oblations when Ketu is a yogakaraka (BPHS 54.51).

strengtheners: Ketu in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th, or with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 54.48-49)
Ketu a yogakaraka (joined with one) and strong (BPHS 54.50-51)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.52-53)
Ketu in the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 54.54)
dasha_ad/mars/ketu.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Ketu from the lagna for the good results and the 2nd/7th, and from Mars for the 6th/8th/12th rule. Santhanam notes that Ketu acts as a yogakaraka when joined with a yogakaraka planet. BPHS prescribes no remedy here.

source_views.source: BPHS 54.48-54, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 658-660
source_views.view: Ketu in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th, or with or aspected by benefics: government favour, wealth, little land at the start and more later, a son, authority, cattle. Yogakaraka and strong: a son, fame, Lakshmi's grace, wealth through employees, army command, friendship with officials, oblations, clothes and ornaments. 6th/8th/12th from Mars: quarrels, tooth trouble, thieves and tigers, fever, dysentery, leprosy, distress to wife and children. 2nd or 7th from the lagna: disease, disgrace, agony, loss of wealth. No remedy is given; Santhanam himself suggests Vishnu Sahasranama and the gift of a goat.

dasha_ad/mars/venus.summary: Venus's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 2 months) brings comforts, money from relatives, jewels and clothes, and in BPHS high position and luxury when Venus is in a kendra, exalted, in its own sign or a trikona lord. Phaladeepika is harsher (defeat, residence abroad, theft, eye trouble), and BPHS gives losses when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars.
common_outcomes: jewels for the wife, clothes, money from relatives, but odium of women and their company (Jataka Parijata 18.91)
property or money, domestic happiness, love affairs, festivities, travel pleasure, skin eruptions (Raman, p. 248)
defeat in battle, residence abroad, theft, left-eye trouble, loss of servants (Phaladeepika 21.27)
rare_outcomes: construction of wells and reservoirs and charitable works when Venus is linked to the 10th lord (BPHS 54.60)
elephants and horses (BPHS 54.55-56)

by_area.personality: Increase of intelligence (Raman).
by_area.career: High position in government (BPHS 54.55-56); gains from the employer (BPHS 54.57-58).
by_area.finance: Property, money from relatives, houses, land and villages by official favour (BPHS 54.57-59; Jataka Parijata 18.91); loss of wealth when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.61-62).
by_area.health: Skin eruptions and boils (Raman); bodily pain if Venus rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.63); left-eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.27).
by_area.relationships: Happiness of wife and children and good fortune when Venus is linked to the lagna lord (BPHS 54.56); love affairs and gifts to the wife (Raman; Jataka Parijata 18.91); disrepute through women (Jataka Parijata 18.91).
by_area.family: Celebrations of a son's birth (BPHS 54.57); dissensions in the family when badly placed (BPHS 54.62).
by_area.spirituality: Holy bathing, religious and charitable works (BPHS 54.59-60); religious observances (Raman).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, exalted, in its own sign, or lord of the 1st, 5th or 9th (BPHS 54.55-56)
Venus in the 5th, 9th, 11th or 2nd from Mars (BPHS 54.57-58)
Venus linked to the lagna lord or the 10th lord (BPHS 54.56, 54.60)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars, or with malefics (BPHS 54.61-62)
Venus as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.63)
dasha_ad/mars/venus.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Venus from the lagna (vv. 55-56) and from Mars (vv. 57-62). The Sanskrit gloss adds the 11th and trikonas to the lagna houses and reads verse 57 as kendra, trikona, 11th or 2nd from the dasha lord; it reads verse 61 as the dasha lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th.

source_views.view: Venus in a kendra, exalted, own sign, or lord of the 1st, 5th or 9th: high position, luxuries, elephants, horses, clothes; related to the lagna lord: happiness of wife and children and good fortune. In the 5th, 9th, 11th or 2nd from Mars: property, a son's birth, gains from the employer, house, land and villages; at the end songs, dances and holy bathing; linked to the 10th lord: wells and reservoirs, religious and charitable works. 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars or with malefics: sorrow, physical distress, loss of wealth, thieves and rulers, family dissension, distress to wife and children, loss of cattle. 2nd or 7th lord: bodily pain. Remedy: gift of a cow or female buffalo.

dasha_ad/mars/sun.summary: The Sun's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 4 months 6 days) joins two fiery friends: honour from authorities, fame and power won through boldness (Phaladeepika, BPHS when the Sun is strong), but also blame and quarrels with elders, fever and heart-ache (Jataka Parijata, Raman). BPHS makes it bad when the Sun is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars or with malefics.

Uttara Kalamrita (p. 161) lists Sun and Mars among pairs that, when strong, give good results in their mutual periods.

dasha_ad/mars/moon.summary: The Moon's sub-period closing Mars's dasha (about 7 months) is mainly favourable in every source: wealth, comforts, home improvements, marriages and festivities, favour from authorities. BPHS scales the good with the Moon's waxing, and gives serious losses and danger when the Moon is debilitated, in an enemy sign, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: various kinds of wealth and children, freedom from enemies, clothes, bed, ornaments and jewels, trouble to elders, spleen or bile complaints (Phaladeepika 21.29)
comforts of wealth, clothes, pearls, gems, ornaments, heavy sleep, ardent passion (Jataka Parijata 18.93)
profit, wealth, house renovated or improved, comforts, heavy sleep, passion (Raman, p. 249)
rare_outcomes: construction of reservoirs and cow shelters (BPHS 54.71)
danger of war (BPHS 54.74)

by_area.finance: Wealth and property (BPHS 54.72-73; Phaladeepika 21.29; Raman); loss of land, wealth and cattle when the Moon is badly placed (BPHS 54.74).
by_area.health: Spleen or bile trouble (Phaladeepika 21.29); bodily distress and mental agony if the Moon rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.75-76).
by_area.relationships: Marriage and festivities, happiness of wife and children (BPHS 54.72); passion (Jataka Parijata 18.93); distress to wife and children when badly placed (BPHS 54.74).
by_area.family: Good relations with parents (BPHS 54.72); trouble to elders (Phaladeepika 21.29).
by_area.spirituality: Merit through public works such as reservoirs (BPHS 54.71).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated or in an enemy sign, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Mars (BPHS 54.74)
Moon as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.75)
waning Moon reduces the good results (BPHS 54.73)

Debilitated, enemy sign, or 6th/8th/12th from the lagna or Mars: death, distress to wife and children, loss of lands, wealth and cattle, danger of war. 2nd or 7th lord: possibility of premature death, bodily distress and mental agony. dasha_ad/mercury/mercury.summary: Mercury's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 2 years 4 months 27 days) is favourable in every classical source: learning, fame, gains through relatives, success in undertakings, a good house and clothes. BPHS turns it bad when Mercury is debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics, and warns of distress to the wife and deaths in the family when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: pearls and gems, learning, success in education, fame, meeting new dignitaries, wealth, happiness from wife, children and parents (BPHS 58.1-3)
devotion to virtue, company of the learned, a clear mind, money through Brahmins, fame from learning, lasting happiness (Phaladeepika 21.57)
beautiful houses and clothes, money through Brahmins and relatives, success in every undertaking (Jataka Parijata 18.134)
a fine house and clothes, money through relatives, success, gain of a brother or sister, growth of the family, business gains, charity, study of mathematics and arts (Raman, p. 266)
rare_outcomes: distress to the wife, deaths in the family, rheumatism and stomach pain when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5)
overwork and its effects, headaches (Rele, p. 96)

by_area.personality: A clear, unbiased mind and devotion to virtue (Phaladeepika 21.57); good mind (Raman).
by_area.career: Success in studies and fame; meeting new superiors (BPHS 58.1-3); success in every undertaking (Jataka Parijata 18.134). Anxiety in official duties when Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.finance: Wealth, gems, business gains (BPHS 58.1-3; Raman); loss of wealth and cattle when Mercury is debilitated or in a dusthana (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.health: Stomach pain and illness when Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3); rheumatism when it rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5); headaches (Rele).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife (BPHS 58.1-3); distress to the wife when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5).
by_area.family: Happiness from children and parents (BPHS 58.1-3); growth of the family and a new sibling (Raman); antagonism with kin when afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.spirituality: Pious deeds and virtuous conduct (BPHS 58.1-3; Phaladeepika 21.57); charity (Raman).

strengtheners: Mercury exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 58.1-3)
Mercury in the 11th, a kendra or a trikona (Rele, p. 96)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 58.1-3)
Mercury lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5)
dasha_ad/mercury/mercury.lagna_or_context_notes: In its own sub-period Mercury is both dasa and sub-period lord, so its position from the dasa lord is always the 1st; the texts judge it from the lagna and by dignity. Rele also judges it 'from the significator', which is Mercury itself here.

Debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna, or with malefics: loss of wealth and cattle, antagonism with kin, stomach pains, anxiety in official duties. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: distress to wife, deaths in the family, rheumatism, stomach pains. Remedy: recite the Vishnu Sahasranama.
