dasha_ad/mercury/ketu.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 11 months 27 days) is mostly described as troubled: sorrow, quarrels, illness, trouble from relatives, failure in business and loss of land or vehicles. BPHS makes it good when Ketu is with benefics in a kendra or trikona, joined with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, or in a kendra or the 11th from Mercury, and bad when Ketu is with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury.
common_outcomes: trouble from relatives, mental agony, loss of comfort, fear of an enemy, failure in business (Jataka Parijata 18.135)
distress, sorrow, quarrels, confusion, trembling of the body, hostile company, loss of land and vehicles (Phaladeepika 21.58)
sorrow, disease, loss of work and dharma, bilious illness, aimless wandering, loss of property, misfortune to relatives, trouble through doctors (Raman, p. 267)
rare_outcomes: a fall from a vehicle, distress to a son, danger from the ruler, danger from scorpions and stinging creatures (BPHS 58.9-11)
a banquet with the king, honours, income from industry when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8)

by_area.personality: Confusion and mental agony (Phaladeepika 21.58; Jataka Parijata 18.135); a tendency to wrong deeds when afflicted (BPHS 58.9-11).
by_area.career: Failure in business (Jataka Parijata 18.135; Raman); loss of work (Raman). When well placed: honours, audience with the ruler, success in studies, income from industry (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.finance: Loss of property, land and vehicles (Phaladeepika 21.58; Raman). Late or modest gain of wealth and more cattle when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.health: Disease, bilious illness, trembling of the body (Phaladeepika 21.58; Raman); physical distress when Ketu is 'lord of the 2nd or 7th' (BPHS 58.12).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels and hostile or low company (Phaladeepika 21.58; BPHS 58.9-11).
by_area.family: Trouble from relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.135); distress to a son (BPHS 58.9-11); affection with kin when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.spirituality: Loss of dharma (Raman, p. 267).

strengtheners: Ketu with benefics in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 58.6-8)
Ketu with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka (BPHS 58.6-8)
Ketu in a kendra or the 11th from Mercury (BPHS 58.6-8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.9-11)

Bad if Ketu is with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury: fall from a vehicle, distress to a son, danger from the king, sinful deeds, scorpion danger, quarrels with menials, sorrow, disease. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: physical distress. Remedy: give a goat in charity.

Verse 9 says the results are good at the start and middle; the bad condition there is read as the dasa lord in the 8th or 12th or with malefics. Verse 12: the remedy is donating a goat.

dasha_ad/mercury/ketu.disagreements: BPHS gives good results under several conditions, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubled results with no conditions. Santhanam's bad condition is Ketu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury; the Sanskrit gloss of verse 9 reads it as the dasa lord in the 8th or 12th or with malefics. Rele counts the 6th, 8th and 12th, and counts from the lagna as well as from the dasa lord.
dasha_ad/mercury/ketu.phrasing_guidance: Describe a short, unsettled stretch: advise patience in business, care in travel and calm handling of relatives. Give the favourable version only when the chart shows the listed placements. Avoid predicting accidents or harm to children.

dasha_ad/mercury/venus.summary: Venus's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 2 years 10 months) is one of the best parts of the period in every source: religious and charitable acts, wealth, clothes and ornaments, help from friends and rulers, married happiness. BPHS makes it bad when Venus is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury, and warns of danger when Venus rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: worship of gods, Brahmins and elders, generous gifts, devotion to duty, clothes and ornaments, meeting friends (Phaladeepika 21.59)
presents to seniors, gods and Brahmins, conduct by religion and morality, wealth, clothing and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.136)
wealth, clothes and jewels, good children, married happiness, prospering relatives, growing trade, knowledge, return from a long journey, betrothal if unmarried, vehicles and a house (Raman, p. 267)
rare_outcomes: a high position in government, building of a reservoir (BPHS 58.13-15)
heart disease, defamation, fever, dysentery when Venus is weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.16-17)
renunciation, in one example chart (Rath, Crux pp. 389-390)

by_area.career: Ambitions fulfilled through the ruler and friends; a high position; extraordinary gains in business (BPHS 58.13-15); trade increases (Raman). Loss of position and credit when Venus is in a dusthana (Rele).
by_area.finance: Agricultural land, wealth and property (BPHS 58.13-15); wealth, ornaments, vehicles and a house (Raman).
by_area.health: Good health (Raman). Heart disease, fever, dysentery when Venus is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.16-17).
by_area.relationships: Married happiness, betrothal (Raman); meeting friends (Phaladeepika 21.59).
by_area.family: Birth of good children; relatives prosper (Raman). Separation from kin when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 58.16-17).
by_area.spirituality: Religious rites, charity, building of water works (BPHS 58.13-15); worship of gods, Brahmins and elders (Phaladeepika 21.59; Jataka Parijata 18.136).

dasha_ad/mercury/venus.lagna_or_context_notes: Rath's Crux (pp. 479-480) notes that when Mercury and Venus, conjoined, are the lagna and 5th lords, they form a dhimanta (intelligence) yoga and a raja yoga that work in their joint periods.

Venus weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury: heart disease, defamation, fever, dysentery, separation from kin, distress. Venus lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. dasha_ad/mercury/sun.summary: The Sun's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 10 months 6 days) brings royal or official favour, gold and possessions, good food and honour in the classical texts, though Raman lists mostly troubles (head and stomach pains, enemies, trouble through superiors) along with some gain. BPHS makes it good when the Sun is strong or in good houses, and bad when it is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Mercury, weak, or with Saturn, Mars or Rahu.

by_area.finance: Gold and valuables (Phaladeepika 21.60); wealth, clothes and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.137); land if the Sun is aspected by Mars (BPHS 58.21).
by_area.health: Bilious trouble, headaches (BPHS 58.23-24); head and stomach pains (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from friends (BPHS 58.20); separation from friends when afflicted (BPHS 58.23-24); illness of the wife (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Hearing moral teachings (Jataka Parijata 18.137).

dasha_ad/mercury/moon.summary: The Moon's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 1 year 5 months) is mixed. BPHS gives marriage, a son, a new house, music, study and gains from abroad when the Moon is strong or linked with Jupiter, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman stress illness, enemies and failed plans. The Moon debilitated, in an enemy sign or weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury brings danger from authorities, fire and thieves and losses through women.
common_outcomes: diseases, ill will of enemies, failure of every concern, risk from four-footed animals (Jataka Parijata 18.138)

rare_outcomes: marriage, birth of a son, a new house, music, study of scripture, a journey south, clothes from overseas, pearls (BPHS 58.26-29)

by_area.finance: Clothes, ornaments, gems and goods from overseas (BPHS 58.26-29); money through women, farming and trade (Raman). Loss of wealth on account of a woman, loss of crops and cattle when afflicted (BPHS 58.32-33).
by_area.health: Physical distress if the Moon is debilitated or in an enemy sign (BPHS 58.30); headache, eye and skin complaints, neck pain (Phaladeepika 21.61); swellings or hurts in the limbs (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Marriage when the Moon is strong (BPHS 58.26-27); trouble and quarrels through women (Raman; BPHS 58.32-33).
by_area.family: Birth of a son (BPHS 58.26-27); a new house (BPHS 58.28).

dasha_ad/mercury/mars.summary: Mars's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 11 months 27 days) is double-edged. Jataka Parijata gives relief from illness and enemies, fame from charity and royal favour, and BPHS gives property, a son and recovery of lost position when Mars is strong. Phaladeepika and Raman stress fire, eye trouble, thieves, wounds, fevers and loss of position. BPHS gives a bad-good-bad pattern when Mars is with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury.

Phaladeepika and Raman stress loss of status, poison, fire or water dangers, skin and heat diseases and bad company. Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury, brings losses, fear and possible confinement.

source_views.view: Rahu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or in Aries, Aquarius, Virgo or Taurus: reverence from government, reputation, wealth, pilgrimage, sacrifices, recognition, clothes; some trouble at the start, good later. In the 8th or 12th from the lagna: loss of wealth, rheumatic fever, indigestion. In the 3rd, 8th (sic), 10th or 11th: meetings with dignitaries; with a benefic, a visit to a new dignitary. With malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury: pressure of work as an official, loss of position, fears, imprisonment, disease, agony to self and kin, heart disease, loss of reputation and wealth. In the 2nd or 6th from the lagna: fear of premature death. Remedy: Durga and Lakshmi mantras; give a tawny cow or a female buffalo.

Verse 50: the 1st, 8th or 12th from the lagna. Verse 51: an upachaya (3, 6, 10, 11) with benefics. Verse 54: Rahu in the 2nd or 7th, untimely death; verse 55: donate a white cow or buffalo.

dasha_ad/mercury/rahu.disagreements: Jataka Parijata is favourable and Phaladeepika troubled; Raman lists both. In BPHS 58.47 Santhanam has Aries where the Sanskrit gloss has Cancer, and the gloss adds the 11th. In 58.51 Santhanam prints the 3rd, 8th, 10th or 11th; the gloss has the upachayas 3, 6, 10, 11. In 58.54 Santhanam has the 2nd or 6th, the gloss the 2nd or 7th. In 58.50 the gloss adds the 1st house. The remedy cow is tawny in Santhanam and white in the gloss. Rele also gives death for Rahu in the 6th, 8th or 12th.
dasha_ad/mercury/rahu.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a long sub-period of recognition and wider contacts that may start unsettled; advise care with company, contracts, digestion and official duties. Do not predict imprisonment or death; when the maraka clauses apply, suggest general health caution.

dasha_ad/mercury/jupiter.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 2 years 3 months 6 days) is good in most sources: health, wealth, royal favour, marriages and festivities at home, religious devotion and victory over enemies. Jataka Parijata and Raman also note friction with friends, relatives and elders. BPHS turns it bad when Jupiter is debilitated, combust, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or linked with Saturn and Mars, and when it is weak in a dusthana from Mercury.
common_outcomes: freedom from illness, defeat of enemies, end of fear, success in religious practice, honour from the ruler, merit from penance (Phaladeepika 21.64)
hatred of friends, relatives and elders, but more wealth and children, with some risk of disease (Jataka Parijata 18.141)
hatred of friends, relatives and elders, wealth, liability to disease, land, gains in trade, reputation, good credit, benefits from superiors, a birth or marriage (Raman, p. 269)
rare_outcomes: attending discourses on the Puranas and worship of Shiva (BPHS 58.56-58)
death of parents, punishment from government, danger from snakes and poison when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 58.59-61)
danger from Brahmins (their wrath) when Jupiter is weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.64)

by_area.personality: Enthusiasm (BPHS 58.62-63); devotion to deities and teachers (BPHS 58.56-58).
by_area.career: Favour of the ruler (BPHS 58.56-58; Phaladeepika 21.64); benefits from superiors, good credit, trade gains (Raman). Punishment and disgrace when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 58.59-61); wrath of government when weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.64).
by_area.finance: Wealth and cattle (BPHS 58.56-58); land and trade gains (Raman). Loss of wealth, land and crops when afflicted (BPHS 58.59-61).
by_area.health: Physical comfort and freedom from illness (BPHS 58.56-58; Phaladeepika 21.64); fever, snakes and poison when afflicted (BPHS 58.59-61); physical distress when Jupiter rules or occupies the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.65).
by_area.relationships: Marriage and festivities at home (BPHS 58.56-58; Raman); friction with friends (Jataka Parijata 18.141); antagonism with the wife when Jupiter is weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.64).
by_area.family: Happiness from kin and a son (BPHS 58.62-63); more children (Jataka Parijata 18.141); hatred of relatives and elders (Jataka Parijata 18.141; Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Puranic discourses, devotion to deities and the teacher, charity, Shiva worship (BPHS 58.56-58); success in religious practice and penance (Phaladeepika 21.64).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lagna, or exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 58.56-58)
Jupiter strong and in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Mercury (BPHS 58.62-63)
Mercury and Jupiter both strong in good houses (Uttara Kalamrita sl. 32-33)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter debilitated, combust, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with or aspected by Saturn and Mars (BPHS 58.59-61)
Jupiter weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.64)
Jupiter lord of or in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.65)
dasha_ad/mercury/jupiter.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter and Mercury each rule a kendra for Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces lagnas; Phaladeepika 20.50-51 warns that benefic kendra lords can turn harmful.

source_views.source: BPHS 58.56-66, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Jupiter in a kendra, trikona or 11th from the lagna, or exalted or in its own sign: physical comfort, wealth, the ruler's favour, marriage at home, sweet food, cattle, Puranic discourses, devotion to deities and the teacher, charity, Shiva worship. Debilitated, combust, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with or aspected by Saturn and Mars: discord with rulers and kin, thieves, death of parents, disgrace, punishment, losses, snakes and poison, fever, losses in farming and land. Strong in a kendra, trikona or 11th from Mercury: happiness from kin and a son, enthusiasm, wealth, fame, giving grain in charity. Weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury: agony, anxiety, disease, antagonism with wife and kin, government wrath, quarrels, losses, the wrath of Brahmins. Lord of or in the 2nd or 7th: physical distress. Remedy: recite the Shiva Sahasranama; give a cow and gold.

dasha_ad/mercury/jupiter.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a constructive period for health, finances, family events and study or devotion, with a caution about friction with elders and colleagues. Mention the afflicted results only when the chart shows them, and never predict a parent's death.

dasha_ad/mercury/saturn.summary: Saturn's closing sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 2 years 8 months 9 days) is the hardest in Phaladeepika and Raman: heavy losses of wealth and merit, failure, enmity, illness and family trouble. Jataka Parijata gives charity, wealth and comforts through minor chiefs, with farming losses. BPHS makes it good when Saturn is exalted, in its own sign or in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, and bad when it is in the 8th or 12th from Mercury, with a death warning when Saturn rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: heavy loss of wealth and religious merit, failure in all undertakings, phlegm and wind illnesses (Phaladeepika 21.65)
charity and good deeds, wealth, comforts through minor chiefs, loss in agriculture (Jataka Parijata 18.142)

bad luck, severe reversals, enmity, pain in Saturn's parts of the body, disgrace to relatives, gloomy thoughts, debts, loss of children, family breakdown, scandal, trouble from foreigners, earnings through wrong means, along with some charity, wealth and comforts (Raman, p. 269)
rare_outcomes: a high position, a fuller household and visits to sacred places when Saturn is strong (BPHS 58.67-68)
loss of thinking power and bad dreams (BPHS 58.69-70)

by_area.personality: Loss of clarity, mental agony and bad dreams when Saturn is in the 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.69-70); gloomy thoughts (Raman). Enthusiasm when Saturn is strong (BPHS 58.67-68).
by_area.career: Gain of position, even a high post, when Saturn is strong (BPHS 58.67-68); failure in all undertakings (Phaladeepika 21.65); loss in ventures (BPHS 58.69-70); severe reversals (Raman).
by_area.finance: Heavy losses (Phaladeepika 21.65); debts and earnings through wrong means (Raman); wealth and comforts through minor chiefs, with farming losses (Jataka Parijata 18.142).
by_area.health: Phlegm and wind illnesses (Phaladeepika 21.65); pain in Saturn's parts of the body, fear of disease (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Danger from enemies, distress to wife and children (BPHS 58.69-70); enmity (Raman).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family when Saturn is strong (BPHS 58.67-68); loss of kinsmen (BPHS 58.69-70); loss of children and family breakdown (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Visits to sacred shrines (BPHS 58.67-68); charity (Jataka Parijata 18.142); loss of religious merit (Phaladeepika 21.65).

strengtheners: Saturn exalted or in its own sign, or in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lagna (BPHS 58.67-68)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in the 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.69-70)
Saturn lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.71)
dasha_ad/mercury/saturn.lagna_or_context_notes: This is the last sub-period of the Mercury dasa, matching BPHS 47.70, which calls the end of the dasa distressing. Saturn is a friend of Mercury.

In the 8th or 12th from Mercury: danger from enemies, distress to wife and children, loss of thinking power, loss of kin, losses in ventures, mental agony, foreign journeys, bad dreams. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa and giving a black cow and a female buffalo.

dasha_ad/mercury/saturn.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a demanding close to the Mercury period that rewards discipline and steady effort; advise caution with debts, ventures and family strain, and suggest rest and routine for health. Never predict premature death.

dasha_ad/moon/moon.summary: The Moon's own sub-period opens its mahadasha and lasts about 10 months. Most sources describe it as pleasant: learning, music, good clothes, devotion, the mother's happiness, marriage or a child, and honour. BPHS makes it good when the Moon is exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with the 9th or 10th lord. It turns troubled when the Moon is debilitated, with malefics or in the 6th, 8th or 12th.
common_outcomes: devoted attention to learning, love of music, fine clothes (Jataka Parijata 18.74; Raman p. 240)
birth of a daughter, new clothes, meeting good Brahmins, the mother's wishes fulfilled, marital comfort (Phaladeepika 21.12)
refined company, good health and reputation, journeys to holy places, vehicles and lands, marriage, birth of a child, change of residence (Raman p. 240)
horses, elephants and clothes, devotion to deities and teachers, high position, name and fame when the Moon is well placed (BPHS 53.1-2)
rare_outcomes: acquisition of abandoned wealth; inclination to public life (Raman p. 240)
imprisonment and loss of kinsmen when the Moon is afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6)
danger of drowning when the Moon is in or with the lords of the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 77)

by_area.personality: Devotion to learning and music (Jataka Parijata 18.74; Raman). Lethargy and mental agony when the Moon is afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6).
by_area.career: High position, name and fame when well placed (BPHS 53.1-2); honour from the public and government (Rele). Loss of position and friction with rulers and ministers when afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6); dismissal from service (Rele).
by_area.finance: Horses, elephants, clothes, vehicles and land (BPHS 53.1-2; Raman). Loss of wealth when the Moon is debilitated, with malefics or in a dusthana (BPHS 53.3-6); sudden loss (Rele).
by_area.health: Sound health (Raman). Bodily pain and fear of premature death when the Moon is a maraka or joined with the 8th or 12th lord (BPHS 53.3-6).
by_area.relationships: Marriage or happiness with the spouse; marital comforts (Phaladeepika 21.12; Raman; Rele).
by_area.family: The mother is happy (Phaladeepika 21.12); birth of a daughter (Phaladeepika 21.12) or a child (Raman; Rele). Distress to the mother and loss of kinsmen when afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6); death of a brother (Rele).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and teachers and singing hymns (BPHS 53.1-2); meeting good Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.12); journeys to holy places (Raman).

strengtheners: Moon exalted or in its own sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with the 9th or 10th lord (BPHS 53.1-2)
full Moon: full strength, command of an army (BPHS 53.3, Sanskrit gloss)
Moon in the 11th (BPHS 53.1, Sanskrit gloss; Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated, with malefics, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 53.3-6)
Moon lord of the 2nd or 7th, or joined with the 8th or 12th lord (BPHS 53.3-6)
Moon in or with the lords of the 2nd or 7th (Rele)
dasha_ad/moon/moon.lagna_or_context_notes: In its own sub-period the Moon is both dasha and sub-period lord, so its position from the dasha lord is always the 1st; BPHS judges it from the lagna, dignity and associations. The Moon owns only Cancer, so 'lord of the 2nd or 7th' applies for Gemini and Capricorn lagnas.

Bad if debilitated, with malefics or in the 6th, 8th or 12th: loss of wealth and position, lethargy, agony, friction with rulers and ministers, distress to the mother, imprisonment, loss of kin. As lord of the 2nd or 7th, or with the 8th or 12th lord: bodily pain and danger of premature death. Remedy: give a tawny cow or a female buffalo.

dasha_ad/moon/moon.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a gentle opening phase, good for study, home life, family events and devotion. Mention the difficult version (money strain, worry, the mother's health) only when the chart shows the listed afflictions, and never predict death.

dasha_ad/moon/mars.summary: Mars's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 7 months) is mixed. BPHS and Rele make it productive when Mars is in a kendra or trikona or in its exaltation or own sign: fortune, recognition, land and business profit. Phaladeepika and Raman describe heat and friction: bile and blood disorders, fever, fire, quarrels and loss of money. BPHS makes it bad when Mars is in the 6th, 8th or 12th or afflicted by malefics.
common_outcomes: advancement of fortune, recognition by government, clothes and ornaments, success in efforts, more farm output and home prosperity, business profit when Mars is well placed (BPHS 53.7-8)
diseases from bile, fire and impure blood, anxiety, trouble from enemies and thieves, loss of wealth and honour (Phaladeepika 21.13)
quarrels and litigation among friends and relatives, rash ventures, marital disputes, loss of money, trouble from brothers, danger from fever and fire, injury, loss of blood (Raman p. 240)
rare_outcomes: fear of ghosts and disease of household animals (Raman p. 240)
loss of blood through an accident or operation (Rele p. 77)

by_area.personality: Hot temperament when Mars is afflicted (BPHS 53.9-12); rashness and harsh speech (Rele; Raman 'petulance').
by_area.career: Recognition by government and success in efforts (BPHS 53.7-8); honours from the ruler (Rele). Friction with employees and government when Mars is badly placed (BPHS 53.9-12); quarrels with superiors (Rele).
by_area.finance: Business profit and growth in farm output when well placed (BPHS 53.7-8); hard-earned wealth (Rele). Losses in business and farming (BPHS 53.9-12); loss of money (Phaladeepika 21.13; Raman).
by_area.health: Bile, fire and blood disorders (Phaladeepika 21.13); fever, injury, loss of blood (Raman); bodily distress (BPHS 53.9-12).
by_area.relationships: Disputes between husband and wife or lovers (Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from kinsmen (BPHS 53.9-12); trouble from brothers and friends (Raman); separation of brothers (Rele).

strengtheners: Mars in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 53.7-8)
Mars exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 53.7-8; Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 53.9-12)
Mars with or aspected by malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.9-12)
Mars in the 2nd or 7th, or the lord of Mars's sign in the 8th (Rele)
dasha_ad/moon/mars.lagna_or_context_notes: Santhanam's BPHS 53.9-12 uses both reference points: Mars in a dusthana from the lagna, and affliction by malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon. Keep them as separate conditions. The Moon and Mars are natural friends (Rele's general rules weigh friendship between period and sub-period lords).

source_views.source: BPHS 53.7-12, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 640-641
source_views.view: Mars in a kendra or trikona: rising fortune, government recognition, clothes and ornaments, success, farm and household prosperity, business profit; exalted or own: great happiness. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna, or with or aspected by malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon: bodily distress, losses at home, in farming and business, friction with employees and government, separation from kin, hot temper. No remedy is given in this translation.

source_views.source: BPHS 53.7-12, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 7 places Mars in a kendra or trine from the lagna. Verse 10: a planet in a bad house aspected by malefics brings bodily suffering and loss of home and land. Verse 11: if the planet is in death-related divisions, quarrels, opposition from rulers and separation from kin. Verse 12: when the 7th lord is in the 2nd and the 8th lord in the 8th, honour a Brahmin to pacify the trouble.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.13 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Diseases from bile, fire and impure blood; anxiety and misery; trouble from enemies and thieves; loss of wealth and honour.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 240
source_views.view: 7 months. Quarrels and litigation among friends and relatives, headlong ventures, marital disputes, disease, petulance, loss and waste of money, trouble from brothers and friends, fever, fire, ghosts, injury from weapons or stones, loss of blood, disease of animals.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, pp. 77-78
source_views.view: In a kendra or trikona: hard-earned wealth, honours, happiness; exalted or own: more prosperity and success. In the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with or aspected by a malefic: litigation, loss of wealth and property, loss of blood by accident or operation. In the 2nd or 7th, or when the lord of Mars's sign is in the 8th: quarrels with superiors or juniors, separation of brothers, harsh speech, rashness.

dasha_ad/moon/mars.disagreements: BPHS and Rele give a good version under the listed placements; Phaladeepika and Raman give only troublesome results. Jataka Parijata 18.75 (Mars in the Moon's dasa) is missing from the readable scan and could not be checked. Santhanam gives no remedy; the Sanskrit gloss gives honouring a Brahmin, under a different condition (7th lord in the 2nd, 8th lord in the 8th).
dasha_ad/moon/mars.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as an active, energetic short phase: good for property and effort when Mars is well placed, but a time to keep tempers down, avoid disputes and take care with fever, cuts and blood pressure. Do not predict accidents as certain.

more prosperity and success in undertakings
losses at home, in farming and business

dasha_ad/moon/rahu.summary: Rahu's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 6 months) is described as one of the harder parts of the period: enemies, fear of thieves, snakes and authorities, illness in the family, scandal and mental unrest. BPHS gives a better version when Rahu is aspected by benefics, in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, or with a yogakaraka. It also gives a religious version, pilgrimage and charity, when Rahu is in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon.
common_outcomes: danger from rulers, thieves and snakes, distress to cattle, loss of kin and friends, loss of reputation, mental agony (BPHS 53.13-14)
severe reproach or blame, more enemies, illness of relatives, danger from storms and lightning, fever from bad food or drink (Phaladeepika 21.14)
risk of falls and serious disease, loss of money and relatives, enmity of superiors, trouble through the wife, scandal, skin disease, danger from thieves and poison, danger to parents (Raman p. 241)
rare_outcomes: living in a forest; suffering from hunger (Raman p. 241)
fear of scorpion stings (BPHS 53.17-18)
gain from the king alongside troubles (Rele p. 78)

by_area.personality: Mental agony and anxiety (BPHS 53.13-14; Raman); a religious bent when Rahu is in a kendra or trikona (Rele).
by_area.career: Danger from government (BPHS 53.13-14); enmity of superiors (Raman); loss of position when Rahu is weak in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.17-18); dismissal (Rele). Success and gains of vehicles and clothes from authorities when well placed (BPHS 53.15-16).
by_area.finance: Loss of money (Raman). Gains of vehicles and garments and success in all ventures when Rahu is in an upachaya, aspected by benefics or with a yogakaraka (BPHS 53.15-16).
by_area.health: Fever from bad food and drink (Phaladeepika 21.14); falls, dangerous disease, skin disease, poison (Raman); bodily trouble when Rahu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.19-21).
by_area.relationships: Distress to the wife (BPHS 53.17-18); trouble through the wife (Raman); illness of the wife (Rele).
by_area.family: Loss of kin and friends (BPHS 53.13-14); illness of relatives (Phaladeepika 21.14); distress to children (BPHS 53.17-18); danger to father and mother (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage, visits to shrines and charity when Rahu is in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.19-21); pilgrimage and a religious bent (Rele).

strengtheners: Rahu aspected by benefics (BPHS 53.15-16)
Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th (BPHS 53.15-16; Rele)
Rahu with a yogakaraka (BPHS 53.15-16) or with trine lords (Rele)
Rahu in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.19-21)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu weak and in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.17-18)
Rahu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon, or debilitated (Rele)
Rahu in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.19-21)
dasha_ad/moon/rahu.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses both reference points here: a kendra or trikona from the lagna gives early good and later trouble (53.13-14); a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon gives religious merit (53.19-21); the 8th or 12th from the Moon spoils it (53.17-18). Santhanam does not say from where the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th of 53.15-16 are counted; the Sanskrit gloss reads them from the lagna. The Moon and Rahu are natural enemies.

source_views.source: BPHS 53.13-21, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 641-642
source_views.view: Rahu in a kendra or trikona: some good at first, then danger from government, thieves and snakes, distress to cattle, loss of kin, friends and reputation, mental agony. Aspected by benefics, in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, or with a yogakaraka: success, vehicles and garments from authorities in the south-west. Weak and in the 8th or 12th from the Moon: loss of position, distress to wife and children, disease, danger from government, scorpions and snakes. In a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon: pilgrimage, shrines, charity. In the 2nd or 7th: bodily trouble. Remedy: Rahu japa and the gift of a goat.

source_views.source: BPHS 53.13-21, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 13 places the kendra or trine from the lagna. Verse 15: benefic association or aspect, an upachaya from the lagna, or a link with a yogakaraka ensures success. Verse 16 gives a meeting with a powerful person from the west or south-west. Verse 20: obstacles to charitable acts; bodily harm if the 2nd or 7th is involved. Verse 21: Rudra japa and the gift of a goat.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.14 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Severe reproach or fault, more enemies, diseases to relations, danger from thunderstorms and lightning, illness and fever from bad food and drink.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, pp. 240-241
source_views.view: 1 year 6 months. Risk of falls and dangerous diseases, waste of wealth, loss of relatives, no bodily ease, enemies stirred up, sickness, anxiety, enmity of superiors and elders, trouble through the wife, scandal, living in a forest, skin disease, thieves and poison, danger to father and mother, hunger.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, p. 78
source_views.view: In a kendra or trikona: trouble from enemies, thieves and serpents, loss of brothers, quarrels with friends and superiors, loss of reputation, worry, but also pilgrimage and a religious mind. With or aspected by benefics, in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, or with trine lords: happiness, wealth, success. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from the period lord, or debilitated: dismissal, worry, trouble from children, illness of the wife, fear of animal bites.

dasha_ad/moon/rahu.disagreements: BPHS gives Rahu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna a poor result (good only at first) but a kendra or trikona from the Moon a religious, favourable one. Phaladeepika and Raman give only troubles. The remedy differs: Santhanam reads Rahu japa, the Sanskrit gloss Rudra japa, both with the gift of a goat. Jataka Parijata 18.76 (Rahu in the Moon's dasa) is missing from the readable scan.
dasha_ad/moon/rahu.phrasing_guidance: Present this as an unsettled stretch that calls for caution with health, food hygiene, family harmony and dealings with officials. Mention its spiritual side (pilgrimage, charity) where the chart supports it. Avoid frightening language about poison, snakes or danger to parents.

dasha_ad/moon/jupiter.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 4 months) is one of the best parts of the period in every source: honour from authorities, celebrations at home, clothes, ornaments, vehicles, land, children, generosity and success. BPHS makes it bad if Jupiter is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, combust, debilitated or with malefics. It warns of premature death if Jupiter is a maraka.
common_outcomes: high position, celebrations at home, clothes and ornaments, recognition, wealth, land and vehicles, success by the ruler's favour (BPHS 53.22-24)
delight in gifts and good deeds, happiness, new clothes and ornaments, meeting friends, high honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.15)
vehicles, plenty of clothing and ornaments, achieving what one strives for (Jataka Parijata 18.77)
more property, plenty of food and comforts, benefits from superiors, birth of a child, patronage of rulers, respect, learning (Raman p. 241)
rare_outcomes: conception by the grace of the chosen deity (BPHS 53.23, Sanskrit gloss)
eating unpalatable food and journeys away from home when Jupiter is weak in a dusthana from the Moon (BPHS 53.29-31)

by_area.personality: Generosity and delight in good deeds (Phaladeepika 21.15); valour and patience when Jupiter is in the 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.career: High position and recognition from government (BPHS 53.22-24; Phaladeepika 21.15); benefits from superiors (Raman); favours from government (Rele). Loss of position when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.finance: Wealth, land and vehicles (BPHS 53.22-24); more property (Raman; Rele); cattle, grain and clothes when Jupiter is 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28). Loss of house, vehicles and land when afflicted (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.health: Premature death is warned of when Jupiter is a maraka from the lagna (BPHS 53.29-31); accidental death in the 2nd or 7th (Rele).
by_area.relationships: Marriage or birth of a son (Rele); marriage celebrations when Jupiter is 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.family: Celebrations at home (BPHS 53.22-24); birth of a child (Raman); happiness from brothers (BPHS 53.25-28). Harm to preceptor, father and children when afflicted (BPHS 53.25-28; Rele).
by_area.spirituality: Gifts and charity (Phaladeepika 21.15); oblations and rites (BPHS 53.25-28); favour of the chosen deity (BPHS 53.23).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or in its own or exaltation sign (BPHS 53.22-24)
Jupiter in the 11th (BPHS 53.22, Sanskrit gloss) or the 3rd or 11th (Rele)
Jupiter in the 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th, combust, debilitated or with malefics (BPHS 53.25-28)
Jupiter weak and in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.29-31)
Jupiter as lord of the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 53.29-31)
dasha_ad/moon/jupiter.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS 53.22-24 counts from the lagna; 53.25-28 and 53.29-31 add positions from the Moon (3rd or 11th from the Moon good; weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon bad). The gloss for verse 27 reads the dasha lord in a kendra, trine, 3rd or 11th. Rele lists the 6th, 8th or 11th from the period lord as bad, apparently a misprint for the 12th. The Moon and Jupiter are natural friends.

source_views.source: BPHS 53.22-31, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 642-644
source_views.view: Jupiter in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, own or exalted: high position, celebrations, clothes, ornaments, recognition, the chosen deity's favour, wealth, land, vehicles, success. In the 6th, 8th or 12th, combust, debilitated or with malefics: harm to preceptor and children, loss of position, mental agony, quarrels, loss of house, vehicles and land. In the 3rd or 11th from the Moon: cattle, grain, clothes, happiness from brothers, property, valour, rites, marriage celebrations, high position. Weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon: bad food, journeys from home. Good at the start, distress at the end. As lord of the 2nd or 7th from the lagna: premature death. Remedy: Shiva Sahasranama and a gift of gold.

source_views.source: BPHS 53.22-31, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 22 adds the 11th house. Verse 23: favourable outcomes such as conception by the grace of the chosen deity. Verse 29 reads the dasha lord in the 7th, 4th or 8th, or weak in the 12th: decline in rites, marriages, splendour and wealth. Verse 30: good at the start, troublesome at the end. Verse 31: risk of untimely death with the 2nd and 7th lords; chant the Shiva Sahasranama; gold removes all troubles.

source_views.view: Exalted, in a kendra or trikona, own, or in the 3rd or 11th: more property, comfort, marriage or a son, government favour. Debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with a malefic: death of father or son, deportation or dismissal, sudden quarrels, loss of property. In the 6th, 8th or 11th from the period lord: misery and distant travel. In the 2nd or 7th: accidental death.

dasha_ad/moon/jupiter.disagreements: All sources agree the period is generally good. BPHS (Santhanam) puts the weak-Jupiter rule at the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon; the gloss reads the 7th, 4th or 8th, or the 12th. Rele says the 6th, 8th or 11th from the period lord. BPHS ties premature death to Jupiter as lord of the 2nd or 7th; Rele ties accidental death to Jupiter placed in the 2nd or 7th.
dasha_ad/moon/jupiter.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a supportive, expansive phase: recognition, family celebrations, generosity and property. Mention the cautions (loss of position, trouble to elders or children) only when the listed afflictions are present, and never predict death.

dasha_ad/moon/saturn.summary: Saturn's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 7 months) is mixed to difficult in most sources. Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman stress illness, the mother's suffering, harsh words and trouble to the spouse. BPHS makes it productive, with a son, friends, property, business through working people and royal favour, when Saturn is in a kendra or trikona, in its own sign or navamsa, exalted or with benefics. Placements in the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd bring pilgrimages, trouble from many people and enemies.
common_outcomes: birth of a son, friends, wealth and property, business profit with the help of working people, more farm output, royal favour when Saturn is well placed (BPHS 53.32-34)
visits to holy places and bathing in holy rivers, trouble from many people and enemies when Saturn is in the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd or debilitated (BPHS 53.35)
various diseases, sickness of friends, children and wife, a great calamity (Phaladeepika 21.16)
mental anguish from the mother's suffering, wind and bile disorders, harsh words and arguments with unfriendly people (Jataka Parijata 18.78)
rare_outcomes: [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] (Phaladeepika 21.16)
the spouse's death or separation (Raman p. 241)
loss of a limb or surgery (Rele p. 79)

by_area.personality: Mental anguish and no peace of mind (Jataka Parijata 18.78; Raman).
by_area.career: Royal favour and business gains through working people when well placed (BPHS 53.32-34); a good time to start a new business (Rele). Dishonour and slander when badly placed (Rele).
by_area.finance: Wealth, property and more farm output when well placed (BPHS 53.32-34); loss of property (Raman).
by_area.health: Many diseases (Phaladeepika 21.16); wind and bile disorders, indigestion (Jataka Parijata 18.78; Raman); physical distress when Saturn is in the 2nd, 7th or 8th (BPHS 53.36-38).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels with the wife at times (BPHS 53.36-38); illness of the wife (Phaladeepika 21.16); the spouse's death or separation (Raman).
by_area.family: Birth of a son when well placed (BPHS 53.32-34). Mental trouble due to the mother (Jataka Parijata 18.78; Raman); quarrels with relatives (Raman); disagreement with wife and children (BPHS 53.36-38; Rele).
by_area.spirituality: Visits to holy places and bathing in holy rivers (BPHS 53.35; Rele).

strengtheners: Saturn in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, in its own sign or navamsa, or exalted (BPHS 53.32-34)
Saturn aspected by or with benefics, or strong in the 11th (BPHS 53.32-34)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd, or debilitated (BPHS 53.35; Rele)
Saturn in the 2nd, 7th or 8th (BPHS 53.36-38)
dasha_ad/moon/saturn.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Saturn from the lagna in 53.32-35 and from the Moon in 53.36-38: in a kendra or trikona from the Moon, or strong, it gives mixed results (enjoyment and gains at times, quarrels with wife and children at others). Santhanam does not say from where the 2nd, 7th and 8th of verse 38 are counted. The Moon is neutral to Saturn and Saturn treats the Moon as an enemy (Rele's friendship rules).

source_views.source: BPHS 53.32-38, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 644-645
source_views.view: Saturn in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, in its own sign or navamsa, exalted, with benefics or strong in the 11th: a son, friends, wealth, property, business through working people, farm output, royal favour. In the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd, or debilitated: holy places and holy baths, trouble from many people and enemies. In a kendra or trikona from the Moon, or strong: enjoyment and gains at times, quarrels with wife and children at others. In the 2nd, 7th or 8th: physical distress. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa and the gift of a black cow or female buffalo.

source_views.source: BPHS 53.32-38, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 35: with Saturn in the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd or debilitated, bathe at and visit sacred places at the start of the sub-period. Verse 36: fear from many people and harm from weapons, even when Saturn is in a kendra or trine or strong. Verse 38: Mrityunjaya japa and a black cow or buffalo restore health.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.16 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Trouble from various diseases, sickness of friends, children and wife, a great calamity or loss of life. A variant reading gives 'many bilious ailments' for 'various diseases'.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.78 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, vol. II)
source_views.view: Mental anguish caused by the mother's suffering, wind and bile disorders, harsh words and arguments with unfriendly people.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 241
source_views.view: 1 year 7 months. The wife's death or separation, mental anguish, loss of property and friends, ill health, mental trouble due to the mother, wind and bile disorders, harsh words, arguments with unfriendly people, indigestion, no peace of mind, quarrels with relatives.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, p. 79
source_views.view: In a kendra, trikona, own sign or the 11th: a larger family circle and more friends, wealth, prosperity; good for starting a new business. Debilitated or in the 2nd, 6th, 8th or 12th: pilgrimage, dishonour, slander, loss of a limb or surgery. In a kendra or trikona from the period lord: happiness, but disagreement with wife and children.

dasha_ad/moon/saturn.disagreements: BPHS and Rele give a clear good version for a well-placed Saturn; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubles, Phaladeepika up to loss of life and Raman the wife's death or separation. The Sanskrit gloss of verse 36 says harm can come even from a strong Saturn in a kendra or trine; Santhanam reads that verse as mixed results.
dasha_ad/moon/saturn.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as a heavier, work-focused phase: steady effort can bring property and business gains, but rest, digestion, the mother's well-being and patience at home need attention. Do not predict the loss of a spouse or death.

dasha_ad/moon/mercury.summary: Mercury's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 5 months) is described as favourable by nearly every source: wealth, learning and the company of scholars, trade profits, recognition, clothes and ornaments, children, settled disputes and clear thinking. BPHS makes it bad when Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon or debilitated. As a maraka it brings fear of fever.
common_outcomes: wealth, recognition, clothes, scripture discussions, knowledge from learned company, enjoyments, children, satisfaction, business profit, vehicles and ornaments (BPHS 53.39-41)
wealth at all times, elephants, horses, cattle and ornaments, much happiness, clear understanding (Phaladeepika 21.17)
wealth from relatives on the mother's side, learned men seeking one's support, clothes and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.79)
wealth from maternal relatives, new clothes and ornaments, settled disputes, joy through children or a lover, intellectual achievements, new education, honour from rulers (Raman pp. 241-242)
rare_outcomes: addiction to betting and drink (Raman p. 242)
imprisonment when Mercury is in a dusthana from the Moon (BPHS 53.44-46)
drinking soma and other tasty drinks (BPHS 53.42-43)

by_area.personality: Clear understanding (Phaladeepika 21.17); intellectual achievements (Raman); more intellect and contentment (Rele).
by_area.career: Recognition by government (BPHS 53.39-41); close relations with authorities (BPHS 53.42-43); honour from rulers and favours from superiors (Raman; Rele).
by_area.finance: Wealth and business profit (BPHS 53.39-41; Phaladeepika 21.17); gains from trade (Rele); wealth from maternal relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.79; Raman). Loss in farming when afflicted (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.health: Good health (BPHS 53.42-43). Bodily pain when Mercury is in a dusthana from the Moon (BPHS 53.44-46); fear of fever as a maraka (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.relationships: Marriage (BPHS 53.42-43; Rele); pleasure through a lover (Raman). Distress to the wife when afflicted (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.family: Birth of children (BPHS 53.39-41); wealth from the mother's relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.79). Distress to wife and children when afflicted (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.spirituality: Discussion of scriptures, company of learned and holy people (BPHS 53.39-41); oblations, charity and religious rites (BPHS 53.42-43).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona, in its own sign or navamsa, exalted, strong (BPHS 53.39-41)
Mercury in a kendra, trikona, the 11th or the 2nd from the Moon (BPHS 53.42-43)
Mercury in the 2nd or 11th from the lagna (Rele)

dasha_ad/moon/mercury.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS 53.39-41 does not state the reference point (the gloss reads the lagna); 53.42-46 counts from the Moon. Rele uses both the lagna and the period lord. The Moon is friendly to Mercury, but Mercury treats the Moon as an enemy.

In a kendra, trikona, 11th or 2nd from the Moon: marriage, oblations, charity, religious rites, closeness to authorities, learned company, pearls, coral, gems, vehicles, good health, affection. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon, or debilitated: bodily pain, farm losses, imprisonment, distress to wife and children. As lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of fever. Remedy: Vishnu Sahasranama and the gift of a goat.

dasha_ad/moon/ketu.summary: Ketu's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 7 months) is mostly troublesome in Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman: loss of mental balance, money and relatives, illness of the wife, stomach trouble and danger from water. BPHS gives a good version, with wealth, family happiness and religious inclination, when Ketu is strong in a kendra, trikona or the 3rd. It is spoiled when Ketu is in the 8th or 12th from the Moon or with malefics.
common_outcomes: loss of mental balance, wealth and relatives, danger from water, trouble to dependants and servants (Phaladeepika 21.18)
illness of the wife, loss of relatives, stomach diseases, loss of property (Jataka Parijata 18.80)
feverish illness, fire, swellings or eruptions, eye trouble, worry, public criticism, danger to parents and children, scandal, bad company, loss of money and memory (Raman p. 242)
wealth, enjoyment, happiness of wife and children, religious inclination when Ketu is strong and well placed (BPHS 53.47-48)
rare_outcomes: eating prohibited food (Raman p. 242)
engaging in hazardous undertakings (Rele p. 79)
being the cause of one's own undoing (Rele p. 80)

by_area.personality: Loss of mental balance (Phaladeepika 21.18); a mind full of cares and weak memory (Raman).
by_area.career: Public criticism or displeasure and dishonour (Raman; Rele). Obstacles in ventures from enemies when Ketu is badly placed (BPHS 53.50-52).
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.18; Jataka Parijata 18.80). Gain of wealth and cattle when Ketu is strong and well placed from the Moon, with some loss at the end (BPHS 53.49).
by_area.health: Stomach disease (Jataka Parijata 18.80; Raman); fever, fire, eruptions and eye trouble (Raman); bodily disease when Ketu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.50-52).
by_area.relationships: Illness of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.80; Raman); happiness with wife and children when well placed (BPHS 53.47-48).
by_area.family: Loss of relatives (Phaladeepika 21.18; Jataka Parijata 18.80); danger to father, mother and children (Raman); trouble to dependants (Phaladeepika 21.18).
by_area.spirituality: Religious inclination and performing rites when Ketu is strong (BPHS 53.47-48).

strengtheners: Ketu strong and in a kendra, trikona or the 3rd from the lagna (BPHS 53.47-48)
Ketu strong and in a kendra, the 5th, 9th or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.49)
Ketu in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the lagna or the period lord (Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 8th or 12th from the Moon, or with or aspected by malefics (BPHS 53.50-52)

dasha_ad/moon/ketu.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS counts 53.47-48 from the lagna and 53.49-52 from the Moon. Strength is a condition in both favourable rules and cannot be read from house position alone. Ketu owns no sign in this library, so the 2nd/7th rule is checked by placement only.

source_views.view: Ketu strong in a kendra, trikona or the 3rd from the lagna: wealth, enjoyment, happiness of wife and children, religious inclination; some loss of wealth at the start, then all well. Strong in a kendra, 9th, 5th or 11th from the Moon: gain of wealth and cattle, loss of wealth at the end of the sub-period. In the 8th or 12th from the Moon, or with or aspected by malefics: obstacles from enemies and quarrels. In the 2nd or 7th: danger of disease. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa, which brings relief and gains by Shiva's grace.

dasha_ad/moon/ketu.disagreements: BPHS and Rele allow a good version; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubles. On timing, Santhanam says loss at the start then all well (53.48) and loss at the end (53.49); the gloss reads loss early with happiness in the middle. Santhanam does not say from where the 2nd and 7th of verse 51 are counted; the gloss reads them from the dasha lord.
dasha_ad/moon/ketu.phrasing_guidance: Describe this as a short, unsettling phase: keep finances careful, watch digestion and fevers, and look after the spouse's health. Note its inward, religious side where Ketu is strong. Do not predict the loss of relatives.

dasha_ad/moon/venus.summary: Venus's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 8 months) is described mainly as comfortable and prosperous: high position, clothes, ornaments, vehicles, a new house, good food, perfumes, marriage or children, and gains through trade, farming and water-related goods. BPHS makes it bad when Venus is debilitated, combust or afflicted, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon. It warns of premature death when Venus is a maraka.
common_outcomes: high position, clothes, ornaments, cattle and vehicles, happiness of wife and children, a new house, sweet food daily, perfumes, sound health (BPHS 53.53-55)
buying and selling of water-related goods, vehicles, gold, jewels and trade goods; farming; gain of children, friends, cattle and grain (Phaladeepika 21.19)
a dowry on the wife's behalf, comforts from farming, cattle, water products and clothes; possible illness inherited from the mother (Jataka Parijata 18.81)
sudden gains through the wife, good works and meals, birth of children, expenses on marriage or other auspicious events, alongside some sickness and enmity (Raman p. 242)
rare_outcomes: acquisition of hidden treasure when Venus is in the 2nd in exaltation or its own sign (BPHS 53.58-60)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] when Venus is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.62)
fear of drowning when Venus is in the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 80)

by_area.career: High position by the ruler's favour (BPHS 53.53-55); gifts and favours from superiors (Rele). Opposition from government when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.finance: Clothes, ornaments, vehicles, cattle, land and houses (BPHS 53.53-61); trade, farming and water-related goods (Phaladeepika 21.19; Jataka Parijata 18.81); gains through the wife (Raman). Loss of land and cattle when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.health: Sound health (BPHS 53.53-56); a disease inherited from the mother (Jataka Parijata 18.81; Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness of the wife, affairs with beautiful women (BPHS 53.53-55); dowry (Jataka Parijata 18.81); love or marriage (Rele). Loss of the wife when Venus is debilitated, combust or afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.family: Happiness of wife and children, a new house (BPHS 53.53-55); birth of a son (BPHS 53.58-60); children, chiefly daughters (Rele). Loss of children when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and Brahmins when Venus is with the 9th or 11th lord (BPHS 53.58-60).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, trikona, the 11th, 4th or 9th from the lagna, or exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 53.53-55)
Venus with the Moon (BPHS 53.56; Rele)

dasha_ad/moon/venus.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses the lagna in 53.53-55 and 53.58-60 and the Moon in 53.56, 53.61 and 53.62. Venus is in the 2nd from the lagna in 53.58. The Moon is neutral to Venus and Venus treats the Moon as an enemy, yet the classical results are mostly favourable.

source_views.source: BPHS 53.53-64, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2, pp. 647-649
source_views.view: Venus in a kendra, trikona, 11th, 4th or 9th from the lagna, or exalted or own: high position, clothes, ornaments, cattle, vehicles, happiness of wife and children, a new house, sweets daily, perfumes, beautiful women, sound health. With the Moon: soundness, reputation, more land and houses. Debilitated, combust or afflicted: loss of land, children, wife and cattle, opposition from government. In the 2nd in exaltation or own sign, or with the 11th lord: hidden treasure, land, a son. With the 9th or 11th lord: rising fortune, ambitions fulfilled, devotion, pearls. In a kendra or trikona from the Moon: more houses and land, wealth. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon: deportation abroad, sorrow, death, danger from thieves and snakes. As lord of the 2nd or 7th: premature death. Remedy: Rudra japa and the gift of a white cow and silver.

Verse 62 adds the 12th or joined with malefics: suffering abroad, distress, death, thieves. Verse 63: fear of untimely death if the 2nd and 7th lords are badly placed; Rudra japa. Verse 64: a white cow and silver bring peace by Shankara's grace.

source_views.view: Exalted, in a kendra or trikona from the lagna or the period lord, own sign, or with the period lord: a happy period, cheerfulness, gifts and favours, love or marriage, children (chiefly female), domestic happiness, hidden treasure. Debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the period lord, or with malefics: scandal and trouble through women, loss of wealth, wife or son, unhappiness abroad, fear of robbers. In the 2nd or 7th: fear of accidental death, especially by drowning.

dasha_ad/moon/venus.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Rele are broadly favourable; Raman mixes gains with sickness, pain, loss of property and enmity. BPHS ties premature death to Venus as lord of the 2nd or 7th, Rele to Venus placed in the 2nd or 7th. Santhanam reads verse 61 as Venus in a kendra or trikona from the Moon; the gloss adds 'a planet in the 11th from the dasha lord'.
dasha_ad/moon/venus.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a comfortable, social and home-building phase: marriage, a home, good food, trade and family events. Mention cautions (relationship strain, government friction, illness) only for the afflicted placements, and never predict death or loss of a spouse.

dasha_ad/moon/sun.summary: The Sun's sub-period closes the Moon's dasha and lasts about 6 months. It is mostly favourable: honour and power from authorities, recovery of lost position or wealth, decline of enemies, end of illness, and a child or the favour of Lakshmi at home. Bile and wind complaints and fever, especially near the end, recur in the sources. BPHS makes it bad when the Sun is in the 8th or 12th from the Moon.
common_outcomes: recovery of a lost position and wealth, family happiness, villages and land through friends and the ruler, birth of a son, Lakshmi's favour (BPHS 53.65-67)
honour from the ruler, great valour, end of illness, decline of enemies; bile and wind complaints (Phaladeepika 21.20)
power almost regal, freedom from illness, decline of enemies, happiness and prosperity (Jataka Parijata 18.82)

feverish complaints, eye pain, success or failure by the positions of the Sun and Moon, legal power, prosperity, but also jaundice, dropsy, loss of money, travel, danger to parents (Raman pp. 242-243)
rare_outcomes: piles and weakness, loss of children and friends (Raman p. 243)
troubles on foreign journeys (BPHS 53.68-70)

by_area.personality: Great valour (Phaladeepika 21.20); lethargy near the end of the sub-period (BPHS 53.65-67).
by_area.career: Recovery of a lost high position (BPHS 53.65-67; Rele); honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.20); power almost regal (Jataka Parijata 18.82); employment and popularity (Rele). Danger from government when the Sun is in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.68-70); quarrels with men in power (Rele).
by_area.finance: Recovery of wealth, villages and land (BPHS 53.65-67); loss of money (Raman); loss of honour and wealth when afflicted (Rele).
by_area.health: End of illness (Phaladeepika 21.20; Jataka Parijata 18.82). Bile and wind complaints (Phaladeepika 21.20); fever near the end (BPHS 53.65-67); fever as a maraka (BPHS 53.68-70); fever and cough in the 2nd or 7th (Rele).
by_area.family: Happiness in the family, birth of a son (BPHS 53.65-67); possibility of conception (Rele); danger to father and mother (Raman).

strengtheners: Sun exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or 3rd (BPHS 53.65-67; Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.68-70)
Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the period lord, or with a malefic (Rele)
Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.68-70)
dasha_ad/moon/sun.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS 53.65-67 does not state a reference point for the good houses (the lagna is implied); 53.68-70 counts from the Moon. The Sun and Moon are natural friends. Raman says success or failure depends on the relative positions of the Sun and Moon.

source_views.view: Sun exalted, own, in a kendra, or in the 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or 3rd: recovery of lost position and wealth, family happiness, villages and land through friends and the ruler, a son, Lakshmi's favour; fever and lethargy likely at the end. In the 8th or 12th from the Moon: danger from government, thieves and snakes, fever, troubles on foreign journeys. As lord of the 2nd or 7th: fever. Remedy: worship of Shiva.

BPHS names the 8th and 12th from the Moon as bad; Rele adds the 6th and malefic association (the gloss also adds malefics). Rele places the 2nd/7th rule on the Sun's position; BPHS on its lordship.
dasha_ad/moon/sun.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a short closing phase that can restore standing and confidence, with recognition from authorities. Advise rest and care against fevers and digestive heat, especially towards its end. Do not predict danger to parents.

dasha_ad/rahu/rahu.summary: Rahu's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 2 years 8 months 12 days) is described mostly as a disturbed time: family quarrels, illness of the spouse, fear of poison or snakes, loss of money and wandering far from home. BPHS makes it good, even giving high position, when Rahu is in Cancer, Scorpio, Virgo or Sagittarius, in an upachaya house, or joined with a yogakaraka.
common_outcomes: danger from poison, water-borne illness or a venomous snake (Phaladeepika 21.30)
separation from loved ones, harsh words, mental distress (Phaladeepika 21.30)
illness of the wife, disputes, poor judgement, loss of wealth, wandering in a distant land (Jataka Parijata 18.97)
quarrels in the family, scandal, fever, wounds or insect bites, court testimony, weakened memory, distant wandering (Raman, p. 251)
rare_outcomes: death of a partner or of the head of the family (Raman, p. 251)
adultery (Phaladeepika 21.30)
a kingdom or high office, royal favour (BPHS 55.1-4 when well placed)

by_area.personality: Mental disturbance, poor judgement and weakened memory (Jataka Parijata 18.97; Raman p. 251).
by_area.career: Friction with officials when Rahu is badly placed (BPHS 55.5-6); high position, government favour and professional success when it is well placed (BPHS 55.1-4). Raman notes testimony in court.
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth (Jataka Parijata 18.97; Raman); gains of clothes, vehicles, ornaments and property when well placed (BPHS 55.1-4).
by_area.health: Poisoning, water-borne illness, snake danger (Phaladeepika 21.30); fever, wounds, insect bites (Raman); distress and disease when Rahu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 55.7).
by_area.relationships: Illness of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.97; Raman); separation from loved ones (Phaladeepika 21.30); distress to spouse and children when badly placed (BPHS 55.5-6).
by_area.family: Loss of kin and family quarrels (BPHS 55.5-6; Raman).

strengtheners: Rahu in Cancer, Scorpio, Virgo or Sagittarius (BPHS 55.1)
Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, with benefic aspect or a yogakaraka (BPHS 55.3)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 55.5-6)
Rahu in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 55.7)
dasha_ad/rahu/rahu.lagna_or_context_notes: In its own sub-period Rahu is both dasha and sub-period lord, so the position from the dasha lord is always the 1st; BPHS judges it from the lagna and by sign. Santhanam's verse 7 speaks of Rahu as 'lord of the 2nd or 7th' or placed there; nodes own no sign in this library, so only the placement is checkable.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.1-7, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Rahu is in Cancer, Scorpio, Virgo or Sagittarius and in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th from the lagna, or linked with a yogakaraka in its exaltation sign: high position, royal favour, family happiness, more property. Bad in the 8th or 12th or with malefics: thieves, wounds, friction with officials, loss of kin, family distress. Lord of or placed in the 2nd or 7th: distress and disease. Remedy: Rahu's mantras and charity of Rahu's articles.

Verse 7 reads as the 2nd or 7th lord in the 7th: chronic disease, relieved by shanti.

dasha_ad/rahu/jupiter.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Rahu's dasha (about 2 years 4 months 24 days) is one of the better parts of the period in every source: illness and enemies recede, royal favour, wealth, children and religious activity. BPHS makes it bad if Jupiter is debilitated, combust, in an enemy sign, in a dusthana or with malefics, and warns of danger when Jupiter is a maraka.
common_outcomes: enemies and ailments subside; royal favour, wealth, children, perseverance (Jataka Parijata 18.98)
happiness, worship of gods and Brahmins, good health, study of scripture (Phaladeepika 21.31)
gains through nobles and superiors, success, a marriage in the family (Raman, p. 252)
rare_outcomes: gain of a village (BPHS 55.12)
also more enemies, litigation, and bathing in a sacred river (Raman, p. 252)

by_area.personality: Steadiness of mind and patience when Jupiter is well placed (BPHS 55.9).
by_area.career: Position, victory over rivals and royal favour (BPHS 55.8-12); support from superiors (Raman). Loss of authority or government displeasure when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 55.13-14).
by_area.finance: Wealth grows steadily, like the waxing Moon; vehicles and cattle (BPHS 55.10); land and food (BPHS 55.15-17). Loss of wealth when Jupiter is afflicted or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.13-14, 55.18).
by_area.health: Good health (Phaladeepika 21.31); illness lifts (Jataka Parijata 18.98). Heart disease when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 55.13-14); bodily distress when in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.18).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 55.12-13); a marriage at home (Raman).
by_area.family: Joy from the birth of a son (BPHS 55.13, Sanskrit gloss); family distress when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 55.13-14).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to gods and Brahmins, pilgrimages, study of scripture (BPHS 55.12; Phaladeepika 21.31); charity and dharma (BPHS 55.16).

strengtheners: Jupiter exalted, in its own sign, or in an own or exalted navamsa (BPHS 55.8)
Jupiter in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 55.8)
Jupiter strong and in a kendra, trikona, or the 2nd, 3rd or 11th from Rahu (BPHS 55.15-17)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter debilitated, combust, in an enemy sign, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 55.13-14)
Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.18)
Jupiter as a maraka (BPHS 55.19)
dasha_ad/rahu/jupiter.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses two reference points: Jupiter's position from the lagna (vv. 8-14) and from Rahu (vv. 15-19). Jupiter as lord of the 2nd or 7th from the lagna is a maraka here. Santhanam doubts the printed 'gain of authority' among the bad results and suggests government punishment instead.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.8-20, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Jupiter is exalted, in own sign or navamsa, in an exalted navamsa, or in a kendra or trikona from the lagna: position, victory over foes, steady growth of wealth, royal favour, vehicles, cows, travel west or south-east, success, pilgrimages, family happiness. Bad if debilitated, combust, in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna, in an enemy sign or with malefics: loss of wealth, obstacles, defamation, family distress, heart disease, loss of authority. Good if strong in a kendra, trikona, or the 11th, 2nd or 3rd from Rahu: land, food, cattle, charity. Bad in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu or with malefics: loss of wealth, bodily distress. As 2nd/7th lord: premature death. Remedy: worship Shiva with a golden idol.

dasha_ad/rahu/jupiter.disagreements: The unconditional classical lists (Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata) are wholly positive, while BPHS makes the results depend on Jupiter's condition. Raman mixes positive results with litigation and more enemies. Santhanam prints Jupiter as 'lord of the 2nd and 7th' for the maraka result, which Jupiter cannot be; the reading 'lord of the 2nd or 7th' is used here.
dasha_ad/rahu/jupiter.phrasing_guidance: Present as a period of relief, support from mentors or authorities, and growth in family and faith, qualified by Jupiter's condition. Rephrase the maraka line as a time to look after health. Offer Shiva worship only as a traditional practice.

dasha_ad/rahu/saturn.summary: Saturn's sub-period in Rahu's dasha (about 2 years 10 months 6 days) is described by most sources as hard: wind and bile disorders, disputes, distress to relatives, scandal and living far from home. BPHS allows good results through service, building works and celebrations when Saturn is in a kendra or trikona, the 3rd or 11th, or in its own or exaltation sign, and warns of danger when Saturn is a maraka.
common_outcomes: wind and bile disorders, wounds, friction with children, spouse or brothers, loss of servants and status (Phaladeepika 21.32)
distress among relatives and friends, living in a remote foreign land (Jataka Parijata 18.99)
scandal, bad company, constant disputes, rheumatic and bilious ailments, residence abroad (Raman, p. 252)
rare_outcomes: danger from a falling tree; divorce (Raman, p. 252)
sudden gain of ornaments even in the bad case (BPHS 55.26)

by_area.personality: Lethargy reduces income (BPHS 55.24).
by_area.career: Royal favour through service when well placed (BPHS 55.22); loss from officials during a western journey (BPHS 55.24); danger from menials, the ruler and enemies when afflicted (BPHS 55.25); loss of status (Phaladeepika 21.32).
by_area.finance: Gains from a wealthy Shudra-class patron and cattle (BPHS 55.23); disputes with co-parceners and in business when afflicted (BPHS 55.26).
by_area.health: Wind and bile disorders (Phaladeepika 21.32; Jataka Parijata 18.99); heart disease and gulma (abdominal swelling) when Saturn is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.27-28).
by_area.relationships: Friction with spouse and children (Phaladeepika 21.32); divorce (Raman).
by_area.family: Marriages and celebrations at home when well placed (BPHS 55.22); distress to family and kin when afflicted (BPHS 55.25-26; Jataka Parijata 18.99).
by_area.spirituality: Meritorious acts, building gardens and water tanks (BPHS 55.22-23).

strengtheners: Saturn in a kendra or trikona, exalted, in own sign or moolatrikona, or in the 3rd or 11th (BPHS 55.21)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn debilitated, in an enemy sign, or in the 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 55.25)
Saturn in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.27)
Saturn as a maraka (BPHS 55.29)
dasha_ad/rahu/saturn.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Saturn from the lagna (vv. 21-26) and from Rahu (vv. 27-29). Even the good case includes some loss on a western journey and through lethargy.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.21-29, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Saturn is in a kendra or trikona, exalted, in own sign or moolatrikona, or in the 3rd or 11th: favour of the ruler, celebrations at home, gardens or reservoirs built, wealth and cattle from wealthy Shudras, return home; also loss from officials on a western journey and lower income through lethargy. Bad if debilitated, in an enemy sign, or in the 8th or 12th from the lagna: danger from menials, the ruler and enemies, family distress, disputes with co-parceners, sudden gain of ornaments (translator finds this last odd). Bad in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu: heart disease, defamation, quarrels, enemies, foreign travel, gulma, poor food. As 2nd/7th lord: premature death. Remedy: give a black cow or she-buffalo.

dasha_ad/rahu/mercury.summary: Mercury's sub-period in Rahu's dasha (about 2 years 6 months 18 days) is broadly favourable in the classical texts: friends, family, business profit, learning, marriage and royal favour. BPHS turns it bad when Mercury is in a dusthana or aspected by Saturn, and gives a maraka warning when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: gain of children, wealth and friends, skill in business and refinement, though the mind may feel low (Phaladeepika 21.33)
good company of friends, relatives, wife and children; wealth and royal favour (Jataka Parijata 18.100)
a strong urge to marry, vehicles, trade gains, family harmony (Raman, pp. 252-253)
rare_outcomes: Raja yoga (BPHS 55.31)
fraudulent schemes and relations with prostitutes (Raman, p. 253)

by_area.personality: Refinement and skill (Phaladeepika 21.33); lying and unwise acts when Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 55.36-38).
by_area.career: Business profit, royal favour and audiences with rulers (BPHS 55.31-32); trade gains (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth, vehicles and cattle (BPHS 55.31-32); loss of fortune when afflicted (BPHS 55.37).
by_area.health: Good health when Mercury is well placed from Rahu (BPHS 55.34).
by_area.relationships: Marriage (BPHS 55.32, 55.35; Raman's 'strong urge to marry'); company of wife and friends (Jataka Parijata 18.100).
by_area.family: Family well-being (BPHS 55.31); quarrels and distress when afflicted (BPHS 55.38).
by_area.spirituality: Hearing the Puranas, sacrifices, charity, religious feeling (BPHS 55.35); disrespect to gods and Brahmins when afflicted (BPHS 55.37).

Mercury as a maraka (BPHS 55.39)

dasha_ad/rahu/ketu.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Rahu's dasha (about 1 year 0 months 18 days) is the most consistently troubled part of the period in the sources: fevers, danger from fire, weapons, thieves and superiors, quarrels and loss of honour or cattle. BPHS allows relief and gains when Ketu is with or aspected by benefics or connected with the lagna lord.
common_outcomes: wandering or foreign travel, danger from the ruler, wind-type fevers, loss of cattle (BPHS 55.40)
fever, danger from fire, weapons and enemies, headache, trembling, harm to friends and elders, quarrels (Phaladeepika 21.34)
robbery, loss of wealth, honour and children, deaths of cattle, general misfortune (Jataka Parijata 18.101)
irregular meals, epidemics, injury or poison, children's ill health, swellings, marital trouble, danger from superiors (Raman, p. 253)
rare_outcomes: anal disorder (Raman, p. 253)
gold, wealth and government recognition when Ketu is with benefics (BPHS 55.41)

by_area.personality: Mental tension and anguish (BPHS 55.41, 55.44).
by_area.career: Danger from the ruler or superiors (BPHS 55.40; Raman); government recognition only with benefic influence (BPHS 55.41).
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth and cattle (Jataka Parijata 18.101; BPHS 55.40); gains when connected with the lagna lord (BPHS 55.42).
by_area.health: Fevers, headache, trembling (Phaladeepika 21.34); rheumatic fever (BPHS 55.40); wounds (BPHS 55.44); swellings and injury (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Marital trouble (Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from parents and hostility of kin when Ketu is weak in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 55.43-44); harm to elders and friends (Phaladeepika 21.34); children's ill health (Raman).

strengtheners: Ketu with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 55.41)
Ketu connected with or conjoined with the lagna lord (BPHS 55.42)
Ketu in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 55.42)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu connected with the 8th lord (BPHS 55.41)
Ketu weak in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 55.43)
dasha_ad/rahu/ketu.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu always stands in the 7th from Rahu, so no 'from the dasha lord' rule applies here. Santhanam's verse 45 speaks of Ketu as 'lord of the 2nd or 7th'; nodes own no sign in this library, so that condition is recorded as manual.

source_views.view: Generally foreign travel, danger from government, rheumatic fever, cattle loss. With the 8th lord: bodily distress and mental tension. With or aspected by benefics: enjoyment, wealth, government recognition, gold. Related to the lagna lord: wishes fulfilled; joined with it: sure gain of wealth; in a kendra or trikona: more cattle. Weak in the 8th or 12th from the lagna: thieves, snakes, wounds, separation from parents, kin hostility, mental agony. As 2nd/7th lord: bodily distress. Remedy: give a goat.

dasha_ad/rahu/ketu.disagreements: Santhanam applies the kendra/trikona clause to Ketu; the Sanskrit gloss applies it to the lagna lord. All unconditional lists are negative; only BPHS gives a favourable version.
dasha_ad/rahu/ketu.phrasing_guidance: Present as a short, testing phase that calls for caution with health, travel, fire and dealings with superiors, noting the relief that benefic influence or a link with the lagna lord brings. Avoid fear-based wording.
