dasha_ad/rahu/venus.summary: Venus's 3-year sub-period in Rahu's dasha brings a mix in all sources: marriage or a fortunate wife, comforts, vehicles and foreign goods, alongside illness, quarrels with relatives and deceit. BPHS gives strong yoga results when Venus is strong in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, or in its own or exaltation sign, and serious troubles when Venus is in a dusthana, debilitated, or with Saturn, Mars or Rahu.
common_outcomes: gaining a wife, comforts, horses, elephants and land, alongside phlegm and wind ailments and family quarrels (Phaladeepika 21.35)
vehicles, umbrellas and wealth from foreign lands, but troubles from disease, foes and relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.102)
foreign vehicles and goods, a wife who brings fortune, friendly alliances, land, a birth or marriage; risk of deception and false friends (Raman, p. 253)
rare_outcomes: kingdom and high office (BPHS 55.46-48)
imprisonment and fines (BPHS 55.56-58)
the upanayana (sacred-thread) ceremony in the family (BPHS 55.51)

by_area.career: Government recognition, high office and business profit when well placed (BPHS 55.46-51); imprisonment, fines and danger to one's employer when afflicted (BPHS 55.53, 55.58).
by_area.finance: Wealth through Brahmins, cattle, a new house, business profits (BPHS 55.47-51); wealth from foreign lands (Jataka Parijata 18.102); loss through royal punishment when afflicted (BPHS 55.58).
by_area.health: Phlegm and wind ailments (Phaladeepika 21.35); stomach pain (BPHS 55.53-54); urinary disorders, diabetes, blood impurity, anaemia, nervous disorder when Venus is with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.56-57).
by_area.relationships: Acquiring a wife (Phaladeepika 21.35; Raman); happiness of spouse and children when Venus is strong (BPHS 55.49); marital unhappiness when afflicted (BPHS 55.53-54).
by_area.family: Celebration of a son's birth (BPHS 55.47); separation from a son or father, kin distress, inheritance disputes when afflicted (BPHS 55.52-53).
by_area.spirituality: Charity of grains and food, dharma (BPHS 55.50).

strengtheners: Venus strong in a kendra, trikona or the 11th (BPHS 55.46)
Venus exalted, in own sign, or in an own or exalted navamsa (BPHS 55.48)
Venus in a kendra, trikona, or the 10th or 11th from Rahu (BPHS 55.54-55)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, in an enemy sign, or with Saturn, Mars or Rahu (BPHS 55.51-53)
Venus with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.56)
Venus as a maraka (BPHS 55.58-59)
dasha_ad/rahu/venus.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Venus from the lagna (vv. 46-53) and from Rahu (vv. 54-59). Venus conjoined with Rahu is listed among the spoiling conditions (v. 51).

source_views.source: BPHS 55.46-59, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Venus is strong in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lagna: wealth through Brahmins, cattle, celebration of a son's birth, government recognition, kingdom, enjoyment. Good if exalted, in own sign, or in own or exalted navamsa: new house, sweets, family happiness, friends, grain charity, government favour, vehicles, clothes, business profit, upanayana. Bad in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna, debilitated, in an enemy sign, or with Saturn, Mars or Rahu: diseases, quarrels, separation from son or father, kin distress, danger to self or employer, family unhappiness, stomach pain. Good in a kendra, trikona or the 11th or 10th from Rahu: enjoyments, desired objects. Bad with malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu: wrath of Brahmins, snakes or government, urinary retention, diabetes, blood impurity, anaemia, coarse food, nervous disorder, imprisonment, fines. As 2nd/7th lord: family distress and premature death to oneself. Remedy: worship Durga and Lakshmi.

dasha_ad/rahu/sun.summary: The Sun's short sub-period in Rahu's dasha (about 10 months 24 days) is described as feverish and quarrelsome in the general lists: high fevers, enmity, family quarrels, danger from poison, fire or weapons and trouble from the government. BPHS gives royal favour, reputation and even rule over a village when the Sun is well placed or linked to the lords of the 1st, 9th and 10th.
common_outcomes: trouble from enemies, eye pain, danger from poison, fire or weapons, illness of spouse and children, royal trouble (Phaladeepika 21.36)
interest in charity and contentment, an end to violence, but the spread of contagious disease (Jataka Parijata 18.103)
high fevers, dizziness, enmity, family quarrels, anxiety about wife, children or relatives, relocation; also benefits from influential people, exam success, reputation (Raman, pp. 253-254)
rare_outcomes: headship of a village; sovereignty over a country (BPHS 55.61-63)

by_area.personality: Mental unrest (Raman); contentment (Jataka Parijata 18.103).
by_area.career: Cordial relations with the government, reputation, government help and recognition by foreign dignitaries when well placed (BPHS 55.60-66); antagonism with the government when the Sun is debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.64-65).
by_area.finance: Increase of grain and wealth (BPHS 55.60-61).
by_area.health: Fever, dysentery and other diseases (BPHS 55.65); eye pain (Phaladeepika 21.36); high fevers and dizziness (Raman); critical illness when the Sun is a maraka (BPHS 55.67).
by_area.relationships: Illness of spouse (Phaladeepika 21.36); anxiety about wife (Raman).
by_area.family: Family quarrels (Raman); happiness of children when well connected (BPHS 55.63-64).
by_area.spirituality: Charity (Jataka Parijata 18.103; Raman).

strengtheners: Sun exalted, in own sign or navamsa, in an exalted navamsa, or in the 11th, a kendra or a trikona (BPHS 55.60)
Sun with or aspected by the lords of the 1st, 9th and 10th (BPHS 55.62)
Sun in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Rahu (BPHS 55.66)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.64)
Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 55.67)
dasha_ad/rahu/sun.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses the lagna (v. 60), links to house lords (v. 62) and the position from Rahu (vv. 64-66). The 2nd/7th-lord result here is critical illness, not death.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.60-67, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if the Sun is exalted, in own sign or navamsa, in an exalted navamsa, or in the 11th, a kendra or trikona from the lagna: cordial government relations, more grain, some popularity, perhaps headship of a village. Good if associated with or aspected by the lords of the lagna, 9th or 10th: reputation, government help, foreign travel, sovereignty, elephants and horses, wishes fulfilled, family happiness. Bad if debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu: fever, dysentery, quarrels, government antagonism, travel dangers, enemies, thieves, fire. Good in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Rahu: well-being and recognition by foreign dignitaries. As 2nd/7th lord: critical illness. Remedy: worship the Sun.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.60-67, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 62 names the 9th, 1st and 10th lords (no 2nd lord); verse 64 reads the lagna lord or dasha lord in the 6th, 7th or 8th; remedy is Surya namaskara and shanti.

dasha_ad/rahu/moon.summary: The Moon's sub-period in Rahu's dasha (1 year 6 months) brings mixed results: abundance, good crops, money and reunion with kin in some lists, but danger to the wife, quarrels, losses and danger from water in others. BPHS makes it prosperous when the Moon is strong or well placed from the lagna or from Rahu, and troubled when a weak Moon is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu.
common_outcomes: abundant enjoyments, good crops, money, close ties with kin (Jataka Parijata 18.104)
loss of wife, quarrels, anguish, farming activity, losses of wealth, cattle and children, danger from water (Phaladeepika 21.37)
abundance, crops, reunion with kin but also loss of relatives, money lost through the wife, limb pain, change of residence, sea voyages, danger to wife or children (Raman, p. 254)
rare_outcomes: kingship and honour from rulers (BPHS 55.68-69)
disturbance from evil spirits or wild animals (BPHS 55.73)

by_area.personality: Anguish (Phaladeepika 21.37); devotion and reputation when well placed (BPHS 55.71-72).
by_area.career: Honour from rulers and success in undertakings when well placed (BPHS 55.68-72).
by_area.finance: Wealth, grain, vehicles, house and land when well placed (BPHS 55.68-72); losses of wealth and cattle (Phaladeepika 21.37); money lost through the wife (Raman); loss of house, land and wealth when weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.73, Sanskrit gloss).
by_area.health: Good health when well placed (BPHS 55.69); stomach disorders and wounds when weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.73-74); limb pain (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Loss of or danger to the wife (Phaladeepika 21.37; Raman); prosperity through wife and friends (BPHS 55.69, Sanskrit gloss).
by_area.family: Children and close ties with kin (BPHS 55.69; Jataka Parijata 18.104); loss of relatives (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Worship of the deity and the Goddess, Lakshmi's grace (BPHS 55.71-72).

strengtheners: Moon exalted, in own sign, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th (BPHS 55.68)
Moon in a friendly sign aspected by benefics (BPHS 55.68)
full Moon (BPHS 55.70, Sanskrit gloss)
Moon in a kendra, the 5th, 9th or 11th from Rahu (BPHS 55.71)
weakeners_or_cancellations: weak Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.73)
Moon as lord of the 2nd (or, as printed, 12th) (BPHS 55.74-75)
dasha_ad/rahu/moon.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges the Moon from the lagna (vv. 68-70) and from Rahu (vv. 71-74). Santhanam prints the maraka condition as lord of the 2nd or 12th; a secondary compilation notes this applies to Gemini and Leo lagnas, where the Moon rules those houses. The Sanskrit gloss reads the 2nd or 7th lord.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.68-75, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if the Moon is exalted, in own sign, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, or in a friendly sign aspected by benefics: kingdom, honour from rulers, wealth, health, garments, children, vehicles, property. Good in the 5th, 9th, a kendra or the 11th from Rahu: Lakshmi's grace, success, wealth and grain, reputation, deity worship. Bad if weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu: disturbance by spirits and wild animals, thieves on journeys, stomach disorders. As lord of the 2nd or 12th (as printed): premature death. Remedy: give a white cow or she-buffalo.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.68-75, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com

dasha_ad/rahu/mars.summary: Mars's sub-period closing Rahu's dasha (about 1 year 0 months 18 days) is described in the general lists as dangerous: rulers, fire, thieves and weapons, severe illness, loss of position, confusion and failing memory. BPHS gives recovery of lost position and wealth, property and command when Mars is well placed from the lagna or from Rahu, and danger when Mars is a maraka.
themes: danger from fire, weapons and thieves
common_outcomes: danger from rulers, fire, thieves and weapons, severe illness, loss of position, heart and eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.38)
a mix of calamities, confusion in every task, lapse of memory (Jataka Parijata 18.105)
danger from rulers, fire, thieves or weapons, defeat in litigation, money lost through cousins, enemy malice, dissolute habits, disputes (Raman, p. 254)
rare_outcomes: recovery of a lost kingdom; command of an army (BPHS 55.76-80)

by_area.personality: Confusion and memory lapses (Jataka Parijata 18.105; Raman); enthusiasm when well placed (BPHS 55.80).
by_area.career: Recovery of lost position, audiences with rulers, army command when well placed (BPHS 55.76-80); loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 55.81; Phaladeepika 21.38).
by_area.finance: Recovery of wealth, growth of house, land and crops (BPHS 55.76-77); wealth through brothers (BPHS 55.80); money lost through cousins, defeat in litigation (Raman).
by_area.health: Severe illness, heart and eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.38); wounds and bodily pain when afflicted (BPHS 55.82); lethargy when Mars is a maraka (BPHS 55.83).
by_area.relationships: Distress to the spouse when Mars is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu (BPHS 55.80-81).
by_area.family: Happiness of children through the household deity's grace (BPHS 55.77); conflict with relatives and siblings when afflicted (BPHS 55.81).
by_area.spirituality: Blessings of the household or chosen deity (BPHS 55.77).

strengtheners: Mars in a kendra or trikona (Santhanam: or the 3rd; Sanskrit: or the 11th), aspected by or joined with benefics, exalted or in own sign (BPHS 55.76)
Mars in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Rahu (BPHS 55.78)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu and aspected by malefics (BPHS 55.80)
Mars as a maraka (BPHS 55.83)
dasha_ad/rahu/mars.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Mars from the lagna (v. 76) and from Rahu (vv. 78-82). Sources differ on the houses in v. 76.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.76-83, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Mars is in the 3rd, 5th, 9th or a kendra from the lagna, aspected by benefics, exalted or in own sign: recovery of lost kingdom and wealth, property, more farm output, gains, household deity's blessings, children, good food. Good in a kendra, or the 5th, 9th, 3rd or 11th from Rahu: red garments, vehicles, audiences with the government, well-being of children and employer, army command, wealth through kin. Bad in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Rahu and aspected by malefics: family and spouse distress, loss of position, conflict, thieves, wounds, bodily pain. As 2nd/7th lord: lethargy and danger of death. Remedy: give a cow or a bull.

source_views.source: BPHS 55.76-83, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com

dasha_ad/saturn/saturn.summary: Saturn's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 3 years) is described by Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman as a heavy time: illness, mental anguish, losses to rulers and thieves, and suffering in the family, with some gains through farming and servants. BPHS makes it excellent (high position, family happiness, land and conveyances) when Saturn is in its own or exaltation sign, in a kendra or trikona, or a yogakaraka. When Saturn is in the 8th or 12th it starts badly and ends well, and when Saturn is a maraka it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: growth of farming, servants and buffalo herds, money through a labourer, friendship with an older woman, laziness and wrongdoing, wind illness (Phaladeepika 21.48)
disease and suffering, envy and pride leading to sorrow, loss of wealth and grain to rulers and robbers (Jataka Parijata 18.122)
opposition, displeasure of officials, fear of cattle being poisoned, suffering of wife and children, fever, wind or phlegm ailments, colic (Jataka Parijata 18.123)
disease, mental anguish, losses to rulers and robbers, family quarrels, disputes with relatives, loss of money (Raman p. 261)
rare_outcomes: a kingdom or command of an army through the ruler's favour (BPHS 57.1-3 when well placed)
loss of children, mental derangement (Raman p. 261)
[maraka: BPHS 57.6 predicts premature death when Saturn is the 2nd or 7th lord]

by_area.personality: Laziness and wrongdoing (Phaladeepika 21.48); envy and pride leading to sorrow (Jataka Parijata 18.122); mental agony in the middle of the period when Saturn is badly placed (BPHS 57.4-5).
by_area.career: High position, command of an army through the ruler's favour when well placed (BPHS 57.1-3); fear of the government when in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.4); displeasure of officials (Jataka Parijata 18.123).
by_area.finance: Gains of land, villages and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.1-3); growth of farming and money through labourers (Phaladeepika 21.48); loss of wealth and grain to rulers and robbers (Jataka Parijata 18.122; Raman).
by_area.health: Wind illness (Phaladeepika 21.48); fever, wind and phlegm ailments, colic (Jataka Parijata 18.123); weapon injuries, bleeding, abdominal swelling (gulma) and dysentery at the start when badly placed (BPHS 57.4-5); blood and bile complaints (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children when well placed (BPHS 57.1-3); suffering of wife and children (Jataka Parijata 18.123).
by_area.family: Family quarrels and disputes with relatives (Raman p. 261); leaving home in the middle of the period when badly placed (BPHS 57.5).

strengtheners: Saturn in its own sign or exaltation, especially deep exaltation (BPHS 57.1-3)
Saturn in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or a yogakaraka (BPHS 57.1-3)
Saturn in its moolatrikona or Libra, in the 11th, or with a rajayoga (BPHS 57.1, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in the 8th or 12th from the lagna, or debilitated with malefics (BPHS 57.4-5)
Saturn as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 57.6)
dasha_ad/saturn/saturn.lagna_or_context_notes: Here Saturn is both dasa and sub-period lord, so BPHS judges it only from the lagna and by dignity. Saturn rules the 2nd or 7th for Cancer, Leo, Sagittarius and Capricorn lagnas, and the maraka warning of 57.6 applies to those. The web Sanskrit gloss labels verses 1-5 as about Rahu, but verse 6 names Saturn's sub-period and Santhanam heads the section Saturn-Saturn.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.1-7, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Saturn is in its own sign, exalted or deeply exalted, in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or a yogakaraka: high position, happiness from wife and children, conveyances, clothes, command of an army, cattle, villages and land. In the 8th or 12th from the lagna, or debilitated with malefics: at the start, fear of government, weapon injuries, bleeding, gulma, dysentery; in the middle, thieves, leaving home, mental agony; the end is good. As 2nd or 7th lord: danger of premature death; relief through Mrityunjaya japa, by Shiva's grace.

dasha_ad/saturn/saturn.disagreements: BPHS gives a fully favourable version under good dignity or house; the other classical texts and Raman describe this sub-period as largely troublesome with no conditions. Santhanam lists own sign, exaltation, kendra/trikona and yogakaraka. The Sanskrit gloss adds moolatrikona, the 11th and rajayoga. For the bad case Santhanam reads 'associated with malefics in debilitation'; the gloss lists weak, debilitated or with malefics as separate conditions.
dasha_ad/saturn/saturn.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as the demanding opening of a long, slow period that rewards patience. Advise care with health, money and dealings with officials. If the chart has the BPHS good conditions, lead with the favourable version. Do not predict death or loss of children.

dasha_ad/saturn/mercury.summary: Mercury's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 8 months 9 days) is one of the better parts of the period in every source: reputation, wealth, comforts, pilgrimage and religious activity, and gains through trade. BPHS makes it good when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona. When Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn, or with the Sun, Mars or Rahu, there are gains at the start and illness and failures later. As 2nd or 7th lord, Mercury brings bodily distress.
common_outcomes: prosperity, contentment, female company, favour from the ruler, victory and help from friends (Phaladeepika 21.49)
more happiness, wealth and fame; merit from piety; gains through agriculture and commerce (Jataka Parijata 18.124)
charitable works, wealth, birth of children, more knowledge, favour of superiors, general prosperity (Raman p. 261)
rare_outcomes: rajayoga or headship of a village (BPHS 57.9, 57.12)
bathing at Setu (Rameshwaram) on pilgrimage (BPHS 57.10, Sanskrit gloss)

by_area.career: Respect from the public, good reputation and rajayoga (BPHS 57.8-9); favour of superiors (Raman); failure in ventures later in the period if Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 57.13).
by_area.finance: Gain of wealth, conveyances (BPHS 57.8-9); wealth from trade, agriculture and commerce (Jataka Parijata 18.124; Sanskrit gloss of BPHS 57.11).
by_area.health: Bodily comfort when well placed (BPHS 57.10); disease in the middle and end when afflicted (BPHS 57.13); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.14); illness from the three humours (Phaladeepika 21.49).
by_area.relationships: Female company (Phaladeepika 21.49); birth of children (Raman).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family (BPHS 57.10); trouble to siblings and children (Phaladeepika 21.49); success to relatives (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Religious sacrifices, pilgrimage, listening to Puranas, charity and food donation (BPHS 57.9-11); acts of piety and customary observances (Jataka Parijata 18.124; Raman).

dasha_ad/saturn/ketu.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is described as a troubled time in every source: loss of position, fear, poverty, foreign travel, quarrels with wife and children, wind and fever illness, and danger from snakes or poison. In Santhanam's reading BPHS holds this even when Ketu is well placed. Relief comes if Ketu is linked to the lagna lord, or in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Saturn. In the 8th or 12th it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: wind and fire ailments, harassment by enemies, constant quarrels with sons and wife, misfortune, danger from snakes (Phaladeepika 21.50)
wind and bile disease, quarrels with wicked people, bad dreams (Jataka Parijata 18.125)
rheumatism or sickness, danger of poison, trouble from sons, loss of money, quarrels with low people, bad dreams, family quarrels (Raman pp. 261-262)
loss of position, danger, poverty, distress, foreign journeys (BPHS 57.16-18)
rare_outcomes: imprisonment, loss of children or spouse (BPHS 57.17, Sanskrit gloss)
bathing in holy rivers and visiting shrines (BPHS 57.18-19)
[maraka: BPHS 57.20-21 predicts fear of premature death when Ketu is in the 8th or 12th]

by_area.personality: Religious thoughts, strength and courage when Ketu is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.19); fear and distress otherwise (BPHS 57.16).
by_area.career: Loss of position and suffering on behalf of one's master (BPHS 57.16-18); audience with rulers when Ketu is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.19).
by_area.finance: Poverty and loss of money (BPHS 57.17; Raman); wealth at the start if Ketu is linked to the lagna lord (BPHS 57.18).
by_area.health: Wind and fire or bile ailments (Phaladeepika 21.50; Jataka Parijata 18.125); cold fever, dysentery, wounds, poor food in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.20-21); physical distress in the 2nd/7th (BPHS 57.22).
by_area.relationships: Constant quarrels with wife and sons (Phaladeepika 21.50); separation from wife and children in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.21).
by_area.family: Family quarrels and trouble from sons (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Bathing in holy rivers and visiting shrines when Ketu is linked to the lagna lord or well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.18-19).

strengtheners: Ketu related to the lagna lord (BPHS 57.18)
Ketu in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Saturn (BPHS 57.19)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn (BPHS 57.20-21)

dasha_ad/saturn/ketu.lagna_or_context_notes: In Santhanam's reading of BPHS 57.16-18, Ketu gives evil even when it is exalted, in its own or a benefic sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with benefics, unless it is related to the lagna lord. The Sanskrit gloss reads verse 16 as listing favourable conditions and verse 17 as warning that a kendra or trikona Ketu can still bring loss. Only Ketu's relation to Saturn (kendra, trikona, 3rd, 11th) is given as clearly good.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.16-23, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Loss of position, dangers, poverty, distress, foreign journeys even if Ketu is exalted, in its own or a benefic sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with benefics. If related to the lagna lord: wealth, enjoyment, holy baths and pilgrimage at the start. In a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Saturn: strength, courage, religious thoughts, audience with rulers, enjoyments. In the 8th or 12th from the lagna or Saturn: fear of premature death, coarse food, cold fever, dysentery, wounds, thieves, separation from wife and children. In the 2nd or 7th from the lagna: physical distress. Remedy: give a goat in charity.

dasha_ad/saturn/venus.summary: Venus's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 3 years 2 months) is generally the best part of the period: marriage, children, wealth, good health, honours and goodwill of relatives. BPHS makes it good when Venus is in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with benefics, or in the 9th, 11th or a kendra from Saturn. It is bad when Venus is debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn. Uttara Kalamrita adds a reversal: when both Venus and Saturn are very strong, their mutual periods can ruin even a king.
common_outcomes: contentment with friends, wife and children; wealth from farming and sea or river travel; wide renown (Phaladeepika 21.51)
goodwill of relatives, public approval, gain of wives, property and wealth, joys of agriculture (Jataka Parijata 18.126)
general happiness, favours and gifts, business profits, more family members, victory over enemies, wife's property (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: a kingdom or high office by the ruler's grace (BPHS 57.25-26)
composition of poetry and study of Vedanta (BPHS 57.31)
the native ruined even if born a king, when both Venus and Saturn are strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 28.5-29.5)

by_area.personality: Interest in shastras, poetry and Vedanta (BPHS 57.31); mental agony when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 57.29).
by_area.career: High office and honours by the ruler's favour (BPHS 57.25-26); loss of position and friction with officials when Venus is badly placed (BPHS 57.29, 57.34).
by_area.finance: Wealth, clothes, ornaments, conveyances (BPHS 57.25-27); business profits (Raman); wealth from agriculture and water travel (Phaladeepika 21.51).
by_area.health: Sound health when well placed (BPHS 57.25); eye trouble, fevers, dental problems, heart disease, pain in the arms, danger from drowning or falls when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.32-34); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.35).
by_area.relationships: Marriage, birth of a son, happiness with wife and children (BPHS 57.24-25, 57.31; Phaladeepika 21.51; Jataka Parijata 18.126); distress to the wife when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 57.28-29).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family (BPHS 57.25); quarrels with close relations and brothers when afflicted (BPHS 57.29, 57.34); goodwill of relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.126).
by_area.spirituality: Charity, religious rites, Puranas and Vedanta when Venus is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.30-31).

dasha_ad/saturn/venus.lagna_or_context_notes: Venus and Saturn are natural friends and are each other's yogakaraka-type lords for Taurus and Libra lagnas. Uttara Kalamrita reverses the usual rule for this pair. The commentator of the P.S. Sastri edition (ch. VI) finds the rule valid in essence but modified by lordship, placement and aspects, and cites charts where well-placed mutual periods still harmed health.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.24-36, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Venus is in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with or aspected by benefics: marriage, birth of a son, wealth, health, family well-being, high position, honours, clothes, ornaments, conveyances. Favourable Jupiter transit brings fortune and property; favourable Saturn transit brings rajayoga or yoga rites. Debilitated, combust or 6th/8th/12th from the lagna: distress to the wife, loss of position, mental agony, quarrels with relations. In the 9th, 11th or a kendra from Saturn: ambitions fulfilled through the ruler, charity, religious rites, shastras, poetry, Vedanta, happiness from wife and children. 6th/8th/12th from Saturn: eye trouble, fevers, loss of good conduct, dental and heart trouble, pain in the arms, danger of drowning or a fall from a tree, friction with relatives, officials and brothers. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical distress. Remedies: Durga Saptashati and the gift of a cow or female buffalo.

If both are weak and 6th/8th/12th from each other, or own such houses or are joined with their lords, the periods are auspicious and give wealth and happiness. If one rules a good house and the other a bad one, results are still good, and if both are malefics they are very favourable.

dasha_ad/saturn/venus.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman treat a strong Venus as good. Uttara Kalamrita says that when both Venus and Saturn are strong (exalted, own sign or vargottama) their mutual periods are disastrous, and that weakness and mutual 6/8/12 placement give good results. This is the reverse of BPHS 57.32-34. Santhanam requires benefic association with the kendra/trikona/11th placement; the Sanskrit gloss lists each as a separate good condition.
dasha_ad/saturn/venus.phrasing_guidance: Present this as usually the most pleasant phase of Saturn's period, good for marriage, family and comforts. If the chart has both Venus and Saturn very strong, mention the classical warning gently as a reason for caution with fortune and health, not as ruin. Avoid predicting harm to the spouse.

dasha_ad/saturn/sun.summary: The Sun's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 11 months 12 days) is one of the hardest in the general texts: danger from enemies and rulers, illness of elders, eye and stomach disease, loss of wealth, and trouble to wife and children. Saturn and the Sun are enemies. BPHS makes it good (good relations with superiors, family well-being, conveyances) when the Sun is exalted, in its own sign, with the 9th lord, or in a kendra or trikona with benefics. It is bad when the Sun is in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn.
common_outcomes: danger from enemies at all times, illness of elders, stomach and eye disease, loss of money and grain (Phaladeepika 21.52)
loss of wife and children, trouble from the king or robbers, sinking of heart (Jataka Parijata 18.127)
trouble from rulers or robbers, heart weakness, blood and intestinal disorders, eye trouble, illness of wife and children (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: [maraka: Phaladeepika 21.52 and Raman p. 262 speak of danger of death]
fear of death to the father-in-law (Raman p. 262)
royal favour, wealth and happiness when both Saturn and the Sun are strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 30.5-31.5)

by_area.personality: Mental agony, fears and anxiety when the Sun is badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41); sinking of heart (Jataka Parijata 18.127).
by_area.career: Good relations with the employer when well placed (BPHS 57.37); defamation, loss of position and obstacles in industry when badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41); trouble from rulers (Jataka Parijata; Raman).
by_area.finance: Conveyances and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.37-38); loss of money and grain (Phaladeepika 21.52); loss of cherished things (BPHS 57.41).
by_area.health: Heart disease and fevers (BPHS 57.39-41); stomach and eye disease (Phaladeepika 21.52); blood and intestinal disorders (Raman); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.42).
by_area.relationships: Loss of or trouble to wife and children (Jataka Parijata 18.127; Raman); happiness from children when well placed (BPHS 57.37).
by_area.family: Illness of elders (Phaladeepika 21.52); separation from close relatives and loss of kinsmen when badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41).

Santhanam's verse 37 has 'in kendra or trikona from the Ascendant associated with or aspected by benefics'; the Sanskrit gloss also lists the 11th. The gloss of verse 39 adds the lagna itself to the 8th and 12th as bad places.

dasha_ad/saturn/moon.summary: The Moon's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 7 months) is mixed: the general texts give illness, grief, death of an elder woman, family disputes and loss alongside some money and cattle. BPHS makes it good when the Moon is full, exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Saturn, or aspected by benefics. It is bad when the Moon is waning, afflicted by malefics or debilitated. When the Moon is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn, it brings lethargy, loss of position and enemies.
common_outcomes: loss of the wife or danger to life, trouble with friends, disease, fear from water and wind (Phaladeepika 21.53)
death of a revered elder woman, sorrow, dislike of relatives, income, wind disease (Jataka Parijata 18.128)
more cattle, enmity of friends and relatives, colds, family disputes, loss of money and property, mortgage and later recovery of property (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: conveyances, garments and ornaments through a great ruler (BPHS 57.43-44)
happiness in both maternal and paternal homes (BPHS 57.45)
[maraka: Phaladeepika 21.53 speaks of danger to life]

by_area.personality: Great distress and anger when the Moon is weak or afflicted (BPHS 57.46-47); sleepiness and lethargy when weak and 6/8/12 from Saturn (BPHS 57.51-52); sorrow (Jataka Parijata 18.128).
by_area.career: Favour of rulers when well placed (BPHS 57.44); losses in business and loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 57.47-48, 57.51-52).
by_area.finance: Conveyances, garments, ornaments and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.43-45); losses in business (BPHS 57.48); mortgage of property and later recovery (Raman).
by_area.health: Irregular meals and medicines when afflicted (BPHS 57.48); disease and fear from water and wind (Phaladeepika 21.53); wind disease (Jataka Parijata 18.128); lethargy and physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.53).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife when well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.49-50); loss or danger to the wife (Phaladeepika 21.53).
by_area.family: Happiness from parents, care of siblings when well placed (BPHS 57.43-45, 57.49-50); separation from parents and illness of children when afflicted (BPHS 57.47); death of an elder woman (Jataka Parijata 18.128).

strengtheners: the Moon full, exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.43)
the Moon in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Saturn (BPHS 57.43, 57.49)
the Moon aspected by benefics, especially Jupiter (BPHS 57.43, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the Moon waning, with or aspected by malefics, debilitated, or in a malefic sign or navamsa (BPHS 57.46-48)
the Moon weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.51-52)
the Moon as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.53)
the Moon 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
dasha_ad/saturn/moon.lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon owns only Cancer, so the 2nd/7th-lord rule applies for Gemini and Capricorn lagnas. BPHS judges the good placements here from Saturn, not from the lagna. Santhanam doubts the text's statement that even an afflicted Moon gives some good at the start.

If waning, with or aspected by malefics, debilitated, or in a malefic sign or navamsa: great distress, anger, separation from parents, illness of children, business losses, irregular meals, medicines; but some good and gains at the start. In a kendra, trikona or 11th from Saturn: conveyances, happiness from kin, parents, wife and employer. Weak and 6th/8th/12th from Saturn: sleepiness, lethargy, loss of position, more enemies, friction with kin. As 2nd or 7th lord: lethargy and physical distress. Remedies: homa and gifts of jaggery, ghee, curd-rice, a cow or female buffalo.

dasha_ad/saturn/mars.summary: Mars's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is described in the general texts as a time of strife: loss of position, family disputes, serious illness, fever, danger from fire or weapons, more enemies and distress to brothers. BPHS makes it good from the start (wealth, government favour, command, farming, a new house) when Mars is exalted, in its own sign, or with the lagna lord or Saturn. It is bad when Mars is debilitated or combust, or in the 8th or 12th with malefics. When Mars is in the 2nd or rules the 7th or 8th, it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: loss of position, family disputes, serious illness, fever, danger from fire, weapons or poison, more enemies, hernia, eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.54)
loss of place, serious illness, many fears, distress of brothers and friends (Jataka Parijata 18.129)
disgrace, serious enmity, strife, wandering, unsettled life, loss by fraud or theft, change of residence, serious illness, distress to brothers, hot diseases (Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: command of an army and construction of a new house (BPHS 57.57)
[maraka: BPHS 57.61 predicts fear of premature death when Mars is in the 2nd or lord of the 7th or 8th]

by_area.personality: Great distress and dependence on others when Mars is in the 2nd or rules the 7th/8th (BPHS 57.61).
by_area.career: Government favour and command when Mars is strong (BPHS 57.55-57); loss of position (Phaladeepika 21.54; Jataka Parijata 18.129); disgrace (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth, conveyances, ornaments, farming and cattle, a new house when strong (BPHS 57.55-57); loss of wealth, thieves and needless spending when afflicted (BPHS 57.58-60); loss by fraud or theft (Raman).
by_area.health: Wounds, weapons, snakes, gout (BPHS 57.58-59); fever, fire, hernia, eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.54); hot diseases (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels with co-partners when Mars is afflicted (BPHS 57.59).
by_area.family: Happiness to kin when Mars is strong (BPHS 57.57); distress to father and brothers and loss of kinsmen when afflicted (BPHS 57.59); family disputes (Phaladeepika 21.54).

strengtheners: Mars exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.55)
Mars with the lagna lord or with Saturn (BPHS 57.55-56)
Mars in a kendra, trikona or the 11th (BPHS 57.55, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars debilitated or combust (BPHS 57.58)
Mars in the 8th or 12th from the lagna with or aspected by malefics (BPHS 57.58)

Santhanam's verse 61 reads Mars 'in the 2nd or lord of the 7th or 8th'; the Sanskrit gloss reads it as the 8th or 7th lord in the 2nd. Mars rules the 7th for Libra and Taurus lagnas and the 8th for Aries and Virgo lagnas.

dasha_ad/saturn/rahu.summary: Rahu's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 10 months 6 days) is described in all the general texts as difficult: quarrels, mental and physical pain, disease in the limbs, fevers, losses to rulers, robbers and enemies, foreign travel and loss of house or land. BPHS gives a better start (wealth, crops, pilgrimage) if Rahu is with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, exalted, or in a kendra or the 11th from the lagna or Saturn, and wealth and honour in certain signs. Association with the 2nd or 7th lord brings bodily distress.
common_outcomes: quarrels, mental agony, physical distress, friction with sons, fear of disease, needless spending, discord with relations, danger from government, foreign journeys, loss of house and fields (BPHS 57.63-64)
deceitful conduct, danger of diabetes or venereal disease, enlarged spleen, persistent fever, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.55)

dasha_ad/saturn/jupiter.summary: Jupiter's sub-period, the last in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 6 months 12 days), is good in every general source: devotion to gods and teachers, royal favour, rank, family happiness and more wealth and grain. BPHS makes it good when Jupiter is in a kendra or trikona, exalted or in its own sign, or with the lagna lord, or 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or a kendra from Saturn. It is bad when Jupiter is debilitated, with malefics or in a dusthana. As 2nd or 7th lord, BPHS warns of death in the family.
themes: relief at the end of the period
common_outcomes: devotion to gods and Brahmins, happiness with wife and children, great increase in wealth and grain (Phaladeepika 21.56)
devotion to gods and Brahmins, royal favour, great happiness, attainment of rank (Jataka Parijata 18.131)
worship of gods and holy people, family happiness, bodily comforts, goals met with help from superiors, a larger family circle, rank (Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: fame in the country, Vedic and Vedanta study, performance of sacrifices (BPHS 57.76-78)

[maraka: BPHS 57.81 predicts death of the native or a family member when Jupiter is the 2nd or 7th lord]

by_area.career: Success all round, reverence and gains through government (BPHS 57.71-73, 57.76-77); rank (Jataka Parijata 18.131); help from superiors (Raman); friction with officials, failed projects, loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 57.74-75, 57.79).
by_area.finance: Conveyances, ornaments, clothes, opulence (BPHS 57.72, 57.76); more wealth and grain (Phaladeepika 21.56); loss of wealth and fines when afflicted (BPHS 57.75, 57.80).
by_area.health: Bodily comforts (Raman); disease such as leprosy (skin disease) when afflicted from the lagna (BPHS 57.75); bodily and mental illness as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.81).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 57.73, 57.76; Phaladeepika 21.56); distress to wife and son when Jupiter is weak and badly placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.80).
by_area.family: Family well-being and a larger family circle (BPHS 57.71; Raman); death of near relations when afflicted (BPHS 57.75).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and the guru, company of the learned (BPHS 57.73); Vedas, Vedanta, sacrifices and charity of grain (BPHS 57.77-78); worship of gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.56; Jataka Parijata 18.131).

dasha_ad/saturn/jupiter.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses two reference points: Jupiter from the lagna (vv. 71-75) and from Saturn (vv. 76-80). Jupiter rules the 2nd or 7th for Aquarius, Scorpio, Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where BPHS 57.81 applies. Rath gives an example in which a long court dispute through Saturn's dasa ended favourably once Jupiter's sub-period began near its end.

source_views.source: BPHS 57.71-82, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Good if Jupiter is in a kendra or trikona, with the lagna lord, or in its own or exaltation sign: success, family well-being, conveyances, ornaments and clothes from the government, reverence, devotion to deities and the guru, company of the learned, happiness from wife and children. Debilitated, with malefics or in the 6th/8th/12th from the lagna: death of near relations, loss of wealth, friction with officials, failed projects, foreign journeys, disease such as leprosy. In the 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or a kendra from Saturn: opulence, happiness to the wife, gains through government, good food and clothes, religious-mindedness, fame, Vedas and Vedanta, sacrifices, charity of grain. Weak and 6th/8th/12th from Saturn: friction with kin, mental agony, quarrels, loss of position and ventures, fines, imprisonment, distress to wife and son. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical distress, agony, death of the native or a family member. Remedies: Shiva Sahasranama and a gift of gold.

dasha_ad/sun/sun.summary: The Sun's own sub-period opens its mahadasha (about 3 months 18 days). BPHS makes it a time of wealth and grain when the Sun is exalted, in its own sign, a kendra, a trikona or the 11th, and a hard time when it is debilitated or badly placed. Other texts stress fame and money through authority, alongside fever, heat, travel and worry about the father.

rare_outcomes: loss of the father (Phaladeepika 21.3); danger to the father if the Sun is afflicted (Raman p. 235)

by_area.finance: Wealth and grain when well placed (BPHS 52.1-3; Phaladeepika 21.3); loss of money (Raman p. 235).
by_area.health: Fever and illness from heat (Phaladeepika 21.3); headache, ear pain, urinary or kidney tendency, stomach-ache (Raman p. 235). Good health when the Sun is strong (Rele p. 72).
by_area.relationships: Birth of a son when the Sun is strong (Rele p. 72).
by_area.family: Trouble among relatives (Rele p. 72; Raman p. 235); risk to the father (Phaladeepika 21.3).
by_area.spirituality: Gains through religious people (Raman p. 235).

BPHS gives medium results when the Sun is in houses other than those listed. The Sun owns only Leo, so it is the 2nd or 7th lord only for Cancer or Aquarius lagna.

dasha_ad/sun/moon.summary: The Moon's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha (6 months) is mostly favourable: marriage or family events, property, vehicles, favour from authorities and the end of troubles when the Moon is in a kendra or trikona, exalted or in its own sign. A waning or afflicted Moon, or one in the 6th, 8th or 12th, brings worry, disputes, losses and water-related or urinary trouble.
common_outcomes: marriage, gain of wealth and property, house, land, cattle and vehicles (BPHS 52.4-6)
enemies subdued, troubles end, wealth grows; farming, house-building, friendships (Phaladeepika 21.4)
wealth through relatives and friends, idle pastimes with good company, jaundice and similar ailments (Jataka Parijata 18.63)
the valour of enemies subdued; health, wealth and happiness (Saravali 42.12)
favours from superiors, more business, new enterprises, new clothes, respect among relatives; trouble through women, eye trouble (Raman p. 235)
rare_outcomes: imprisonment, journeys to difficult places (BPHS 52.7-10)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] when the Moon rules a maraka house (BPHS 52.13-14)

by_area.career: Favours from the ruler and fulfilment of ambitions (BPHS 52.6); new office or employment (Rele p. 73); loss of position and antagonism with authorities when afflicted (BPHS 52.7-10).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, property and vehicles (BPHS 52.4-6; Phaladeepika 21.4); loss of wealth and grain when the Moon is waning or with malefics (BPHS 52.7-10).
by_area.health: Jaundice (Jataka Parijata 18.63; Raman); consumption, fire accidents and water-borne disease if the Moon is malefic (Phaladeepika 21.4); urinary trouble and bodily pain when in 6/8/12 (BPHS 52.7-10); eye trouble (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Marriage, birth of children, happiness from wife and children (BPHS 52.4-6, 52.11-12); distress to wife and children when the Moon is waning or afflicted (BPHS 52.7-10).
by_area.family: Disputes with co-sharers of property when the Moon is in 6/8/12 (BPHS 52.7-10); wealth through relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.63).
by_area.spirituality: Religious functions at home (BPHS 52.11-12).

source_views.source: BPHS 52.4-14, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Moon in a kendra or trikona: marriage, wealth, house, land, cattle, vehicles. Exalted or own sign: marriage, children, favour of rulers, ambitions fulfilled. Waning or with malefics: distress to wife and children, failures, disputes, loss of servants, antagonism with government, loss of wealth. In the 6th, 8th or 12th: danger from water, mental agony, imprisonment, disease, loss of position, hard journeys, disputes with co-sharers, bad food, thieves, displeasure of the ruler, urinary trouble, bodily pain. Benefics in the 1st, 9th or a kendra from the dasha lord: luxuries, fortune, kingdom, marriage, land, vehicles, children and grandchildren. Moon in 6/8/12 from the dasha lord or weak: coarse food, living away from home. Lord of a maraka house: premature death. Remedy: give a white cow and a female buffalo.

Classical texts without conditions (Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata, Saravali) are mostly favourable.
dasha_ad/sun/moon.phrasing_guidance: Present as a generally supportive, home-focused stretch: property, family events and goodwill from superiors. If the Moon is weak or afflicted, advise care of emotional balance, fluids and diet. Avoid predictions of drowning, suicide or death.

dasha_ad/sun/mars.summary: Mars's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha (about 4 months 6 days) gives land, houses, wealth, command and victory over enemies when Mars is exalted, in its own sign, a kendra or a trikona, especially with the lagna lord. Mars in the 8th or 12th from the Sun, weak or with malefics brings harshness, quarrels with brothers, loss of kin and money, and illness.
common_outcomes: land, wealth, grain and a house (BPHS 52.15-16)
wealth in gems and gold, royal favour, bilious disease (Jataka Parijata 18.64)
corals, gold, success in battle, splendour and happiness (Saravali 42.13)
disease and wounds, loss of status, enemies, quarrels with relatives, danger from authorities, loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.5)
rheumatism, quarrels, enteric fever, dysentery, theft or waste of money, alongside gold, gems and royal favour (Raman pp. 235-236)
rare_outcomes: command of an army (BPHS 52.17-18)
imprisonment (BPHS 52.19-20)
apoplexy, accidents by fire or animals when Mars is in the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 74)

by_area.personality: Firm mind and courage when strong (BPHS 52.18; Rele p. 73); brutality or a cruel mind and mental ailment when afflicted (BPHS 52.19-20).
by_area.career: Commander's post, defeat of enemies (BPHS 52.17-18); military rank with the 9th or 10th lord (Rele p. 73); loss of status and danger from authorities (Phaladeepika 21.5).
by_area.finance: Land, houses, wealth and grain (BPHS 52.15-16); gems and gold (Jataka Parijata 18.64; Saravali 42.13); loss of wealth through government when Mars is debilitated or weak (BPHS 52.21).
by_area.health: Bilious disease (Jataka Parijata 18.64); wounds and disease (Phaladeepika 21.5); rheumatism, fever, dysentery (Raman); mental and bodily disease when Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 52.21).
by_area.family: More siblings and family comfort when strong (BPHS 52.18); disputes with brothers and loss of kinsmen when afflicted (BPHS 52.19-20).

strengtheners: Mars exalted or in its own sign, in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 52.15)
Mars joined with the lagna lord (BPHS 52.17)
Mars joined with the 9th or 10th lord (Rele p. 73); with the 9th and 11th lords (BPHS 52.17 gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 8th or 12th from the Sun (BPHS 52.19)
Mars with malefics or without dignity and strength (BPHS 52.19-20)
Mars debilitated or weak (BPHS 52.21)
Mars lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 52.21)
dasha_ad/sun/mars.lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS counts the good positions from the lagna (verse 15) and the bad 8th/12th from the dasha lord (verse 19). Mars is a natural friend of the Sun (Rele p. 120).

source_views.source: BPHS 52.15-22, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Mars exalted, own sign, kendra or trikona: land, wealth, grain, house. With the lagna lord: all-round gains, army command, enemies destroyed, peace of mind, family comfort, more siblings. In the 8th or 12th from the dasha lord, with malefics or without dignity: brutality, mental ailment, imprisonment, loss of kin, disputes with brothers, failures. Debilitated or weak: loss of wealth through government. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: disease of mind and body. Remedy: Vedic recitation, japa, vrishotsarga (release of a bull).

source_views.source: BPHS 52.15-22, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Adds the 11th to the good houses, red garments among the gains, and gains with the 9th and 11th lords; reads verse 19 as a 10th lord in the 12th or 8th, afflicted and weak; remedy as Santhanam.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.5 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, wisdomlib)
source_views.view: Disease and wounds, loss of status, trouble from enemies, quarrels with relatives, danger from authorities, loss of wealth.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.64 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri vol. 2)
source_views.view: Wealth as gems and gold, royal favour leading to prosperity, bilious and allied disease.

source_views.source: Saravali 42.13 (English text, lakshminarayanlenasia.com PDF)
source_views.view: Corals, gold, success in battle, splendour and happiness.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, pp. 235-236
source_views.view: 4 months 6 days. Rheumatic trouble, quarrels, enteric fever, dysentery, trouble to relatives, loss by theft or waste, failures; also gold and gems, royal favour, bilious disease, worry, danger from fire, loss of reputation.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, pp. 73-74
source_views.view: Exalted, own sign, 11th, angles or trines: property, wealth, courage, military success; with the lagna lord all-round happiness; with the 9th or 10th lord leadership or military rank; enemies destroyed, happiness from brothers, much travel. Debilitated or in evil houses from the significator with malefics: quarrels with superiors and inferiors, fickle mind, imprisonment, loss of a brother. In the 2nd or 7th: acute disease, fever, fire or animal accidents, apoplexy.

dasha_ad/sun/mars.disagreements: Phaladeepika gives only adverse results, Saravali and Jataka Parijata mostly favourable ones; BPHS makes it depend on placement. The gloss reads BPHS 52.19 as a 10th lord in the 8th or 12th; Santhanam as Mars in the 8th or 12th from the dasha lord.
dasha_ad/sun/mars.phrasing_guidance: Describe an energetic, competitive phase good for property and decisive action when Mars is strong. If afflicted, advise avoiding quarrels (especially with siblings), impulsive spending and risky physical activity. No predictions of imprisonment as fact.

dasha_ad/sun/rahu.summary: Rahu's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha (about 10 months 24 days) is widely treated as difficult: new enemies, loss or theft of money, family disputes, poison or snake fears, headaches and eye trouble. BPHS says the first two months are worst when Rahu is in a kendra or trikona, after which things improve if Rahu is with benefics; Rahu in an upachaya house brings recognition and fame.
common_outcomes: new enemies, wealth lost or stolen, poison danger, strong sensual cravings, headaches and eye complaints (Phaladeepika 21.6)
trouble from relatives and enemies, loss of place, mental misery (Jataka Parijata 18.65)
loss of wealth, danger from thieves and snakes, wounds, distress to wife and children in the first two months (BPHS 52.23-24)
family disputes, journeys, loss of money, failure, fear of thieves and reptiles, scandal (Raman p. 236)
rare_outcomes: [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] (Jataka Parijata 18.65 'pang of death prematurely setting in'; BPHS 52.30 with Rahu in the 2nd or 7th)
imprisonment, loss of position (BPHS 52.27-29)
deportation, tumour, wasting disease, dysentery (Rele p. 74)
gains by speculation, influential friends, great power (Rele p. 74)

by_area.personality: Mental misery (Jataka Parijata 18.65); excessive craving for sensual pleasure (Phaladeepika 21.6).
by_area.career: Favours from government, recognition and fame when Rahu is in an upachaya or well placed from the Sun (BPHS 52.25-26); loss of position when badly placed (BPHS 52.27-28; Jataka Parijata 18.65).
by_area.finance: Loss or theft of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.6; BPHS 52.23); loss of cattle, house and fields when Rahu is 8th or 12th from the Sun (BPHS 52.29).
by_area.health: Poison, headaches, eye complaints (Phaladeepika 21.6); wounds (BPHS 52.24); consumption, skin enlargement, dysentery when badly placed (BPHS 52.29).
by_area.relationships: Distress to wife and children in the early part (BPHS 52.24); birth of a son when Rahu is in an upachaya (BPHS 52.26).
by_area.family: Family disputes and trouble from relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.65; Raman); family happiness when well placed (BPHS 52.26).

strengtheners: Rahu with benefics or in a benefic navamsa (BPHS 52.24-25)
Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th from the lagna (BPHS 52.26)
Rahu with a yogakaraka (BPHS 52.25-26)
Rahu auspiciously placed from the Sun (BPHS 52.26)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th from the Sun, or weak (BPHS 52.27-29)
Rahu in the 2nd or 7th, or with their lords (BPHS 52.30)
dasha_ad/sun/rahu.lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu is a natural enemy of the Sun; Phaladeepika 20.39 and 20.52-53 say the nodes act through the planets they join. BPHS uses the lagna for the kendra/trikona and upachaya rules and the dasha lord (the Sun) for the 8th/12th rule.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.23-31, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Rahu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna: first two months loss of wealth, thieves, snakes, wounds, distress to wife and children; after that, comforts, health, satisfaction and royal favour if Rahu is with benefics or in a benefic navamsa. In an upachaya from the lagna, with a yogakaraka or well placed from the dasha lord: recognition, fortune, fame, a son, family happiness, with some distress to wife and children. Weak, or 8th/12th from the dasha lord: imprisonment, loss of position, thieves and snakes, wounds, loss of cattle, house and fields, consumption, dysentery. In the 2nd or 7th or with their lords: premature death, snakes. Remedy: worship and japa of Durga, gift of a black cow or female buffalo.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.23-31, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Same structure; verse 30 reads Rahu in the 2nd with the 2nd lord; remedy adds the gift of a goat.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.6 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, wisdomlib)
source_views.view: New enemies, wealth lost or stolen, general trouble, poison danger, excessive sensual craving, severe headaches, eye complaints.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.65 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri vol. 2)
source_views.view: Pang of death prematurely setting in, trouble from relatives and enemies, loss of place, mental misery.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 236
source_views.view: 10 months 24 days. Many troubles, changes by Rahu's position, family disputes, journeys, pang of death, trouble from relatives and enemies, mental misery, loss of money, failures, fear of thieves and reptiles, scandal.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, p. 74
source_views.view: In angles or trines: early loss of wealth and snake bite, later happiness, influential friends, power, travel, gains by speculation. In the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, with trine lords or friendly from the significator: fame, a son. In evil houses from the significator: deportation, imprisonment, losses, tumour, phthisis, dysentery. In the 2nd or 7th or with their lords: death, accident or calamities.

dasha_ad/sun/rahu.disagreements: Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only adverse results; BPHS and Rele allow a favourable second phase or good results from an upachaya. Santhanam's verse 27-29 list includes 'happiness to wife and children' among bad results, which looks like a misprint for distress. Saravali 42 gives no Sun-Rahu result.
dasha_ad/sun/rahu.phrasing_guidance: Present as a testing sub-period calling for caution with money, security and family harmony, often easing after the first couple of months. Mention upachaya gains when the chart shows them. Do not predict death, snake bite or imprisonment as fact.

dasha_ad/sun/jupiter.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha (about 9 months 18 days) is among the best in this mahadasha: marriage, favour from authorities, wealth, a son, honour and religious merit, with high position when Jupiter rules the 9th or 10th. Jupiter in the 6th or 8th from the Sun or with malefics brings trouble to family, displeasure of superiors and losses.
common_outcomes: marriage, royal favour, wealth and grain, a son, ambitions fulfilled, clothes (BPHS 52.32-33)
enemies destroyed, wealth from many sources, daily worship, honouring elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.7)
wealth through a worthy son, honour to gods and Brahmins, virtuous acts, good company and conversation (Jataka Parijata 18.66)
destruction of diseases, enemies, sins and poverty; virtue and happiness (Saravali 42.15)
benefits from friends, education, employment in high circles, birth of a child, reputation and court honours (Raman p. 236)
rare_outcomes: kingdom or a high government post, palanquin or car (BPHS 52.34-35)
ear disease and lung consumption (Phaladeepika 21.7)
Rele: may administer justice; when afflicted, may cheat under the garb of religion (p. 75)

by_area.personality: Charitable, religious, devoted to deity and teacher (BPHS 52.36); philanthropic and just (Rele p. 75); mental worry when afflicted (BPHS 52.38).
by_area.career: Royal favour (BPHS 52.32-33); high position when Jupiter rules the 9th or 10th (BPHS 52.34-35); employment in high circles (Raman); displeasure of superiors when afflicted (BPHS 52.37-38).
by_area.finance: Wealth and grain (BPHS 52.33); wealth from many sources (Phaladeepika 21.7); loss of wealth through wrong deeds when afflicted (BPHS 52.38).
by_area.health: Ear disease, consumption (Phaladeepika 21.7); bodily pain when afflicted (BPHS 52.37-38); diseases destroyed (Saravali 42.15).
by_area.relationships: Marriage and a son (BPHS 52.32-33); distress to wife and children when afflicted (BPHS 52.37).
by_area.family: Honouring elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.7); wealth through a son (Jataka Parijata 18.66).
by_area.spirituality: Worship of deities, devotion to the teacher, charity and merit (BPHS 52.35-36; Jataka Parijata 18.66; Phaladeepika 21.7).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra or trikona, exalted, in its own sign or own varga (BPHS 52.32)
Jupiter lord of the 9th or 10th (BPHS 52.34)
Jupiter well placed from the Sun (BPHS 52.35-36)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 6th or 8th from the Sun (BPHS 52.37)
Jupiter with malefics (BPHS 52.37)
Jupiter debilitated (Rele p. 75)
dasha_ad/sun/jupiter.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter is a natural friend of the Sun (Rele p. 120). BPHS counts the good kendra/trikona from the lagna and the bad 6th/8th from the dasha lord.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.32-39, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Jupiter in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, exalted, own sign or own varga: marriage, government favour, wealth and grain, a son, ambitions fulfilled, clothes. Lord of the 9th or 10th: high position, conveyances. Well placed from the dasha lord: fortune, charity, religious leanings, worship, devotion to the teacher. In the 6th or 8th from the dasha lord or with malefics: distress to wife and children, bodily pain, displeasure of the ruler, goals unmet, loss of wealth through sinful acts, worry. Remedy: gift of gold and a tawny cow, worship of the chosen deity.

dasha_ad/sun/jupiter.phrasing_guidance: Present as a supportive, expansive phase for family, learning, mentors and recognition. If Jupiter is afflicted, advise honesty in money matters and care for family members' wellbeing. Do not predict the death of family members.

dasha_ad/sun/saturn.summary: Saturn's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha (about 11 months 12 days) pairs natural enemies and is treated by most texts as hard: losses, hostility, illness in the family, separation from children or elders, low energy and trouble from authorities. BPHS and Uttara Kalamrita allow good results (enemies defeated, marriage at home, wealth) when Saturn is in a kendra or trikona or strong in dignity.
common_outcomes: hostility from everyone, low energy, an ignoble calling, worry, risk from rulers or thieves (Jataka Parijata 18.67)
loss of wealth, separation from children, loss of elders, unusual expenses, loss of goods or servants, phlegm disorders (Phaladeepika 21.8)
royal anger, poverty, defeat by enemies (Saravali 42.17)
family sickness, new enemies, loss of property, expulsion from home, accidents, quarrels, loans (Raman pp. 236-237)
rare_outcomes: renown in the country, wealth from many sources (BPHS 52.41-42)
imprisonment (BPHS 52.43-44)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] when Saturn rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 52.46); Rele: death of parents (p. 75)

by_area.personality: Low energy and worry (Jataka Parijata 18.67; Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition and renown when Saturn is strong (BPHS 52.41-42); loss in ventures (BPHS 52.43-44); an ignoble calling (Jataka Parijata 18.67); authority over workers when strong (Rele p. 75).
by_area.finance: Some gain of grain, more property and wealth from many sources when well placed (BPHS 52.40-42); loss of wealth and unusual expenses (Phaladeepika 21.8; BPHS 52.44).
by_area.health: Rheumatism, pain, fever, dysentery (BPHS 52.43); phlegm disorders, uncleanliness (Phaladeepika 21.8); bile, phlegm and abdominal trouble (Rele p. 75).
by_area.relationships: Marriage and auspicious events at home when Saturn is in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 52.40; Rele p. 75); separation from children (Phaladeepika 21.8).
by_area.family: Quarrels with co-sharers (BPHS 52.44); separation from parents if Saturn is debilitated (BPHS 52.46); loss of elders (Phaladeepika 21.8).

strengtheners: Saturn in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 52.40)
Saturn exalted, own or friendly sign with a friendly planet (BPHS 52.41-42)
Sun and Saturn both in own or exaltation signs or navamsas, in or ruling kendras/trikonas (Uttara Kalamrita 6.30)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in the 8th or 12th from the Sun, or with malefics (BPHS 52.43-44)

dasha_ad/sun/saturn.lagna_or_context_notes: Saturn is a natural enemy of the Sun (Rele p. 120: a temporal friendship can improve it). BPHS counts the good kendra/trikona from the lagna and the bad 8th/12th from the dasha lord.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.40-47, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Saturn in a kendra or trikona from the lagna: enemies destroyed, enjoyment, some grain, marriage at home. Exalted, own or friendly sign with a friendly planet: wellbeing, more property, recognition, renown, wealth from many sources. In the 8th or 12th from the dasha lord or with malefics: rheumatism, pain, fever, dysentery, imprisonment, loss in ventures and wealth, quarrels with co-sharers. Phases: loss of friends at the start, good in the middle, distress at the end. Debilitated: separation from parents, wandering. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: danger of premature death. Remedy: give a black cow, buffalo and goat; Mrityunjaya japa.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.40-47, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.67 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri vol. 2)

In evil houses from the significator or with evil planets: bile and phlegm disease, abdominal pain, dysentery, loss of wealth and honour, estrangement from family, imprisonment, death of parents, travel. In the 2nd or 7th: accident or death.

dasha_ad/sun/saturn.phrasing_guidance: Present as a demanding, slow phase that rewards patience and discipline: advise care with authority figures, budgeting, steady health routines (joints, digestion, colds) and kindness toward elders. Mention its better side when Saturn is well placed. Avoid predicting a parent's death or imprisonment.

dasha_ad/sun/mercury.summary: Mercury's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha (about 10 months 6 days) gives high position, vehicles, ornaments, learning, pilgrimage, marriage and a son when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona, especially in the 5th, 9th or 10th or with the 9th lord. Classical texts without conditions stress skin trouble, digestive and humoral disorders, family trouble and worry; when Mercury is in the 12th from the Sun BPHS predicts body and mind distress.
common_outcomes: high position, enthusiasm, happiness from wife and children, vehicles, clothes, ornaments, pilgrimage (BPHS 52.48-49)
skin eruptions, boils, jaundice, flatulence, pain in belly and hips, loss of land, humoral disease (Phaladeepika 21.9)
trouble from relatives, mental distress, low spirits, waste of money, slight comfort (Jataka Parijata 18.68)
itch, skin disease, more enemies (Saravali 42.14)
gain of money, reputation, new clothes, new learning, alongside trouble through relatives, worry, ill-health, disputes with rulers or judges, short journeys (Raman p. 237)
rare_outcomes: fame through a new name, composing poems under one's own name (BPHS 52.52-53)
exile to a foreign country at the end (BPHS 52.54-56)

by_area.personality: Enthusiasm and vivacity (BPHS 52.48); wit and extempore speech (Rele p. 75); depression and worry (Jataka Parijata 18.68).
by_area.career: High position and vehicles through the ruler's favour (BPHS 52.48-49); popularity and respect (BPHS 52.50-51); displeasure of the ruler at the end (BPHS 52.55-56); disputes with judges (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth and grain increase (BPHS 52.51); waste of money (Jataka Parijata 18.68); loss of land (Phaladeepika 21.9).
by_area.health: Skin disease, jaundice, flatulence, belly and hip pain (Phaladeepika 21.9; Saravali 42.14); body pain and fever when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 52.56).
by_area.relationships: Marriage and a son (BPHS 52.51-52); distress to wife and children when Mercury is 12th from the Sun (BPHS 52.54).
by_area.family: Trouble from relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.68; Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage, religious rites, devotion to teacher and deities, charity, japa (BPHS 52.49-53).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 52.48-49)
Mercury joined with the 9th lord (BPHS 52.50)
Mercury in the 5th, 9th or 10th (BPHS 52.51)
Mercury in a good house such as a trikona from the Sun (BPHS 52.52-53)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Sun (in practice only the 12th) (BPHS 52.54)
Mercury debilitated (BPHS 52.54 gloss; Rele p. 76)
Mercury lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 52.56)
dasha_ad/sun/mercury.lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury is never more than one sign from the Sun, so 'from the dasha lord' it can only be 12th, 1st or 2nd; Santhanam notes the 6th and 8th are impossible. Rele treats Mercury as neutral to the Sun.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.48-57, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna: high position, enthusiasm, happiness from wife and children, vehicles, clothes, ornaments, pilgrimage, cattle. With the 9th lord: very beneficial. In the 9th, 5th or 10th: popularity, pious deeds, devotion, more wealth, a son. In an auspicious house such as a trikona from the dasha lord: marriage, rites, charity, fame, a new name, good food, wealth. In 6/8/12 from the dasha lord: body distress, disturbed mind, distress to wife and children. Phases: evil at the start, some good in the middle, displeasure of the ruler and exile at the end. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: body pain and fever. Remedy: recite the Vishnu Sahasranama, give grains and a silver idol.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.48-57, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Adds varga strength and the 9th and 11th lords for increased profits; verse 54 adds debilitation of the dasha lord among the adverse conditions; verse 56 reads the 7th lord in the 2nd; remedy Vishnu Sahasranama, food donation, silver image.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.9 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, wisdomlib)
source_views.view: Skin eruptions, boils or ulcers, skin disease, jaundice, flatulence, pain in belly and hips, loss of land, disease from imbalance of the three humours.

source_views.view: Trouble from relatives, mental distress, depression, waste of money, slight comfort.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 237
source_views.view: 10 months 6 days. Gain in money, good reputation, new clothes and ornaments, new learning; trouble through relatives, distress, depression, waste, friends turning enemies, anxiety, bad health, ungrateful children, disputes with ruler or judge, disgrace, many short journeys.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, pp. 75-76
source_views.view: Exalted, in angles, trines or the 11th from the lagna or significator: respect among the learned, extempore speech, wit, marriage or a son, favours, pilgrimage, prosperity. In 6/8/12 from the significator or debilitated: mental and physical pain, many short journeys, trouble to wife and children, indiscreet speech. In the 2nd or 7th: illness, fever, stammering.

dasha_ad/sun/mercury.disagreements: BPHS and Rele are largely favourable for a well-placed Mercury; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Saravali give only troubles (skin disease, worry, family trouble); Raman mixes both. For the 2nd/7th rule Santhanam reads Mercury as lord of the 2nd or 7th, the gloss as the 7th lord in the 2nd.
dasha_ad/sun/mercury.phrasing_guidance: Present as a period for study, communication, business and recognition when Mercury is well placed; advise care with skin, digestion and nerves, and tact in speech and with officials, especially near the end of the sub-period.

dasha_ad/sun/ketu.summary: Ketu's sub-period in the Sun's mahadasha (about 4 months 6 days) is described as generally bad: bodily pain, mental agony, loss of money and friends, displeasure of authorities, quarrels with kin and pain in the head or legs. BPHS gives good results (happiness with family, fame, gains) when Ketu is in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th.
common_outcomes: bodily pain, mental agony, loss of wealth, danger from government, quarrels with kinsmen (BPHS 52.58)
loss of friends, family disputes, enemies, loss of wealth and position, illness of elders, severe pain in legs and head (Phaladeepika 21.10)
throat disease, mental anguish, eye inflammation (Jataka Parijata 18.69)
loss of money, nervous exhaustion, misgivings, a long journey, change of house through disputes, fear of rulers, being cheated (Raman p. 237)
rare_outcomes: [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] (Jataka Parijata 18.69 'premature death'; BPHS 52.64 for Ketu in or 'lord of' the 2nd or 7th)
[maraka: text predicts the death of the father] when Ketu is 8th or 12th from the Sun (BPHS 52.60-61)
news of a death at the end when Ketu is with the lagna lord (BPHS 52.59)

by_area.personality: Mental agony (BPHS 52.58; Jataka Parijata 18.69); mind full of misgivings (Raman).
by_area.career: Danger from government (BPHS 52.58); loss of position (BPHS 52.60-61; Phaladeepika 21.10); renown when Ketu is in an upachaya (BPHS 52.62-63).
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth (BPHS 52.58; Phaladeepika 21.10; Raman).
by_area.health: Bodily pain (BPHS 52.58); teeth or cheek disease and urinary trouble (BPHS 52.60); throat and eye disease (Jataka Parijata 18.69); head and leg pain (Phaladeepika 21.10).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children when Ketu is in an upachaya (BPHS 52.62-63).
by_area.family: Quarrels with kinsmen (BPHS 52.58); illness of elders (Phaladeepika 21.10).

strengtheners: Ketu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th from the lagna (BPHS 52.62)
Ketu with a yogakaraka and in an auspicious navamsa or varga (BPHS 52.62 gloss)
Ketu in the 8th or with a trikona lord (Rele p. 76)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 8th or 12th from the Sun (BPHS 52.60)
Ketu in, or 'lord of', the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 52.64)
dasha_ad/sun/ketu.lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is a natural enemy of the Sun. BPHS counts the good upachaya from the lagna and the bad 8th/12th from the dasha lord. Rele reads the bad houses as the 6th or 12th from the lagna or the dasha lord and makes the 8th from the lagna a mitigating placement.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.58-64, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Bodily pain, mental agony, loss of wealth, danger from government, quarrels with kin. With the lagna lord: some happiness at the start, distress in the middle, news of a death at the end. In the 8th or 12th from the dasha lord: teeth or cheek disease, urinary trouble, loss of position, friends and wealth, death of the father, foreign travel, enemies. In the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th from the lagna: happiness from wife and children, satisfaction, more friends, clothes, renown. Lord of or in the 2nd or 7th: danger of premature death. Remedy: Durga mantras (Shat Chandi path) and a goat in charity.

source_views.source: BPHS 52.58-64, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 62 requires Ketu in an upachaya with a yogakaraka and in an auspicious amsa and varga; verse 59 gives early happiness and wealth, middle distress, and eventually news of death with the lagna lord.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.10 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, wisdomlib)
source_views.view: Loss of friends, disputes with family, trouble from enemies, loss of wealth and position, illness of elders, severe pain in legs and head.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.69 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri vol. 2)
source_views.view: Throat disease, mental anguish, ophthalmia or premature death.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 237
source_views.view: 4 months 6 days. Loss of money, troubled mind, fainting or nervous exhaustion, misgivings, a long journey, change of house due to disputes, trouble among relatives, throat disease, ophthalmia or premature death, fear of rulers and enemies, being cheated.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, p. 76
source_views.view: Generally bad: mental and physical trouble, displeasure of superiors, trouble from relatives. Mitigated if Ketu is in the 8th or with a trikona lord: success, contentment, happiness from wife and children. In the 6th or 12th from the lagna or the significator: teeth and mouth trouble, urinary trouble, deportation, distant travel, loss of wealth, death of the father or a trusted friend, harassment from enemies.

dasha_ad/sun/ketu.disagreements: All sources treat the sub-period as mainly adverse. BPHS gives good results from the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th; Rele instead names the 8th or a link with a trikona lord as mitigating and counts the 6th as bad. Santhanam's verse 64 speaks of Ketu as 'lord of' the 2nd or 7th, though nodes own no sign in this library; only the placement is checkable. Saravali 42 gives no Sun-Ketu result.
dasha_ad/sun/ketu.phrasing_guidance: Present as a short, unsettled phase: advise rest, care with eyes, throat, teeth and head, avoiding disputes with relatives and officials, and caution over being misled. Do not predict a death in the family.
