nakshatra/swati.summary: Swati (6°40'-20°00' Libra, ruled by Rahu, deity Vayu the wind) gives a gentle, courteous, self-reliant and trade-minded nature that bends with circumstances and grows strong slowly.
common_outcomes: gentle, kind and pleasant in speech (BJ 16.8; HS 28.15)
self-controlled and principled, often a merchant or in trade (BJ 16.8)
compassionate and inclined to dharma (BJ 16.8; HS 28.15)
lives or works away from home; may run into debts (HS 28.15)
diplomatic, social, avoids taking sides; can procrastinate (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: strained relations with relatives and few sons (HS 28.15)
devoted to gods and Brahmins and fond of enjoyment, wealthy but of modest intelligence (JP 9.87)
great commercial wealth when the Moon here rules the 11th (Trivedi's example)

by_area.personality: Mild, courteous, self-controlled and compassionate (BJ, HS); Trivedi adds a strong need for balance and harmony that can turn into indecision and following the crowd.
by_area.career: Trade and business are the classic fit (BJ 16.8 'merchant'); Trivedi lists business, law, diplomacy, aviation, transport, teaching and technology.
by_area.finance: Wealth is promised by Jataka Parijata (9.87) and Trivedi calls it the best nakshatra for business; Hora Sara (28.15) warns of debts.
by_area.relationships: Pleasant and sociable (all sources); Hora Sara notes friction with one's own relatives.
by_area.family: Few sons (HS 28.15).
by_area.spirituality: Linked by Trivedi to Saraswati and learning; Jataka Parijata has the native please gods and Brahmins.

strengtheners: the birth star aspected by or joined with benefics gives its good results fully (HS 28.28, general rule for any birth star)
Rahu, Mercury, Venus and Saturn give strong results here (Trivedi)
Mercury linked to Swati brings out its learning side (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the Sun and Mars are uneasy here and Ketu is incompatible with it (Trivedi)
lower expression: indulgence, greed, people-pleasing (Trivedi)
nakshatra/swati.lagna_or_context_notes: Trivedi: those with prominent Swati tend to bloom late, with a stronger second half of life.

attributes.deity: Vayu, the wind god (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi)
attributes.symbol: a young plant shoot blown by the wind; also coral and a sword (Trivedi). Raman (HPA) describes the star (Arcturus) as a single star resembling a sapphire.
attributes.gana: Deva (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: buffalo, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives buffalo
attributes.nature: chara (movable) (BS 98.11; Raman Muhurta). Trivedi: passive, rajasic, level-facing, Deva, female, butcher caste.
attributes.sign_span: 6°40'-20°00' Libra; all 4 padas in Libra (Frawley; Raman HPA; PVR)

nakshatra/swati.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.8): gentle and self-controlled, a principled trader, compassionate, sweet-spoken and devoted to dharma. Hora Sara (28.15): mild, happy, kind, courteous and virtuous, but runs into debts, lives away from home, is at odds with relatives, dresses simply and has few sons. Jataka Parijata (9.87): pleases gods and Brahmins, enjoys life and has much wealth but limited intelligence. Trivedi: the keyword is balance; diplomatic, sociable, adaptable and good at long-term planning, but prone to indecision and to following the crowd.
nakshatra/swati.as_lagna: Trivedi: Swati natives are usually slim and well proportioned, often seen wearing a fixed smile in groups; his example is Mark Twain (lagna, Mercury and Saturn in Swati), where the intellectual side shows.
planets_in_it: Saturn reaches its highest exaltation in Swati and the Sun its deepest debilitation (Trivedi, ch. 15)
Venus in the lagna and in Swati (or Krittika, Revati, Pushya, Ashwini) makes one a ruler (Saravali 35.148)
Rahu, Mercury, Venus and Saturn give strong results; the Sun and Mars are uneasy; Ketu does not suit it; Jupiter and the Moon are neutral (Trivedi)

padas.1: 6°40'-10°00' Libra, Sagittarius navamsha (Jupiter): restless and curious; writing, communication, travel; most planets do reasonably well (Trivedi).
padas.2: 10°00'-13°20' Libra, Capricorn navamsha (Saturn): most grounded pada; focus on material growth and comfort; good business sense (Trivedi).
padas.3: 13°20'-16°40' Libra, Aquarius navamsha (Saturn): most intellectual pada; learning and group work; Mercury, Venus and Saturn strong (Trivedi).
padas.4: 16°40'-20°00' Libra, Pisces navamsha (Jupiter): most adaptable; a Pushkara navamsha; success through hard work and sociability; all planets except Mercury do well (Trivedi).

nakshatra/swati.disagreements: Hora Sara alone stresses debts, friction with relatives and few sons, while Jataka Parijata promises much wealth (but little intelligence) and Brihat Jataka gives only positive traits. Trivedi gives the element as fire although Swati is ruled by Rahu and linked to the wind.
nakshatra/swati.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Lead with courtesy, independence and a head for trade; mention debts and indecision as tendencies to manage.

nakshatra/vishakha.summary: Vishakha (20°00' Libra-3°20' Scorpio, ruled by Jupiter, deities Indra and Agni) gives single-minded drive towards a goal, eloquence and ambition, with a pull towards envy and quarrels.
common_outcomes: eloquent and dignified, but envious and greedy (BJ 16.9)
inclined to quarrels or to stir them up (BJ 16.9)
talks a lot, has wife, children, money and learning, respects teachers and is generous (HS 28.16)
proud but devoted to the spouse, overcomes enemies, irritable (JP 9.87)
fixated on goals; restless after each achievement (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: eye trouble (HS 28.16)
skill at making money (Trivedi quoting Varahamihira)

by_area.personality: Eloquent and driven, but envious and argumentative (BJ, HS, JP); Trivedi's keyword is 'fixation': unmatched single-mindedness, with the risk of choosing unwholesome goals.
by_area.career: Trivedi lists politics, broadcasting, sport, military and police work, and the liquor trade, and notes frequent career changes.
by_area.finance: Good at earning (Trivedi quoting Varahamihira); Hora Sara gives wealth.
by_area.health: Eye diseases (HS 28.16).
by_area.relationships: Devoted to the spouse (JP 9.87); Trivedi links it to marriage symbolism (the decorated gateway) and to intense, longing love.
by_area.family: Has wife and sons (HS 28.16).
by_area.spirituality: Respects the learned and Brahmins (HS); Trivedi sees the frustration that follows success turning some natives towards higher knowledge and penance.

strengtheners: Jupiter is the planet that does well here (Trivedi)
the Sun, Moon and Jupiter bring out its sattvic, hardworking side (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus-Jupiter tension in the Libra padas makes it turbulent (Trivedi)
pada 4 (Scorpio) is volatile and revengeful in its lower expression (Trivedi)

attributes.deity: Indragni, Indra and Agni together (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi); PVR's table shows Indra
attributes.symbol: a decorated arch or gateway (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): three stars resembling a potter's wheel
attributes.gana: Rakshasa (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: tiger, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives tiger
attributes.nature: mishra (mixed, soft-and-sharp) (BS 98.11; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: active, sattvic, downward-facing, female, outcaste (mleccha).
attributes.sign_span: 20°00' Libra-3°20' Scorpio; padas 1-3 in Libra, pada 4 in Scorpio

nakshatra/vishakha.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.9): envious and greedy, yet dignified and clever with words, and given to starting quarrels. Hora Sara (28.16): jealous, very talkative, with sons, wife, wealth and learning, respectful to the learned and generous, but prone to eye disease. Jataka Parijata (9.87): proud yet devoted to the wife, overcomes enemies, easily irritated. Trivedi: obsessive pursuit of goals, followed by emptiness after each success; capable of great effort and penance when the goal is worthy.
nakshatra/vishakha.as_lagna: Trivedi: a fierce look with sharp features and angles to the face; manners range from very courteous to obnoxious; tends to hide negative feelings behind a front. His lagna example is Nicole Kidman.
planets_in_it: only Jupiter functions well here in the present age, in the author's experience (Trivedi)
Venus or Mars suit pada 1; Mercury and Saturn suit pada 3; only Jupiter steadies pada 4 (Trivedi)

padas.1: 20°00'-23°20' Libra, Aries navamsha (Mars): energy, impulse, social ambition; passion over commitment (Trivedi).
padas.2: 23°20'-26°40' Libra, Taurus navamsha (Venus): endurance; material ambitions fulfilled; a Pushkara navamsha (Trivedi).
padas.3: 26°40'-30°00' Libra, Gemini navamsha (Mercury): drive turned to thought and belief; inner conflict between openness and anxiety (Trivedi).
padas.4: 0°00'-3°20' Scorpio, Cancer navamsha (Moon): most one-pointed and emotionally volatile pada; can be revengeful, or give penetrating insight and will (Trivedi).

source_views.source: Prash Trivedi, The Book of Nakshatras, ch. 16 (Vishakha)
source_views.view: Keyword 'fixation'; goal-driven, prone to envy, excess and emptiness after success; Rakshasa, sattvic, mixed, active; tiger yoni; pada notes; only Jupiter works well here.

nakshatra/vishakha.disagreements: Deity: Brihat Samhita and Raman give the pair Indra-Agni (Indragni); PVR's table lists only Indra. Hora Sara and Jataka Parijata stress family and marital devotion, while Brihat Jataka gives only temperament (envy, eloquence, quarrels). Trivedi calls it sattvic despite its Rakshasa gana.
nakshatra/vishakha.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Frame envy and quarrelsomeness as the shadow of strong ambition; emphasise focus, persistence and eloquence.

nakshatra/anuradha.summary: Anuradha (3°20'-16°40' Scorpio, ruled by Saturn, deity Mitra) gives friendliness, devotion, organising ability and a life of travel or residence abroad, with a strong appetite.
common_outcomes: prosperous; lives abroad and travels (BJ 16.9; HS 28.17)
cannot bear hunger; strong appetite (BJ 16.9; HS 28.17)
kind, virtuous and fortunate (HS 28.17)
able, easy-going, honourable, famous and powerful (JP 9.88, partly legible)
a bridge between people; founder or leader of groups (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: grief or sorrow (HS 28.17)
interest in occult subjects and numbers (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Friendly and devoted but emotionally sensitive behind a tough exterior (Trivedi); kind and virtuous (HS).
by_area.career: Trivedi: organisers and heads of institutions, scientists, statisticians, astrologers, and work involving foreign countries.
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BJ 16.9).
by_area.health: Troubled by hunger and thirst (HS 28.17).
by_area.relationships: Trivedi: friendly and good at putting people at ease, but in the present age prone to too many shallow friendships.
by_area.spirituality: Channels emotion into devotion (Trivedi; 'power of worship').

strengtheners: all planets can work well here, depending on the chart (Trivedi)
Mars in Anuradha, if vargottama or exalted, forms a raja yoga (Saravali 35.164)
weakeners_or_cancellations: pada 3 carries some self-undoing and wastefulness (Trivedi)
nakshatra/anuradha.lagna_or_context_notes: Trivedi: living in foreign lands is usually satisfying and fruitful for Anuradha natives.

attributes.deity: Mitra (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi)
attributes.symbol: a staff, also a lotus (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): three stars resembling an umbrella
attributes.gana: Deva (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: hare, female (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi gives deer
attributes.nature: mridu (soft) (BS 98.10; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: passive, tamasic, level, male, shudra caste.

nakshatra/anuradha.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.9): prosperous, living abroad, a wanderer who cannot bear hunger. Hora Sara (28.17): troubled by hunger and thirst, given to grief, yet kind, virtuous and fortunate; wanders and lives abroad. Jataka Parijata (9.88, OCR partly legible): able, ease-loving, honourable, famous and powerful. Trivedi: an explorer who works through people, combining friendliness with reserve; devoted, organised, drawn to travel and the occult.
nakshatra/anuradha.as_lagna: Trivedi: a stout, often hairy body with a prominent chest and thighs and a belly with age; a friendly face with a hint of secrecy in the eyes. His lagna example is Jim Morrison.
planets_in_it: Mars in Anuradha (or Ashwini, Dhanishta) gives a raja yoga only if Mars is also vargottama or exalted (Saravali 35.164)
Mars-Saturn conjunctions or mutual aspects carry Anuradha's energy (Trivedi)
the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Ketu are strong in pada 1; Mercury and Rahu in pada 2; Venus and Saturn in pada 3; the Sun, Jupiter and Ketu in pada 4 (Trivedi)

padas.1: 3°20'-6°40' Scorpio, Leo navamsha (Sun): self-understanding applied to career; curb pride or militancy (Trivedi).
padas.2: 6°40'-10°00' Scorpio, Virgo navamsha (Mercury): learning, discipline, numbers and organisation; a Pushkara navamsha (Trivedi).
padas.3: 10°00'-13°20' Scorpio, Libra navamsha (Venus): arts, music, the occult; sociable, some wastefulness (Trivedi).
padas.4: 13°20'-16°40' Scorpio, Scorpio navamsha (Mars): abundant energy; the task is channelling passion constructively (Trivedi).

source_views.view: Keyword 'exploration' through communal effort; friendly, devoted, organising, drawn abroad; Deva, tamasic, soft, passive; deer yoni; pada notes.

nakshatra/anuradha.disagreements: Yoni: Raman's Muhurta table gives Anuradha (female) and Jyeshtha (male) the hare; Trivedi gives Anuradha the deer and Jyeshtha the stag. The classical Moon results agree on wealth, travel abroad and hunger; Hora Sara alone adds grief.
nakshatra/anuradha.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Emphasise friendship, devotion and success abroad; mention appetite lightly.

nakshatra/jyeshtha.summary: Jyeshtha (16°40'-30°00' Scorpio, ruled by Mercury, deity Indra) gives seniority, a protective and responsible streak, contentment with few friends, and a quick temper; its end meets Mula at a gandanta junction.
common_outcomes: few friends, contented, virtuous, quick to anger (BJ 16.10)
satisfied, virtuous, many sons and friends, angry, troubled by relatives, prominent in the family (HS 28.18)
cares about image and respect; protective of the weak (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: drawn to women not his own (JP 9.88, partly legible)
lustful (Trivedi quoting Varahamihira)
vindictiveness and jealousy in its lower expression (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Contented and virtuous but quick-tempered (BJ, HS); Trivedi: concerned with image and standing, protective, responsible, but prone to exaggerating troubles and to jealousy.
by_area.career: Trivedi: police, military, administration, government, broadcasting and other authority or protective roles.
by_area.finance: Trivedi: pada 1 swings between financial extremes; the poverty side is reduced in pada 4.
by_area.relationships: Few friends (BJ 16.10) versus many friends (HS 28.18).
by_area.family: Many sons; prominent among one's own family but troubled by relatives (HS 28.18). See padas for the classical warnings about relatives.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi: penance is needed for Jyeshtha to work well.

strengtheners: only a well-placed Mercury gives good results here (Trivedi)
Jupiter gives the best results in pada 1 (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: most planets here need watching as they tend to disturb peace of mind (Trivedi)
birth in the gandanta portion at its end (junction with Mula) is held to be inauspicious (JP 9.45; Hora Sara 1.14; Saravali 3.20-21)
nakshatra/jyeshtha.lagna_or_context_notes: Gandanta: the last part of Jyeshtha joins the first part of Mula. Jataka Parijata 9.45 gives the junction as a span of ghatikas; Hora Sara 1.14 gives one ghatika at the junction (some say the evil runs 4 or 6 years); Saravali 3.20-21 names the end of Scorpio.

attributes.deity: Indra (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi)
attributes.symbol: a round talisman or earring (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): three stars (Antares) resembling an umbrella
attributes.gana: Rakshasa (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: hare, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi gives stag
attributes.nature: tikshna (sharp, dreadful) (BS 98.7; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: active, sattvic, level, female, servant caste.
attributes.sign_span: 16°40'-30°00' Scorpio; all 4 padas in Scorpio; ends at the Scorpio-Sagittarius gandanta

nakshatra/jyeshtha.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.10): few friends, contented, virtuous and quick to anger. Hora Sara (28.18): satisfied and virtuous with many sons and friends, very angry, troubled by relatives, and a leading figure in the family. Jataka Parijata (9.88, OCR largely illegible): the legible words link Jyeshtha with desire for women not one's own. Trivedi: image-conscious, protective of the weak and responsible, but liable to magnify troubles, to jealousy and to a wish to 'get even'.
nakshatra/jyeshtha.as_lagna: Trivedi: matures early in body and mind and does not keep youth long; well proportioned with a stronger upper body; penetrating, probing eyes.
planets_in_it: only a well-placed Mercury gives good results; most planets here tend to work against peace of mind (Trivedi)
Mercury-Mars and Mercury-Mars-Ketu conjunctions carry Jyeshtha's energy (Trivedi)
Mars does poorly in pada 4; Venus and Jupiter there raise material gain (Trivedi)

padas.1: 16°40'-20°00' Scorpio, Sagittarius navamsha (Jupiter): family and money concerns, generous, a risk-taker; Jupiter best; planets here are said to harm siblings' wellbeing (Trivedi). Jataka Parijata 9.50: birth in the 1st quarter endangers the eldest brother [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.2: 20°00'-23°20' Scorpio, Capricorn navamsha (Saturn): rigid, authoritative, late achievement; affects younger siblings (Trivedi). JP 9.50: 2nd quarter endangers an elder brother [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.3: 23°20'-26°40' Scorpio, Aquarius navamsha (Saturn): humanitarian, protective of the underprivileged; said to affect the mother (Trivedi). JP 9.50: 3rd quarter endangers the father [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.4: 26°40'-30°00' Scorpio, Pisces navamsha (Jupiter): very emotional, risk of indulgence; devotion at best; most self-destructive in its negative form (Trivedi). JP 9.50: 4th quarter endangers the native [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. This pada ends at the Jyeshtha-Mula gandanta.
padas.tenths: JP 9.46-48 divide Jyeshtha's duration into ten parts, each said to endanger a different relative (maternal grandparents, maternal uncle, mother, the child, cattle and wealth, both families, the whole line, father-in-law, everything) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 9.45-50, 59, 64-67 (Vaidyanatha, tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1932)
source_views.view: 45: gandanta at the Jyeshtha-Mula, Ashlesha-Magha and Revati-Ashwini junctions is harmful; the ghatika at the Jyeshtha-Mula junction is Abhukta-mula and birth then ruins the family [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. 46-48: tenths of Jyeshtha each endanger a relative. 49: a girl born in Jyeshtha on a Tuesday endangers her eldest brother. 50: quarters 1-4 endanger the eldest brother, an elder brother, the father, the native [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. 59: ganda at the end of Jyeshtha operates at night. 64-67: the period of risk for Jyeshtha is one year.

source_views.source: Hora Sara 1.14 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: One ghatika at each of the Revati-Ashwini, Ashlesha-Magha and Jyeshtha-Mula junctions is gandanta; its evil lasts four years (some say six).

source_views.source: Hora Sara 28.29 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: A girl born in Jyeshtha (with Ardra, Ashlesha, Shatabhisha, Pushya, Mula, Chitra, Krittika) should be avoided in marriage, as she brings grief, death, consumption or quarrels to relatives [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Saravali 3.20-21 (English tr. as uploaded)
source_views.view: The ends of Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces are gandanta; one born then may not survive, may lose the mother or end the line, but if he survives becomes a king [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Prash Trivedi, The Book of Nakshatras, ch. 18 (Jyeshtha)
source_views.view: A sense of arriving; image-conscious, protective, responsible, temper and jealousy; Rakshasa, sattvic, sharp, active; stag yoni; pada notes with effects on siblings and mother; only a well-placed Mercury does well.

nakshatra/jyeshtha.disagreements: Friends: Brihat Jataka says few friends; Hora Sara says many sons and friends. Yoni: hare (Raman) versus stag (Trivedi). Pada effects on relatives: Jataka Parijata 9.50 assigns the 3rd quarter to the father, Trivedi assigns pada 3 to the mother. Gandanta extent: one ghatika (Hora Sara 1.14), a span of ghatikas (JP 9.45), or simply the end of the sign (Saravali); Santhanam's note on Hora Sara cites Lagnachandrika's last five ghatis of Jyeshtha.
nakshatra/jyeshtha.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. The Jyeshtha quarter and gandanta verses are traditional warnings about family members; never repeat them as predictions. If gandanta applies, say tradition recommends propitiatory rites for this birth portion, without fear-based language.

nakshatra/mula.summary: Mula (0°00'-13°20' Sagittarius, ruled by Ketu, deity Nirriti) gives pride, wealth, steadiness and a drive to get to the root of things; its start is the Jyeshtha-Mula gandanta, and it carries strong traditional warnings for relatives.
common_outcomes: proud, wealthy, happy, not cruel, steady and fond of luxury (BJ 16.10)
wise, happy, rich, eldest among siblings, a ruler, but prone to disease and theft, and unsteady (HS 28.19)
gets to the root of things; relentless, impulsive, sometimes arrogant (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: eloquent but dishonest, ungrateful and poor (JP 9.88, partly legible)
a seeker who can rise to power and later lose it (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Proud and steady, fond of comfort (BJ); Trivedi: direct, sarcastic, bold and reserved, quick to drastic action; seeks the root and core of every matter.
by_area.career: Trivedi: medicine and healing, research (genetics, microbiology), investigation, law, military, public speaking.
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BJ 16.10; HS 28.19); Jataka Parijata's legible text says indigent; Trivedi: pada 3 is against money.
by_area.health: Prone to disease (HS 28.19).
by_area.family: Eldest among siblings (HS 28.19). See padas for traditional warnings about parents.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi: first of the nakshatras of the soul's spiritual journey; Jupiter's sign makes the transformation benign when well guided.

strengtheners: a well-placed Sun, Mars and Jupiter do well in Mula (Trivedi)
Jupiter's involvement steers Ketu's energy to good ends (Trivedi)
the person born in Abhukta-mula who survives raises the family and may lead an army (JP 9.64-67)
weakeners_or_cancellations: birth in the first portion (Abhukta-mula / gandanta) is treated as dangerous for the family (JP 9.45; HS 1.14; Saravali 3.20-21)
Ketu here often adds an extreme or idiosyncratic tinge (Trivedi)
nakshatra/mula.lagna_or_context_notes: Gandanta: Mula opens the Scorpio-Sagittarius junction. JP 9.59: ganda at the start of Mula operates by day. Sun in Mula in the ascendant gives rulership of a small territory (Saravali 35.147).

attributes.deity: Nirriti, goddess of dissolution (Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi); the Iyer table for BS 98.4-5 on wisdomlib shows Prajapati
attributes.symbol: a tied bunch of roots (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): six stars resembling a crouching lion
attributes.gana: Rakshasa (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: dog, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives dog
attributes.nature: tikshna (sharp, dreadful) (BS 98.7; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: active, tamasic, downward, neutral gender, butcher caste.
attributes.sign_span: 0°00'-13°20' Sagittarius; all 4 padas in Sagittarius; begins at the Scorpio-Sagittarius gandanta

nakshatra/mula.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.10): proud, wealthy, happy, not cruel, steady and fond of luxury. Hora Sara (28.19): wise, happy and rich but prone to disease and theft, fortunate, unsteady, the eldest among siblings and a ruler. Jataka Parijata (9.88, OCR partly legible): eloquent but dishonest, ungrateful and indigent. Trivedi: relentless, impulsive and proud, seeking the root of things; capable of great power, which tends to be taken away at some point.
nakshatra/mula.as_lagna: Trivedi: a prominent nose and ears and thick lower lip; not conventionally attractive but magnetic; arrogance, sarcasm and boldness in manner. His examples: Hanuman born with Mula rising; Ravana with his lagna lord (Sun) in Mula.
planets_in_it: the Sun in Mula (or Revati, Purva Phalguni, Uttara Phalguni) identical with the ascendant makes one head of a small country (Saravali 35.147)
the Moon in pada 1 is said to harm the father's wellbeing (Trivedi)
Jupiter-Ketu conjunction carries Mula's full energy (Trivedi)
a well-placed Sun, Mars and Jupiter do well; Ketu is strong but idiosyncratic (Trivedi)

padas.1: 0°00'-3°20' Sagittarius, Aries navamsha (Mars): deep searching; planets here, especially the Moon, said to harm the father (Trivedi). JP 9.51: birth in the 1st quarter endangers the father [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]; JP 9.57 also says the first quarter of Mula costs the father.
padas.2: 3°20'-6°40' Sagittarius, Taurus navamsha (Venus): hardworking, creative; bad for the mother's wellbeing (Trivedi). JP 9.51: 2nd quarter endangers the mother [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
padas.3: 6°40'-10°00' Sagittarius, Gemini navamsha (Mercury): wordplay and communication; against money, afflicted planets can bring poverty (Trivedi). JP 9.51: 3rd quarter brings loss of wealth.
padas.4: 10°00'-13°20' Sagittarius, Cancer navamsha (Moon): most turbulent emotionally; ancient texts call it harmful and prescribe propitiation (Trivedi). JP 9.51: 4th quarter makes the native happy.
padas.fifteenths: JP 9.52-55 divide Mula into fifteen parts, each said to endanger a relative (father, paternal uncle, sister's husband, grandfather, mother, maternal aunt and uncle, and others), with the 12th part endangering the native [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.view: 45: Abhukta-mula, the ghatika at the Jyeshtha-Mula junction, ruins the family [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. 49: a girl born in Mula on a Sunday endangers her father-in-law. 51: quarters 1-4 bring danger to father, mother, loss of wealth, happiness. 52-55: fifteen parts each endanger a relative. 57: first quarter of Mula costs the father. 64-67: risk period for Mula is 4 years; birth in Abhukta-mula endangers the father at once, but if the child lives he raises his family and may command an army [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Hora Sara 1.14 and 28.29 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: 1.14: one ghatika at the Jyeshtha-Mula junction is gandanta, evil for 4 (or 6) years. 28.29: a girl born in Mula is among those to be avoided in marriage [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: Saravali 3.20-21 and 35.147 (English tr. as uploaded)
source_views.view: 3.20-21: birth at the end of Scorpio (gandanta) threatens survival or the mother, but a survivor becomes a king. 35.147: Sun in Mula in the ascendant gives rule over a small country.

source_views.source: Prash Trivedi, The Book of Nakshatras, ch. 19 (Mula)
source_views.view: Gets to the root; relentless, impulsive, proud; can give and later take away power; Rakshasa, tamasic, sharp, active; dog yoni; pada notes including harm to father/mother; Jupiter-Ketu carries its energy.

nakshatra/mula.disagreements: Deity: Raman, PVR and Trivedi give Nirriti; the Iyer translation's table of BS 98.4-5 (as rendered on wisdomlib) shows Prajapati, which looks like a table error but is recorded. Wealth: Brihat Jataka and Hora Sara say rich; Jataka Parijata's legible text says indigent. Pada 4: Jataka Parijata 9.51 calls it happy; Trivedi says ancient texts call it harmful and needing propitiation. Abhukta-mula: JP 9.45 places it at the Jyeshtha-Mula junction ghatika; the commentary note cites Lagnachandrika's first three ghatis of Mula.
nakshatra/mula.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Mula is widely feared in Indian families; reassure that 'Mula dosha' verses are traditional cautions answered by shanti rites, and never say a parent or relative is at risk.

nakshatra/purva_ashadha.summary: Purva Ashadha (13°20'-26°40' Sagittarius, ruled by Venus, deity Apah the waters) gives pride, loyalty in friendship, a pleasing spouse and an optimistic, 'cannot lose' drive.
common_outcomes: a pleasing, devoted spouse; proud; steady in friendship (BJ 16.11)
firm friendships, modest, many sons, leads others, intelligent, enjoys good food and pleasure from the spouse, favoured by rulers (HS 28.20)
well-behaved, honourable, well off and calm (JP 9.88)
optimistic and undaunted by setbacks (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: unrealistic aims, insensitivity to others (Trivedi)
little formal education; rising from hard circumstances (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Proud yet modest and calm (BJ, HS, JP); Trivedi: invincible optimism, flamboyance and a love of life, with a habit of not learning from mistakes.
by_area.career: Trivedi: shipping, navy and water-related work, entertainment, motivational teaching, management, arts.
by_area.finance: Well off (JP 9.88).
by_area.relationships: A pleasing, loving spouse and happiness through the spouse (BJ 16.11; HS 28.20); steady friendships.
by_area.family: Many sons (HS 28.20). See padas and planets for the Jataka Parijata warning about the father.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi links it to the initiate of mystery schools and purification by the waters.

strengtheners: all planets except Saturn usually do well; Saturn is fine in padas 2-3 unless afflicted (Trivedi)
pada 3 is a Pushkara navamsha (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon in Purva Ashadha with Sagittarius rising endangers the father (JP 9.60) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
acting without regard for consequences (Trivedi)
nakshatra/purva_ashadha.lagna_or_context_notes: JP 9.60 combines this nakshatra with a Sagittarius lagna; JP 9.64-67 give the risk period as the 9th month.

attributes.symbol: a handheld fan (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): with Uttara Ashadha, four stars resembling a square
attributes.gana: Manushya (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: monkey, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives monkey
attributes.nature: ugra (fierce) (BS 98.8; Raman Muhurta 'dreadful'; Trivedi). Trivedi: balanced, rajasic, downward, female, Brahmin caste.

Hora Sara (28.20): firm in friendship, modest, many sons, a leader of men, intelligent, fond of fine food, happy with the spouse and dear to the ruler. Jataka Parijata (9.88): consistently well-behaved, honourable, well off and calm-minded. Trivedi: an optimistic conviction that it cannot lose; lives each moment fully and shrugs off hardship, though aims can be unrealistic.
nakshatra/purva_ashadha.as_lagna: Trivedi: a proud, serious face that breaks easily into laughter; flamboyant in dress and manner; keeps part of themselves secret.
planets_in_it: the Moon in Purva Ashadha with Sagittarius rising is said to cause the father's death (JP 9.60) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
Venus reaches its highest individual energy here (Trivedi)
all planets except Saturn usually do well (Trivedi)

padas.1: 13°20'-16°40' Sagittarius, Leo navamsha (Sun): proud and confident; ethical and spiritual (Trivedi).
padas.2: 16°40'-20°00' Sagittarius, Virgo navamsha (Mercury): hard work towards great achievement; planets other than Venus help career (Trivedi).

padas.4: 23°20'-26°40' Sagittarius, Scorpio navamsha (Mars): secretive; occult wisdom or perversity; good for foreign affairs (Trivedi).

nakshatra/purva_ashadha.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Lead with loyalty, pride and resilience; do not repeat the father-related verse as a prediction.

nakshatra/uttara_ashadha.summary: Uttara Ashadha (26°40' Sagittarius-10°00' Capricorn, ruled by the Sun, deity the Vishvedevas) gives modesty, righteousness, gratitude, many friends and lasting, hard-won victory.
common_outcomes: modest, dharmic, many friends, grateful and fortunate (BJ 16.11)
honourable, calm, happy, wealthy and learned (JP 9.89)
practical, responsible, respected for advice; finishes what it starts (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: many enemies, distress, wandering and many wives, but kind and learned (HS 28.21)
rigidity and intolerance (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Modest, grateful and righteous (BJ); Trivedi: traditional, practical and principled, sometimes rigid.
by_area.career: Trivedi: leadership, government, law and justice, military, management, counselling.
by_area.finance: Wealthy (JP 9.89).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (BJ 16.11); Hora Sara adds many enemies and many wives.
by_area.spirituality: Knows dharma (BJ); Trivedi: a determination to pierce illusion and find one's true nature.

the Sun, Jupiter, Mars and Ketu are potent in pada 1 (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter is debilitated in the Capricorn part (Trivedi)
Mercury, Venus and Jupiter can make one too materialistic in the Capricorn part (Trivedi)
nakshatra/uttara_ashadha.lagna_or_context_notes: Abhijit, the 28th nakshatra used in some muhurta and chakra work, is placed by Trivedi within the last part of Uttara Ashadha; PVR calls the last quarter of Uttara Ashadha Abhijit; Frawley places it between Shravana and Dhanishta.

Trivedi: good qualities valued for advice; launches enterprises and sees them through; respect for tradition, sometimes rigid.
nakshatra/uttara_ashadha.as_lagna: Trivedi's lagna example is Swami Vivekananda, born with Uttara Ashadha rising and showing its ten virtues.
planets_in_it: Jupiter is debilitated in the Capricorn part, so that part does not suit excess idealism (Trivedi)
Guru-Sani, Surya-Guru, Surya-Sani conjunctions carry Uttara Ashadha's energy (Trivedi)
Rahu, Mercury and Saturn are comfortable in pada 3, Saturn strongest; the Moon, Mars and Saturn handle pada 4 best (Trivedi)

padas.1: 26°40'-30°00' Sagittarius, Sagittarius navamsha (Jupiter): righteous and confident; Pushkara and vargottama; strong results; Jupiter best (Trivedi).

padas.4: 6°40'-10°00' Capricorn, Pisces navamsha (Jupiter): physical prowess, courage, philanthropy; conflict between material and spiritual values (Trivedi).

nakshatra/shravana.summary: Shravana (10°00'-23°20' Capricorn, ruled by the Moon, deity Vishnu) gives learning through listening, prosperity, fame and a noble spouse, with a gift for teaching and organising.
common_outcomes: prosperous, graceful, learned in sacred knowledge, a noble spouse, well known (BJ 16.12)
learned in the Vedas, lives abroad, an exalted spouse, wealthy and famous (HS 28.22)
reveres Brahmins and gods, of the ruling class, rich and pious (JP 9.89)
skilled speaker and teacher; perseveres until things are finished (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: few sons, many enemies and many expenses (HS 28.22)
few children and little joy from them when lagna or Moon is here (Trivedi)
debts from excessive generosity (Trivedi)

by_area.relationships: A noble or liberal-minded spouse (BJ 16.12; HS 28.22).
by_area.family: Few sons (HS 28.22); Trivedi: few children and anxiety over them, especially with lagna or Moon here or a 5th-house link.
by_area.spirituality: Learned in sacred lore, pious (BJ, JP); Trivedi: power to listen to and spread universal knowledge.

strengtheners: pada 2 is a Pushkara navamsha where any planet gives its best (Trivedi)
the Moon, Saturn, Mars, Mercury and Venus do well (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: easily misled by bad company or advice (Trivedi)
nakshatra/shravana.lagna_or_context_notes: Trivedi: in the 5th house, or with the 5th lord here, it tends to show few children.

planets_in_it: Saturn here makes one listen more and speak less; Mars makes one talkative but a poor listener (Trivedi)
the Moon, Saturn, Mars, Mercury and Venus do well; Venus can make one too materialistic (Trivedi)
the Moon in Capricorn, Saturn in Cancer, or a Moon-Saturn conjunction carry Shravana's energy (Trivedi)

padas.2: 13°20'-16°40' Capricorn, Taurus navamsha (Venus): diplomacy and tact; a Pushkara navamsha where any planet gives its best; music business (Trivedi).

nakshatra/dhanishta.summary: Dhanishta (23°20' Capricorn-6°40' Aquarius, ruled by Mars, deity the eight Vasus) gives generosity, wealth, courage and a gift for music and rhythm, with a traditional warning about marital harmony.
common_outcomes: generous, wealthy, brave, fond of music, eager for wealth (BJ 16.12)
wealthy, generous, courageous, happy abroad, likes dance and song, but loses the spouse, lies, talks much (HS 28.23)
credulous, wealthy, sturdy in thigh and neck, joyful (JP 9.89)
sociable, rhythmic, sporting, ambitious; marital difficulties, especially in the Capricorn part (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: loss of the spouse (HS 28.23)
success in a foreign land (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Generous, brave and joyful (BJ, JP); Trivedi: confident, adaptable and sociable, does not like being told what to do.
by_area.career: Trivedi: music, dance, entertainment management, sports, military, dealing in gems and precious metals.
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BJ, HS, JP); Trivedi: power to give fame and abundance.
by_area.relationships: Hora Sara: loses the wife; Trivedi: marital discord widely noted by scholars, worse in the Capricorn part and with Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu here, especially linked to the 7th; Cancer lagnas of 16°40'-30° tend to struggle in marriage.

the Moon, Mars, Saturn, Mercury, Venus and Rahu usually do well (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu here (especially the Capricorn part) aggravate marital difficulties (Trivedi)
Saturn here slows success and may deny marital pleasure (Trivedi)
nakshatra/dhanishta.lagna_or_context_notes: Raman (Muhurta ch. IV): from the third quarter of Dhanishta to the end of Revati is Nakshatra Panchaka, avoided for certain elections.

nakshatra/dhanishta.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.12): generous, wealthy, brave, fond of music and eager for wealth. Hora Sara (28.23): wealthy, generous and courageous, happy abroad, fond of dance and song, but loses the spouse, tells lies and talks much. Jataka Parijata (9.89): credulous, wealthy, plump in thigh and neck, joyful. Trivedi: confident, rhythmic and sociable; with the Moon here one often chooses very different partners, leading to conflict, most of all in the Capricorn part.
nakshatra/dhanishta.as_lagna: Trivedi: a rich, radiant, confident expression and a captivating smile, sometimes roving eyes; good conversationalists, especially in the Aquarius part.

Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu here, especially in Capricorn and linked to the 7th, make married life difficult (Trivedi)
the Moon and Mars do better in the Capricorn part; Mercury, Venus and Rahu in the Aquarius part; Saturn slows success (Trivedi)

padas.1: 23°20'-26°40' Capricorn, Leo navamsha (Sun): ambitious, easy success and limelight; not good for marriage (Trivedi).
padas.2: 26°40'-30°00' Capricorn, Virgo navamsha (Mercury): skilful, adaptable, musical and athletic; not good for marital harmony (Trivedi).
padas.3: 0°00'-3°20' Aquarius, Libra navamsha (Venus): sociable, musical, wealthy; promotes marital harmony; most refined pada (Trivedi).
padas.4: 3°20'-6°40' Aquarius, Scorpio navamsha (Mars): martial energy, drumming, sport; not good for marriage (Trivedi). Raman: Nakshatra Panchaka begins with Dhanishta's 3rd quarter.

nakshatra/dhanishta.disagreements: Marriage: Hora Sara (loss of the spouse) and Trivedi (discord) are negative, while Brihat Jataka and Jataka Parijata are silent on marriage. Trivedi notes the gana is Rakshasa despite the nakshatra's generous qualities.
nakshatra/dhanishta.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Present the marital note as a need for patience and compatibility, never as a forecast of separation or a spouse's death.

nakshatra/shatabhisha.summary: Shatabhisha (6°40'-20°00' Aquarius, ruled by Rahu, deity Varuna) gives frank or harsh speech, daring, victory over enemies, secrecy and a reclusive, healing, truth-seeking bent.
common_outcomes: speaks frankly, may fall into vices, hardworking, bold, destroys enemies, hard to fathom (BJ 16.13)
harsh-spoken or garrulous, cunning, dependent, wealthy, fickle, stingy, destroys enemies (HS 28.24)
an astrologer, tranquil, eats sparingly, daring (JP 9.89)
secretive, suspicious, reclusive, analytical (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: loses sons and brothers (HS 28.24)
with the 2nd lord here, loss of wealth or family at some stage (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Frank to harsh in speech and daring (BJ, HS, JP); Trivedi: secretive, suspicious, reclusive and intellectual, with sudden outbursts.
by_area.career: Astrology (JP 9.89); Trivedi: technology, electricity, media, medicine (including radiation and chemotherapy), astronomy, aviation.
by_area.finance: Wealthy but stingy (HS 28.24); Trivedi: tends to make a 'zero' of what it touches materially.
by_area.health: Trivedi: vulnerability to addictions and mental strain in its negative form.
by_area.relationships: Trivedi: draws hard-to-cross boundaries around itself.
by_area.family: Loss of sons and brothers (HS 28.24); Trivedi: does not promote childbirth when linked to the 5th house or Jupiter.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi: power of healing; capacity for solitude, contemplation and meditation.

strengtheners: Mercury, Venus and Rahu do best; Saturn does well but can make one melancholic (Trivedi)
pada 3 is vargottama and often good materially (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: pada 4 can bring intoxication or confusion (Trivedi)
a girl born in Shatabhisha is listed among those to avoid in marriage (HS 28.29) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
nakshatra/shatabhisha.lagna_or_context_notes: Falls within Raman's Nakshatra Panchaka (third quarter of Dhanishta to end of Revati) for elections.

attributes.deity: Varuna (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi)
attributes.symbol: an empty circle (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): a hundred stars resembling a flower
attributes.gana: Rakshasa (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: horse, female (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi gives mare
attributes.nature: chara (movable) (BS 98.11; Raman Muhurta). Trivedi: active, tamasic, upward, neutral gender, butcher caste.

nakshatra/shatabhisha.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.13): frank in speech, prone to vices, hardworking and bold, a destroyer of enemies, hard to pin down. Hora Sara (28.24): foul-mouthed or garrulous, a cheat and a dependent, loses sons and brothers, wealthy, fickle, miserly and cunning, destroys enemies. Jataka Parijata (9.89): an astrologer, tranquil, sparing in diet and daring. Trivedi: secrecy above all; suspicious, solitary and analytical; blurts out harsh truths; a healer and truth-seeker at its best.
nakshatra/shatabhisha.as_lagna: Trivedi: magnetic without conventional charm, often unkempt; calm, shy and reserved with occasional explosions; absent-minded and aloof. His example: Ramakrishna Paramahansa with lagna, Sun and Mercury here.
planets_in_it: the 2nd lord here may bring a period of poverty or loss of family (Trivedi)
Mercury, Venus and Rahu do best; Saturn does well but melancholic (Trivedi)
Rahu-Saturn conjunctions carry its energy (Trivedi)

padas.1: 6°40'-10°00' Aquarius, Sagittarius navamsha (Jupiter): optimistic, philanthropic, can be fanatical (Trivedi).
padas.2: 10°00'-13°20' Aquarius, Capricorn navamsha (Saturn): practical and organisational; watch excess ambition (Trivedi).
padas.3: 13°20'-16°40' Aquarius, Aquarius navamsha (Saturn): visionary, philosophical, can be eccentric; vargottama, good materially (Trivedi).
padas.4: 16°40'-20°00' Aquarius, Pisces navamsha (Jupiter): healing and compassion, or confusion and intoxication; good for imaginative work (Trivedi).

nakshatra/shatabhisha.disagreements: Jataka Parijata gives a tranquil, abstemious astrologer, while Hora Sara gives a harsh, cunning and miserly person; Brihat Jataka sits between (frank, bold, possibly vice-prone). Trivedi quotes Varahamihira as 'truthful but harsh', which differs in wording from the siva.sh rendering.
nakshatra/shatabhisha.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Frame harsh speech as frankness and solitude as a strength for research and healing; drop the gendered marriage verse unless asked about tradition.

nakshatra/purva_bhadrapada.summary: Purva Bhadrapada (20°00' Aquarius-3°20' Pisces, ruled by Jupiter, deity Aja Ekapada) gives cleverness and wealth with grief, stinginess and an intense, ascetic, two-sided nature.
common_outcomes: troubled, dominated by the spouse, wealthy, clever but miserly (BJ 16.13)
no fixed residence, hard to win over, enjoys, gets money from the ruler, long-lived, dutiful (HS 28.25)
bold in speech, mischievous, timid and weak (JP 9.90)
devoted, hardworking and persevering, but drawn to extremes (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: adulterous and base (HS 28.25)
places all wealth at the disposal of spouse or teacher (Trivedi, quoting Varahamihira)

by_area.personality: Clever but stingy and troubled (BJ); bold in speech yet timid (JP); Trivedi: intense, devoted, persevering and two-faced, with a strong capacity for regret and revenge.
by_area.career: Trivedi: work around death and medicine (surgeons, morticians), research, occult work.
by_area.finance: Wealthy and stingy (BJ 16.13; Trivedi); money from the ruler (HS 28.25).
by_area.relationships: Dominated by or devoted to the spouse (BJ 16.13; Trivedi).
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi: the energy of extreme penance; must choose the right object of devotion.

strengtheners: only a well-aspected, well-fortified Jupiter is good here; Saturn is acceptable if Jupiter is strong; a well-placed Ketu in the Pisces part gives detachment (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: most planets do not fare well here (Trivedi)
Saturn-Ketu conjunction relates to this nakshatra's harsher side (Trivedi)
nakshatra/purva_bhadrapada.lagna_or_context_notes: Within Raman's Nakshatra Panchaka for elections.

attributes.deity: Aja Ekapada, the one-footed goat or unborn one (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi)
attributes.symbol: front part of a funeral cot (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): with Uttara Bhadrapada, four stars resembling the legs of a cot
attributes.gana: Manushya (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: lion, male (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives lion
attributes.nature: ugra (fierce) (BS 98.8; Raman Muhurta 'dreadful'; Trivedi). Trivedi: passive, sattvic, downward, male, Brahmin caste.
attributes.sign_span: 20°00' Aquarius-3°20' Pisces; padas 1-3 in Aquarius, pada 4 in Pisces

nakshatra/purva_bhadrapada.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.13): troubled, ruled by the spouse, wealthy, clever but stingy. Hora Sara (28.25): adulterous, without fixed residence, hard to win over, pleasure-loving, gets money from the ruler, base but dutiful and long-lived. Jataka Parijata (9.90): bold in speech, mischievous, cowardly and weak. Trivedi quotes Varahamihira as: good at earning, stingy, places wealth at the partner's disposal, speaks distinctly, suffers grief. Trivedi: the most intense nakshatra; persevering and devoted, but with a hidden, extreme side.
nakshatra/purva_bhadrapada.as_lagna: Trivedi: hard to tell apart in daily life; a highly strung, nervous, serious look; likely to snap first in confrontation while acting amiable socially.
planets_in_it: few planets fare well; only a well-aspected, well-fortified Jupiter is good; Saturn is acceptable if Jupiter is well placed; Ketu in the Pisces part gives positive detachment (Trivedi)
conjunctions of Mars, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu in harsh nakshatras carry similar energy (Trivedi)

padas.1: 20°00'-23°20' Aquarius, Aries navamsha (Mars): most aggressive; determination; control temper (Trivedi).
padas.2: 23°20'-26°40' Aquarius, Taurus navamsha (Venus): indulgent and earthy (Trivedi).
padas.3: 26°40'-30°00' Aquarius, Gemini navamsha (Mercury): communicative and curious; the lightest pada (Trivedi).
padas.4: 0°00'-3°20' Pisces, Cancer navamsha (Moon): extremely benign or extremely dangerous; most socially adept (Trivedi).

nakshatra/purva_bhadrapada.disagreements: Jataka Parijata calls the native timid and weak, whereas Hora Sara and Trivedi describe someone hard to win over and persevering. Hora Sara alone promises long life and money from the ruler. Trivedi's strongly negative portrait goes well beyond the classical one-line results.
nakshatra/purva_bhadrapada.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Trivedi's language here is extreme; do not pass on labels such as 'diabolical'. Frame it as intensity, devotion and a need to channel strong energy constructively.

nakshatra/uttara_bhadrapada.summary: Uttara Bhadrapada (3°20'-16°40' Pisces, ruled by Saturn, deity Ahirbudhnya) gives eloquence, happiness, many children, virtue and victory over enemies, with calm, patient wisdom.
common_outcomes: eloquent, happy, many children, subdues enemies, religious (BJ 16.14)
good speaker, happy, has children, virtuous (HS 28.26)
gentle, liberal, opulent and learned (JP 9.90)
calm, compassionate, restrained; a good counsellor (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: permanent enemies, timidity and greed for money (HS 28.26)
benefits from gifts, donations and inheritance (Trivedi)
laziness or premature withdrawal from worldly duties (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Eloquent, gentle and virtuous (BJ, HS, JP); Trivedi: the 'wise old one', calm, never hasty, sometimes too slow.
by_area.career: Trivedi: counselling and therapy, yoga and meditation, charity, occult sciences, filmmaking.
by_area.finance: Opulent (JP 9.90); greedy to accumulate (HS); Trivedi: usually fortunate with money, gains from gifts and inheritance.
by_area.family: Many children and grandchildren (BJ 16.14; HS 28.26; Trivedi quoting Varahamihira).
by_area.spirituality: Religious (BJ); Trivedi: always some seeking of higher awareness; linked to the retiring stage of life (vanaprastha).

strengtheners: active planets such as the Sun, Mars and Rahu do best here; Saturn does well when aspected by Mars or Jupiter (Trivedi)
any planet here makes this inert nakshatra dynamic (Trivedi)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn-Ketu conjunction relates more to Purva Bhadrapada (Trivedi)
nakshatra/uttara_bhadrapada.lagna_or_context_notes: Within Raman's Nakshatra Panchaka for elections.

attributes.deity: Ahirbudhnya, the serpent of the depths (BS 98.4-5; Raman Muhurta; PVR; Trivedi)
attributes.symbol: back part of a funeral cot (Trivedi); Raman (HPA): with Purva Bhadrapada, four stars resembling the legs of a cot
attributes.gana: Manushya (Raman Muhurta; Trivedi)
attributes.yoni: cow, female (Raman Muhurta); Trivedi also gives cow
attributes.nature: dhruva (fixed) (BS 98.6; Raman Muhurta; Trivedi). Trivedi: balanced, tamasic, upward, male, Kshatriya caste.

nakshatra/uttara_bhadrapada.as_moon: Varahamihira (BJ 16.14): eloquent and happy, with many children, subdues enemies and is religious. Hora Sara (28.26): a good speaker, happy, has children and lasting enemies, virtuous, but timid and greedy to amass money. Jataka Parijata (9.90): gentle in nature, liberal, opulent and learned. Trivedi: patient wisdom; reasonable, compassionate and restrained, a natural counsellor, though prone to delay and inertia.
nakshatra/uttara_bhadrapada.as_lagna: Trivedi: a serene, calm face; often a large frame with broad shoulders, short with a tendency to gain weight; shy and unhurried. His example: Rabindranath Tagore with this nakshatra rising.
planets_in_it: the Sun, Mars and Rahu do best; Saturn does well if aspected by Mars or Jupiter; Jupiter, Mercury and Venus do well when associated with active planets (Trivedi)
Jupiter-Saturn conjunction carries its energy (Trivedi)

padas.1: 3°20'-6°40' Pisces, Leo navamsha (Sun): active, proud, achievement-oriented; spreads the light of experience (Trivedi).
padas.2: 6°40'-10°00' Pisces, Virgo navamsha (Mercury): analytical and planning; planets stay in the background (Trivedi).
padas.3: 10°00'-13°20' Pisces, Libra navamsha (Venus): passive and balance-seeking; may lack drive to make findings known (Trivedi).
padas.4: 13°20'-16°40' Pisces, Scorpio navamsha (Mars): occult and intense; extremes of confusion or wisdom (Trivedi).

nakshatra/revati.summary: Revati (16°40'-30°00' Pisces, ruled by Mercury, deity Pushan) gives a well-formed body, good fortune, purity, courage and wealth, with a gentle, sociable, nurturing nature; its end meets Ashwini at a gandanta junction.
common_outcomes: well-formed body, fortunate, brave, pure and wealthy (BJ 16.14, from the Sanskrit; the English is cut off)
full span of life, fortunate, self-respecting, spirited and courageous (HS 28.27)
loving, attractive, clever in counsel, with sons, family and friends and steady prosperity (JP 9.90)
kind, helpful, sociable, optimistic; supported when most in need (Trivedi)
rare_outcomes: at the disposal of women; spiteful (HS 28.27)
a broad mark on the body (JP 9.90)
living in self-made illusions (Trivedi)

by_area.personality: Pure, fortunate and courageous (BJ, HS); Trivedi: benevolent, refined, optimistic and charming, but can over-rely on faith and fantasy.
by_area.career: Trivedi: arts, acting, entertainment, counselling, linguistics, and time-related sciences such as astrology (pada 2).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BJ); steady, continuous prosperity (JP 9.90); Trivedi: easy money and comfort.
by_area.health: Full span of life (HS 28.27).
by_area.relationships: Friends and family (JP 9.90); Trivedi: socialite and good host, long friendships.
by_area.family: Sons, family and friends (JP 9.90); Trivedi: often a good childhood and refined family.
by_area.spirituality: Trivedi: summation of all nakshatras; Ketu here suits spiritual pursuits.

strengtheners: Jupiter, Mercury, Venus and the Moon usually do well (Trivedi)
Saturn's aspect grounds it (e.g. Jupiter here aspected by Saturn gives the expansive benefits) (Trivedi)
Venus in the lagna in Revati makes one a ruler (Saravali 35.148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: birth at the very end (Revati-Ashwini gandanta) is treated as inauspicious (JP 9.45; HS 1.14; Saravali 3.20-21)
4th quarter of Revati: parent of the corresponding sex is endangered (JP 9.61-63) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
Jupiter here without Saturn's aspect may lean to idle fantasy (Trivedi)

Hora Sara (28.27): long-lived, fortunate, under women's influence, self-respecting and proud, spirited, very courageous and spiteful. Jataka Parijata (9.90): a broad mark on the body, love-sick, lovely, clever in counsel, with sons, family and friends and steady prosperity. Trivedi: one of the most benevolent nakshatras; optimistic, supportive, refined and sociable, but dreamy and easily hurt.
nakshatra/revati.as_lagna: Trivedi: a lustrous, ample body and a smiling, light-hearted manner. His example: Dolly Parton with Revati rising; Tagore had the Moon here.
planets_in_it: the Sun in Revati identical with the ascendant gives rule over a small country (Saravali 35.147)
Venus in the ascendant in Revati makes one a ruler (Saravali 35.148)
Venus reaches maximum exaltation in Revati (Trivedi, in the Purvashadha chapter)
Jupiter here does well when aspected by Saturn, otherwise tends to fantasy (Trivedi)
Jupiter, Mercury, Venus and the Moon usually do well; Ketu good for spiritual pursuits (Trivedi)

padas.2: 20°00'-23°20' Pisces, Capricorn navamsha (Saturn): practical and realistic; time-related sciences such as astrology (Trivedi).
padas.3: 23°20'-26°40' Pisces, Aquarius navamsha (Saturn): bohemian and humanitarian; hard to express materially (Trivedi).
padas.4: 26°40'-30°00' Pisces, Pisces navamsha (Jupiter): the eternal dreamer; good material results only with Mars or Saturn here (Trivedi). JP 9.61-63: birth with the Moon in the 4th quarter endangers the father or mother according to the child's sex [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]; JP 9.57: birth in the last quarter brings loss to mother, father and child [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]. Ends at the Revati-Ashwini gandanta.

nakshatra/revati.disagreements: Deity: Pushan in Raman, PVR and Trivedi; the Iyer table renders it 'Puṣya'. Hora Sara adds spite and being ruled by women to otherwise favourable results. Gandanta extent differs: one ghatika (Hora Sara), a span of ghatikas (JP 9.45), the end of Pisces (Saravali); Santhanam's note cites Lagnachandrika's last five ghatis of Revati.
nakshatra/revati.phrasing_guidance: Describe tendencies, not fixed fate; the nakshatra is one factor among many (sign, house, aspects, dasha). Classical one-line Moon-nakshatra results are short lists of traits: present the positive ones as potentials and the negative ones as things to watch. Never state death, harm to relatives, or disease as a prediction. Lead with good fortune, kindness and refinement. For births in the gandanta or 4th-quarter portion, mention only that tradition prescribes shanti rites; never suggest danger to parents.

rising_sign/aries.summary: Aries rising is classically read as a lean, quick, combative and self-willed person, brave but hot-tempered and restless. For this lagna the Sun and Jupiter are the main helpers, Mars as lagna lord supports them, and Saturn, Mercury and Venus are counted as difficult; Venus is the main maraka.
common_outcomes: Brave, enterprising and independent, with a quick temper and a dislike of being directed (PD 9.1; JP 9.104; HJH; Frawley).
Restless or always on the move (PD 9.1: always on his legs; JP 9.104: wandering habits).
Lean or middle stature, round eyes, weak knees noted by Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata; Raman adds a long face and neck and a mark or scar on the head.
Liable to cuts, bruises and wounds and to complaints of the head when Aries is afflicted (PD 9.1; BR Mesha st. 5; HJH).
rare_outcomes: Bhavartha Ratnakara (Mesha st. 22): baths in the Ganges in the periods of Venus, Jupiter and the Sun if all three are in the 10th.
Jataka Parijata 9.104: hostile to relatives and of uncertain wealth.
Raman: mental strain is possible if Saturn and the Moon are both in Aries (HJH ch. IV).

by_area.personality: Fierce, proud, quick-tempered and quarrelsome yet heroic (JP 9.104); fickle and impatient (PD 9.1); independent, courageous, ambitious, stubborn but frank, goes to extremes (HJH); dynamic, competitive, lives in the head, strategic, can be self-centred (Frawley p. 117).
by_area.career: Enterprising, able to plan, drawn to scientific thought (HJH); good at research, invention and new ideas (Frawley p. 117).
by_area.finance: Possessed of uncertain wealth (JP 9.104). Self-earned fortune if Mars and Venus are in the 7th (BR Mesha st. 15); the Sun, Mercury and Venus in the 11th give fortune in their periods (BR Mesha st. 20).
by_area.health: Fear of eruptive fevers (smallpox), weapons and wounds (BR Mesha st. 5); bruised limbs (PD 9.1); head complaints when Aries is afflicted and a hot constitution (HJH); Mercury and Mars in the 6th give wounds and skin eruptions in their periods (BR Mesha st. 14).
by_area.relationships: Longs for women (PD 9.1); Frawley says Aries types benefit from relationships to balance their self-focus (p. 117).
by_area.family: Hostile to relatives (JP 9.104). Raman notes Parasara and Lomasa hold that the lagna lord in the 5th gives little happiness from children (BR Mesha notes to st. 12).
by_area.spirituality: Frawley: growth comes from using a sharp mind to seek truth rather than to promote oneself (p. 117).

strengtheners: Bhavartha Ratnakara: the lords of the 4th and 5th (Moon and Sun) together give Raja Yoga (Mesha st. 1); the Sun or Moon in Cancer gives Raja Yoga (st. 21); the Sun aspected by Jupiter becomes a yogakaraka (st. 19).
The 2nd lord in the 12th is good only for Aries, because Venus is then exalted in Pisces (BR Mesha st. 7 and Raman's note).
Mars becomes a yoga-giver in the 2nd with Jupiter and Venus (st. 9), in the 4th with Jupiter (st. 11; Raman: neecha-bhanga) and in the 5th (st. 12).
Jupiter-Sun, Jupiter-Mars or Mars-Sun links are highly favourable for Aries (Santhanam's note on BPHS 34.19-22); Laghu Parashari notes list Sun+Mars, Sun+Moon, Mars+Jupiter as fruitful (Verma).
The lagna is strong when occupied or aspected by its own lord, Jupiter or Mercury, and not by other planets (Brihat Jataka 1.19).
Whatever a sign gives as lagna is also given, in a lesser way, when the Moon occupies it (Phaladeepika 9.13); the lagna and Moon should be read together.
Raman: the sign delineations hold for an empty lagna; planets in the 1st, the strength of the lagna lord and aspects on the lagna modify them (How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1, ch. IV, p. 25).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter and Saturn together (9th and 10th lords) do not give Raja Yoga because Saturn also owns the 11th (BPHS 34.19-22; LP Aries vv.; BR Mesha st. 4; HPA).

Jupiter gives bad results if under the control of a malefic (BPHS 34.19-22); Jupiter in the 11th gives no yoga in its period (BR Mesha st. 13); Jupiter in the 10th (debilitated) can act as a maraka (BR Mesha st. 3).
Mars in the 3rd with Jupiter and Venus gives no yoga (BR Mesha st. 10); Mars in the 8th gives no yoga by itself (st. 16).
Mars joined with the 6th lord can bring death through head disease in its period (BR Mesha st. 6) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].
Raman: when the Sun, Moon and lagna are afflicted by more than one malefic, proneness to accidents is indicated (How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1, ch. IV, p. 25-26).
BPHS 34.45-46 (Santhanam): lordship-based roles are only a frame; a planet that forms a strong yoga (e.g. a Nabhasa yoga) gives that yoga's results despite its role for the lagna.
rising_sign/aries.lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries the 9th lord Jupiter also owns the 12th and the 10th lord Saturn also owns the 11th, so the 9-10 combination is spoiled; the cleaner Raja Yoga for Aries comes from the Sun (5th) with the Moon (4th) or with Mars or Jupiter.

description_by_source.source: Frawley, Astrology of the Seers p. 117
description_by_source.description: Dynamic, aggressive, competitive, much initiative, penetrating perception, scientific and inventive, willful, can be self-centred.

yogakaraka: none by single lordship (PVR Table 30); Jupiter is called 'the yogakaraka' by Raman in HPA ch. XVII; the Sun becomes a yogakaraka when aspected by Jupiter (BR Mesha st. 19)
functional_benefics: Jupiter (BPHS 34.19-22; LP; HJH: best benefic; HPA; PVR)
Sun (BPHS 34.19-22; LP; HJH; HPA; PVR)
Mars, lagna lord, helpful to other good planets though also 8th lord (BPHS 34.19-22; HJH: next benefic after Jupiter; PVR)
functional_malefics: Saturn, 10th and 11th lord (BPHS 34.19-22; LP; HJH; HPA; PVR)
Mercury, 3rd and 6th lord (BPHS; LP; HJH: the greatest malefic; HPA; PVR)
Venus, 2nd and 7th lord (BPHS; LP; HJH; HPA; PVR)
neutral_or_mixed: Moon, 4th lord: not discussed by Parasara; mixed by association (Santhanam's note); auspicious if weak (Verma's LP note); not listed for movable lagnas by PVR because it depends on waxing or waning
marakas: Venus: direct or independent killer (BPHS 34.19-22); maraka (BR Mesha st. 2) [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death]
Saturn and Mercury kill when associated with Venus (BPHS 34.19-22); Laghu Parashari ranks Saturn, Mercury, Venus as marakas in reducing order
Jupiter becomes a maraka if in the 10th (BR Mesha st. 3)
functional_roles.notes: Raja Yoga for Aries is said to arise from the Sun and Moon combined (BR Mesha st. 1; Frawley p. 161).

source_views.source: BPHS ch. 34 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) vv. 19-22
source_views.view: Jupiter and the Sun are auspicious; Saturn, Mercury and Venus malefic; Mars, though 8th lord, helps good planets; Jupiter-Saturn conjunction gives no good; Jupiter under a malefic gives bad results; Venus is an independent killer and Saturn and others kill if joined to him [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death].

source_views.source: BPHS ch. 4 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) vv. 4-7
source_views.view: Aries is the head of Kalapurusha; movable, male, bilious; blood-red, large-bodied, quadruped, night-strong, courageous, eastern, royal, hill-roaming, rajasic, rises with its back, fiery, ruled by Mars.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka ch. 1 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) vv. 4, 10, 20
source_views.view: Aries governs the head; a nocturnal, back-rising sign; colour red.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 9 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) v. 1; Phaladeepika 1 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) vv. 4-9
source_views.view: Aries rising gives round eyes, weak knees, fierceness, fear of water, sparing diet, restlessness, fickleness and bruised limbs; Aries is movable, cruel, male, abode a forest.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 9 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) v. 104
source_views.view: Hostile to relatives, wandering, lean, irritable, quarrelsome, proud, weak-kneed, uncertain wealth, heroic.

source_views.source: Laghu Parashari / Jataka Chandrika ch. 5 (tr. and notes O.P. Verma), Aries vv. 43-46
source_views.view: Saturn, Mercury and Venus inauspicious, Jupiter and Sun auspicious; Saturn-Jupiter gives no yoga; the verse that Venus does not kill though a maraka is judged corrupt by Verma, who calls Venus a strong maraka in the 2nd or 7th.

source_views.source: Bhavartha Ratnakara ch. 1 (tr. and notes B.V. Raman, 2nd ed. 1947), Mesha st. 1-22
source_views.view: Moon-Sun gives Raja Yoga; Venus is a maraka; Jupiter is a maraka in the 10th; Jupiter-Saturn no Raja Yoga; fear of pox, weapons, wounds; 2nd lord in the 12th is good only here; many placements of Mars that make or break yoga. Raman's notes: Keraleeya names Mercury and Saturn as marakas; in his experience several Aries natives died in Venus dasa.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1, ch. II p. 13 and ch. IV p. 26
source_views.view: Jupiter best benefic, then Mars; Saturn, Mercury and Venus malefic, Mercury the worst. Aries rising: courageous, independent, enterprising, quick-tempered; head troubles if afflicted.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XVII (Key-Planets for Each Sign), pp. 134-137
source_views.view: Saturn, Mercury and Venus ill-disposed; Jupiter and Sun auspicious; Jupiter the yogakaraka; Jupiter-Saturn gives no benefit; Venus as maraka will not kill but Saturn and similar planets can.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, pp. 117, 161
source_views.view: Aries types are dynamic, competitive, strategic and headstrong; for Aries and Scorpio, Raja Yoga comes from the Sun with the Moon.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach, sec. 13.2, Table 30
source_views.view: Functional benefics Sun, Mars, Jupiter; malefics Mercury, Venus, Saturn; no yogakaraka; Moon not listed for movable lagnas.

rising_sign/aries.disagreements: Venus as killer: BPHS 34 makes Venus an independent killer; Raman (BR notes) reports Parasara and Keraleeya saying Venus alone cannot kill, and HPA says Venus as maraka will not kill; Verma rejects that reading as corrupt; Raman's own experience is that Aries natives have died in Venus dasa. Jupiter: auspicious in BPHS, Raman's yogakaraka in HPA, but a maraka in the 10th per Bhavartha Ratnakara. Mercury vs Saturn as worst malefic: HJH names Mercury; Santhanam's note on BPHS stresses Saturn's 11th (moolatrikona) lordship. Moon: BPHS silent; Verma counts a weak Moon auspicious.
rising_sign/aries.phrasing_guidance: Describe the rising sign as a tendency, not a fixed fate; blend it with planets in the 1st house, the lagna lord and the Moon sign. Name functional roles plainly (e.g. 'Saturn tends to work in your favour') and never turn maraka lore into a death or illness prediction; skip old caste, gender and fidelity stereotypes from the classical lists.

rising_sign/taurus.summary: Taurus rising is classically read as a steady, enduring, pleasure-loving and generous person, attached to land, cattle, comfort and beauty, and happier in the middle and later parts of life. Saturn (9th and 10th lord) is the yogakaraka for most authorities, while Jupiter, the Moon and Venus are counted as difficult.
common_outcomes: Patient and enduring; bears hardship and forgives (PD 9.2; HJH; Frawley).
Fond of comfort, beauty, music and pleasure (PD 9.2; HJH; Frawley).
Linked with agriculture, cattle and property (PD 9.2; JP 9.104; Frawley p. 118).
Obstinate and slow to move once committed (HJH; Frawley).
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 9.2: marks or moles on the back, face or sides.
Bhavartha Ratnakara (Vrishabha st. 2): Rahu in the 10th, or Mars and Jupiter in Capricorn, gives baths in sacred rivers.
Raman: nervous complaints are common after about fifty (HJH ch. IV).

by_area.personality: Forgiving, liberal, enduring, fond of young women (PD 9.2); respectful to elders and Brahmanas, fond of debate, wandering, fortunate, calm (JP 9.104); obstinate, proud, ambitious, open to flattery but affectionate, self-reliant, with a piercing intellect and great endurance (HJH); stable, fixed, sensual, possessive, slow to anger and slow to forgive (Frawley p. 118).
by_area.career: Agriculture (PD 9.2); business, banking or property, artistic and poetic work (Frawley p. 118); sees himself as born to exercise authority (HJH).
by_area.finance: Plenty of wealth in Venus dasa (BR Vrishabha st. 13); Jupiter and Mercury joined or in mutual aspect give Dhana Yoga, spoiled if Mars joins or aspects (st. 5-6); the Moon in the lagna reduces wealth (st. 14); Mars dasa gives financial gain (st. 8).
by_area.health: Plump thighs and a large face (PD 9.2); Raman: stout or corpulent tendency and nervous complaints after fifty (HJH).
by_area.relationships: Fond of young women (PD 9.2); lustful (JP 9.104); values marriage and a stable home, romantic (Frawley p. 118).
by_area.family: Few sons (JP 9.104); not much happiness from children (HJH).
by_area.spirituality: Pays homage to elders and Brahmanas (JP 9.104); devotional, drawn to tradition and ritual (Frawley p. 118).

strengtheners: Saturn alone gives Raja Yoga (BPHS 34.23-24; LP Taurus vv. 47-48; HPA); Raman (after B. Suryanarayana Rao) says Saturn is best in the 10th (BR notes).
Mercury joining Saturn or the Sun acts more effectively (Santhanam's note on BPHS 34.23-24); Saturn + Mercury is the best yoga for Taurus (Verma's LP note).
The Moon in the 4th, or aspected by Jupiter or Mercury, can give yoga (BR Vrishabha st. 3).
Mars in the 7th becomes benefic (BR Vrishabha st. 4); Jupiter, Mercury and Mars linked together become yoga-givers (st. 7); Mercury in a kendra gives yoga in its period (st. 8).
Venus and Mercury in the lagna with Jupiter in the 7th gives a powerful yoga in Mercury dasa (BR Vrishabha st. 9).
The lagna is strong when occupied or aspected by its own lord, Jupiter or Mercury, and not by other planets (Brihat Jataka 1.19).
Whatever a sign gives as lagna is also given, in a lesser way, when the Moon occupies it (Phaladeepika 9.13); the lagna and Moon should be read together.
Raman: the sign delineations hold for an empty lagna; planets in the 1st, the strength of the lagna lord and aspects on the lagna modify them (How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1, ch. IV, p. 25).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter, 8th and 11th lord, is the first-rate adversary (Santhanam's note on BPHS 34.23-24).
The Dhana Yoga of Jupiter and Mercury fails if Mars joins or aspects them (BR Vrishabha st. 6).
The Moon in the lagna does not give much wealth for Taurus, though it helps other lagnas (BR Vrishabha st. 14-15).
Raman/Suryanarayana Rao: Saturn may give Raja Yoga without letting the native hold on to the gains; Saturn in the 2nd is destructive (BR notes).
Raman: when the Sun, Moon and lagna are afflicted by more than one malefic, proneness to accidents is indicated (How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1, ch. IV, p. 25-26).
BPHS 34.45-46 (Santhanam): lordship-based roles are only a frame; a planet that forms a strong yoga (e.g. a Nabhasa yoga) gives that yoga's results despite its role for the lagna.
rising_sign/taurus.lagna_or_context_notes: Saturn owns the best trine (9th) and the best angle (10th) for Taurus, hence its reputation as the strongest yogakaraka of the zodiac (Santhanam; Verma). Venus as lagna lord also owns the 6th (its moolatrikona Libra), which is why several texts do not count it as a benefic.

attributes.body_part: face (BPHS 4.4; BJ 1.4; PD 1.4); face and neck (Frawley p. 117)

description_by_source.description: Owns many cows, reveres elders and Brahmanas, fond of learned debate, wandering, fortunate, lustful, calm, few sons.

description_by_source.source: Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. IV p. 26
description_by_source.description: Obstinate, proud, ambitious, affectionate; short, stout, square build, large eyes; self-reliant, enduring, magnetic, fond of music and pleasure.

description_by_source.source: Frawley, Astrology of the Seers pp. 117-118
description_by_source.description: Stable, enduring, fixed; sense of form and beauty; possessive and materialistic; good memory; values marriage and home; devotional.

yogakaraka: Saturn, 9th and 10th lord (BPHS 34.23-24; LP; HJH; HPA; PVR; Raman, HJH ch. II p. 15) - but Bhavartha Ratnakara (Vrishabha st. 1) denies it
functional_benefics: Saturn (all except BR)
Sun, 4th lord (BPHS 34.23-24 auspicious; HJH; PVR; Laghu Parashari editions differ: auspicious or neutral)
Mercury, 2nd and 5th lord (BPHS: somewhat auspicious; LP: auspicious; HJH; PVR)
Mars per HJH only (owner of 7th and 12th)
functional_malefics: Jupiter, 8th and 11th lord (BPHS; LP; HJH; HPA; PVR)

rising_sign/taurus.disagreements: Saturn: the author of Bhavartha Ratnakara denies Saturn yogakaraka status for Taurus; Parasara, Laghu Parashari, Raman, PVR all affirm it, and Raman explains the dissent as Saturn granting status without letting it be kept. Sun: auspicious in BPHS and HJH; neutral in some LP readings. Mars: benefic (HJH), neutral (PVR, Verma), killer (BPHS).
