source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 4 (First House)
source_views.view: Body stout if Jupiter aspects the lagna from a watery sign; in charts Jupiter's aspect gives fair complexion, large eyes, dignified stature, corpulence.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 2 ch. XII (Eighth House)
source_views.view: Balarishta rule naming the absence of Jupiter's aspect on malefics in the lagna.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Jupiter aspects the 5th and 9th besides the 7th; results vary with the dignities of aspecting and aspected planets, but Jupiter's aspect as a natural benefic is weighty even when he is temporarily ill-disposed.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

aspect/jupiter/2.summary: Jupiter, the significator of wealth, aspecting the 2nd makes earnings good even against afflictions there, and his aspect on the 2nd from the Moon brings plenty of wealth.
common_outcomes: if Jupiter aspects the 2nd, earnings will be good, with money through friends and business (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5, under Rahu in the 2nd)
exalted Jupiter aspecting the 2nd makes the house very strong (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5, chart notes)
the 2nd from the Moon aspected by Venus or another benefic such as Jupiter: plenty of wealth (Saravali 34.15-20)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: earned wealth is lost (Saravali 34.15-20) - Mercury's aspect on Jupiter, recorded under aspect/mercury/2.

by_area.finance: Good earnings and accumulated wealth (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5; Saravali 34.15-20).

strengtheners: Jupiter exalted (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5 chart notes).

aspect/jupiter/5.summary: Jupiter, the significator of children, aspecting the 5th is the classic support for children and intelligence: many children with Mercury and Venus, doubled count, and protection of children against Mars there.
common_outcomes: many children when the 5th lord is strong and the 5th is aspected by strong Mercury, Jupiter and Venus (BPHS 16.12)
benefic aspect on the 5th gives children and doubles their count (Saravali 34.25-27)
Mars in the 5th aspected by Jupiter or Venus: loss limited to the first child (Saravali 34.41; Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8 repeats that the first child is at risk)
Jupiter's aspect on the 5th is a redeeming feature against malefics (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8 and ch. 10, chart notes)
rare_outcomes: Mercury in the 5th well aspected by Jupiter: gains through speculation and authorship (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8).
Frawley p. 154: Jupiter in the 5th is not good for children, but his aspect on it is.

by_area.personality: Good judgement and intelligence (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8).
by_area.finance: Gains through speculation and writing (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8).
by_area.family: Children and joy through them (BPHS 16.12; Saravali 34.25-27).

strengtheners: Strong Mercury and Venus also aspecting (BPHS 16.12).
Frawley p. 154: the significator's aspect rather than occupation.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Three malefics in the 5th are not counterbalanced by Jupiter's aspect alone (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8, chart notes).
aspect/jupiter/5.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter aspects house 5 fully from the 11th (7th aspect), the 1st (5th aspect) and the 9th (9th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 5th and 9th aspects full for Jupiter; Brihat Jataka 2.13 calls Jupiter auspicious in them.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 16.12
source_views.view: Many children if the 5th lord is strong while the 5th is aspected by strong Mercury, Jupiter and Venus.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.25-27, 34.41
source_views.view: Benefic aspect on the 5th gives children and doubles their number; Mars in the 5th kills children as born, but with Jupiter's or Venus's aspect only the first child is lost, and with all planets aspecting none.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 8 (Fifth House), rules and chart notes
source_views.view: Jupiter's aspect on the 5th good, Mars's bad; well aspected by Jupiter favours gain through speculation and authorship; Jupiter's aspect alone cannot offset three malefics.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers p. 154
source_views.view: It is usually good if the significator of a house aspects that house, not good if it occupies it (e.g. Jupiter in the 5th is not good for children).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1950) 4.11
source_views.view: In completely warding off evil and promoting prosperity Jupiter is the most powerful planet; Mercury and Venus have smaller shares of that power (fractions illegible in the scan).

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Jupiter aspects the 5th and 9th besides the 7th; results vary with the dignities of aspecting and aspected planets, but Jupiter's aspect as a natural benefic is weighty even when he is temporarily ill-disposed.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

aspect/jupiter/5.disagreements: Frawley prefers Jupiter's aspect over his occupation of the 5th; BPHS 16 does not draw that distinction. Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. Phaladeepika 4.9: some hold only the 7th aspect fully effective, others hold the special aspects equally effective. Raman (HPA XIII) and PVR (ch. 10) use only full aspects in practice.
aspect/jupiter/5.phrasing_guidance: Speak of blessings through children, learning and creativity; never promise a number of children. Describe Jupiter's aspect as protection, growth, wisdom and blessing on that house; keep it hopeful but not a guarantee.

effects: the house is protected and its matters prosper when aspected by its own lord, even if malefics also influence it
conditional_results.source: BPHS 11.14-16 with Santhanam's notes; Phaladeepika 15.1; Raman HPA ch. XIII

effects: the good results of the aspect are not ensured when the aspecting planet is debilitated, combust or in an enemy sign
the aspect is good by nature but mixed, because Jupiter is a functional malefic for this lagna (Raman's example: aspect on the 4th for Aquarius lagna, where Jupiter rules 2 and 11)
conditional_results.source: Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 2 and ch. 7 chart notes

effects: as a natural benefic owning only angles Jupiter becomes a functional malefic (kendradhipati dosha)
Jupiter's protective aspect is at its best as lagna or trine lord
conditional_results.source: Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 2; vol. 2 ch. XIV chart notes (9th-lord Jupiter aspecting the 10th)

aspect/jupiter/6.summary: As the strongest benefic, Jupiter aspecting the 6th removes fear of enemies and gives some relief in disease combinations.
common_outcomes: benefic aspect on the 6th keeps one free from fear of enemies (Saravali 34.43-44)
Jupiter's aspect gives slight relief to an afflicted 6th-lord combination (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 9, chart notes)
rare_outcomes: Sun aspected by Jupiter: success and promotion in the Sun's sub-period (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 9) - aspect on the Sun, not the house.

by_area.career: Victory over rivals (Saravali 34.43-44).
by_area.health: Relief and recovery (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 9).

aspect/jupiter/6.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter aspects house 6 fully from the 12th (7th aspect), the 2nd (5th aspect) and the 10th (9th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 5th and 9th aspects full for Jupiter; Brihat Jataka 2.13 calls Jupiter auspicious in them.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.43-44
source_views.view: Benefics occupying or aspecting the 6th keep one free from fear of enemies.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 9 (Sixth House), chart notes
source_views.view: Slight relief as Jupiter aspects an afflicted combination involving the 6th lord.

aspect/jupiter/7.summary: Jupiter aspecting the 7th gives a spouse of Jupiter's nature and good background, protects marriage from break-up and adds stability.
common_outcomes: a spouse corresponding to Jupiter and the sign (Saravali 34.45)
Jupiter related to the 7th: a spouse of the same background (Saravali 34.49)
Jupiter's aspect on the 7th from the Moon prevented a complete break-up of a troubled marriage (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI, chart)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter aspecting Saturn in the 7th: stability with inner turmoil and resentment (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
Jupiter aspecting or with the Sun in the 7th: a spiritually evolved partner who guides the native (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
Mercury and Venus in the 7th with a benefic aspect: a wife at an advanced age instead of none (Saravali 34.56).
Jupiter and the Moon in mutual opposition: extremely good (Raman HPA ch. XIII).

by_area.relationships: Wise, ethical, supportive partner; resilience in marriage (Saravali 34.45-49; Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
by_area.spirituality: Partner may be spiritually inclined (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).

strengtheners: Jupiter's aspect fortifies Venus in such charts (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI chart notes).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter as 3rd and 6th or 6th and 9th lord is counted with reservation in Raman's chart notes (HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
aspect/jupiter/7.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter aspects house 7 fully from the 1st (7th aspect), the 3rd (5th aspect) and the 11th (9th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 5th and 9th aspects full for Jupiter; Brihat Jataka 2.13 calls Jupiter auspicious in them.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.45, 34.49, 34.56
source_views.view: Jupiter in or aspecting the 7th gives a wife after its nature; Jupiter and Venus related to the 7th give a bride of the same caste; benefic aspect rescues the Mercury-Venus-in-7th combination.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 2 ch. XI (Seventh House), rules and chart notes
source_views.view: Jupiter's aspect on the 7th from the Moon prevented a complete break-up; Jupiter aspecting Saturn in the 7th gives stability with inner turmoil; Jupiter aspecting the Sun in the 7th gives a spiritual partner.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Opposition of Jupiter and the Moon is extremely good.

aspect/jupiter/8.summary: No classical rule gives Jupiter's aspect on the 8th itself; Raman's longevity rules use Jupiter's aspect on the lagna lord, and his cases count it as a mitigating factor.
common_outcomes: long life when benefics occupy kendras and the lagna lord is with benefics or aspected by Jupiter (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII) - aspect on the lagna lord

by_area.health: Jupiter's aspect is treated as a protective factor in longevity judgement (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII).

aspect/jupiter/8.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter aspects house 8 fully from the 2nd (7th aspect), the 4th (5th aspect) and the 12th (9th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 5th and 9th aspects full for Jupiter; Brihat Jataka 2.13 calls Jupiter auspicious in them.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 2 ch. XII (Eighth House)
source_views.view: Purnayu (long life) if benefics are in kendras and the lagna lord is with benefics or aspected by Jupiter; chart notes count Jupiter's aspect on the 8th or its lord as mitigation.

aspect/jupiter/9.summary: Jupiter aspecting the 9th gives piety, pilgrimages and dutifulness to parents; his own aspect on the 9th (as a strong planet from the lagna or 5th) makes one very fortunate.
common_outcomes: Jupiter aspecting the 9th: travel to many holy places and religious centres (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII)
Jupiter's aspect on the 9th gives the fortune of bathing in the Ganges (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII)
Jupiter aspecting the 9th: pious and dutiful towards parents in the 9th lord's period (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII)
a strong planet giving full aspect to the 9th from the 3rd (scan unclear), 5th or lagna makes one extremely lucky (Saravali 32.5) - Jupiter in the lagna or 5th does this by his special aspects
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 9th aspected by the 9th lord: kingship (Saravali 32.23) - aspect on Jupiter.

by_area.finance: Good fortune (Saravali 32.5).
by_area.family: Devotion to parents and father's well-being (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).
by_area.spirituality: Piety, pilgrimage, respect for teachers (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).

strengtheners: Saravali 32.4: as 9th lord (Cancer and Leo lagnas) his aspect keeps fortune at home.
Saravali 32.26-27: a benefic aspect relieves or improves a malefic in the 9th.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 32.4: if Jupiter does not own the 9th, fortune tends to come abroad.
aspect/jupiter/9.lagna_or_context_notes: Jupiter aspects house 9 fully from the 3rd (7th aspect), the 5th (5th aspect) and the 1st (9th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 5th and 9th aspects full for Jupiter; Brihat Jataka 2.13 calls Jupiter auspicious in them.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 2 ch. XIII (Ninth House)
source_views.view: Jupiter aspecting the 9th gives travels to holy spots and religious centres, bathing in the Ganges, and piety and duty to parents during the 9th lord's period.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 32.4-5, 32.26-27
source_views.view: 9th aspected by its own lord: fortune at home; full aspect on the 9th from a strong planet in the 3rd(?), 5th or lagna: extremely lucky; benefic aspect relieves malefics in the 9th.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers p. 154
source_views.view: It is usually good if the significator of a house aspects that house, not good if it occupies it (e.g. Jupiter in the 5th is not good for children).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1950) 4.11
source_views.view: In completely warding off evil and promoting prosperity Jupiter is the most powerful planet; Mercury and Venus have smaller shares of that power (fractions illegible in the scan).

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Jupiter aspects the 5th and 9th besides the 7th; results vary with the dignities of aspecting and aspected planets, but Jupiter's aspect as a natural benefic is weighty even when he is temporarily ill-disposed.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

aspect/jupiter/9.disagreements: Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. Phaladeepika 4.9: some hold only the 7th aspect fully effective, others hold the special aspects equally effective. Raman (HPA XIII) and PVR (ch. 10) use only full aspects in practice.
aspect/jupiter/9.phrasing_guidance: Speak of faith, generosity, mentors and good fortune. Describe Jupiter's aspect as protection, growth, wisdom and blessing on that house; keep it hopeful but not a guarantee.

aspect/jupiter/10.summary: Jupiter aspecting the 10th brings distinction, authority and ethical or learned work (teaching, law, judiciary, writing, banking), and with the 9th lord forms Raja yoga.
common_outcomes: 9th-lord Jupiter aspecting the 10th brings distinction and authority in career (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)

Sun and Rahu in the 10th aspected by Jupiter: presides over political meetings without politics being the profession (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV)

rare_outcomes: 10th lord in the 9th aspected by Jupiter: a beacon to spiritual seekers (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV) - aspect on the lord.

by_area.spirituality: Ethical conduct in work (BPHS 21.2).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV: a wide Jupiter aspect can be outweighed by aspects of Mars and the Sun exact to the 10th cusp.

aspect/jupiter/12.summary: Jupiter aspecting the 12th turns expenditure towards charity, service and spiritual life, and in Raman's cases supports selfless philanthropy and married comfort.
common_outcomes: benefic Jupiter aspecting the 12th made a selfless worker whose philanthropy helped many (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart)
Jupiter and Saturn aspecting the 12th in the chart of a missionary (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart)
the 12th and its lord with and aspected by benefics: moving within one's own country (BPHS 23.12)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter's aspect gave conjugal life until the native renounced it (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).
12th lord aspected by Jupiter with the 9th lord in the 4th and the 10th lord in a kendra: a charitable disposition (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI) - aspect on the lord.
Benefic in the 12th with its lord exalted, or with or aspected by a benefic: final emancipation (BPHS 23.10).

by_area.finance: Spending on good causes (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI).
by_area.relationships: Comfort in married life (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).
by_area.spirituality: Charity, service, spiritual practice, moksha indications (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI; BPHS 23.10).

source_views.view: In completely warding off evil and promoting prosperity Jupiter is the most powerful planet; Mercury and Venus have smaller shares of that power (fractions illegible in the scan).

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Jupiter aspects the 5th and 9th besides the 7th; results vary with the dignities of aspecting and aspected planets, but Jupiter's aspect as a natural benefic is weighty even when he is temporarily ill-disposed.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

aspect/jupiter/12.disagreements: Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. Phaladeepika 4.9: some hold only the 7th aspect fully effective, others hold the special aspects equally effective. Raman (HPA XIII) and PVR (ch. 10) use only full aspects in practice.
aspect/jupiter/12.phrasing_guidance: Describe Jupiter's aspect as protection, growth, wisdom and blessing on that house; keep it hopeful but not a guarantee.

effects: the house is protected and its matters prosper when aspected by its own lord, even if malefics also influence it

aspect/ketu/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Calculator convention: Ketu aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th from itself, so it aspects house 1 from houses 9, 7 and 5. Sources differ: Vijnananda's note to Brihat Jataka 2.13 says Ketu has no aspect at all; PVR (by omission) and Braha give the nodes no graha drishti; BPHS 26 says only that all planets aspect the 7th; Raman applies 'aspected by Rahu or Ketu' in his rules. Calculator dignity default: exalted in Scorpio, debilitated in Taurus.

source_views.source: BPHS 26.2-5 (tr. Santhanam)

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 2.13, translator's note (Swami Vijnananda, 1912)
source_views.view: Rahu aspects the 5th, 7th, 9th and 12th with full sight, the 2nd and 10th with three-quarters, the 3rd, 4th, 6th and 8th with half, and the 1st and 11th not at all; Rahu's aspects are counted in the reverse direction. Ketu has no aspect at all. (A note by the translator, not Varahamihira's verse.)

aspect/ketu/1.disagreements: Whether Ketu aspects at all is disputed. Calculator: 5th, 7th, 9th. Vijnananda (note to Brihat Jataka 2.13): Ketu has no aspect. Sanjay Rath's position could not be verified.
aspect/ketu/1.phrasing_guidance: No source read gives a result for this aspect; say nothing specific beyond the node's placement.

aspect/mars/1.summary: Mars aspecting the lagna gives a martial, courageous, quick-tempered and physically robust nature, with scars or injuries, and in Saravali a combative, righteous streak.
common_outcomes: fond of bold deeds and fights, irritable, prone to broken relationships, yet very righteous (Saravali 34.1-7)
martial nature, ruddy and sturdy body (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4, chart notes)
scars on the body (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4, chart notes)
a fiery person, especially if Mars also aspects the lagna lord (Frawley p. 216)
rare_outcomes: Lagna aspected by Mars while the 6th lord is in the 10th, 7th or 1st: harm from enemies' black magic (Jataka Parijata 6.93).
Sun in the lagna aspected by Mars: colic, consumption and asthma (Jataka Parijata 6.62); Raman repeats this as asthma or lung trouble (HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).
Saravali 34.1-7 also names strong sexual vigour as a Mars-aspect trait.

Aspects on the natal Moon (the Moon treated as a second lagna, BPHS ch. 12): Phaladeepika 18.6-11 gives Mars's aspect on the Moon as kingship in Aries, Leo, Scorpio and Capricorn; poverty in Taurus; trade in iron tools in Gemini; a warrior in Cancer; cleverness in Virgo; a rogue in Libra; a cheat in Sagittarius; liaisons with others' spouses in Aquarius; sinfulness in Pisces.

by_area.personality: Brave, combative, fiery, quick to anger, principled (Saravali 34.1-7; Frawley p. 216).
by_area.health: Robust build but scars, cuts and heat-related trouble (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).
by_area.relationships: Relationships may break through anger (Saravali 34.1-7).

strengtheners: Saravali 34.8: Aries or Scorpio lagna aspected by its own lord Mars gives happiness, wealth and closeness to rulers.
Mars as yogakaraka or lagna lord (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 2; HPA ch. XIII).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.10-11: a malefic aspecting the lagna is inauspicious unless it owns it.
Mars combust in a Raman case 'aspects the lagna adversely' (HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart notes).
aspect/mars/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 1 fully from the 7th (7th aspect), the 10th (4th aspect) and the 6th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.1-7
source_views.view: If Mars aspects the ascendant one is fond of valorous acts and battles, irascible, has severed relationships, is very righteous and sexually well endowed.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.8, 34.10-11
source_views.view: A planet aspecting its own sign as lagna gives happiness, wealth, royal favour; otherwise a malefic aspect on the lagna is inauspicious.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 6.62, 6.93
source_views.view: Sun in the lagna aspected by Mars: colic, consumption and asthma; lagna aspected by Mars with the 6th lord in the 10th, 7th or 1st: suffering from enemies' magic.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 4 (First House), general rules and chart notes
source_views.view: Mars aspect on the lagna gives martial nature, ruddiness, healthy constitution, sturdy figure and scars; the Sun in the lagna aspected by Mars gives asthma or lung trouble.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers p. 216
source_views.view: Mars on the ascendant renders a person fiery, particularly if it also aspects the lagna lord.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1950) 18.6-11
source_views.view: Moon in each sign aspected by Mars (first in the list).

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Mars aspects the 4th and 8th besides the 7th; these aspects are sometimes evil and sometimes beneficial: when Mars is a yogakaraka (e.g. lord of 4 and 9) and aspects a friendly planet by his 4th aspect, the significations of that planet and house are greatly enhanced; the same holds for the 8th aspect.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

aspect/mars/1.disagreements: Saravali calls the Mars-aspected native 'very righteous' while also irascible; Raman stresses physical marks. Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. Phaladeepika 4.9: some hold only the 7th aspect fully effective, others hold the special aspects equally effective. Raman (HPA XIII) and PVR (ch. 10) use only full aspects in practice.
aspect/mars/1.phrasing_guidance: Present as courage, drive and energy; advise care with temper and with cuts, burns or accidents; do not mention black magic. Describe Mars's aspect as energy, drive, heat and conflict entering that house; say it is protective when Mars rules good houses; avoid violent or fatal wording.

effects: the house is protected and its matters prosper when aspected by its own lord, even if malefics also influence it
happiness, wealth and closeness to people in power

aspect/mars/2.summary: Mars aspecting the 2nd sharpens intellect, calculation and memory and gives a cutting tongue; with the luminaries in the 2nd or 12th and Saturn's influence it is named in eye disease.
common_outcomes: sharp, piercing intelligence with a mathematical bent and strong memory (Frawley pp. 284-285, 290-291, chart readings)
sharp, sarcastic speech (Frawley pp. 284-285)
rare_outcomes: Moon or Sun in the 2nd (and the other luminary in the 12th) conjoined with or aspected by Saturn and Mars: eye disease (Phaladeepika ch. 14).
Mars aspecting the 2nd from both the lagna and the Moon recorded in a limb-trouble case (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 9, chart notes).

by_area.personality: Quick, incisive mind; outspoken (Frawley pp. 284-291).
by_area.health: Eye strain when the luminaries in the 2nd/12th are also afflicted (Phaladeepika ch. 14).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars, Saturn and the Sun occupying the 2nd destroy wealth (Saravali 34.15-20) - occupation, not aspect; no text gives Mars's aspect on the 2nd as wealth loss.
aspect/mars/2.lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 2 fully from the 8th (7th aspect), the 11th (4th aspect) and the 7th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers pp. 284-285, 290-291 (example charts)
source_views.view: Mars aspecting the 2nd house of speech and its lord gives a sharp mind and biting sarcasm; Mars aspecting the 2nd and its lord from lagna and Moon gives a mathematical-musical mind and powerful memory.

aspect/mars/3.summary: Mars is the significator of younger siblings; joined by the 3rd lord, his aspect on the 3rd favours brothers and courage, but his aspect on Saturn or Mercury in the 3rd harms co-born or friends.
common_outcomes: the 3rd lord together with Mars aspecting the 3rd: good results for the 3rd house (BPHS 14.2)
Moon alone in the 3rd aspected by male planets (Mars is one): younger brothers (BPHS 14.12-13)
planets aspecting the 3rd increase the number of younger co-born (Saravali 34.21-24)
rare_outcomes: Saturn in the 3rd aspected by Mars destroys co-born; Mercury in the 3rd aspected by Mars harms friends (Saravali 34.21-24).
The 3rd and 11th houses influenced by Saturn and Mars: ear disease (Phaladeepika ch. 14); Raman's deafness cases have Mars aspecting the 3rd (HJH vol. 1 ch. 6).

by_area.personality: Courage and enterprise (BPHS 14.1 associates the 3rd with courage).
by_area.health: Hearing trouble with Saturn's added influence (Phaladeepika ch. 14).
by_area.family: Younger brothers and support from siblings when Mars joins the 3rd lord's aspect (BPHS 14.2, 14.12-13); harm to co-born when Mars aspects Saturn there (Saravali 34.21-24).

strengtheners: BPHS 14.2: Mars with the 3rd lord aspecting (or occupying) the 3rd.
Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 6: Mars's aspect on the 3rd is more powerful from his own sign.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars and Saturn both aspecting the 3rd are bad for it (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 6, chart notes).
aspect/mars/3.lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 3 fully from the 9th (7th aspect), the 12th (4th aspect) and the 8th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 14.2, 14.12-13
source_views.view: If the 3rd lord along with Mars aspects the 3rd, the 3rd gives good results (Santhanam: an alternative reading has them jointly aspect or occupy it); Moon alone in the 3rd aspected by male planets gives younger brothers.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.21-24
source_views.view: Aspects on the 3rd increase the number of younger co-born; Saturn in the 3rd aspected by Mars destroys co-born; Mercury there aspected by Mars destroys friends.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 6 (Third House), chart notes
source_views.view: Mars (Bhratrukaraka) aspecting the 3rd: stronger from his own sign; Mars and Saturn aspecting it is bad; Mars aspecting the 3rd with the 3rd lord afflicted appears in deafness cases.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1950) ch. 14 (diseases), slokas before 14.27 and 14.27
source_views.view: Moon and Sun in the 12th and 2nd, conjoined with or aspected by Saturn and Mars: eye disease; the 3rd, 11th and Jupiter influenced by Saturn and Mars: ear disease; Rahu aspected by Mars in the 6th or 8th: carbuncle.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Mars aspects the 4th and 8th besides the 7th; these aspects are sometimes evil and sometimes beneficial: when Mars is a yogakaraka (e.g. lord of 4 and 9) and aspects a friendly planet by his 4th aspect, the significations of that planet and house are greatly enhanced; the same holds for the 8th aspect.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. common_outcomes: energy in studies; a technical or engineering bent, especially from a watery sign (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 10, Practical Examples)

a malefic related to the 4th brings vehicle losses and accidents (BPHS 15.10-14)
rare_outcomes: Classical combination: Saturn in the 10th, Mars aspecting the 4th and the Sun aspecting the 7th: [maraka: text predicts death by assassination] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII).

strengtheners: Mars as 4th lord aspecting the 4th from his own sign (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 7 chart notes; Raman HPA ch. XIII).

aspect/mars/5.summary: Mars aspecting the 5th is a classic affliction to children (miscarriage, loss, worry) unless Mars is the lagna lord or otherwise a functional benefic; it also sharpens intellect and risk-taking.
common_outcomes: Mars's aspect on the 5th is bad as a natural malefic but good when Mars is lagna lord (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8, chart notes)
Mars aspecting the 5th from a fiery sign: repeated miscarriages in the wife (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8, chart)
Mars as 5th lord aspecting the 5th: births followed by loss of children (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8, chart)
Rahu in the 5th from the Moon aspected by Mars: miscarriages and premature births (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8, chart)
rare_outcomes: Sun in the 5th in Saturn's divisions aspected by Mars: children of base character (Saravali 34.31-32).
Mars aspecting the 5th lord and Putrakaraka spoils the 5th (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8 charts).

by_area.personality: Rash speculation tendencies when Mars influences the 5th (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8 general notes).
by_area.family: Delays, miscarriage or worry over children under Mars's aspect (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8).

strengtheners: Mars as lagna lord (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8).
Jupiter's aspect on the 5th as a redeeming feature (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 10, Practical Examples).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman: mutual aspect of Mars and Saturn involving the 5th can destroy its significations (HJH vol. 1 ch. 8, chart notes).
aspect/mars/5.lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 5 fully from the 11th (7th aspect), the 2nd (4th aspect) and the 10th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

aspect/mars/7.summary: Mars aspecting the 7th (from the lagna, 4th or 12th) brings heat, quarrels and in Raman's cases violent clashes into marriage; as 7th lord his aspect protects it.
common_outcomes: Mars's aspect on the 7th (with Ketu there) gave violent clashes in married life (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI, chart)
Mars aspecting the 7th is unwelcome when he rules malefic houses; a 9th-lord aspect can check it (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI, chart)
Mars as 7th lord aspecting the 7th protects it (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI, chart)
rare_outcomes: Saturn or Mars aspecting Venus in the 7th: adultery (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI, classical rules).

Sun in the 7th afflicted by Mars: strife-ridden marriage, with blood pressure and heart strain (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
Mars afflicting Saturn in the 7th: courts may intervene, or [maraka: text speaks of violence such as suicide or murder ending the marriage] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
7th afflicted by Mars's 8th aspect with Ketu there, in a death-timing case (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart).

by_area.relationships: Passion with friction; quarrels, separations or legal disputes in partnership under malefic Mars (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI); stable if Mars rules the 7th.

strengtheners: Mars as 7th lord (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
Aspect of the 9th lord or Jupiter checking Mars (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI, chart notes).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars ruling malefic houses (3, 6, 11) (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).
Mars with Ketu or Rahu (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI chart notes).

common_outcomes: Saturn in the 8th aspected by Mars (especially by the 4th or 8th aspect) is not conducive to mutual understanding in marriage (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI)

8th from the Moon (Scorpio) aspected by Mars from a fiery sign with Rahu: a highly malefic aspect (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart).
Retrograde planet in the 6th, 8th or a kendra in a sign of Mars and aspected by Mars: [maraka: text gives the child 3 years] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, balarishta list).
Rahu in the 8th aspected by Mars: carbuncle (Phaladeepika 14.27).

by_area.health: Accidents, surgery or sudden crises in Raman's cases (HJH vol. 2 ch. XII).
by_area.relationships: Friction with the partner when Mars aspects Saturn in the 8th (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars with Rahu or in a fiery sign makes the aspect harsher (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart notes).

aspect/mars/9.summary: Mars aspecting Jupiter in the 9th gives gold and wealth; on the 9th itself Raman's cases read Mars as a blemish to father, fortune or freedom.
common_outcomes: Jupiter in the 9th aspected by Mars: endowed with gold (Saravali 32.6-7)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 9th aspected by Mars together with: the Sun - sovereignty, gems, courage, vehicles; the Moon - army chief or minister; Mercury - learning, virtue, keeping one's word; Venus - wealth, learning, life abroad but cruelty; Saturn - a mean, spiteful life abroad among unsteady people (Saravali 32.8-22).
Mars aspecting the 9th with Saturn in the 2nd, the Sun in the 5th and Rahu in the 12th: imprisonment (Bandhana yoga) in a Raman case (HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI).
Mars adversely aspecting the 9th lord: theft of valuables (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).

by_area.finance: Gold and wealth when Mars aspects Jupiter in the 9th (Saravali 32.6-7).
by_area.family: Father's affairs blemished when the 9th is aspected by Mars and its lord and karaka are weak (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII, chart notes).

strengtheners: Saravali 32.4: the 9th aspected by its lord (Mars for Leo and Cancer lagnas) gives fortune in one's own country.
Saravali 32.27: a malefic in the 9th that owns it is auspicious, more so with benefic aspect.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 32.4: aspect by planets other than the 9th lord moves fortune abroad.
Saravali 32.23: the results for Jupiter in the 9th hold only when no other planets aspect.

aspect/mars/10.summary: Mars aspecting the 10th gives a forceful career in engineering, the armed forces, law, printing, medicine or property, and in Raman's cases authority with a combative edge.
common_outcomes: Mars aspecting the 10th or its lord: immovable property from the father (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV)
lagna and lagna lord aspected by Mars from the 10th: an armed-forces career (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)
Mars and Jupiter aspecting the 10th and its lord: a post of authority (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)
Mars aspecting the 10th in great strength (with neecha-bhanga) and Mercury as 6th lord: a forceful lawyer (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)
Mars aspecting a 10th held by Jupiter: printing alongside publishing (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)
rare_outcomes: Mars aspecting the 10th with Saturn-Mars in the 7th and the Sun aspected by Saturn: a rise from humble life to dictatorship and a violent end, in a Raman case (HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV).

by_area.career: Engineering, defence, police, law, surgery, property or industry; drive and authority (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV).
by_area.finance: Property through the father (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV).

strengtheners: Mars as 10th lord aspecting the 10th from a kendra while exalted: great authority (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart).
Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV: aspects close to the 10th cusp decide the type of work.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars with Rahu aspecting the 10th in a physician case (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV) - mixed rather than harmful.
aspect/mars/10.lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 10 fully from the 4th (7th aspect), the 7th (4th aspect) and the 3rd (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 2 ch. XIV (Tenth House), rules and chart notes
source_views.view: Mars aspecting the 10th lord gives property from the father; Mars's aspect on the 10th or lagna appears in charts of soldiers, lawyers, engineers, printers, doctors and an authoritarian ruler.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII
source_views.view: Mars aspects the 4th and 8th besides the 7th; these aspects are sometimes evil and sometimes beneficial: when Mars is a yogakaraka (e.g. lord of 4 and 9) and aspects a friendly planet by his 4th aspect, the significations of that planet and house are greatly enhanced; the same holds for the 8th aspect.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

aspect/mars/10.disagreements: Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. common_outcomes: gains through gold, coral, ornaments, ruby, money, valour, journeys, fire and weapons (Saravali 34.60)

aspect/mars/12.summary: Mars's aspect on the 12th spoils the wealth-saving effect of benefics there and appears with eye trouble and wasteful spending.
common_outcomes: Jupiter, a waxing Moon or Venus in the 12th increase wealth only if Mars does not aspect them (Saravali 34.69-70)
rare_outcomes: Sun in the 12th aspected by Mars or Saturn: defective vision (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI).
Luminaries in the 12th and 2nd aspected by Saturn and Mars: eye disease (Phaladeepika ch. 14).
12th with malefics aspected by Mars and the Moon: money wasted on pleasures and racing (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).
12th lord and lagna lord Mars aspecting the 12th with Jupiter and Saturn: life spent propagating a faith (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).

by_area.finance: Spending or losses rise; benefic savings in the 12th are undone (Saravali 34.69-70).
by_area.health: Eye strain under combined Mars-Saturn influence (Phaladeepika ch. 14; Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.69-70: Mars's aspect cancels the wealth growth that benefics in the 12th would give.
BPHS 23.11: the 12th and its lord with and aspected by malefics: wandering from country to country.
aspect/mars/12.lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 12 fully from the 6th (7th aspect), the 9th (4th aspect) and the 5th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

aspect/mercury/2.summary: Mercury's aspect on the 2nd is double-edged in Saravali: on a lone Saturn there it brings great riches, but on Jupiter or a weak Moon there it drains wealth; Raman links it with self-earned money and mathematical skill.
common_outcomes: Saturn alone in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: great wealth (Saravali 34.15-20)
Mars in the 2nd aspected by Mercury (or with the Moon): a good mathematician (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5)
Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: earning by self-effort (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: the wealth earned is lost (Saravali 34.15-20).
Weak Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: even ancestral property is lost and other income is hindered (Saravali 34.15-20).

by_area.personality: Numeracy and quick speech (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5).
by_area.finance: Mixed: wealth through effort and commerce, but the texts warn of losses depending on which planet occupies the 2nd (Saravali 34.15-20; Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5).

strengtheners: Benefics in the 2nd bring money in many ways (Saravali 34.15-20).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.15-20: Mercury's aspect on Jupiter or a weak Moon in the 2nd.
aspect/mercury/2.lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects house 2 from the 8th house.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.15-20
source_views.view: Saturn alone in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: great riches; Jupiter in the 2nd aspected by Mercury, or Mercury in the 2nd aspected by the Moon: earned wealth lost; weak Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: even ancestral property destroyed.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 5 (Second House)
source_views.view: Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury favours earning by self-exertion; Mars in the 2nd with the Moon or aspected by Mercury makes a good mathematician.

common_outcomes: 3rd strong and occupied or aspected by Mercury and Jupiter: an exceedingly fine voice (Jataka Parijata 12.46)
planets aspecting the 3rd increase the number of younger co-born (Saravali 34.21-24)
benefic aspect on the 3rd gives co-born and courage (BPHS 14.1)

strengtheners: Jupiter's aspect together with Mercury's (Jataka Parijata 12.46).

4th occupied by its lord or the lagna lord and aspected by a benefic: full residential comfort (BPHS 15.2)

weakeners_or_cancellations: Frawley pp. 236-237: under malefic influence Mercury is not a benefic.
aspect/mercury/4.lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects house 4 from the 10th house.

aspect/mercury/5.summary: A strong Mercury aspecting the 5th (with Jupiter and Venus) gives many children; alone, in a Saturn-ruled 5th, Saravali gives unusual ways of obtaining children.
common_outcomes: 5th lord strong and the 5th aspected by strong Mercury, Jupiter and Venus: many children (BPHS 16.12)
benefic aspect on the 5th gives children and doubles their count (Saravali 34.25-27)
rare_outcomes: 5th in Saturn's divisions with Mercury's aspect and no aspect of Jupiter, Mars or the Sun: a child raised through a kinsman by the old niyoga custom (Saravali 34.28; the scan reads '3rd' but the verse is about progeny).
Mercury in its own 5th aspected by the Moon: a child by adoption (Saravali 34.29 - this is the Moon's aspect, recorded here for completeness).

by_area.family: Children, especially with Jupiter and Venus also aspecting (BPHS 16.12).

strengtheners: Strength of Mercury and of the 5th lord (BPHS 16.12).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury's aspect alone on a Saturn-ruled 5th (Saravali 34.28).
aspect/mercury/5.lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects house 5 from the 11th house.

source_views.view: Many children if the 5th lord is strong and the 5th is aspected by strong Mercury, Jupiter and Venus.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.25-28
source_views.view: Benefic aspect on the 5th gives and multiplies children; Mercury's lone aspect on a 5th in Saturn's divisions gives progeny through a kinsman.

common_outcomes: benefic aspect on the 6th keeps one free from fear of enemies (Saravali 34.43-44)
rare_outcomes: Lagna lord in a sign of Mars or Mercury and aspected by Mercury: diseases of the face (BPHS 17.6; Santhanam notes the exceptions for Aries and Scorpio lagnas).

by_area.career: Overcoming rivals (Saravali 34.43-44).
by_area.health: Facial ailments when Mercury aspects the lagna lord in a Mars or Mercury sign (BPHS 17.6).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Frawley pp. 236-237: under malefic influence Mercury is not a benefic.
aspect/mercury/6.lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects house 6 from the 12th house.

aspect/mercury/9.summary: Mercury aspecting Jupiter in the 9th makes one affluent; when Mercury owns the 9th its aspect keeps fortune at home.
common_outcomes: Jupiter in the 9th aspected by Mercury: affluent (Saravali 32.6-7)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 9th aspected by Mercury together with: the Sun - grace, a fine spouse, poetry and arts; the Moon - fine houses and comforts; Mars - learning, virtue, keeps his word; Venus - an artisan, virtuous and fortunate; Saturn - fortunate, learned, eloquent and modest (Saravali 32.8-22).
Jupiter or Mercury aspecting the 9th lord in the 11th: gains through newspapers, books or educational institutions (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).

by_area.career: Publishing, education when Mercury aspects the 9th lord in the 11th (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).
by_area.finance: Affluence (Saravali 32.6-7).

strengtheners: Saravali 32.4: the 9th aspected by its lord (Mercury for Taurus or Aquarius lagna) gives fortune at home.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 32.4: aspect by others moves fortune abroad; 32.23: listed results hold only without other aspects.
aspect/mercury/9.lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects house 9 from the 3rd house.

common_outcomes: 10th aspected by Mercury and Jupiter: journalism (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)

by_area.career: Commerce, accounts, writing, journalism, law (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV).

aspect/moon/1.summary: The Moon's full aspect on the lagna (Moon in the 7th) gives a gentle, courteous and fortunate nature, wealth, gains from water-related trade and a strong influence of women in one's life.
common_outcomes: courteous and soft-natured (Saravali 34.1-7)
fortunate and wealthy (Saravali 34.1-7)
gains through water-born goods (Saravali 34.1-7)
under the influence of women (Saravali 34.1-7)
better proportion and delicacy of body (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4, chart notes)
rare_outcomes: Lagna in a decanate of Mercury aspected by the Moon from an angle: even one of royal birth turns to craft work (Saravali 34.71).

The Moon cannot aspect itself; on aspects of the Moon on the Sun Saravali ch. 22 gives sign-wise results, e.g. Sun in Cancer aspected by the Moon: a king or equal to a king (22.28-33); Sun in Leo aspected by the Moon: a scholar (22.36-41).

by_area.personality: Soft, courteous, sensitive (Saravali 34.1-7).
by_area.finance: Wealthy; trade in water-born or liquid goods (Saravali 34.1-7).
by_area.health: Better bodily proportion (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).
by_area.relationships: Women strongly shape the native's choices (Saravali 34.1-7).

strengtheners: Waxing Moon increases the good (Trailokya Prakasa via Santhanam).
Saravali 34.8: Cancer lagna aspected by its own lord gives happiness, wealth and closeness to rulers.
Two or more planets aspecting the lagna give happiness and wealth (Saravali 34.10-11).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon reduces the effects (Trailokya Prakasa via Santhanam).
aspect/moon/1.lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon casts only the 7th aspect in full, from the 7th house onto the lagna. For Cancer lagna it is the lagna lord's own aspect.

aspect/moon/2.summary: In Saravali the Moon's aspect on the 2nd is a caution for wealth: a weak Moon aspecting a 2nd already holding malefics deepens loss, and the Moon's aspect on Mercury in the 2nd costs earned wealth; Raman reads the Moon's link with Mercury in the 2nd more kindly.
common_outcomes: a weak (waning) Moon aspecting the 2nd intensifies the loss shown by Mars, Saturn and the Sun there (Saravali 34.15-20)
Mercury in the 2nd aspected by the Moon: the wealth earned is lost (Saravali 34.15-20)
rare_outcomes: Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5: one loses wealth if Mercury aspected by the Moon joins the Jupiter-in-2nd combination; but the Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury favours earning by one's own effort.

by_area.finance: Earned wealth can slip away when the Moon aspects Mercury in the 2nd, and a weak Moon worsens malefic damage to the 2nd (Saravali 34.15-20).

strengtheners: A waxing Moon is not named as harmful here; the rules stress the weak Moon (Saravali 34.15-20).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Weak Moon aspecting the 2nd (Saravali 34.15-20).
aspect/moon/2.lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon aspects the 2nd from the 8th house.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.15-20
source_views.view: Mars, Saturn and the Sun in the 2nd destroy wealth, more so if a weak Moon aspects the 2nd; Mercury in the 2nd aspected by the Moon deprives the native of earned wealth.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 5 (Second House)
source_views.view: Loses wealth if Mercury aspected by the Moon contacts the Jupiter-in-2nd combination; the Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury favours earning by self-exertion.

source_views.view: A house occupied or aspected by the Moon gains good effects if the Moon is waxing; otherwise its effects diminish.

effects: the house is protected and its matters prosper when aspected by its own lord, even if malefics also influence it

aspect/moon/3.summary: The Moon's aspect on the 3rd adds to the count of younger co-born; when the Moon owns the 3rd its aspect is good for the house.
common_outcomes: planets aspecting the 3rd increase the number of younger co-born (Saravali 34.21-24)
the 3rd lord Moon aspecting the 3rd is good (Raman HJH vol. 2, chart notes)

by_area.family: More younger siblings indicated (Saravali 34.21-24).

strengtheners: Benefic aspect on the 3rd gives co-born and courage (BPHS 14.1).
aspect/moon/3.lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon aspects the 3rd from the 9th house.

aspect/moon/4.summary: The Moon is the significator of the mother and the 4th; its aspect on the 4th, as a benefic aspect, supports home comforts and vehicles.
common_outcomes: benefic aspect on the 4th gives happiness with vehicles and freedom from accidents (BPHS 15.10-14)
4th occupied by its lord or the lagna lord and aspected by a benefic: full residential comfort (BPHS 15.2)

by_area.finance: Comfort with vehicles and property (BPHS 15.10-14).
by_area.family: Supports mother and home (BPHS 15.2; Raman names the Moon Matrukaraka, HJH vol. 1 ch. 7).

strengtheners: Frawley p. 154: a house significator aspecting its house is good (as opposed to occupying it).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon reduces the effects (Trailokya Prakasa via Santhanam).
aspect/moon/4.lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon aspects the 4th from the 10th house.

aspect/moon/5.summary: The Moon's aspect on the 5th is a benefic influence for children and, in Raman and Saravali, leans towards daughters; with Saturn or Mercury in their own 5th it points to adoption.
common_outcomes: the Moon's aspect on the 5th favours more female children (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8, chart notes)
a benefic aspect on the 5th gives children and doubles their count (Saravali 34.25-27)
5th with only Moon/Venus divisions and aspects of the Moon and Venus alone: daughters only (Saravali 34.39)
rare_outcomes: Saturn in his own 5th aspected by the Moon, or Mercury in his own 5th aspected by the Moon: a child by adoption or purchase (Saravali 34.29).

by_area.family: Children, often daughters (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 8; Saravali 34.39).

strengtheners: Benefic aspect on the 5th (Saravali 34.25-27).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Waning Moon reduces the effects (Trailokya Prakasa via Santhanam).

aspect/moon/6.summary: The Moon's aspect on the 6th has no direct classical result; it appears in infant-health combinations and in Raman's disease case notes.

by_area.relationships: Gentle, caring or changeable partner after the Moon's nature; more than one relationship indicated in Saravali's counting (34.45-48).

strengtheners: Raman HPA ch. XIII: the Jupiter-Moon opposition is extremely good.

aspect/moon/9.summary: The Moon's aspect on Jupiter in the 9th gives splendour and enjoyment; when the Moon owns the 9th its aspect keeps fortune in the home country.
common_outcomes: Jupiter in the 9th aspected by the Moon: splendour and pleasures (Saravali 32.6-7)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 9th aspected by the Moon together with: Mars - army chief or minister; Mercury - fine houses, comforts, patience and intelligence; Venus - great wealth but no sons and attachment to others' spouses; Saturn - lasting livelihood abroad but argumentative and untruthful; the Sun - plenty, devotion to parents, fame (Saravali 32.8-16). Valid only when no other planet aspects (32.23).

by_area.finance: Comfort and enjoyment when the Moon aspects Jupiter in the 9th (Saravali 32.6-7).

strengtheners: Saravali 32.4: the 9th aspected by its own lord (the Moon for Scorpio lagna) gives fortune in one's own country.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 32.4: aspect by a planet other than the 9th lord shifts fortune abroad.
aspect/moon/9.lagna_or_context_notes: The Moon aspects the 9th from the 3rd house.

aspect/rahu/1.summary: Few sourced results: Raman uses Rahu's aspect on planets in the lagna (with the 6th lord or Gulika) as a source of trouble, and PVR reads Rahu's aspect on a mundane lagna as turbulence.
rare_outcomes: Raman (HJH vol. 1, pp. 249-250): Jupiter or Venus in the lagna with the 6th lord, aspected by Saturn, Rahu or Mars, brings trouble from relatives
Raman (HJH vol. 1, pp. 266-267): Gulika in the lagna aspected by Rahu points to poison in the body through swelling, or the evil eye
PVR Narasimha Rao (ch. on mundane charts, chart 81): Rahu's aspect on the lagna of a nation's new-year chart can disturb general well-being in Rahu dasha

by_area.health: Raman links Rahu's aspect on Gulika in the lagna with toxins and swelling; report with care
by_area.family: trouble from relatives when Rahu aspects benefics joined with the 6th lord in the lagna (Raman)

aspect/rahu/1.lagna_or_context_notes: Calculator convention: Rahu aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th from itself, so it aspects house 1 from houses 9, 7 and 5. Sources differ: Vijnananda's note to Brihat Jataka 2.13 gives full aspects on the 5th, 7th, 9th and 12th counted backward (so from houses 5, 7, 9 - the same set - and also from house 12), three-quarter from houses 2 and 10, half from houses 3, 4, 6, 8; BPHS 26 says only that all planets aspect the 7th; PVR (by omission) and Braha give Rahu no graha drishti. Raman notes Rahu generally behaves like Saturn (HJH vol. 1, p. 43). Calculator dignity default: exalted in Taurus, debilitated in Scorpio.

effects: toxins in the body through swelling, or the evil eye

aspect/rahu/1.disagreements: Which aspects Rahu has is disputed. Calculator: 5th, 7th, 9th. Vijnananda (note to Brihat Jataka 2.13): full 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th counted in reverse, plus partial aspects on the 2nd, 10th, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th, none on the 1st and 11th; counted backward the 5th and 9th fall on the same houses as forward, but the reverse 12th lands on the house just ahead of Rahu. BPHS 26.2-5: only 'all planets aspect the 7th', nodes not named. PVR Narasimha Rao: no graha drishti for the nodes (only rasi drishti). Braha: the nodes cast no aspects; few astrologers accept the texts that give them. Raman uses nodal aspects in his rules without specifying houses. Sanjay Rath's position on nodal graha drishti could not be verified (the Crux text read applies Rahu's rasi drishti).

aspect/rahu/3.disagreements: Which aspects Rahu has is disputed. Calculator: 5th, 7th, 9th. Vijnananda (note to Brihat Jataka 2.13): full 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th counted in reverse, plus partial aspects on the 2nd, 10th, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th, none on the 1st and 11th; counted backward the 5th and 9th fall on the same houses as forward, but the reverse 12th lands on the house just ahead of Rahu. BPHS 26.2-5: only 'all planets aspect the 7th', nodes not named. PVR Narasimha Rao: no graha drishti for the nodes (only rasi drishti). Braha: the nodes cast no aspects; few astrologers accept the texts that give them. Raman uses nodal aspects in his rules without specifying houses. Sanjay Rath's position on nodal graha drishti could not be verified (the Crux text read applies Rahu's rasi drishti).
aspect/rahu/3.phrasing_guidance: Do not mention the death verse to users; say nothing specific.

aspect/rahu/12.disagreements: Which aspects Rahu has is disputed. Calculator: 5th, 7th, 9th. Vijnananda (note to Brihat Jataka 2.13): full 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th counted in reverse, plus partial aspects on the 2nd, 10th, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th, none on the 1st and 11th; counted backward the 5th and 9th fall on the same houses as forward, but the reverse 12th lands on the house just ahead of Rahu. BPHS 26.2-5: only 'all planets aspect the 7th', nodes not named. PVR Narasimha Rao: no graha drishti for the nodes (only rasi drishti). Braha: the nodes cast no aspects; few astrologers accept the texts that give them. Raman uses nodal aspects in his rules without specifying houses. Sanjay Rath's position on nodal graha drishti could not be verified (the Crux text read applies Rahu's rasi drishti).

Saravali 34.47: each aspecting planet adds to the count of spouses

aspect/saturn/7.lagna_or_context_notes: Saturn aspects house 7 fully from house 1 (7th aspect), house 5 (special 3rd aspect) and house 10 (special 10th aspect) (BPHS 26.2-5; Brihat Jataka 2.13; Phaladeepika 2.23; Saravali 4.32-33). Classical partial aspects: one-half from houses 3 and 11, three-quarters from houses 4 and 12. Jataka Parijata 2.31 calls Saturn exceedingly powerful through its 3rd/10th ('quarter') aspect; JP 2.32 says Saturn's look inclines downward. As a natural malefic its aspect is classed as harmful (Phaladeepika 15.2; Braha: harm plus an ascetic, restrictive quality), but when Saturn owns the house, or is yogakaraka, sources read it as protective or strengthening (Phaladeepika 15.1; Saravali 34.8; Raman).

aspect/sun/1.summary: The Sun's full 7th aspect on the lagna (Sun in the 7th) gives courage, a commanding and sometimes harsh temper, and links fortune to the father's side and to service of authority.
common_outcomes: valorous and bold (Saravali 34.1-7)
irritable or severe with women (Saravali 34.1-7)
gains wealth from the father's side; may inherit from the father (Saravali 34.1-7; Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII)
service of a ruler or government (Saravali 34.1-7)
rare_outcomes: Aspects on the natal Moon (the Moon treated as a second lagna, BPHS ch. 12): Phaladeepika 18.6-11 gives the Sun's aspect on the Moon as poverty in Aries, Gemini and Capricorn, service in Taurus, eye trouble in Cancer, kingly status in Leo and Virgo, wickedness in Libra, lack of money in Scorpio, arrogance in Sagittarius, respect in Aquarius and sinfulness in Pisces; 18.12-15 give separate results by the Moon's navamsa. Brihat Jataka 19.1-3 gives a parallel list (e.g. Moon in Aries aspected by the Sun: poor).
Mars in the lagna aspected by the Sun (or Saturn) brings wounds and accidents (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).

by_area.career: Service under rulers or government (Saravali 34.1-7).
by_area.finance: Wealth through the father's line (Saravali 34.1-7; Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).

by_area.family: Father-linked inheritance (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.10-11: a malefic aspecting the lagna is inauspicious unless it owns the sign.
Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

aspect/sun/1.disagreements: Saravali calls the Sun's aspect 'cruel' in tone while Raman stresses the paternal inheritance; both appear in Saravali 34.1-7. Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. Phaladeepika 4.9: some hold only the 7th aspect fully effective, others hold the special aspects equally effective. Raman (HPA XIII) and PVR (ch. 10) use only full aspects in practice.
aspect/sun/1.phrasing_guidance: Present as strength, self-assertion and a father-linked inheritance; mention a sharp temper as something to manage. Describe the Sun's aspect as bringing authority, pride or pressure to the house; avoid saying it 'destroys' anything, and weigh its functional role.

effects: the house is protected and its matters prosper when aspected by its own lord, even if malefics also influence it
happiness, wealth and closeness to people in power (planet aspecting its own sign as lagna)

aspect/sun/2.lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun aspects the 2nd from the 8th house.

aspect/sun/3.summary: The Sun's aspect on the 3rd adds a 'male' planetary influence on siblings: with the Moon alone in the 3rd it indicates younger brothers, and any aspect on the 3rd raises the count of co-born.
common_outcomes: Moon alone in the 3rd aspected by male planets (the Sun is one) indicates younger brothers (BPHS 14.12-13)
planets aspecting the 3rd increase the number of younger co-born counted from its navamsas (Saravali 34.21-24)
rare_outcomes: Mercury in the 3rd aspected by the Sun (a variant reading for Mars in Saravali 34.21-24) harms the native's friends.

by_area.family: Younger brothers indicated when the Moon in the 3rd is aspected by male planets (BPHS 14.12-13); more co-born when the 3rd is aspected (Saravali 34.21-24).

weakeners_or_cancellations: A malefic owning and occupying the 3rd harms co-born (Saravali 34.21-24); the Sun's aspect is malefic by nature.
Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.
aspect/sun/3.lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun aspects the 3rd from the 9th house.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 14.12-13
source_views.view: If the Moon is alone in the 3rd and aspected by male planets there will be younger brothers; Venus's aspect shows younger sisters.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.21-24
source_views.view: The navamsas passed in the 3rd give the number of younger co-born, increased when other planets aspect the 3rd; Mercury in the 3rd aspected by Mars (some texts: by the Sun) destroys friends.

aspect/sun/4.summary: The Sun's aspect on the 4th is a malefic influence on home and vehicles in the general rule; no source gives a Sun-specific result.

by_area.family: A malefic related to the 4th brings vehicle losses and accidents in the general rule (BPHS 15.10-14, Santhanam).

weakeners_or_cancellations: BPHS 15.10-14: a malefic related to the 4th or its lord harms vehicles and brings accidents.
Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.
aspect/sun/4.lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun aspects the 4th from the 10th house.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 15.10-14
source_views.view: A benefic related to the 4th house and its lord gives happiness with conveyances and freedom from accidents; a malefic causes losses through vehicles and accidents.

aspect/sun/5.summary: The Sun's aspect on the 5th mainly appears in special progeny combinations in Saravali (adoption, unusual circumstances of a child's birth); as a malefic aspect it makes progeny harder.
common_outcomes: a malefic aspect on the 5th gives progeny with difficulty (Saravali 34.27)
rare_outcomes: Mars in the 5th in Saturn's divisions aspected by the Sun: a son adopted after being given up by his parents (Saravali 34.33, after sage Karuna).
Moon in the 5th aspected by or with the Sun: a child through an unmarried girl (Saravali 34.35).
Moon and Saturn in the 5th in Saturn's vargas aspected by the Sun and Venus: a child by a remarried widow (Saravali 34.34).

by_area.family: Progeny with difficulty under malefic aspect (Saravali 34.27).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.27: malefic aspect on the 5th makes progeny difficult.
Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.
aspect/sun/5.lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun aspects the 5th from the 11th house.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.27, 34.33-35
source_views.view: Malefic aspect on the 5th gives children with difficulty; several rules use the Sun's aspect on planets in the 5th for adoption and unusual births.

aspect/sun/7.summary: The Sun's aspect on the 7th counts as one more planet bearing on marriage; Saravali links solar influence on the 7th with a spouse from a different social background, and Raman's chart notes treat it by the Sun's functional role.
common_outcomes: each planet aspecting the 7th adds to the count of marriages in Saravali's method (34.47)
the Sun related to the 7th: a spouse from a lower social order (Saravali 34.49)
rare_outcomes: Classical combination: Saturn in the 10th, Mars aspecting the 4th and the Sun aspecting the 7th: [maraka: text predicts death by assassination] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII).

by_area.relationships: Adds to the number of marriage indications (Saravali 34.47); spouse of different social standing (Saravali 34.49). Raman treats a well-placed 10th-lord Sun aspecting the 7th as supportive (HJH vol. 2 ch. XI chart notes).
